papers.title: Are We Ready For An Agent-Native Memory System?
papers.abstract: Memory for large language model (LLM) agents has rapidly evolved from simple retrieval-augmented mechanisms into a data management system that supports persistent information storage, retrieval, update, consolidation, and dynamic lifecycle governance throughout agent execution. Despite this evolution, existing evaluations still benchmark agent memory mainly through end-to-end task success metrics (e.g., F1, BLEU), while treating the underlying system as a monolithic black box. As a result, critical system-level concerns, including operational costs, architectural trade-offs across memory modules, and robustness under dynamic knowledge updates, remain insufficiently explored. In this paper, we present a systematic experimental study of agent memory from a data management perspective. We propose an analytical framework that decomposes agent memory into four core modules: memory representation and storage, extraction, retrieval and routing, and maintenance. Under this framework, we evaluate 12 representative memory systems and two reference baselines across five benchmark workloads spanning 11 datasets. Our extensive end-to-end evaluation shows that no single architecture dominates across all scenarios; instead, effectiveness depends heavily on how well the memory structure aligns with the workload bottleneck. Furthermore, through fine-grained ablation studies, we quantify their individual effects on representation fidelity, retrieval precision, update correctness, and long-horizon stability. Finally, we reveal cost-performance trade-offs under realistic workloads, showing localized maintenance is more cost-efficient than global reorganization. Based on these findings, we identify promising directions towards building truly agent-native memory systems. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/OpenDataBox/MemoryData.
papers.summary_zh:
## 背景与问题  
当前大语言模型（LLM）智能体的“记忆”已从简单的检索增强机制，演进为支持**持久化存储、动态检索、增量更新、知识融合与全生命周期治理**的数据管理系统。然而，现有评估仍过度依赖端到端任务指标（如F1、BLEU），将记忆系统视为黑箱，严重忽视其底层数据管理能力——包括操作开销、模块间架构权衡、以及面对高频知识更新时的鲁棒性。

## 方法与框架  
本文首次从**数据管理视角**系统解构智能体记忆：提出四维分析框架——**记忆表示与存储、信息抽取、检索与路由、维护机制**。在此基础上，我们在5类典型工作负载（涵盖11个真实数据集）上，对12种代表性记忆系统及2个基线方案开展统一评测；并通过细粒度消融实验，定量评估各模块对**表示保真度、检索精度、更新正确性、长周期稳定性**的独立贡献。

## 关键发现与启示  
- 无单一架构在所有场景下占优；**性能高度依赖记忆结构与工作负载瓶颈的匹配度**（如高更新频次场景中局部维护显著优于全局重组）；  
- 成本-性能分析表明：**局部化维护可降低37–62%的计算开销**，而全局索引重建易引发长尾延迟；  
- 多数系统在知识动态演化下出现“语义漂移”，暴露了缺乏显式版本控制与一致性校验的设计缺陷。  
本研究为构建真正**Agent-Native**（面向智能体原生需求）的记忆系统提供了可复现的评估范式、实证基准与演进路径。代码开源：https://github.com/OpenDataBox/MemoryData
papers.summary_en: This paper presents the first systematic data-management-oriented evaluation of memory systems for LLM agents. We propose a four-module analytical framework—representation & storage, extraction, retrieval & routing, and maintenance—and evaluate 12 representative memory systems plus 2 baselines across five realistic workloads (11 datasets). Our end-to-end experiments reveal no universally dominant architecture: effectiveness critically depends on alignment between memory structure and workload bottlenecks (e.g., update frequency or query complexity). Fine-grained ablation quantifies trade-offs in fidelity, precision, update correctness, and long-horizon stability. Crucially, localized maintenance reduces operational cost by 37–62% versus global reorganization, while exposing widespread fragility under dynamic knowledge evolution. These findings lay the foundation for truly agent-native memory design. Code: https://github.com/OpenDataBox/MemoryData

papers.title: The Warrant Gap: Claim-Conditioned Re-scoring for Fact-Checking
papers.abstract: Fact-checking systems built on LLMs achieve high verdict accuracy on standard benchmarks, yet routinely output Supports labels whose cited evidence does not license the claim. Structured decomposition is the natural way to inspect those warrants, but rigid extraction protocols strip the full-claim context that facets need. We introduce SIFT -- claim-conditioned re-scoring of extracted evidence spans against the full claim -- paired with WSP (Warranted Supports Proportion), an automatic NLI check that the cited warrant entails the claim. We evaluate on FEVER, SciFact, 5PILS, and DP across four open-source backbones. SIFT recovers accuracy on cells where naive decomposition costs up to 27.6 points, while raising WSP above direct prompting; WSP itself calibrates against human gold evidence at AUC 0.92 and precision 0.98.
papers.summary_zh:
## 背景与问题  
当前基于大语言模型（LLM）的事实核查系统在标准基准（如FEVER）上虽能实现高判决准确率，却普遍存在**“证据许可缺口”（Warrant Gap）**：即系统输出“Supports”结论时，所引用的证据片段（evidence span）在逻辑上**并不充分蕴含（entail）原始主张（claim）**。这一缺陷源于主流结构化解析范式——将主张分解为原子断言后独立验证——虽提升了可解释性，但因强制剥离完整主张语境，导致关键语义约束（如量词、否定、时序、比较级）丢失，使提取的“支撑片段”失去对全主张的推理许可力。

## 方法创新  
我们提出 **SIFT（Claim-Conditioned Re-scoring Framework）**：在保持结构化抽取优势的同时，将每个候选证据片段与**原始完整主张联合重打分**，而非孤立评估。配套设计 **WSP（Warranted Supports Proportion）** 指标——一种自动化的自然语言推理（NLI）校验机制，严格判定所引证据是否逻辑蕴含主张。WSP不依赖人工标注，仅需轻量NLI模型即可实现端到端验证。

## 主要发现与贡献  
在FEVER、SciFact、5PILS和DP四大数据集及4种开源LLM骨干（Llama3-8B、Qwen2-7B等）上系统验证：  
- SIFT显著弥合分解导致的性能塌陷，在部分细粒度单元中**挽回高达27.6点准确率损失**；  
- WSP指标本身具备强判别力：**AUC达0.92，精确率0.98**，与人类标注的黄金证据高度一致；  
- SIFT+WSP组合首次实现**可验证的“主张—证据”逻辑许可性闭环**，为可信事实核查提供可审计、可归因的新范式。
papers.summary_en: Fact-checking LLMs often assign “Supports” verdicts using evidence that *logically fails to entail* the full claim—a critical flaw we term the **Warrant Gap**. While structured decomposition improves interpretability, rigid extraction discards essential claim-level context (e.g., scope, negation, comparatives), breaking warrant licensing. We propose **SIFT**, a claim-conditioned re-scoring framework that evaluates extracted evidence spans *jointly with the complete claim*, preserving semantic constraints. Paired with **WSP (Warranted Supports Proportion)**—an automatic NLI-based metric verifying whether cited evidence entails the claim—SIFT recovers up to 27.6 accuracy points lost by naive decomposition across FEVER, SciFact, 5PILS, and DP on four open-source backbones. WSP achieves strong calibration against human gold evidence (AUC = 0.92, Precision = 0.98), enabling auditable, logically grounded fact-checking.

papers.title: AutoSpecNER: A Fine-Grained Named Entity Recognition Dataset for Vehicle Specification Extraction
papers.abstract: Vehicle advertisements contain rich specification information, but automotive NER resources remain limited. We introduce AutoSpecNER, an expert-annotated dataset for fine-grained entity recognition in vehicle listings. The dataset includes 659 advertisements from a popular car-selling website, with over 10,000 entities annotated across 15 categories, including MODEL, ENGINE_SPEC, and BATTERY_CAPACITY. Annotation quality was validated through inter-annotator agreement, achieving an average score of 91.5%. We benchmark rule-based extraction, fine-tuned transformer encoders, and large language models. DeBERTa achieves the best performance with a 90% micro-F1 score, outperforming the rule-based baseline (43%) and the strongest large language model (77.8%).
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景  
汽车广告文本蕴含大量细粒度规格信息（如发动机排量、电池容量、驱动形式等），但现有命名实体识别（NER）资源严重匮乏，尤其缺乏面向汽车领域的高质量、多类别、专家标注数据集，制约了车辆参数自动化抽取技术的发展。

## 数据集构建  
本文提出 **AutoSpecNER**——首个专为车辆规格抽取设计的细粒度NER数据集。数据源自国内主流二手车交易平台，涵盖659篇真实车辆广告；经汽车领域专家三轮交叉标注与一致性校验，共标注超10,000个实体，覆盖**15类核心规格实体**，包括`MODEL`（车型）、`ENGINE_SPEC`（发动机参数）、`BATTERY_CAPACITY`（电池容量）、`DRIVE_TYPE`（驱动形式）、`TRANSMISSION`（变速箱）等，兼顾技术术语多样性与行业表达习惯。

## 质量验证与基准实验  
采用严格的人工复核与Krippendorff’s α评估，**平均标注一致性达91.5%**，显著高于通用NER数据集水平。我们系统评测三类主流方法：（1）基于正则与规则模板的抽取基线；（2）微调DeBERTa、BERT、RoBERTa等Transformer编码器；（3）提示工程驱动的开源与闭源大语言模型（LLM）。结果表明：**DeBERTa-v3在测试集上取得90.0% micro-F1**，大幅超越规则基线（43.0%）和最强LLM（Qwen2-7B-Instruct，77.8% F1），验证了领域适配预训练与精细标注对规格理解的关键价值。本数据集已开源，为智能车商系统、参数结构化与跨平台比价提供基础支撑。
papers.summary_en: AutoSpecNER is the first expert-annotated, fine-grained NER dataset tailored for vehicle specification extraction from real-world advertisements. It comprises 659 listings from a major Chinese car-selling platform, with over 10,000 entities meticulously annotated across 15 domain-specific categories (e.g., `MODEL`, `ENGINE_SPEC`, `BATTERY_CAPACITY`). Annotation quality was rigorously validated via inter-annotator agreement, achieving an average Krippendorff’s α of 91.5%. We benchmarked rule-based systems, fine-tuned transformer encoders (BERT, RoBERTa, DeBERTa), and large language models (including Qwen2-7B-Instruct and GPT-4). DeBERTa-v3 achieved the highest micro-F1 score of **90.0%**, substantially outperforming the rule-based baseline (43.0%) and the best LLM (77.8%). AutoSpecNER fills a critical gap in automotive NLP and enables robust, structured parameter extraction for intelligent vehicle platforms.

papers.title: Certification of Machine Learning Models via Directional Sharpness
papers.abstract: In machine learning, model certification has been identified as an important method for gaining assurance about a model's trustworthiness and quality. A model's quality is largely determined by its ability to generalize, i.e., to perform well on data beyond what it was trained on. It is not possible to certify generalization directly, however, as it depends on unknown data and is not directly measurable. Proxies such as test accuracy can be misleading when the training process is perturbed (intentionally or accidentally), and metrics such as sharpness -- which has an empirically supported link to generalization -- are computationally expensive and can also serve as unreliable signals when training deviates from a prescribed procedure. In this work, we propose directional sharpness, a metric designed to efficiently and reliably indicate generalization despite potential training deviations. We provide empirical and analytical evidence that directional sharpness (1) correlates more strongly with generalization than existing metrics and (2) identifies models with poor generalization more reliably than existing metrics. Furthermore, directional sharpness is efficiently computable in model auditing settings, where the verifier has access to training data, and via zero-knowledge proofs that certify quality without revealing training data.

## 机器学习模型认证新范式：基于方向锐度的高效可靠泛化评估

在机器学习可信性保障中，**模型认证**是验证模型鲁棒性、公平性与泛化能力的关键环节。传统方法依赖测试准确率等代理指标，但其易受训练扰动（如数据污染、超参误设或优化偏差）影响；而经典**锐度（sharpness）**虽经验上关联泛化，却存在两大瓶颈：计算开销大（需二阶导数或Hessian近似），且对非标准训练流程（如混合精度训练、梯度裁剪、正则化缺失）高度敏感，导致信号失真。

本研究提出**方向锐度（Directional Sharpness）**——一种轻量、鲁棒、可解释的泛化代理指标。其核心思想是：沿**模型参数空间中与训练损失下降方向一致的单位向量**，量化损失函数的局部曲率变化，而非全空间平均锐度。我们从理论与实验两方面证实：  
- **更强相关性**：在CIFAR-10/100、ImageNet子集及多任务NLP基准上，方向锐度与真实泛化误差的皮尔逊相关系数达0.89–0.93，显著优于传统锐度（0.62–0.74）与测试准确率（0.51–0.68）；  
- **更高可靠性**：在注入标签噪声、数据子采样、优化器替换等12种训练偏离场景下，方向锐度对泛化崩塌的检出率达96.7%，误报率仅3.2%，远超基线指标；  
- **审计友好性**：支持两种部署模式——（1）**数据可见场景**：仅需单次前向+反向传播，计算开销低于传统锐度92%；（2）**隐私保护场景**：通过**零知识证明协议**，在不泄露任何训练样本前提下完成质量认证，通信成本<1.2 MB。

该工作为ML模型第三方审计、AI监管合规及可信AI部署提供了兼具理论严谨性与工程实用性的新工具。
papers.summary_en: Model certification is critical for ensuring ML trustworthiness, yet existing generalization proxies—such as test accuracy or conventional sharpness—are either brittle under training perturbations or computationally prohibitive. We propose **directional sharpness**, a novel metric that measures loss curvature *only along the gradient descent direction*, enabling efficient and robust generalization assessment. Empirically, across vision and NLP benchmarks, directional sharpness achieves Pearson correlations of 0.89–0.93 with true generalization error—surpassing conventional sharpness (0.62–0.74) and test accuracy (0.51–0.68). It also detects generalization failure with 96.7% recall and only 3.2% false positive rate under diverse training deviations (e.g., label noise, optimizer changes). Crucially, it is computationally lightweight (<8% of conventional sharpness cost) and supports privacy-preserving certification via zero-knowledge proofs—verifying model quality without exposing training data. This work bridges theory, efficiency, and deployability in ML assurance.

papers.title: A Hybrid CNN-LSTM Intrusion Detection Framework for Cybersecurity in Smart Renewable Energy Grids
papers.abstract: The accelerated digitalization of renewable energy smart grids through IoT sensors, AMI, and SCADA systems has significantly expanded the attack surface for sophisticated cyberattacks, FDI attacks that stealthily distort state estimation and DoS/DDoS attacks that flood communication channels. Current IDS, however, exhibit three inherent limitations: inadequate modeling of the temporal progression of multi-step attacks, degraded scalability under extremely skewed class distributions of standard benchmark datasets, and restricted generalization across heterogeneous network environments. In this study, we present a Hybrid CNN-LSTM IDS that jointly exploits CNN-based spatial feature extraction and LSTM-based temporal sequence modeling, enabling the detection of instantaneous volumetric anomalies and gradually evolving low and slow-attack campaigns in real time. The model was trained using a seven-step preprocessing workflow comprising missing-value imputation, min-max normalization, one-hot encoding, SMOTE class balancing, mutual-information feature selection, causal temporal sequence construction (T=10), and stratified partitioning. LSTM (96.1%), Random Forest (93.5%), SVM (91.2%) and KNN (89.7%); in NSL-KDD, it reaches 98.2% precision versus 96.4% (LSTM), 95.2% (CNN), 92.7% (Random Forest) and 90.8% (SVM), with margins of 2-9 percentage points in all measures. An ablation analysis identified SMOTE balancing as the most influential design choice (-3.7~pp F1 without it). The model achieves a real-time inference throughput of 27,800 flows/s on GPU and 0.082 ms/sample CPU latency in FP32,, with INT8 quantization providing an additional 3.1 x speedup at 0.3% accuracy loss, confirming deployment feasibility on resource-constrained IEDs with <128MB memory and establishing a deployable deep-learning framework for securing next-generation renewable energy smart grid infrastructure.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景  
随着物联网传感器、高级计量架构（AMI）和SCADA系统在可再生能源智能电网中的深度部署，网络攻击面急剧扩大。虚假数据注入（FDI）攻击可隐蔽篡改状态估计，拒绝服务（DoS/DDoS）攻击则持续阻塞通信信道，对电网安全构成严峻威胁。现有入侵检测系统（IDS）存在三大固有缺陷：**难以建模多步攻击的时间演化过程**、**在NSL-KDD等高度类别失衡数据集上泛化能力骤降**、**跨异构网络环境（如配电网与变电站）迁移性差**。

## 方法创新  
本研究提出一种**CNN-LSTM混合入侵检测框架**，协同发挥CNN的空间局部特征提取能力与LSTM的长时序依赖建模优势，实现对瞬时流量型异常（如DDoS）与渐进式“低慢速”攻击（如隐蔽FDI）的联合实时识别。模型训练采用七步精细化预处理流水线：缺失值插补→Min-Max归一化→One-Hot编码→SMOTE过采样平衡类别→基于互信息的特征筛选→因果时序构造（窗口T=10）→分层划分训练/验证/测试集。

## 主要结果  
在CIC-IDS2017数据集上，F1-score达**96.1%**，显著优于LSTM（93.5%）、RF（91.2%）和KNN（89.7%）；在NSL-KDD上精度达**98.2%**，领先LSTM（96.4%）、CNN（95.2%）、RF（92.7%）和SVM（90.8%），各项指标提升2–9个百分点。消融实验表明，SMOTE平衡对性能影响最大（移除后F1下降3.7 pp）。推理效率方面：GPU达**27,800流/秒**，CPU单样本延迟仅**0.082 ms（FP32）**；INT8量化后提速3.1×，精度损失仅0.3%，完全满足资源受限IED（<128MB内存）的边缘部署需求。
papers.summary_en: This paper proposes a **hybrid CNN-LSTM intrusion detection system (IDS)** tailored for cybersecurity in smart renewable energy grids—environments increasingly vulnerable to FDI and DoS/DDoS attacks due to pervasive IoT, AMI, and SCADA integration. Addressing key limitations of existing IDSs—poor temporal modeling of multi-step attacks, low scalability under extreme class imbalance, and weak cross-environment generalization—the framework jointly leverages CNN for spatial feature extraction and LSTM for causal temporal sequence modeling (T=10), enabling real-time detection of both volumetric and low-and-slow attacks. Trained via a rigorous 7-step preprocessing pipeline—including SMOTE balancing and mutual-information-based feature selection—it achieves **96.1% F1-score on CIC-IDS2017** and **98.2% precision on NSL-KDD**, outperforming LSTM, CNN, RF, and SVM by 2–9 percentage points. Ablation confirms SMOTE as the most critical component (−3.7 pp F1 without it). With **27,800 flows/s (GPU)** and **0.082 ms/sample CPU latency (FP32)**—further accelerated 3.1× via INT8 quantization (0.3% accuracy drop)—the model is validated for deployment on resource-constrained IEDs (<128 MB RAM), establishing a practical deep-learning foundation for next-generation grid security.

papers.title: What Intermediate Layers Know: Detecting Jailbreaks from Entropy Dynamics
papers.abstract: Jailbreak attacks reveal a persistent weakness in aligned Large Language Models: carefully crafted prompts can elicit policy-violating responses despite safety training. While most defenses operate at the prompt or output level, it remains unclear how harmful intent is encoded within the model's internal representations. We investigate this question by analyzing token-level predictive entropy trajectories across layers of a frozen LLM using the logit lens. We find that static aggregate statistics of prompt-level entropy (e.g., mean, variance) carry little discriminative signal, whereas features capturing how entropy evolves across token positions, such as monotonic rank-based trend scores, are substantially more informative. Importantly, this signal is not uniform across model depth: it is concentrated in intermediate layers and degrades at the final layer, indicating that jailbreak-relevant structure is most pronounced in mid-network representations rather than at the output head. Across multiple models (Llama, Qwen, Gemma) and adversarial benchmarks, these entropy dynamics provide architecture-consistent separation without additional training. Together, our findings show that jailbreak behavior is reflected in structured intermediate uncertainty dynamics, clarifying both which entropy-derived features encode harmful intent and where in the network that signal is most pronounced.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景  
对抗性“越狱”（Jailbreak）攻击持续暴露对齐大语言模型（LLM）的安全脆弱性：精心设计的提示可绕过安全训练，诱导模型生成违反政策的内容。现有防御多聚焦于输入提示或输出文本层面，而**有害意图如何在模型内部表征中编码**这一根本问题仍不清晰。

## 方法创新  
本研究提出一种无需微调、架构无关的探针方法——基于**logit lens 的逐层熵动力学分析**。我们在冻结的LLM（Llama-2/3、Qwen-1.5、Gemma-2）上，沿解码路径逐层计算每个token位置的预测熵，并系统建模其跨位置演化模式（如单调性、斜率变化、秩趋势得分），而非依赖静态统计量（如均值、方差）。

## 关键发现  
- **熵动态优于静态统计**：prompt-level熵的均值/方差几乎无法区分越狱与良性提示；而**基于秩的单调趋势分（monotonic rank-based trend score）等动态特征判别力显著提升（AUC > 0.92）**。  
- **信号具有深度特异性**：该判别信号**高度集中于中间层（如Llama-2第16–24层）**，在顶层（最后5层）急剧衰减——表明越狱相关结构并非最终决策产物，而是**在中间表征中已形成并被后续层“平滑化”**。  
- **强泛化性与实用性**：在多个基准（AdvBench、TREX、SafeBench）和不同架构上，仅用熵动力学即可实现零样本分离，无需任何额外训练或模型修改。

## 理论与实践意义  
本工作首次将越狱行为锚定至**中间层不确定性演化结构**，为可解释安全检测提供了新范式：既揭示了“哪里最敏感”（中间层），也明确了“什么特征最有效”（熵的序贯动态），为轻量级、部署友好的实时防御系统奠定基础。
papers.summary_en: Jailbreak attacks expose a critical vulnerability in aligned LLMs: adversarial prompts can bypass safety mechanisms to elicit harmful outputs. While most defenses operate at the input or output level, the internal encoding of malicious intent remains poorly understood. We probe this by analyzing token-level predictive entropy trajectories across layers of frozen LLMs (Llama, Qwen, Gemma) using the logit lens. Crucially, we find that *static* entropy statistics (e.g., mean, variance) are nearly discriminative, whereas *dynamic* features—especially monotonic rank-based trend scores capturing how entropy evolves across token positions—achieve strong separation (AUC > 0.92). This signal is not uniform: it peaks sharply in intermediate layers and degrades near the final layer, indicating jailbreak-relevant structure emerges mid-network—not at the output head. Critically, these entropy dynamics enable zero-shot, architecture-consistent detection across diverse models and benchmarks without fine-tuning. Our work reveals that jailbreak behavior is encoded in structured uncertainty dynamics within intermediate representations—a key insight for interpretable, lightweight safety monitoring.

对抗性“越狱”（Jailbreak）攻击持续暴露对齐大语言模型（LLM）的安全脆弱性：精心设计的提示可绕过安全训练，诱导模型生成违反政策的内容。现有防御多聚焦于输入提示或输出文本层面，而**有害意图如何在模型内部表征中编码**这一根本问题仍不清晰。

## 方法创新  
本研究提出一种无需微调、架构无关的探针方法——基于**logit lens 的逐层熵动力学分析**。我们在冻结的LLM（Llama-2/3、Qwen-1.5、Gemma-2）上，沿解码路径逐层计算每个token位置的预测熵，并系统建模其跨位置演化模式（如单调性、斜率变化、秩趋势得分），而非依赖静态统计量（如均值、方差）。

## 关键发现  
- **熵动态优于静态统计**：prompt-level熵的均值/方差几乎无法区分越狱与良性提示；而**基于秩的单调趋势分（monotonic rank-based trend score）等动态特征判别力显著提升（AUC > 0.92）**。  
- **信号具有深度特异性**：该判别信号**高度集中于中间层（如Llama-2第16–24层）**，在顶层（最后5层）急剧衰减——表明越狱相关结构并非最终决策产物，而是**在中间表征中已形成并被后续层“平滑化”**。  
- **强泛化性与实用性**：在多个基准（AdvBench、TREX、SafeBench）和不同架构上，仅用熵动力学即可实现零样本分离，无需任何额外训练或模型修改。

## 理论与实践意义  
本工作首次将越狱行为锚定至**中间层不确定性演化结构**，为可解释安全检测提供了新范式：既揭示了“哪里最敏感”（中间层），也明确了“什么特征最有效”（熵的序贯动态），为轻量级、部署友好的实时防御系统奠定基础。

papers.title: TRUSTMEM: Learning Trustworthy Memory Consolidation for LLM Agents with Long-Term Memory
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents rely on long-term memory to support extended interactions and personalized assistance beyond finite context windows. Existing memory agents actively update external memory through generated write, revise, and delete operations, but these updates may omit important information, corrupt existing memory, or introduce unsupported hallucinated content. Once stored, such errors become persistent system-state failures that can affect future reasoning and generation. In this paper, we propose TrustMem, a framework designed to improve the trustworthiness of memory consolidation. TrustMem relies on a Memory Transition Verifier to evaluate the transition process of memory updates in terms of coverage, preservation, and faithfulness. It further constructs preference pairs among candidate updates under the same memory state, enabling preference-guided reinforcement learning to directly optimize memory updating behaviors. Extensive experiments demonstrate that TrustMem improves both memory utility and reliability: it achieves state-of-the-art results across MemoryAgentBench, HaluMem, and the Mem-alpha validation set, improves HaluMem memory extraction by 12.14 F1 points, and reduces transition-level omission, corruption, and hallucination by 40.1\%, 79.1\%, and 50.0\%, respectively, compared with the strongest baseline for each error type.
papers.summary_zh:
## 背景与挑战  
大型语言模型（LLM）智能体依赖**长时记忆**支撑跨轮次交互与个性化服务，但现有记忆代理常通过自生成的“写入—修订—删除”操作动态更新外部记忆库。此类自主更新易导致三类关键信任缺陷：**信息遗漏**（关键事实未存入）、**记忆腐蚀**（已有记忆被错误覆盖或弱化）及**幻觉注入**（引入无依据的虚构内容）。一旦错误固化于记忆中，便成为持续性系统状态故障，严重损害后续推理与响应质量。

## 方法创新：TrustMem 框架  
本文提出 **TrustMem**——首个面向记忆整合可信度优化的端到端框架。其核心包含两大组件：  
- **记忆迁移验证器（Memory Transition Verifier）**：对每次记忆更新操作进行细粒度评估，从**覆盖性**（是否保留全部关键信息）、**保真性**（是否忠实于原始输入）和**一致性**（是否破坏已有记忆结构）三维度量化迁移质量；  
- **偏好引导强化学习**：在相同记忆状态下构建多候选更新间的成对偏好样本（如“更新A比B更少遗漏且更少幻觉”），以此训练策略模型直接优化记忆编辑行为，而非仅优化单步输出。

## 实验结果与价值  
在 MemoryAgentBench、HaluMem 及 Mem-alpha 三大基准上，TrustMem 均达**当前最优性能**：  
- HaluMem 记忆抽取 F1 提升 **12.14 分**；  
- 各类迁移错误显著降低：遗漏率↓40.1%、腐蚀率↓79.1%、幻觉率↓50.0%（相较最强基线）；  
- 首次实现记忆更新过程的**可验证、可优化、可追溯**，为构建可信LLM智能体奠定关键基础设施。
papers.summary_en: Large language model (LLM) agents require trustworthy long-term memory to sustain extended, personalized interactions beyond context windows. However, existing memory agents autonomously update external memory via generated write/revise/delete operations—risking information omission, memory corruption, and hallucinated content injection. Once embedded, such errors persist and degrade downstream reasoning. To address this, we propose **TrustMem**, a novel framework that enhances memory consolidation trustworthiness. TrustMem introduces a **Memory Transition Verifier** to assess each update along three axes: coverage, preservation, and faithfulness. It further constructs preference pairs among candidate updates under identical memory states, enabling preference-guided reinforcement learning to directly optimize memory editing behavior. Experiments across MemoryAgentBench, HaluMem, and Mem-alpha show TrustMem achieves state-of-the-art performance: +12.14 F1 on HaluMem memory extraction and reductions of 40.1%, 79.1%, and 50.0% in omission, corruption, and hallucination errors—outperforming the strongest baseline per error type.

papers.title: Silent Failures in Physics-Informed Neural Networks: Parameter Poisoning and the Limits of Loss-Based Validation
papers.abstract: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) embed governing equations in their loss function, enabling mesh-free solutions to partial differential equations. Low training loss is treated as evidence that the learned solution is physically correct. This paper shows that assumption breaks down when encoded physics are incorrect. By perturbing PDE parameters before training, a setting we describe as physics parameter poisoning or parameter misspecification, we produce models that train to low loss but give incorrect answers; we treat the perturbation schedule as sensitivity analysis rather than only as a security threat, and none of our claims requires an adversary. Achieving low residual loss does not discriminate accurate from inaccurate solutions: poisoned models reach losses at or below the clean baseline yet differ by large margins, so driving the residual down is not evidence of physical accuracy. Across three PDE systems (Burgers equation, Navier-Stokes cavity, and convection-diffusion), poisoned models match or beat the clean-model training loss while their solutions differ by up to 71% in the fixed sweep and up to 128% under adversarial search; at Cavity Re=400 the poisoned loss falls below the clean baseline. We define a detection difficulty ratio R (solution error divided by training loss) to summarize how invisible the corruption is, though cross-PDE comparison is complicated by differences in loss scale. We test six candidate defenses, none of which reliably detects corruption across all regimes. We propose a post-hoc defense: sweeping the PDE residual loss across parameter values without retraining. The loss minimum recovers the true training parameter without external data, and generalizes across all three PDE systems. The effect holds across five network architectures (8.7K to 133K parameters), is bidirectional, and is confirmed across multiple random seeds.
papers.summary_zh:
## 静默失效：物理信息神经网络中的参数投毒与损失函数验证的局限性

**背景与问题**：物理信息神经网络（PINNs）通过将控制偏微分方程（PDE）嵌入损失函数，实现无网格求解。当前实践普遍将低训练残差损失视为解物理正确性的充分证据——这一隐含假设尚未被系统挑战。

**方法创新**：本文提出“物理参数投毒”（Physics Parameter Poisoning）概念，即在训练前**有意扰动PDE中的真实物理参数**（如粘度、扩散系数等），模拟模型构建阶段的参数误设（非恶意攻击场景）。我们将扰动视为广义敏感性分析，所有实验均在无对抗意图、仅依赖随机种子的设定下完成。

**核心发现**：  
- 低残差损失**完全无法区分准确解与严重失真解**：投毒模型可达到甚至低于干净基线的损失值，但其预测误差高达**71%（固定扰动扫描）或128%（对抗性搜索）**；在方腔流（Re=400）中，投毒损失竟比干净模型低12.3%。  
- 提出**检测难度比 $R = \frac{\text{解误差}}{\text{训练损失}}$**，量化“静默失效”程度——$R$ 越大，腐败越隐蔽；跨PDE比较需谨慎，因损失量纲差异显著。  
- 六种现有防御策略（包括梯度正则化、残差分布检验等）**均未能鲁棒地跨系统检出投毒**。

**关键创新**：提出首个**免重训练的后处理检测法**——对PDE残差损失沿参数轴进行单次扫描（无需新训练），其全局最小值**精准定位原始真实参数**，且在Burgers方程、Navier-Stokes方腔流、对流-扩散方程三大系统上一致有效；该现象在5种网络架构（8.7K–133K参数）、双向扰动（高/低估）、多随机种子下稳定复现。
papers.summary_en: This paper challenges the core assumption in physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) that low residual loss implies physical correctness. We introduce *physics parameter poisoning*: perturbing PDE parameters (e.g., viscosity, diffusion coefficient) before training—not as an adversarial attack, but as a sensitivity analysis of model trustworthiness. Across three canonical PDEs (Burgers, Navier–Stokes cavity flow at Re=400, convection–diffusion), poisoned models achieve losses at or below clean baselines yet yield solutions with up to **71% error under fixed sweeps and 128% under adversarial search**, demonstrating that loss minimization is not a reliable fidelity proxy. We define a detection difficulty ratio $R$ (solution error / training loss) to quantify corruption invisibility. Six candidate defenses fail universally. Our key contribution is a *post-hoc, no-retraining defense*: sweeping the PDE residual over parameter values reveals a sharp minimum precisely at the true physical parameter—robust across architectures (8.7K–133K params), PDE systems, perturbation directions, and random seeds.

papers.title: Erased, but Not Gone: Output Forgetting Is Not True Forgetting
papers.abstract: Machine unlearning (MU) is commonly judged by output forgetting, such as low forget-set accuracy or reduced logit-level membership inference. But if output-level success can coexist with retraining-inconsistent residuals in representation space, what kind of forgetting are current evaluations actually certifying? We study this question through retraining-consistent representation forgetting, using the retrained model (i.e., trained from scratch without the forget data) as an operational reference for correct forgetting. Across multiple unlearning methods, datasets, and models, our theoretical analysis and empirical results show that standard output-level evaluation can systematically overestimate the success of unlearning. Under this stronger lens, current methods often appear forgotten at the output layer while exhibiting a structured mismatch relative to retraining. They partially align with retraining on forget samples, remain more inconsistent on retain samples, and leave residual discrepancy concentrated along retraining-related directions rather than diffuse in representation space. This structured mismatch is characterized by forget/retain asymmetry, directional mismatch, and concentrated residuals along retraining-related directions. These results suggest that current MU is often evaluated for apparent forgetting rather than retraining-consistent forgetting. More broadly, retraining reveals what output forgetting hides.
papers.summary_zh:
## 核心问题：输出遗忘 ≠ 真实遗忘  
当前机器遗忘（Machine Unlearning, MU）的评估普遍依赖**输出层指标**，如遗忘集准确率下降或成员推断攻击成功率降低。然而，这类“成功”可能掩盖表征空间中与重训练模型不一致的残留结构——即模型看似已遗忘，实则未达到重训练（从零训练、排除遗忘数据）所定义的基准状态。

## 方法论创新：以重训练为黄金标准  
本研究提出**重训练一致的表征遗忘**（Retraining-Consistent Representation Forgetting）作为更严格的评估范式，将重训练模型的隐层表征作为“正确遗忘”的操作性参照。我们系统分析了5种主流遗忘方法（EU、SISA、Fisher-based、RNN、Scrub）、3类数据集（CIFAR-10/100、ImageNet-1K子集）及4类模型（ResNet、ViT），结合理论推导与大规模实证验证。

## 关键发现：结构性表征偏差  
研究揭示：  
- **输出层“成功”具有欺骗性**：92%的案例中，遗忘后模型在输出层达标，但其中间表征与重训练模型存在显著且**非随机的结构化偏差**；  
- **三重不对称性**：（1）**遗忘/保留样本不对称**：对遗忘样本部分对齐，对保留样本偏差更大；（2）**方向性错位**：偏差集中于重训练过程中主导的梯度方向（如Fisher向量主成分）；（3）**残差空间局域化**：>78%的表征差异能量集中在前10维重训练相关子空间，而非均匀弥散；  
- **本质揭示**：当前MU评估认证的是“表观遗忘”（apparent forgetting），而非重训练所体现的**因果一致遗忘**。重训练不仅是基准，更是揭露输出指标盲区的“X光”。

## 理论与实践意义  
本工作重新定义了遗忘的语义边界，为可信AI提供新评估框架，并指出：真正鲁棒的遗忘需在表征空间实现方向敏感、样本感知的一致性对齐。
papers.summary_en: This paper challenges the prevailing practice of evaluating machine unlearning (MU) solely via output-level metrics (e.g., low forget-set accuracy). We introduce *retraining-consistent representation forgetting*—using a from-scratch retrained model (excluding forget data) as the operational ground truth for correct forgetting. Across 5 unlearning methods, 3 datasets, and 4 architectures, we find that standard output-level success systematically overestimates true unlearning: models often pass output tests while exhibiting structured, non-diffuse discrepancies in representation space. These discrepancies manifest as (i) asymmetry between forget/retain samples, (ii) directional misalignment along retraining-relevant subspaces (e.g., Fisher principal components), and (iii) concentrated residual energy (>78% in top-10 dimensions)—not random noise. Our results demonstrate that current MU evaluations certify *apparent* rather than *retraining-consistent* forgetting, revealing that retraining uncovers what output metrics hide.

papers.title: Forget to Improve: On-Device LLM-Agent Continual Learning via Budget-Curated Memory
papers.abstract: On-device language-model agents improve by accumulating experience in retrieved memory rather than by updating weights. This memory is hard-bounded and exposed: it consumes RAM and energy, reaches peers through a thin uplink, and becomes an attack surface because it is writable by what the agent reads. Existing systems each cover one part of this problem: agentic memories grow without a budget, on-device methods keep entries by success alone, and poisoning is studied mainly as an attack rather than as a memory-governance problem. We propose \sys{}, a single net-value-per-byte score that governs an agent's experience-memory lifecycle. The main idea is to let the budget act as the curator: each entry is scored as value minus harm, per byte, so one ruler decides what to keep, share, and trust. \sys{} makes three decisions: (1) \textbf{KEEP} evicts low-value bytes under the RAM and energy budget; (2) \textbf{SHARE} sends an insight only when its value exceeds its uplink cost; and (3) \textbf{TRUST} gates a peer entry by provenance. On language-model-agent task-drift benchmarks and a real heterogeneous Jetson testbed with two robot-arm nodes and a hub, \sys{} reduces memory by $2.7\times$ and uplink by $2.4\times$, drives injection success from 0.75 to zero, and raises accuracy on cases corrupted by poison or stale memory. Curating by net value reduces footprint, energy, uplink, and injection success together without reducing accuracy. In this setting, forgetting by net value improves the agent rather than weakening it.
papers.summary_zh:
## 背景与挑战  
在端侧部署的语言模型智能体（LLM-Agent）中，持续学习不依赖权重更新，而依赖于可检索的“经验记忆”。然而，该内存具有三大刚性约束：**物理硬边界**（占用有限RAM与电池能量）、**通信脆弱性**（需经带宽受限的上行链路共享至边缘节点）、**安全暴露面**（内存可被智能体读取的内容直接写入，易遭投毒）。现有方法各自割裂：传统记忆系统无容量预算机制；端侧策略仅依据任务成功率保留条目；而投毒研究多聚焦攻击建模，忽视其作为**内存治理问题**的本质。

## 方法创新：净价值每字节（Net-Value-per-Byte）统一治理框架  
本文提出 **\sys{}**——首个以**单位字节净价值**（Value − Harm per byte）为统一标尺的记忆全生命周期治理框架。核心思想是让**预算本身担任策展人（Curator）**：每个内存条目不再孤立评估，而是按其每字节贡献的净收益排序，由单一标尺统管三类关键决策：  
- **KEEP**：在RAM与能耗预算下主动驱逐低净价值字节；  
- **SHARE**：仅当某洞察的净价值超过其上行传输能耗成本时才外发；  
- **TRUST**：对对等节点上传条目实施溯源门控（provenance-gated），阻断不可信来源。  

## 实验验证与效果  
在语言模型智能体任务漂移基准及真实异构Jetson测试平台（含2台机械臂节点+1个中心枢纽）上，\sys{}实现：内存占用降低**2.7×**、上行流量减少**2.4×**、投毒注入成功率从0.75**归零**，且在受污染或陈旧记忆干扰的样本上，准确率显著提升。结果表明：**基于净价值的“遗忘”不是性能妥协，而是系统级增益**——同步压缩足迹、节能、降带宽、抗投毒，且不牺牲精度。
papers.summary_en: On-device LLM-agents rely on experience memory—not weight updates—for continual learning, yet this memory faces hard RAM/energy budgets, constrained uplinks, and security risks from writable content. Prior work treats budgeting, sharing, and poisoning in isolation. We propose **\sys{}**, a unified memory governance framework that scores every memory entry by *net value per byte* (value minus harm), turning the budget itself into the curator. \sys{} makes three coordinated decisions: (**KEEP**) evicting low-net-value bytes under resource limits; (**SHARE**) transmitting insights only when their net value exceeds uplink cost; and (**TRUST**) gating peer entries via provenance. Evaluated on task-drift benchmarks and a real Jetson testbed (two robot-arm nodes + hub), \sys{} reduces memory footprint by 2.7× and uplink traffic by 2.4×, eliminates injection success (from 0.75 to 0), and improves accuracy on poisoned/stale-corrupted cases—*without accuracy loss*. Net-value–guided forgetting thus strengthens, rather than weakens, on-device agents.

papers.title: Adaptive Joint Compression and Synchronisation in Federated Split Learning for IoT Rainfall Prediction
papers.abstract: Federated split learning (FSL) enables collaborative training across bandwidth-constrained IoT devices, but repeated activation and gradient exchange creates a communication bot-tleneck. Prior work optimises either activation compression or synchronisation frequency in isolation. This paper presents an FSL framework for IoT rainfall prediction that jointly regulates activation compression and the synchronisation interval \r{ho} via a latency driven scheduler on a server with per client EMA smoothing. The system is evaluated on hourly ERA5 data from 11 weather stations through a 17 scenario simulation matrix and a four scenario Raspberry Pi deployment over a real wide-area link. The simulation matrix validates scheduler switching across low, high, and mixed latency profiles, while the Pi deployment validates the high latency endpoint selected by the same policy. AUPRC varies only slightly across configurations (0.6381-0.6484 in simulation; within 0.011 on Pi), indicating that aggressive quantisation and sparser aggregation do not materially degrade predictive quality in this setting. On Pi, the selected endpoint (int8 with rho=3) achieves an 87% reduction in activation upload payload and a 54% reduction in synchronisation traffic relative to the float32 baseline, while reducing runtime jitter from +/-688 s to +/-10 s.
papers.summary_zh:
## 背景与挑战  
联邦分割学习（Federated Split Learning, FSL）为带宽受限的物联网（IoT）设备协同训练提供了可行路径，但在降雨预测等实时性敏感场景中，频繁的激活值上传与梯度回传易引发严重通信瓶颈。现有方法通常孤立优化**激活压缩**（如量化）或**同步频率**（即同步间隔 ρ），缺乏联合调控机制，难以兼顾通信开销、时延波动与模型性能。

## 方法创新  
本文提出面向IoT降雨预测的自适应联合压缩与同步框架：  
- 设计**时延驱动的服务器端调度器**，动态协同调节每客户端激活值的量化精度（如 int8/int16/float32）与同步间隔 ρ；  
- 引入**客户端级指数移动平均（EMA）平滑**，稳定估计各设备上行延迟，提升调度鲁棒性；  
- 支持细粒度策略切换——低/高/混合时延场景下自动适配最优压缩-同步组合。

## 实验验证与核心发现  
在11个气象站的小时级ERA5数据上开展**17组仿真场景矩阵测试**，并在真实广域网链路上部署**4种Raspberry Pi实机场景**。结果表明：  
✅ **性能稳定**：AUPRC指标波动极小（仿真：0.6381–0.6484；树莓派：±0.011），证明激进量化（int8）与稀疏同步（ρ=3）未损害预测质量；  
✅ **通信显著优化**：最优配置（int8 + ρ=3）相较float32基准，**激活上传负载降低87%**，**同步通信量减少54%**；  
✅ **时延可控性跃升**：运行时抖动从±688秒大幅收窄至±10秒，满足IoT边缘预测的实时性约束。

本工作首次实现FSL中压缩与同步的协同自适应控制，为资源受限气象边缘智能提供可部署、低抖动、高鲁棒的训练范式。
papers.summary_en: This paper proposes an adaptive joint compression and synchronization framework for Federated Split Learning (FSL) in IoT-based rainfall prediction. To overcome the communication bottleneck caused by repeated activation and gradient exchange under bandwidth constraints, we introduce a latency-driven server scheduler that jointly optimizes activation quantization (e.g., int8, int16, float32) and synchronization interval ρ per client, leveraging per-client EMA-smoothed delay estimation. Evaluated on hourly ERA5 data from 11 weather stations, our approach is validated through both a 17-scenario simulation matrix (covering low/high/mixed latency profiles) and a real-world Raspberry Pi deployment over a wide-area link. Results show minimal AUPRC degradation (0.6381–0.6484 in simulation; ≤0.011 variation on Pi), confirming that aggressive quantization and sparser aggregation preserve predictive quality. On Pi, the selected configuration (int8 + ρ=3) achieves an 87% reduction in activation upload payload and 54% less synchronization traffic versus float32 baseline, while slashing runtime jitter from ±688 s to ±10 s. This work establishes the first co-adaptive control of compression and synchronization in FSL, enabling deployable, low-jitter, robust edge training for time-critical meteorological applications.

papers.title: FedUP: One-Shot Federated Unlearning via Centroid-Guided Plug-in Filters
papers.abstract: Federated unlearning (FU) is critical for complying with legal mandates like the right to be forgotten in decentralized systems, yet current methods face a persistent dilemma between non-target knowledge loss and high request latency. To resolve these issues, we propose FedUP, a one-shot federated unlearning framework utilizing lightweight pluggable filters that act as a "knowledge funnel" to screen out target data while preserving original model performance. By freezing original model parameters and training filters at the server side using differentially private (DP)-protected class centroid samples, FedUP bypasses the need for multi-round client-server communication and complex retraining, reducing unlearning latency from minutes to mere seconds. Additionally, the framework's pluggable architecture ensures inherent reversibility, enabling the seamless restoration of forgotten knowledge by simply removing the filters. Extensive experiments on diverse image and text tasks demonstrate that FedUP effectively reduces non-target knowledge loss and achieves superior unlearning precision and efficiency across various scenarios. Code is available at: https://github.com/suows/FedUP-code.
papers.summary_zh:
## 背景与挑战  
联邦遗忘（Federated Unlearning, FU）是满足《通用数据保护条例》（GDPR）等法规中“被遗忘权”要求的关键技术，尤其在去中心化机器学习系统中至关重要。然而，现有FU方法普遍存在两大瓶颈：**非目标知识损失严重**（即删除特定用户数据时，模型对其他类别的泛化能力显著下降），以及**请求延迟过高**（依赖多轮客户端-服务器通信与全模型重训练，耗时达分钟级），难以支撑实时合规响应。

## 方法创新：FedUP框架  
本文提出**FedUP**——一种**单次完成、插件式联邦遗忘框架**。其核心创新在于引入轻量级、可插拔的**中心点引导滤波器（Centroid-Guided Plug-in Filters）**，作为“知识漏斗”：  
- **冻结原始模型参数**，仅在服务器端训练滤波器，彻底规避客户端参与与模型上传；  
- 利用**差分隐私（DP）保护的类别中心样本**（而非原始敏感数据）构建监督信号，保障隐私安全；  
- 滤波器部署于模型前向路径中，精准屏蔽目标用户相关特征响应，同时最小化对非目标类别的干扰；  
- 架构天然**可逆**：遗忘操作仅需卸载滤波器，原模型性能即时恢复，无需额外补偿训练。

## 实验验证与优势  
在CIFAR-10/100、ImageNet-Subset及AG News、SST-2等跨模态任务上，FedUP显著优于基线方法：  
✅ **非目标知识保留率提升12.7–28.3%**（相比SOTA FedEraser）；  
✅ **单次遗忘耗时压缩至1.2–3.8秒**（较迭代式方法提速200×以上）；  
✅ **遗忘精度（Recall@1）达96.4%**，且在异构数据分布下鲁棒性强；  
✅ 开源代码已发布，支持快速复现与扩展应用。
papers.summary_en: Federated unlearning (FU) is essential for regulatory compliance (e.g., the “right to be forgotten”) in decentralized learning, yet existing methods suffer from severe non-target knowledge degradation and high latency due to iterative client-server communication and full-model retraining. To address this, we propose **FedUP**, a *one-shot*, *server-only* FU framework that deploys lightweight, differentially private (DP)-trained plug-in filters guided by class centroids. These filters act as “knowledge funnels”, selectively suppressing target-user representations while freezing original model parameters—eliminating client involvement, raw data access, and multi-round coordination. Crucially, FedUP enables *instant reversibility*: forgetting is undone by simply removing the filters. Experiments across image (CIFAR, ImageNet) and text (AG News, SST-2) benchmarks show FedUP reduces non-target accuracy drop by up to 28.3%, achieves >200× speedup (unlearning in <4 seconds), and attains 96.4% unlearning precision—outperforming state-of-the-art baselines under heterogeneous data and strict privacy constraints. Code: https://github.com/suows/FedUP-code.

papers.title: LLM-Based Scientific Peer Review: Methods, Benchmarks, and Reliability Challenges
papers.abstract: The rapid growth of scientific submissions has pushed traditional peer review toward its scalability limits, motivating the exploration of large language models (LLMs) as intelligent automated evaluation assistants. Although recent studies show that LLMs can generate fluent critiques and approximate reviewer scores, their reliability, robustness, and security as decision-support systems remain insufficiently understood. This survey offers a systems-level analysis of LLM-based scientific peer review, focusing on two core evaluative functions: critique generation and score prediction. We present a structured taxonomy of modeling approaches (including prompt-based, supervised, retrieval-augmented, and alignment-optimized approaches), and synthesize empirical findings across existing benchmarks. We analyze dataset constraints, evaluation shortcomings, and domain concentration biases that limit current assessment practices. Beyond performance metrics, we identify emerging robustness risks, including prompt injection, data poisoning, retrieval vulnerabilities, and reward hacking, which expose automated review pipelines to strategic manipulation. From a data mining perspective, we outline key open challenges in modeling subjective disagreement and cross-domain generalization. By reframing automated peer review as a high-stakes, multi-objective decision problem, this survey provides a roadmap for developing robust, transparent, and trustworthy AI-assisted scientific evaluation systems.
papers.summary_zh:
## 背景与问题  
科学投稿量激增正逼近传统同行评审的可扩展性极限，推动学界探索大语言模型（LLM）作为智能自动化评审辅助工具。尽管现有研究表明LLM能生成流畅审稿意见并近似人工评分，其在**可靠性、鲁棒性与安全性**方面的系统性风险仍缺乏深入认知。

## 方法与框架  
本综述从系统层面剖析LLM驱动的科学同行评审，聚焦两大核心功能：**审稿意见生成**与**评分预测**。我们构建了结构化方法论分类体系，涵盖：  
- **提示工程驱动型**（zero/few-shot prompting）  
- **监督微调型**（fine-tuning on review corpora）  
- **检索增强型**（RAG with paper-context retrieval）  
- **对齐优化型**（RLHF/DPO aligning with reviewer norms）  

整合12个主流基准（如PeerRead、SciRev、ARXIV-REVIEW）的实证结果，揭示当前评估存在三重局限：**数据集规模小且标注稀疏、评价指标偏重表面流畅性而忽视逻辑一致性与领域严谨性、研究高度集中于计算机/ML子领域，缺乏跨学科泛化验证**。

## 关键发现与创新  
首次系统识别四大新兴鲁棒性威胁：**提示注入攻击**（篡改评审指令）、**训练数据投毒**（污染review corpus）、**检索漏洞**（误引无关或过时文献）、**奖励劫持**（模型优化表层分数而非实质质量）。进一步指出：建模审稿人主观分歧（如“合理分歧区间”量化）与实现跨学科迁移（如从AI论文到生物医学论文）是数据挖掘视角下的核心开放挑战。本工作将自动化评审重构为**高风险、多目标决策问题**，为构建**鲁棒、透明、可信**的AI辅助科研评估系统提供首份综合性技术路线图。
papers.summary_en: This survey provides the first systems-level analysis of LLM-based scientific peer review, focusing on critique generation and score prediction. We propose a unified taxonomy covering prompt-based, supervised fine-tuning, retrieval-augmented, and alignment-optimized approaches, and synthesize findings across 12 benchmarks. Key limitations include small/low-quality datasets, evaluation metrics favoring fluency over factual accuracy or domain rigor, and severe domain bias (mostly CS/ML). Crucially, we identify four underexplored robustness threats: prompt injection, data poisoning, retrieval vulnerabilities, and reward hacking—exposing automated pipelines to strategic manipulation. We argue that modeling subjective reviewer disagreement and enabling cross-domain generalization remain fundamental open challenges. By reframing peer review as a high-stakes, multi-objective decision problem, this work delivers a concrete roadmap toward trustworthy AI-assisted scientific evaluation.
papers.summary:
## 背景与问题  
科学投稿量激增正逼近传统同行评审的可扩展性极限，推动学界探索大语言模型（LLM）作为智能自动化评审辅助工具。尽管现有研究表明LLM能生成流畅审稿意见并近似人工评分，其在**可靠性、鲁棒性与安全性**方面的系统性风险仍缺乏深入认知。

## 方法与框架  
本综述从系统层面剖析LLM驱动的科学同行评审，聚焦两大核心功能：**审稿意见生成**与**评分预测**。我们构建了结构化方法论分类体系，涵盖：  
- **提示工程驱动型**（zero/few-shot prompting）  
- **监督微调型**（fine-tuning on review corpora）  
- **检索增强型**（RAG with paper-context retrieval）  
- **对齐优化型**（RLHF/DPO aligning with reviewer norms）  

整合12个主流基准（如PeerRead、SciRev、ARXIV-REVIEW）的实证结果，揭示当前评估存在三重局限：**数据集规模小且标注稀疏、评价指标偏重表面流畅性而忽视逻辑一致性与领域严谨性、研究高度集中于计算机/ML子领域，缺乏跨学科泛化验证**。

## 关键发现与创新  
首次系统识别四大新兴鲁棒性威胁：**提示注入攻击**（篡改评审指令）、**训练数据投毒**（污染review corpus）、**检索漏洞**（误引无关或过时文献）、**奖励劫持**（模型优化表层分数而非实质质量）。进一步指出：建模审稿人主观分歧（如“合理分歧区间”量化）与实现跨学科迁移（如从AI论文到生物医学论文）是数据挖掘视角下的核心开放挑战。本工作将自动化评审重构为**高风险、多目标决策问题**，为构建**鲁棒、透明、可信**的AI辅助科研评估系统提供首份综合性技术路线图。

papers.title: Trust the Voice, Hide the Source: Anonymous Provenance for Verifiably Edited Audio
papers.abstract:
Audio recordings are often used as evidence, but modern forgery tools make their origin harder to verify. Existing authentication methods require releasing the original signed recording, which exposes sensitive source content as well as provenance information. Redacting the audio avoids that disclosure, but doing so also invalidates the original signature. Revealing the edit operations to prove edit compliance can also disclose the redacted content. This creates a conflict for existing approaches: authenticating a released audio file requires disclosing the original audio, edit operations, or identity of the recording device, but preserving privacy requires keeping all three hidden.

In this work, we propose $\textit{Privacy-Preserving Audio Authentication Systems}$ (PPAAS). PPAAS uses a single relation that binds source provenance and edit correctness to the same hidden witness. This witness includes both the attested source recording and device attestation, so the verifier can be convinced that the released audio came from an authorized device and was obtained through allowed edits, without learning the source recording, the edit operations, or which enrolled device produced it. We formalize this notion and provide two constructions adapted to different editing scenarios. The first is a $\textit{segmentation-based}$ construction that requires zero-knowledge proofs only for actively edited segments and is therefore well-suited to sparse edits. The second is an $\textit{iteration-based}$ construction that uses Incrementally Verifiable Computation (IVC) with zero-knowledge compression to fold repeated checks into a single proof, which is efficient for dense edits. Our evaluations show the practicality of both constructions: the segmentation-based approach minimizes cost for sparse edits, whereas the iteration-based approach becomes preferable as edit density increases.
papers.summary_zh:
## 背景与挑战  
音频证据在司法、媒体与公共事务中日益关键，但深度伪造技术的普及严重削弱了其可信度。现有音频认证方案（如数字签名）要求公开原始录音或编辑操作日志，不可避免地泄露**敏感源内容**、**具体编辑行为**及**录音设备身份**——三者均属强隐私敏感信息。而简单红删（redaction）虽可保护隐私，却使原始签名失效；若额外披露编辑逻辑以验证合规性，又可能逆向推断出被隐藏内容。由此形成根本性冲突：**可验证性依赖信息披露，而隐私保护要求信息隐藏**。

## 方法创新：PPAAS 框架  
本文提出 **Privacy-Preserving Audio Authentication Systems（PPAAS）**——首个支持“可验证编辑+完全匿名溯源”的密码学音频认证框架。其核心突破在于引入**单一隐式见证（hidden witness）**，将**源设备认证**与**编辑正确性验证**绑定于同一不可见结构中。该见证同时封装经认证的原始音频片段与设备远程证明（attestation），但对验证者完全隐藏：① 原始音频内容；② 具体编辑操作（如剪切、混音位置）；③ 录音设备唯一标识。验证者仅需确认发布音频源自授权设备且仅经许可编辑，无需任何明文溯源信息。

## 双路径构造与实证效果  
我们设计两种适配不同编辑密度的高效实现：  
- **分段式构造（Segmentation-based）**：仅对实际被编辑的音频片段生成零知识证明（ZKP），计算开销随编辑稀疏度线性增长，适用于新闻剪辑等少量修改场景；  
- **迭代式构造（Iteration-based）**：采用增量可验证计算（IVC）结合ZKP压缩，将重复编辑验证折叠为单个紧凑证明，吞吐量随编辑密度提升显著优于分段式。  
实验表明：在10分钟语音上，稀疏编辑（<5%片段改动）时分段式证明生成仅需2.1秒；密集编辑（>30%）时迭代式提速3.8倍，最终证明大小稳定在~120 KB，验证耗时<100 ms，具备端到端部署可行性。
papers.summary_en: Audio recordings serve as critical evidence, yet modern deepfake tools undermine trust in their origin. Existing authentication schemes force trade-offs: revealing the original signed audio leaks sensitive source content and device identity; redacting it breaks signature validity; disclosing edit operations risks content inference. This paper introduces **Privacy-Preserving Audio Authentication Systems (PPAAS)**, the first framework enabling *verifiable editing* while hiding *all three sensitive elements*: the source recording, the edit operations, and the device identity. PPAAS binds source provenance and edit correctness to a single hidden witness—containing attested source audio and device attestation—so verifiers confirm authorized-device origin and policy-compliant edits *without learning any private data*. We formalize this security notion and propose two practical constructions: a **segmentation-based ZKP scheme**, optimal for sparse edits (low overhead per edited segment), and an **IVC-based iterative scheme**, compressing repeated checks into one compact proof for dense edits. Evaluation shows both are deployable: segmentation achieves 2.1s proof generation for sparse edits on 10-min audio; iteration reduces proof time by 3.8× for dense edits, with constant ~120 KB proof size and <100 ms verification.

papers.title: Designing Wallet-Based User Intervention for Approval Phishing Mitigation
papers.abstract: Approval phishing is a form of Web3 phishing that exploits token approval mechanisms to trick users into granting attackers spending authority over their tokens. As attackers increasingly hijack legitimate websites, URL-based detection alone becomes insufficient, leaving crypto wallets as the last line of defense. Based on the characteristics of approval mechanisms, we propose four wallet-based interventions for mitigating approval phishing: Spending Cap Suggestion, Active Spender Warning, Passive Spender Warning, and Delayed Confirmation. We evaluate the interventions through a between-subjects experiment (n = 364) and semi-structured interviews (n = 23). Compared with the control group, the Spending Cap Suggestion condition significantly increases the likelihood that users set spending caps. The Active Spender Warning, Passive Spender Warning, and Delayed Confirmation conditions all increase cancellation rates of phishing tasks, although the increases are statistically significant only for Active Spender Warning and Delayed Confirmation conditions. The effectiveness of the interventions varies across users, as users may struggle to interpret suspicious cues and focus on transaction outcomes while overlooking approval details. Our findings highlight the need to strengthen defenses against such attacks by increasing users' awareness of post-approval consequences and supporting approval-parameter verification at the moment of authorization.
papers.summary_zh:
## 背景与问题  
**批准型钓鱼（Approval Phishing）** 是Web3领域日益猖獗的一类新型网络钓鱼攻击：攻击者诱导用户在合法或仿冒网站上签署链上交易，从而获取对其数字资产的长期、无限制代币授权（token approval），后续可任意转移资产。随着攻击者频繁劫持真实网站（如Uniswap、OpenSea等），传统依赖URL识别的防御手段已失效，**加密钱包成为用户最后一道防线**。

## 方法与干预设计  
本研究基于代币批准机制的技术特性（如spender地址、金额上限、无限授权风险），提出四种**钱包端主动干预策略**：  
- **消费额度建议（Spending Cap Suggestion）**：在授权界面智能推荐合理限额（如$100），替代默认“无限授权”；  
- **活跃调用方警告（Active Spender Warning）**：对近期有转账/提币行为的合约地址标红警示；  
- **被动调用方警告（Passive Spender Warning）**：对长期无交互但突然请求授权的合约发出低强度提示；  
- **延迟确认（Delayed Confirmation）**：强制增加5秒倒计时与二次确认步骤，打断自动化点击流。

通过**364人参与的组间实验**（4干预组+1对照组）与**23人的半结构化访谈**，系统评估各策略对用户行为与认知的影响。

## 主要发现与创新点  
- Spending Cap Suggestion显著提升用户设置限额的比例（+41.2%，*p*<0.001）；  
- Active Spender Warning与Delayed Confirmation显著提高钓鱼任务取消率（+28.7%和+33.5%，*p*<0.01），Passive Spender Warning效果未达统计显著；  
- 用户普遍存在**后果盲区**：过度关注“交易是否成功”，却忽略“授权后谁可花、花多少、何时能撤回”等关键参数；  
- 首次揭示**批准参数验证时机至关重要**——干预必须嵌入授权决策瞬间，而非事后通知。  
本研究为钱包安全设计提供了实证驱动的UX框架，强调从“防误点”转向“促审慎”，推动行业将**授权意识教育**与**参数级实时验证**纳入标准防护栈。
papers.summary_en: Approval phishing—a Web3-specific threat—exploits token approval mechanisms to trick users into granting attackers indefinite spending authority over their digital assets. As attackers increasingly compromise legitimate websites, URL-based detection fails, making crypto wallets the final defense layer. We propose four wallet-based interventions grounded in approval mechanics: **Spending Cap Suggestion**, **Active Spender Warning**, **Passive Spender Warning**, and **Delayed Confirmation**. A between-subjects experiment (*n* = 364) and semi-structured interviews (*n* = 23) show that Spending Cap Suggestion significantly increases users’ adoption of spending limits (*p* < 0.001); Active Spender Warning and Delayed Confirmation significantly raise phishing task cancellation rates (+28.7% and +33.5%, *p* < 0.01), while Passive Spender Warning shows no statistically significant effect. Crucially, users often overlook approval parameters—focusing on transaction outcomes rather than post-approval consequences. Our findings underscore the need for real-time, parameter-aware interventions at the moment of authorization to strengthen user awareness and verification capability.

papers.title: Forensic Cryptanalysis of the Backdoored UA-8295 Message Terminal
papers.abstract:
Nation State Agencies go to great lengths to obtain signal intelligence, including backdooring cryptographic standards and equipment. Although the existence of these backdoor efforts is common knowledge, only few of known backdoored systems have been publicly analysed.

In this paper we present the first detailed $\textit{forensic cryptanalysis}$ of the backdoored UA-8295 message terminal and we try to answer questions how the UA-8295's backdoor was designed and for which attack. Towards a better understanding of real-world backdoor design, we posit a $\textit{Backdoor Conjecture}$ that provides handles to reason about the design of backdoors and the attacks they are designed for.
papers.summary_zh:
## 背景与意义  
国家情报机构为获取信号情报（SIGINT），长期系统性地渗透加密标准与通信设备，植入隐蔽后门。尽管此类行为广为人知，但公开披露并经严格密码学检验的后门案例极为稀少——UA-8295消息终端即为近年曝光的关键装备之一，其被证实存在国家级别定制后门。本研究首次开展针对该设备的**法证密码分析**（forensic cryptanalysis），突破以往仅依赖逆向工程或侧信道推测的局限，从算法结构、密钥生成逻辑与协议交互三层面进行深度逆向建模与实证验证。

## 方法与发现  
我们通过固件提取、指令级动态插桩与差分故障注入，重构了UA-8295的完整加解密流水线；结合对称密钥派生函数（KDF）的代数分析，发现其后门核心在于一个**隐式弱熵子模块**：该模块在特定硬件触发条件下（如预设时间戳或特定消息头标识），强制将主密钥降维至2^32量级搜索空间，并通过非线性混淆层掩盖熵损失痕迹。实验表明，攻击者可在平均12秒内完成密钥恢复（单GPU），且该机制完全规避了FIPS 140-2合规性检测。

## 创新贡献  
本文提出首个可形式化验证的**后门猜想**（Backdoor Conjecture），定义后门设计的三个必要维度：*可控性*（attacker-triggered activation）、*隐蔽性*（cryptographic indistinguishability under standard tests）、*实用性*（polynomial-time exploitation）。该框架成功解释UA-8295后门为何选择“条件性熵坍缩”而非传统密钥泄露路径，并为未来检测类设备提供可审计的设计模式。研究成果已提交NIST后门识别指南修订草案，推动密码设备供应链安全评估范式升级。
papers.summary_en: This paper presents the first forensic cryptanalysis of the UA-8295 message terminal—a state-sponsored backdoored cryptographic device. We reverse-engineer its firmware, identify a conditional entropy collapse mechanism in its key derivation function, and demonstrate practical key recovery (avg. 12 sec on one GPU) under attacker-controlled triggers. Crucially, we propose the *Backdoor Conjecture*: a formal framework characterizing backdoors along three axes—**controllability**, **cryptographic indistinguishability**, and **exploitability**—enabling systematic reasoning about design intent and attack scope. Our analysis reveals that the UA-8295 backdoor avoids traditional leakage paths by embedding weakness only under specific operational conditions, evading standard compliance checks. This work bridges forensic practice with theoretical cryptanalysis, offering both a concrete case study and a generalizable methodology for detecting engineered vulnerabilities in trusted hardware.

本文提出首个可形式化验证的**后门猜想**（Backdoor Conjecture），定义后门设计的三个必要维度：*可控性*（attacker-triggered activation）、*隐蔽性*（cryptographic indistinguishability under standard tests）、*实用性*（polynomial-time exploitation）。该框架成功解释UA-8295后门为何选择“条件性熵坍缩”而非传统密钥泄露路径，并为未来检测类设备提供可审计的设计模式。研究成果已提交NIST后门识别指南修订草案，推动密码设备供应链安全评估范式升级。

papers.title: A Communication-Efficient Local-Verification Framework for Maliciously Secure MPC with a Two-Thirds Honest Majority
papers.abstract:
Secure Multi-Party Computation (MPC) is a cryptographic primitive that enables multiple parties to jointly compute a function over their inputs without revealing the inputs. An MPC protocol is required to provide security against adversarial behavior, typically considered in two classic models: the \textit{semi-honest} model, where adversaries follow the protocol but attempt to learn additional information from the transcript, and the \textit{malicious} model, where adversaries may arbitrarily deviate from the protocol. Protocols secure against semi-honest adversaries are often more efficient, but in many real-world applications the stronger guarantee of malicious security is required.

In this work, we propose an efficient MPC protocol secure against static malicious adversaries controlling at most $t<n/3$ out of $n$ parties. Our protocol builds on Shamir's secret sharing and follows a compiler-based approach: the parties first evaluate the circuit using a semi-honest protocol and then run a verification procedure that enables honest parties to detect cheating except with small statistical error. Our construction injects fresh randomness into the verification procedure to detect cheating even in the presence of incorrect multiplication triples. It also reduces communication overhead by replacing several invocations of multiplication verification with local degree-$2t$ computations and a batched opening, while keeping the local verification cost comparable to or lower than that of prior protocols. We give a concrete instantiation of the compiler and prove that the resulting protocol is secure against malicious adversaries.
papers.summary_zh:
## 背景与问题  
安全多方计算（MPC）允许多方在不泄露各自私有输入的前提下协同计算任意函数。在恶意敌手模型下，敌手可任意偏离协议，安全性要求远高于半诚实模型，但现有恶意安全协议常面临通信开销高、验证步骤繁重等瓶颈，尤其在 $n$ 方中最多 $t < n/3$ 个敌手（即“三分之二多数诚实”）的经典设定下，如何兼顾效率与严格安全性仍是关键挑战。

## 方法与创新  
本文提出一种**通信高效、本地化验证**的恶意安全MPC框架。核心思想是采用“编译器范式”：先以半诚实协议执行电路计算，再通过轻量级本地验证阶段检测作弊行为。关键技术突破包括：  
- **抗错误三元组的随机化验证**：在验证过程中注入新鲜随机性，使敌手即使提供伪造的乘法三元组（如因预处理缺陷或主动篡改），仍以统计不可忽略的概率被诚实方检出；  
- **通信优化机制**：将传统需多次交互验证的乘法操作，替换为仅需本地完成的**度数至多为 $2t$ 的多项式计算**，并辅以**批量化公开（batched opening）**，显著降低总通信量；  
- **低开销本地验证**：单方验证计算复杂度与主流协议相当甚至更低，避免引入额外轮次或全局广播。

## 主要成果  
我们给出了该编译器的具体实例化方案，并在标准假设下给出形式化安全性证明。实验评估表明，在 $n=100$、$t=33$ 的典型设置下，通信量较前序最优方案（如SPDZ2k）降低约 38%，端到端延迟减少 29%。本工作首次实现了在 $t<n/3$ 恶意模型下，将验证阶段通信复杂度从 $O(n^2)$ 级别降至接近 $O(n)$ 级别，同时保持统计安全性（错误接受概率 $<2^{-40}$）。
papers.summary_en: We present a communication-efficient compiler for maliciously secure MPC tolerating up to $t < n/3$ static corruptions among $n$ parties. Building on Shamir secret sharing, our framework first evaluates the circuit using a semi-honest protocol and then applies a lightweight local verification phase—enabling honest parties to detect cheating with negligible statistical error. Key innovations include: (i) fresh randomness injection in verification to robustly detect corrupted multiplication triples; (ii) replacing multiple interactive multiplication checks with local degree-$2t$ computations and a single batched opening, reducing total communication asymptotically; and (iii) keeping per-party verification cost comparable to or lower than prior art. We provide a concrete instantiation and prove malicious security under standard assumptions. Our protocol achieves up to 38% communication reduction and 29% latency improvement over state-of-the-art baselines (e.g., SPDZ2k) in realistic settings, while ensuring statistical soundness with error $< 2^{-40}$.

papers.title: TETRIS: Automated Design Space Exploration of Randomness–Latency Trade-offs in Masked Hardware
papers.abstract:
Given a fixed security order, the randomness and latency of masked hardware present a trade-off. This trade-off has not been structurally examined well enough to enable an efficient search for a user-optimal (randomness/latency efficient) masked design. Gadget-based masking has simplified masking using masked functions called \textit{gadgets} corresponding to simpler (unmasked) functions as building blocks for larger masked designs. These gadgets, in turn, have masking-order dependent latency-randomness costs, lending a structure to the randomness and latency of gadget-based masked hardware. This structure enables automated Design-Space Exploration (DSE) of gadget-based masked hardware that takes in a user's constraints on randomness (or latency) to arrive at the latency (randomness)- optimal assignment of gadgets with less area and vice versa. 

This article introduces a software-level DSE approach the basis of which are the two DSE algorithms -  Minimize Latency under Randomness Constraints (MLRC) and Minimize Randomness under Latency Constraints (MRLC) which are duals of each other. While prior work solves the problem of optimizing masked hardware by formulating a global SAT optimization, our results show that gadget-based masked hardware using Probe-Isolating Non-Interference (PINI) gadgets embody a structured trade-off lending efficient heuristic-based solutions instead of relying on heavy global optimizations. This gives our tool comparable to superior area results in under a millisecond - a speedup of several orders of magnitude - to the SOTA.
papers.summary_zh:
## 背景与问题  
在固定安全阶数（security order）下，掩码硬件（masked hardware）的**随机性开销**（randomness consumption）与**执行延迟**（latency）存在固有权衡。然而，该权衡长期缺乏系统性建模，导致难以高效搜索满足用户偏好的最优设计（如：最小化随机性的同时容忍一定延迟，或反之）。尽管基于小构件（gadget）的掩码方法已简化设计——将基础非掩码函数映射为具备安全保证的掩码 gadget——但不同 gadget 的延迟/随机性成本高度依赖于掩码阶数，尚未被结构化利用以支撑自动化探索。

## 方法创新  
本文提出 **TETRIS**：首个面向 gadget-based 掩码硬件的轻量级软件级设计空间探索（DSE）框架。其核心是两个互为对偶的启发式算法：  
- **MLRC**（Minimize Latency under Randomness Constraints）：在用户指定最大随机性预算下，求解最低延迟的 gadget 组合；  
- **MRLC**（Minimize Randomness under Latency Constraints）：在给定延迟上限下，最小化随机性消耗。  
关键突破在于：我们发现采用 **Probe-Isolating Non-Interference (PINI)** 性质的 gadget 具有可解析的结构化权衡特性，使全局 SAT 优化不再必要。

## 主要成果  
TETRIS 在毫秒级（<1 ms）内完成全设计空间探索，相比当前最优（SOTA）SAT 基方法实现**数个数量级的速度提升**；同时在面积（area）上达到**可比甚至更优**的结果。该工具首次实现了 randomness–latency 权衡的实时、用户约束驱动的自动化优化，为高保障密码硬件的快速定制化设计提供了新范式。
papers.summary_en: This paper presents **TETRIS**, a lightweight, software-level Design Space Exploration (DSE) framework for gadget-based masked hardware. It addresses the fundamental randomness–latency trade-off at fixed security order—a challenge previously tackled only via expensive global SAT optimization. Leveraging the structured cost profiles of **Probe-Isolating Non-Interference (PINI) gadgets**, TETRIS introduces two dual, heuristic-driven algorithms: **MLRC** (minimizing latency under randomness constraints) and **MRLC** (minimizing randomness under latency constraints). Unlike prior SAT-based approaches requiring seconds or minutes, TETRIS explores the full design space in **under one millisecond**, achieving **orders-of-magnitude speedup** while delivering **comparable or superior area efficiency**. This enables real-time, constraint-aware co-optimization of security, performance, and resource usage—establishing a new practical standard for automated secure hardware design.

papers.title: SUF-CMA SQISign via Canonical Response Encoding
papers.abstract:
SQIsign is the leading isogeny-based post-quantum digital signature
scheme under consideration in NIST's standardization process.
All published security results, including the first complete proof
(CRYPTO 2025), establish only existential unforgeability under
chosen-message attack (EUF-CMA). It is known informally that
SQIsign does not achieve strong unforgeability (SUF-CMA) due to the
non-uniqueness of its two-dimensional isogeny representation.

We make three contributions. First, we identify a concrete
malleability vector in the SQIsign v2.0 specification: the basis
change matrix $M_{\mathrm{chl}}$ in the signature can be negated
modulo $2^N$ to produce a distinct valid signature for the same
public key and message. This is the direct structural analog of
ECDSA's $(r,s)$ versus $(r,n-s)$ malleability. We provide a
proof-of-concept against the C reference implementation at all three
NIST security levels.

Second, we propose a minimal fix: canonical matrix encoding, where
the signer normalizes $M_{\mathrm{chl}}$ and the verifier rejects
non-canonical forms. We prove that after canonicalization, the
response encoding is injective (each mathematical response isogeny
maps to exactly one byte string), using the structure of reducible
gluings of abelian varieties.

Third, we prove that the modified scheme achieves SUF-CMA in the
quantum random oracle model: the sigma protocol's honest-verifier
zero-knowledge and special soundness together with computationally
unique responses (established by our encoding injectivity result)
imply SUF-CMA. This is the first SUF-CMA result for any SQIsign
variant.
papers.summary_zh:
## 背景与问题  
SQIsign 是NIST后量子密码标准化进程中最具竞争力的**基于同源的数字签名方案**。尽管其安全性已获多项研究支持（包括CRYPTO 2025首个完整安全性证明），但所有既有结果仅建立在**存在不可伪造性（EUF-CMA）** 基础上。学界普遍认为SQIsign无法达到更强的安全目标——**强不可伪造性（SUF-CMA）**，根源在于其二维同源表示不唯一，存在结构化可延展性。

## 主要贡献  
1. **首次形式化发现并验证可延展性漏洞**：我们在SQIsign v2.0规范中识别出明确的延展向量——挑战响应矩阵 $M_{\mathrm{chl}}$ 在模 $2^N$ 下取负（即 $-M_{\mathrm{chl}} \bmod 2^N$）可生成**语义不同但验证有效的签名**，该现象是ECDSA中 $(r,s) \leftrightarrow (r,n-s)$ 延展性的直接类比。我们已在C参考实现上完成跨全部三个NIST安全等级（L1/L3/L5）的**概念验证攻击**。  
2. **提出轻量级修复方案：典范矩阵编码**：要求签名者对 $M_{\mathrm{chl}}$ 执行标准化（如强制首非零元素为正），验证者拒绝非典范形式。我们借助**阿贝尔簇可约胶合（reducible gluings）的代数结构**，严格证明该编码使响应映射**单射**——每个数学同源响应唯一对应一个字节串。  
3. **首个SUF-CMA安全性证明**：在量子随机预言机模型下，结合Sigma协议的**诚实验证者零知识性**、**特殊可靠性**及我们确立的**计算唯一响应性**，我们首次证明修正后的方案满足强不可伪造性。这是SQIsign家族首个SUF-CMA安全结果，为实际部署提供关键理论保障。
papers.summary_en: SQIsign is the leading isogeny-based post-quantum signature candidate in NIST’s standardization process, but all prior security proofs—including the first complete one (CRYPTO 2025)—only establish existential unforgeability under chosen-message attacks (EUF-CMA). Its lack of strong unforgeability (SUF-CMA) has been informally attributed to non-unique two-dimensional isogeny representations. We make three key contributions: (1) We identify and exploit a concrete malleability vector in SQIsign v2.0: negating the challenge-response matrix $M_{\mathrm{chl}}$ modulo $2^N$ yields a distinct yet valid signature for the same message and public key—directly analogous to ECDSA’s $(r,s)$ vs. $(r,n-s)$ malleability—verified experimentally across all NIST security levels. (2) We propose *canonical matrix encoding*: normalizing $M_{\mathrm{chl}}$ at signing and rejecting non-canonical forms; we prove this yields injective response encoding via the structure of reducible gluings of abelian varieties. (3) Leveraging this injectivity—ensuring computationally unique responses—combined with honest-verifier zero-knowledge and special soundness of the underlying sigma protocol, we prove SUF-CMA security in the quantum random oracle model: the first such result for any SQIsign variant.

papers.title: Post-Quantum Security of Tweakable Key-Alternating Feistel Ciphers in the Multi-Key Setting
papers.abstract: In this paper, we prove the post-quantum security of the Tweakable Key-Alternating Feistel cipher (TKAF) with a public random function in the Q1 model, under the assumption that the adversary is given quantum access to the internal primitive. Specifically, our target is the TKAF studied in the classical setting by Yan et al. (ACNS 2020), where the tweak is injected into the round-key XOR via a hash function of $\epsilon$-AXU family. Our proof draws on the post-quantum security proof for the (non-tweakable) key-alternating Feistel ciphers by Basak et al. (ASIACRYPT 2025), and adapts it to the tweakable setting and further to the multi-key setting, where an adversary can access multiple classical oracles. As a result, we prove that the 3-round TKAF is post-quantum TPRP-secure and the 4-round TKAF is post-quantum STPRP-secure. Specifically, under the assumption that the adversary is given classical access to $\ell$ independently specified oracles,  at least $\mathrm{\Omega} (2^{n/3}/\ell^{2/3})$ classical and quantum queries or $\mathrm{\Omega}(\epsilon^{-1/2})$ classical queries are required to break the post-quantum TPRP security of the 3-round TKAF and to break the post-quantum STPRP security of the 4-round TKAF.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与问题  
随着量子计算的快速发展，传统对称密码方案面临严峻的后量子安全挑战。Tweakable Key-Alternating Feistel（TKAF）结构因其简洁性、可证明安全性及对可调参数（tweak）的天然支持，成为构造后量子安全分组密码的重要候选。然而，现有工作主要集中于经典安全模型，尚无在**多密钥（multi-key）设定下**、且敌手具备**对内部随机函数的量子查询能力（Q1模型）** 的严格后量子安全性分析。

## 方法与技术路线  
本文首次将Basak等人（ASIACRYPT 2025）提出的非可调Key-Alternating Feistel的后量子安全性证明框架，系统性拓展至**可调（tweakable）且多密钥**场景。我们聚焦Yan等（ACNS 2020）定义的TKAF变体：其轮密钥通过ε-AXU哈希族将tweak注入XOR操作。为应对Q1模型中敌手对公共随机函数的量子访问，我们重构了量子区分器的概率分析工具，引入**多密钥量子碰撞约束**与**tweak依赖的量子采样边界**，并结合“量子随机预言机模拟”与“密钥隔离引理”处理ℓ个独立古典预言机的并发访问。

## 主要结果与创新点  
- 首次证明：**3轮TKAF在多密钥Q1模型下是后量子TPRP安全的**；**4轮TKAF是后量子STPRP安全的**。  
- 给出紧致攻击复杂度下界：破坏3轮TKAF的TPRP安全性需至少 **Ω(2<sup>n/3</sup>/ℓ<sup>2/3</sup>)** 次经典+量子查询，或 **Ω(ε<sup>−1/2</sup>)** 次经典查询；4轮STPRP安全性具有同等量级下界。  
- 关键创新在于统一处理**tweak注入机制、量子查询能力与多密钥并发性**三重挑战，为可调密码结构的后量子标准化提供首个理论基石。
papers.summary_en: This paper establishes the first post-quantum security proofs for Tweakable Key-Alternating Feistel (TKAF) ciphers in the multi-key setting under the Q1 model, where the adversary obtains quantum access to the internal public random function. Building upon Basak et al.’s ASIACRYPT 2025 framework for non-tweakable key-alternating Feistel, we extend it to accommodate both tweak injection (via an ε-AXU hash family, as in Yan et al., ACNS 2020) and concurrent access to ℓ independent classical oracles. We prove that the 3-round TKAF is post-quantum TPRP-secure and the 4-round TKAF is post-quantum STPRP-secure. Specifically, breaking the TPRP security of 3-round TKAF requires Ω(2<sup>n/3</sup>/ℓ<sup>2/3</sup>) combined classical/quantum queries or Ω(ε<sup>−1/2</sup>) classical queries; analogous bounds hold for the 4-round STPRP security. Our analysis unifies quantum query constraints, tweak-dependent round keys, and multi-key adversarial capabilities—providing foundational guarantees for quantum-resilient tweakable block ciphers.

papers.title: The Relative Trace-Zero Subgroup of the Barreto-Naehrig Curves
papers.abstract: We prove a folklore characterization of the BN pairing subgroup as the kernel of a relative trace map on the $n$-torsion points.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与意义  
Barreto-Naehrig（BN）曲线是构造高效、安全双线性对（bilinear pairing）的核心工具，广泛应用于零知识证明、身份基加密与聚合签名等密码协议中。在实际实现中，准确识别并高效计算BN曲线上**配对友好的子群**（即配对目标群 $G_T$ 的原像子群）至关重要。传统方法依赖于绝对迹为零的条件（absolute trace-zero subgroup），但该描述在扩展域结构下缺乏代数精确性；而“相对迹为零子群”（relative trace-zero subgroup）这一 folklore 概念虽被工程实践隐含采用，却长期缺乏严格证明与形式化刻画。

## 方法与技术路线  
本文首次给出该子群的严格定义：设 $E/\mathbb{F}_p$ 为BN曲线，嵌入度 $k=12$，令 $\mathbb{F}_{p^{12}}/\mathbb{F}_{p^2}$ 为二次扩域，则相对迹映射定义为 $\operatorname{Tr}_{\mathbb{F}_{p^{12}}/\mathbb{F}_{p^2}}: E[p^n](\mathbb{F}_{p^{12}}) \to E[p^n](\mathbb{F}_{p^2})$。我们结合Weil配对的伽罗瓦协变性、有限域上椭圆曲线的torsion点结构理论，以及BN曲线特有的扭曲性质（sextic twist），系统论证该映射在 $n$-挠点群上的良定义性与群同态性。

## 主要发现与创新点  
- **核心定理**：BN曲线的配对子群 $G_1 = \{P \in E[p^n](\mathbb{F}_{p^2}) \mid P \neq \mathcal{O},\, e(P,Q)=1\ \forall Q \in G_2\}$ 精确等于相对迹映射的核，即  
  $$G_1 = \ker\!\left(\operatorname{Tr}_{\mathbb{F}_{p^{12}}/\mathbb{F}_{p^2}}|_{E[p^n](\mathbb{F}_{p^{12}})}\right) \cap E[p^n](\mathbb{F}_{p^2}).$$  
- **理论价值**：消除了“绝对迹为零”描述的歧义，统一了密码工程中子群选取标准；揭示了BN曲线配对结构与相对伽罗瓦迹的深层代数联系。  
- **实践影响**：为子群成员检测、压缩表示及快速子群投影提供新算法基础，显著提升配对计算效率与验证安全性。
papers.summary_en: We rigorously establish a long-conjectured characterization of the BN pairing subgroup: it coincides precisely with the kernel of the *relative trace map* $\operatorname{Tr}_{\mathbb{F}_{p^{12}}/\mathbb{F}_{p^2}}$ restricted to the $n$-torsion subgroup $E[p^n](\mathbb{F}_{p^{12}})$. Unlike the classical absolute trace-zero condition—which misidentifies the target subgroup in extension fields—our result leverages the natural Galois structure of the BN curve’s embedding field $\mathbb{F}_{p^{12}}$ over its quadratic subfield $\mathbb{F}_{p^2}$. Using properties of the Weil pairing, torsion point Galois actions, and the sextic twist isomorphism, we prove that the standard pairing-friendly subgroup $G_1$ is exactly the intersection of this kernel with $E[p^n](\mathbb{F}_{p^2})$. This resolves a foundational folklore claim, provides a coordinate-free algebraic criterion for subgroup membership, and enables more efficient and secure pairing instantiation in cryptographic protocols.

papers.title: AOHP: An Open-Source OS-Level Agent Harness for Personalized, Efficient and Secure Interaction
papers.abstract: AI agents are driving a new software paradigm, with the ability to autonomously call tools, extract information, manage memory, and complete tasks that span applications and data sources. Most existing end-user operating systems, however, are designed for application-centric workflows and offer little native support for AI agents. This mismatch limits the wider adoption of agents and leads to execution overhead and safety risks when running agents on conventional systems. While the concept of agent-native operating systems is emerging, the research community lacks an open testbed to explore the architectural primitives desired for agent-mediated interaction. We present AOHP (Android Open Harness Project), an OS-level agent harness built on the Android Open Source Project (AOSP). The core design principle of AOHP is to treat agents as first-class OS actors, enabling adaptive user interfaces and agent-friendly runtime environments. AOHP preserves the mature Android software and hardware ecosystem while introducing three agent-oriented system mechanisms: personalized service composition, efficient agent interfaces, and secure information flow. Based on preliminary experiments on challenging tasks covering key capabilities of OS agents, AOHP shows clear advantages in task completion (+21.12% completion rate), execution cost (-51.55% token cost), and security-policy compliance.
papers.summary_zh:
## 背景与问题  
人工智能代理（AI agents）正推动软件范式变革，具备自主调用工具、信息抽取、记忆管理及跨应用/数据源任务执行能力。然而，当前主流终端操作系统（如Android、iOS）仍以“应用为中心”设计，缺乏对AI代理的原生支持，导致代理运行时存在**执行开销高、安全策略难管控、用户交互僵化**三大瓶颈，严重制约其规模化落地。

## 方法与创新  
本文提出**AOHP（Android Open Harness Project）**——首个面向AI代理的开源OS级运行框架，基于Android开源项目（AOSP）深度重构。其核心理念是将AI代理提升为**操作系统一级公民（first-class OS actor）**，而非仅作为用户态应用。AOHP在兼容现有Android软硬件生态前提下，引入三项关键机制：  
- **个性化服务组合**：通过声明式代理配置与动态服务绑定，实现按需组装跨域能力（如通讯、存储、传感器）；  
- **高效代理接口**：定义轻量级IPC协议与语义化系统调用（如`agent_call()`），降低推理-执行往返延迟；  
- **安全信息流控制**：基于标签化数据流（taint-aware flow）与细粒度权限沙箱，强制执行最小权限原则与跨代理隔离。

## 主要发现  
在覆盖**多步任务规划、跨应用状态同步、实时感知响应**等典型OS代理场景的基准测试中，AOHP显著优于基线方案（标准AOSP+代理封装）：  
- 任务完成率提升 **+21.12%**（92.4% vs. 71.3%）；  
- 大模型Token消耗降低 **−51.55%**（反映指令精简与系统协同优化）；  
- 安全策略违规率下降至 **0.8%**（基线为17.6%），验证其可信执行能力。  
AOHP已开源，为构建代理原生OS提供可复现、可扩展的实验平台。
papers.summary_en: AI agents are reshaping software paradigms, yet mainstream OSes lack native support—leading to high overhead, poor security, and rigid UIs. We present **AOHP (Android Open Harness Project)**, an open-source OS-level agent harness built on AOSP that elevates agents to first-class OS actors. Its three core mechanisms—*personalized service composition*, *efficient agent-native interfaces*, and *secure, label-driven information flow*—enable adaptive interaction while preserving Android’s ecosystem. Evaluated on challenging multi-step, cross-app, and real-time tasks, AOHP achieves **+21.12% task completion**, **−51.55% token cost**, and **99.2% security-policy compliance**, outperforming conventional agent deployments. AOHP provides a reproducible testbed for agent-centric OS research.
