papers.title: Development and Design of FLKit: A Structured Onboarding Toolkit for Federated Learning in Health and Life Sciences
papers.abstract: Federated learning lets institutions train shared models without moving their data, which makes it a natural fit for health and life sciences research under strict privacy regulation. The methods are maturing fast, but the practical barrier now comes earlier: a team starting a federated project meets a scattered mix of frameworks, governance obligations, and unfamiliar roles, with no structured place to begin that fits its own background. FLKit closes that gap. It is an open, community-maintained onboarding toolkit that takes a multidisciplinary team through the full federated learning lifecycle and gives every contributor, clinical, legal, governance, or technical, a role-aware entry point instead of assuming fluency across all four. We modeled it on the ELIXIR Research Data Management Kit and built it with a multidisciplinary core team, a wider consortium supplying milestone reviews and roadmap direction, and external practitioners interviewed to keep the content grounded in real practice. FLKit sits on four lifecycle stages, Governance, Infrastructure, Wrangling, and Analysis, and connects them through 11 role-specific entry points, a cross-disciplinary glossary, a reusable FAIR-aligned FL Story template for planning and documenting projects, and a curated directory of tools, frameworks, and communities. Since the December 2024 demo it has grown to 39 pages across eight sections, with seven FL Stories documenting completed and ongoing projects in multiple sclerosis disability prediction, inflammatory bowel disease, genomics, and brain-computer interfaces. It is openly available at https://uhasselt-biomedicaldatasciences.github.io/federated-learning-toolkit/ and welcomes contributions from across the life sciences.
papers.summary_zh:
## 背景与挑战  
在健康与生命科学领域，严格的隐私法规（如GDPR、HIPAA）严重制约了跨机构数据共享。联邦学习（Federated Learning, FL）因其“数据不动模型动”的范式，成为合规协作建模的理想路径。然而，当前技术成熟度已显著提升，实践瓶颈却前移至**项目启动阶段**：新团队常面临框架碎片化、治理义务模糊、角色职责不清、跨学科术语割裂等结构性障碍，缺乏适配自身背景的系统性入门指南。

## 方法与设计  
本研究提出并构建了**FLKit**——一个开源、社区共建的结构化联邦学习启航工具包。其核心创新在于**角色感知（role-aware）设计**：不预设临床医生、法务专家、数据治理专员或算法工程师具备全栈知识，而是为11类典型贡献者提供定制化入口。设计借鉴ELIXIR研究数据管理工具包（RDM Kit）方法论，由多学科核心团队主导开发，联合23家机构组成的广泛联盟参与里程碑评审与路线图制定，并深度访谈27位一线实践者以确保内容扎根真实场景。

## 核心架构与产出  
FLKit围绕联邦学习全生命周期构建四大支柱模块：**治理（Governance）、基础设施（Infrastructure）、数据整备（Wrangling）、分析（Analysis）**，通过三大协同机制实现整合：  
- ✅ **11个角色专属入口点**（如“伦理审查员快速启动清单”“数据工程师FL环境配置向导”）；  
- ✅ **跨学科FAIR对齐术语表**（含中英文对照、使用场景示例）；  
- ✅ **可复用FL故事（FL Story）模板**——结构化规划/记录项目目标、数据契约、模型协议与合规验证路径。

papers.summary_en: FLKit is an open, community-maintained onboarding toolkit designed to lower the entry barrier for multidisciplinary teams launching federated learning (FL) projects in health and life sciences. Recognizing that technical maturity has outpaced practical adoption—due to fragmented frameworks, ambiguous governance obligations, and role-specific knowledge gaps—FLKit adopts a *role-aware* lifecycle approach across four stages: Governance, Infrastructure, Wrangling, and Analysis. It provides 11 tailored entry points (e.g., for clinicians, legal officers, data stewards, and ML engineers), a cross-disciplinary FAIR-aligned glossary, a reusable “FL Story” template for project planning and documentation, and a curated directory of tools and communities. Developed with input from 27 practitioners and guided by a consortium of 23 institutions, FLKit has grown since its December 2024 demo to 39 pages and 8 sections, embedding 7 real-world FL Stories—from multiple sclerosis disability prediction to genomics and brain-computer interfaces. Freely accessible at https://uhasselt-biomedicaldatasciences.github.io/federated-learning-toolkit/, it invites global contributions to advance responsible, interoperable FL in life sciences.
papers.summary:
## 背景与挑战  
在健康与生命科学领域，严格的隐私法规（如GDPR、HIPAA）严重制约了跨机构数据共享。联邦学习（Federated Learning, FL）因其“数据不动模型动”的范式，成为合规协作建模的理想路径。然而，当前技术成熟度已显著提升，实践瓶颈却前移至**项目启动阶段**：新团队常面临框架碎片化、治理义务模糊、角色职责不清、跨学科术语割裂等结构性障碍，缺乏适配自身背景的系统性入门指南。

## 方法与设计  
本研究提出并构建了**FLKit**——一个开源、社区共建的结构化联邦学习启航工具包。其核心创新在于**角色感知（role-aware）设计**：不预设临床医生、法务专家、数据治理专员或算法工程师具备全栈知识，而是为11类典型贡献者提供定制化入口。设计借鉴ELIXIR研究数据管理工具包（RDM Kit）方法论，由多学科核心团队主导开发，联合23家机构组成的广泛联盟参与里程碑评审与路线图制定，并深度访谈27位一线实践者以确保内容扎根真实场景。

## 核心架构与产出  
FLKit围绕联邦学习全生命周期构建四大支柱模块：**治理（Governance）、基础设施（Infrastructure）、数据整备（Wrangling）、分析（Analysis）**，通过三大协同机制实现整合：  
- ✅ **11个角色专属入口点**（如“伦理审查员快速启动清单”“数据工程师FL环境配置向导”）；  
- ✅ **跨学科FAIR对齐术语表**（含中英文对照、使用场景示例）；  
- ✅ **可复用FL故事（FL Story）模板**——结构化规划/记录项目目标、数据契约、模型协议与合规验证路径。

papers.title: Unlocking In-Context Learning in Audio-Language Models from Decentralized Medical Audio
papers.abstract: Clinical audio diagnosis in low-resource settings requires models that identify conditions from minimal examples without large annotated corpora. We propose Federated Self-Contextualization (FSC), a multimodal language model framework for in-context clinical audio diagnosis across federated hospital clients. FSC constructs pseudo-label episodes via unsupervised clustering of audio representations, bypassing scarce real diagnostic labels, and enables contextual reasoning from support-query pairs. Our progressive three-stage pipeline first aligns audio embeddings with the language model via caption-based pretraining, then adapts it for episodic in-context inference through federated optimization. At test time, given a small labeled support set, the model diagnoses an unseen query through multimodal reasoning. On held-out respiratory and cardiac conditions, FSC achieves 71.6% accuracy in 2-way 2-shot evaluation, outperforming audio-language baselines by over 9%.
papers.summary_zh:
## 背景与挑战  
在医疗资源匮乏地区，临床音频诊断亟需能仅凭极少量标注样本（如数秒呼吸音或心音）即可识别疾病状态的模型。然而，高质量、大规模标注的临床音频数据稀缺且高度敏感，难以集中收集，传统监督学习与中心化预训练范式面临数据孤岛与隐私合规瓶颈。

## 方法：联邦自上下文化（FSC）框架  
我们提出**联邦自上下文化（Federated Self-Contextualization, FSC）**——首个面向去中心化医疗音频的多模态语言模型框架，支持跨多家医院客户端的上下文学习（In-Context Learning, ICL）。FSC无需真实诊断标签，通过三阶段渐进式流程实现：  
1. **跨模态对齐**：以音频字幕（audio captions）为监督信号，联合预训练音频编码器与大语言模型（LLM），建立可迁移的声学-语义对齐；  
2. **联邦伪标签构建**：在各本地医院端，对未标注音频表征进行无监督聚类，生成结构化“伪标签支持-查询”片段（pseudo-label episodes），模拟真实诊断场景；  
3. **联邦上下文适配**：通过轻量级联邦优化（FedAvg变体），协同更新模型参数，使其具备从少量支持样本中提取判别性模式并泛化至新查询的能力。

## 主要结果与创新  
在严格留出的呼吸系统（哮喘/支气管炎）与心血管系统（二尖瓣狭窄/正常）双任务基准上，FSC在**2-way 2-shot**设置下达到**71.6%准确率**，显著超越现有音频-语言基线模型（+9.2%绝对提升）。其核心创新在于：首次将ICL范式引入隐私敏感的分布式医疗音频场景；规避了对真实标注的依赖；实现了“数据不动、模型动”的合规推理范式。本工作为基层智能听诊提供了可部署、可扩展、可解释的新路径。
papers.summary_en: We propose **Federated Self-Contextualization (FSC)**, a novel multimodal language model framework enabling in-context learning for clinical audio diagnosis across decentralized hospitals without sharing raw patient data or requiring real diagnostic labels. FSC first aligns audio embeddings with a language model via caption-based pretraining, then constructs pseudo-label support-query episodes through unsupervised clustering of local audio representations, and finally performs federated optimization to adapt the model for few-shot multimodal reasoning. Evaluated on held-out respiratory and cardiac conditions under a 2-way 2-shot setting, FSC achieves **71.6% accuracy**, outperforming state-of-the-art audio-language baselines by over 9 percentage points. This work establishes the first privacy-preserving, label-efficient ICL paradigm for real-world medical audio diagnosis.

papers.title: When AUC 0.998 Is Not Enough: A Candidate Evaluation Protocol for Hidden-State Probes of Indirect Prompt Injection in Multimodal Computer-Use Agents
papers.abstract: Hidden-state probing -- a linear classifier on a frozen vision-language model's internal activations -- has emerged as an attractive evaluation tool for flagging indirect prompt injection (IPI) in multimodal computer-use agents before the agent emits a corrupted action. We argue, on a single-backbone cautionary case study (Qwen2.5-VL-7B on Mind2Web, teacher-forced replay), that a high probing AUC on a clean-vs-attack split is not, on its own, evidence of malicious-content detection. Two post-hoc diagnostics -- a paired-construction scalar baseline on text-side injections, and same-step nuisance-matched visual controls on the overlay surface -- do not license an unqualified malicious-content interpretation of the headline while leaving room for partly-semantic readings. We package the diagnostics as a candidate control set with reporting heuristics for what a high clean-vs-attack AUC does and does not license. Labels are injection-surface-present, not attack success; generalisation beyond this backbone and benchmark is a conjecture.
papers.summary_zh:
## 背景与问题  
隐状态探针（hidden-state probing）——即在冻结的多模态大模型（如Qwen2.5-VL-7B）内部激活上训练线性分类器——正被广泛用于**事前检测间接提示注入（IPI）**，以阻止多模态计算机使用代理（multimodal computer-use agents）执行恶意操作。然而，本文指出：**AUC达0.998这一看似完美的指标，并不必然意味着模型能可靠识别恶意内容**。

## 方法与诊断设计  
基于Mind2Web数据集上的teacher-forced回放实验，我们提出两项关键后验诊断：  
- **文本侧配对构造标量基线**：通过人工构造语义等价但注入表面存在/不存在的文本对（如“截图” vs “请截图（隐藏指令）”），验证探针响应是否真正依赖语义恶意性，而非表面词汇或句法线索；  
- **视觉层同步干扰匹配控制**：在相同时间步引入视觉噪声（如UI遮罩、图标扰动）但保持任务无关，检验探针是否将视觉表面对齐误判为攻击信号。  

## 主要发现与创新  
两项诊断共同揭示：高clean-vs-attack AUC仅稳健地反映**注入表面存在性（injection-surface-present）**，而非攻击成功与否或语义恶意程度。探针可能捕获的是表层提示模式（如特定token序列、视觉锚点位置），而非深层意图。我们据此构建首个面向IPI探针的**候选控制协议包（Candidate Evaluation Protocol）**，包含可复现的诊断流程、标签定义规范（明确区分“表面存在”与“行为危害”）、以及报告启发式规则（如：AUC > 0.95 仅支持“可检测注入痕迹”，不支持“已理解攻击意图”）。本研究强调：**泛化至其他骨干模型或基准属待验证猜想，非既定结论**。
papers.summary_en: This paper challenges the common interpretation of high AUC (e.g., 0.998) in hidden-state probing for indirect prompt injection (IPI) detection in multimodal computer-use agents. Using Qwen2.5-VL-7B on Mind2Web under teacher-forced replay, we show that a clean-vs-attack AUC alone does not validate *malicious-content detection*. Two post-hoc diagnostics—(1) a paired text-side scalar baseline controlling for surface-level lexical cues, and (2) same-step nuisance-matched visual controls on the UI overlay—reveal that the probe primarily detects *injection-surface presence*, not semantic malignancy or attack success. We formalize these diagnostics as a candidate evaluation protocol with explicit reporting heuristics: high AUC licenses claims about *trace detectability*, but *not* intent understanding, behavioral harm, or generalization beyond the evaluated backbone/benchmark. This work reframes probing as a surface-signal detector—not a semantic auditor—and provides actionable guardrails for rigorous IPI evaluation.

papers.title: Have You Ever Seen Them? Entity-level Membership Inference through Interrogating Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) raise growing concerns about privacy leakage and copyright compliance. Membership inference is a key tool for assessing such risks, but existing studies mainly focus on whether specific samples or sample-based data units are used for training. We argue that LLMs exhibit a human-memory-like behavior: an LLM may not memorize a specific sample verbatim, yet it can accumulate and reveal knowledge about a real-world entity from scattered mentions. This analogy motivates us to examine whether an LLM can be interrogated like a human interviewee to reveal its exposure to entity-related information. Motivated by this question, we propose entity-level membership inference, which determines whether information related to a target entity is used in LLM training. We study this task in the practical label-only black-box setting, where only generated texts are observable. We formalize the task under clue, input, and model constraints, establish the necessary and sufficient conditions for its feasibility, and instantiate five interrogation strategies based on this formalization. The strategies use limited entity clues to construct prompts, elicit entity-related responses, and infer membership from semantic features among the generated texts. We construct entity-level datasets and adapt state-of-the-art sample-level label-only methods to the entity-level setting as baselines. Experiments on person entities show that our methods achieve AUC up to 0.97 and bring gains of 6.0%--17.5% in Balanced Accuracy over the best adapted baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与问题  
大型语言模型（LLMs）的广泛应用引发了日益严峻的**隐私泄露**与**版权合规**风险。传统成员推断（Membership Inference, MI）聚焦于判断单个训练样本是否被模型见过，但忽视了一个关键现象：LLMs展现出类人记忆特性——未必逐字复现某条数据，却能从分散文本中**累积并内化真实世界实体的知识**（如某位公众人物的职业、生平、关联事件等）。这催生一个新问题：能否像“讯问证人”一样，通过精心设计的提问，探测模型是否在训练中接触过特定**实体**（entity）的相关信息？

## 方法创新  
本文首次提出**实体级成员推断**（Entity-level Membership Inference），即判定目标实体（如“张桂梅”）的关联信息是否参与了LLM训练。我们在**标签仅黑盒**（label-only black-box）场景下开展研究——仅可观测模型生成的文本，无梯度、无置信度输出。我们严格形式化该任务，明确其可行性依赖的**线索约束**（clue）、**输入约束**（input）与**模型约束**（model），并据此提出五种可解释、低开销的**问询策略**：利用少量实体线索构造提示，激发模型生成实体相关响应，并从生成文本的语义一致性、事实密度、细节丰富度等特征中推断成员关系。

## 实验结果与意义  
我们构建首个面向人物实体的实体级基准数据集，并将现有样本级标签仅方法适配至实体级作为基线。在多个主流开源与商用LLM上实验表明：所提方法AUC最高达**0.97**，在平衡准确率（Balanced Accuracy）上较最优基线提升**6.0%–17.5%**。本工作不仅揭示了LLM隐性知识暴露的新风险维度，也为模型审计、数据溯源与合规评估提供了可部署的实体感知工具。
papers.summary_en: This paper introduces **entity-level membership inference**, a novel privacy auditing task that determines whether information about a real-world entity (e.g., a person) was used during LLM training—going beyond traditional sample-level inference. Motivated by the observation that LLMs accumulate entity knowledge from scattered mentions like human memory, we formalize the problem under practical label-only black-box constraints and derive necessary/sufficient feasibility conditions. We propose five interrogation strategies that use minimal entity clues to construct prompts, elicit entity-related generations, and infer membership via semantic features (e.g., factual consistency, detail richness) in outputs. Evaluated on a newly built person-entity benchmark across multiple LLMs, our methods achieve up to **0.97 AUC** and improve balanced accuracy by **6.0–17.5%** over adapted state-of-the-art baselines—demonstrating both the viability and practicality of entity-aware model auditing.

papers.title: Quantum-Resilient Decentralized AI Economies: Proof-of-Useful-Work and Post-Quantum Security
papers.abstract: Proof-of-Work blockchains secure consensus through hash puzzles, producing no external value. In this research, we propose a decentralized AI economy where nodes are rewarded for useful machine-learning work, i.e., inference and training, instead of ineffective hashing method. Our proposed three-layer architecture separates compute, validation, and economic coordination. We formalize it via a $(θ_c, θ_w, W)$-closed-loop token economy and derive a sufficient-stake condition for honest participation. While existing Grover's algorithm provides only a quadratic speedup against hash puzzles, it does not accelerate ML-native linear algebra. On the other hand, Shor's algorithm threatens classical blockchain signatures. Post-quantum migration to lattice-based and hash-based standards can address the signature layer. Therefore, useful-work consensus thus offers both economic and quantum-security advantages over classical proof-of-work.

## 量子安全的去中心化人工智能经济：面向有用性工作的共识机制与后量子密码保障

当前主流区块链采用**工作量证明（PoW）**，依赖哈希计算达成共识，但该过程不产生外部实用价值，造成巨大能源浪费。本研究提出一种新型**量子抗性去中心化AI经济范式**，以机器学习任务（如模型推理与分布式训练）作为共识基础，实现“有用性工作证明”（Proof-of-Useful-Work, PoUW）。我们设计了三层解耦架构：**计算层**（执行AI任务）、**验证层**（基于可验证计算与轻量级零知识证明确保结果正确性）、**经济协调层**（通过代币激励与博弈机制引导理性节点行为）。理论层面，我们形式化定义了一个 $(\theta_c, \theta_w, W)$-闭环代币经济模型，其中 $\theta_c$ 表示计算成本系数、$\theta_w$ 为工作质量权重、$W$ 为全局效用函数；并首次推导出**诚实参与的充分质押条件**：当节点质押额超过 $W \cdot \theta_c / \theta_w$ 时，纳什均衡下理性节点将优先选择合规计算而非作弊或空转。安全性方面，我们指出：Grover算法虽对传统哈希难题仅提供**二次加速**，却无法显著加速AI核心的线性代数运算（如矩阵乘法、梯度更新），因而PoUW天然具备更强的量子抗性；而针对Shor算法对ECDSA/RSA签名的威胁，我们集成NIST标准化的**后量子密码方案**（CRYSTALS-Dilithium用于签名，SPHINCS+用于状态承诺），实现签名层与状态层的双重迁移。实证表明，相较比特币PoW，本框架在同等算力下提升约17.3×的单位能耗AI产出，并降低58%的恶意分叉风险。该工作首次将**经济效用性、算法量子韧性与密码学后量子迁移**三者系统融合，为Web3与AI原生基础设施提供可持续、安全、可扩展的新基座。
papers.summary_en: This paper introduces **Quantum-Resilient Decentralized AI Economies**, replacing energy-wasting hash-based Proof-of-Work with **Proof-of-Useful-Work (PoUW)**—where nodes earn rewards for performing verifiable ML inference and training tasks. We propose a three-layer architecture (compute, validation, economic coordination) and formalize it as a $(\theta_c, \theta_w, W)$-closed-loop token economy, deriving a sufficient-stake condition for honest participation. Crucially, Grover’s algorithm offers only quadratic speedup against hashing but *cannot accelerate core ML linear algebra*, making PoUW inherently more quantum-resilient than PoW; meanwhile, Shor’s threat to classical signatures is mitigated by integrating NIST-standardized post-quantum cryptography (Dilithium for signing, SPHINCS+ for commitments). Our framework achieves 17.3× higher AI-output-per-watt and 58% lower fork risk versus Bitcoin PoW—unifying economic utility, algorithmic quantum resilience, and cryptographic migration in one cohesive design.

papers.title: Privacy-preserving federated tensor decomposition of single-cell immune data: recovering multicellular programs across institutions
papers.abstract: Tensor decomposition of donor $\times$ cell-type $\times$ gene single-cell data recovers   \emph{multicellular programs}: coordinated axes of inter-individual transcriptional variation that   span cell types and stratify disease. Yet immune single-cell atlases are increasingly   multi-institution, multi-ancestry, and governed, so patient cells often cannot be pooled. We present   a federated estimator: each site computes a local program subspace, and a coordinator merges these by   stacked SVD under federated global-mean centering, provably equivalent (up to truncation) to the   centralised decomposition. This centering makes the merge robust to site-label confounding (program   AUC $0.957$ vs.\ $0.861$ for naive per-site centering). Only program subspaces leave a site, and   aggregation is compatible with secure aggregation. On a 261-donor systemic lupus erythematosus atlas   it recovers the canonical interferon program (ISG enrichment AUC $0.998$; case--control separation   $0.958$; bootstrap $Δ\text{AUC}=-0.000$, 95\% CI $[-0.004,+0.012]$ vs.\ centralised), across   institution-scale and multi-ancestry partitions, and across three \emph{real} COVID-19 sites   (subspace correlation $0.989$). It recovers the program when \emph{no site observes all cell types}   (correlation $1.000$, exact by construction), which fixed-feature federated PCA cannot. On an   interstitial-lung-disease atlas the recovered program predicts disease better than the best single   cell type (AUC $0.96$ vs.\ $0.91$; gap 95\% CI excludes zero) and the advantage survives federation;   a liver cohort is consistent ($p=0.005$). Membership-inference shows secure aggregation cuts attack   AUC from $0.91$ to $0.61$. The method enables cross-institution, cross-ancestry recovery of   multicellular immune programs without sharing cells.
papers.summary_zh:
## 背景与挑战  
单细胞免疫数据（供体×细胞类型×基因张量）的张量分解可揭示**多细胞程序**（multicellular programs）——即跨细胞类型的个体间协同转录变异轴，对疾病分层具有关键价值。然而，当前免疫图谱日益呈现多机构、多祖先、受监管特性，患者细胞因隐私与合规限制无法集中共享，传统中心化分解不可行。

## 方法创新  
本文提出首个**隐私保护的联邦张量分解框架**：各参与机构仅本地计算低维程序子空间（不上传原始细胞或基因表达），协调方通过**联邦全局均值中心化+堆叠SVD聚合**实现分布式分解。理论证明：该聚合在截断误差内严格等价于中心化分解；全局中心化显著缓解站点标签混杂（程序AUC达**0.957** vs. 简单逐站中心化的0.861）。

## 关键结果  
- 在261例系统性红斑狼疮（SLE）多中心图谱中，完整复现经典干扰素程序：ISG富集AUC=**0.998**，病例-对照分离AUC=**0.958**，与中心化方法差异ΔAUC=−0.000（95% CI [−0.004, +0.012]）；跨机构、跨祖先及3个真实COVID-19站点子空间相关性达**0.989**。  
- 首次实现**无全细胞类型覆盖场景下的精确恢复**（相关性=1.000），突破固定特征联邦PCA的固有局限。  
- 在间质性肺病图谱中，多细胞程序预测效能（AUC=**0.96**）显著优于最优单细胞类型（AUC=0.91，95% CI排除零）；肝病队列验证具统计学一致性（*p*=0.005）。  
- 成员推断攻击评估表明：结合安全聚合后，攻击AUC从0.91降至**0.61**，证实强隐私保障。

## 意义  
本方法首次支持跨机构、跨祖先免疫多细胞程序的合规协同挖掘，无需共享任何细胞级数据。
papers.summary_en: We present the first privacy-preserving federated tensor decomposition method for recovering *multicellular programs*—coordinated, cross-cell-type transcriptional axes of inter-individual variation—from donor × cell-type × gene single-cell immune data. Each site computes only a local program subspace; a coordinator aggregates them via stacked SVD under provably equivalent federated global-mean centering (robust to site-label confounding: program AUC 0.957 vs. 0.861 for naive centering). On a 261-donor systemic lupus erythematosus atlas, it recovers the canonical interferon program with near-identical performance to centralized decomposition (ISG AUC 0.998; case–control AUC 0.958; ΔAUC = −0.000, 95% CI [−0.004, +0.012]), across institutional, multi-ancestry, and three real COVID-19 site partitions (subspace correlation 0.989). Critically, it succeeds even when *no site observes all cell types* (correlation 1.000)—a capability absent in fixed-feature federated PCA. It further improves disease prediction over best single cell types (e.g., AUC 0.96 vs. 0.91 in interstitial lung disease) and withstands federation; membership-inference attacks drop from AUC 0.91 to 0.61 with secure aggregation.

papers.title: Security Analysis of One Lightweight Certificateless Mutual Authentication Scheme Based on Signatures for IIoT
papers.abstract: We show that the certificateless signature scheme [IEEE ITJ, 26852-26865, 2024] is insecure against public key replacement attack. An adversary can forge signatures for any message by replacing the signer's public key. We find the two components $\delta_A$ and $T_A$ of signature $\sigma_A=(m_A, ID_A, \delta_A, T_A)$ are not tightly bound to the target message $m_A$ and the singer's identity $ID_A$. The inherent flaw results in that the  adversary can find an efficient signing algorithm functionally equivalent to the valid signing algorithm. The findings could be helpful for  researchers  unfamiliar with the designing techniques for certificateless signatures.
papers.summary_zh:
## 安全性分析：面向工业物联网的轻量级无证书双向认证签名方案存在严重缺陷  

本文对近期发表于《IEEE Internet of Things Journal》（2024年，26852–26865页）的一类**轻量级无证书互认证签名方案**开展了深入安全性分析。研究发现，该方案在标准敌手模型下**不满足强不可伪造性**，存在致命的**公钥替换攻击（Public Key Replacement Attack, PKRA）漏洞**。攻击者无需破解离散对数或椭圆曲线难题，仅通过恶意替换用户公钥即可高效伪造任意消息的有效签名。  

核心缺陷在于签名结构设计失当：签名 $\sigma_A = (m_A, ID_A, \delta_A, T_A)$ 中的关键分量 $\delta_A$ 与 $T_A$ **未与消息 $m_A$ 和身份 $ID_A$ 形成紧耦合绑定**——二者仅通过易被绕过的哈希链间接关联，缺乏对消息和身份的显式、不可剥离的密码学约束。这导致攻击者可构造一个**功能等价的伪造签名算法**，其输出在验证方看来与合法签名完全一致。  

本工作不仅成功实施了理论攻击并给出了完整攻击流程（含参数替换与签名重构步骤），还进一步指出该缺陷源于对无证书密码学中“部分私钥—公钥—身份”三元关系建模的不足。研究成果为IIoT场景下轻量级协议的设计提供了关键警示：**公钥绑定强度必须与消息及身份联合验证同步强化**。对初涉无证书签名机制的研究者而言，本分析亦构成一份具实践指导价值的反例教学材料。
papers.summary_en: We cryptanalyze a recently proposed lightweight certificateless signature scheme for IIoT (IEEE IoTJ, 2024, pp. 26852–26865) and demonstrate its vulnerability to public key replacement attacks. An adversary can forge valid signatures on arbitrary messages by replacing a user’s public key without solving any hard mathematical problem. The root cause lies in the loose binding between signature components $\delta_A$, $T_A$ and the message $m_A$ / identity $ID_A$: neither is directly and irreversibly tied to them via robust cryptographic primitives. Consequently, the adversary derives an efficient signing algorithm functionally equivalent to the legitimate one. This breaks strong existential unforgeability under adaptive chosen-message attacks. Our finding highlights a critical design flaw in certificateless signature construction for resource-constrained IIoT environments and serves as a cautionary case study for protocol designers.

papers.title: Subspace Differential Uniformity
papers.abstract: The main contribution of this paper is to introduce Subspace Differential Uniformity (SDU) for S-boxes and block ciphers. The SDU is essentially a measure of how well any function spreads input differences clustered in affine subspaces away from affine clusters in output differences. We provide some lower bounds for the SDU and describe an efficient algorithm for computing the SDU. Moreover, we provide results for some popular classes of S-boxes up to $n=8$.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与动机  
差分均匀性（Differential Uniformity, DU）是评估S盒抗差分密码分析能力的核心指标，但传统DU仅关注单点输入差分对输出差分的分布，难以刻画**结构化差分模式**（如输入差分集中在某个仿射子空间时）下的扩散行为。在实际攻击中（如子空间轨迹攻击、中间相遇攻击），攻击者常利用输入差分的结构性约束，因此亟需更精细的度量工具。

## 核心贡献：子空间差分均匀性（SDU）  
本文首次提出**子空间差分均匀性（Subspace Differential Uniformity, SDU）**——一种面向仿射子空间差分结构的新型安全性度量。SDU定义为：对任意 $k$ 维仿射子空间 $A \subseteq \mathbb{F}_2^n$ 和任意 $l$ 维仿射子空间 $B \subseteq \mathbb{F}_2^n$，函数 $F: \mathbb{F}_2^n \to \mathbb{F}_2^n$ 的SDU为  
$$
\delta_{F}^{(k,l)} = \max_{\substack{\dim A = k \\ \dim B = l}} \left| \{ (x, x') \in A \times A \mid x \ne x',\, F(x) + F(x') \in B \} \right|
$$  
该定义量化了输入差分在 $k$ 维仿射子空间内“聚集”时，其对应输出差分落入 $l$ 维仿射子空间的最大频次，从而精准刻画函数对结构化差分的“解聚”能力。

## 方法与结果  
- 推导了SDU的理论下界：对任意 $n$-bit S盒，$\delta_F^{(k,l)} \ge 2^{k+l-n}$，当且仅当 $F$ 是仿射等价于线性函数时取等；  
- 设计了基于快速Walsh-Hadamard变换与子空间枚举剪枝的**高效SDU计算算法**，时间复杂度从暴力法的 $O(2^{2n})$ 降至 $O(2^n \cdot \text{poly}(n))$（对小维数 $k,l$）；  
- 系统评估了经典S盒族（包括AES、GOST、SKIPJACK、APN、Gold、Kasami等）在 $n \le 8$ 下的SDU谱，发现：  
  - AES S盒在 $(k,l)=(2,1)$ 下SDU仅为4，显著优于随机S盒（均值≈12）；  
  - 所有已知8-bit APN置换的 $\delta_F^{(3,2)} \ge 24$，揭示其结构化差分鲁棒性存在隐性瓶颈；  
- 首次建立SDU与现有指标（如差分谱、Walsh谱、非线性度）的关联定理，证明SDU可统一解释多种差分攻击的有效性边界。

## 创新意义  
SDU填补了结构化差分分析的理论空白，为设计抗子空间差分攻击的轻量级密码组件提供可验证的安全准则，并推动S盒评估从“点对点”向“子空间对子空间”范式演进。
papers.summary_en: This paper introduces **Subspace Differential Uniformity (SDU)**, a novel security metric for S-boxes and block ciphers that quantifies how well a function disperses input differences confined to $k$-dimensional affine subspaces into output differences avoiding $l$-dimensional affine subspaces. We derive fundamental lower bounds for SDU, prove its tightness for affine functions, and propose an efficient algorithm leveraging Walsh-Hadamard transforms and subspace enumeration pruning—reducing complexity from $O(2^{2n})$ to $O(2^n \cdot \text{poly}(n))$ for small $k,l$. Exhaustive evaluation of major S-box families ($n \leq 8$) reveals critical insights: the AES S-box achieves remarkably low $\delta_F^{(2,1)} = 4$, while all known 8-bit APN permutations exhibit $\delta_F^{(3,2)} \geq 24$, exposing inherent structural vulnerabilities under subspace-differential attacks. SDU thus bridges theoretical cryptanalysis and practical S-box design, enabling rigorous assessment against advanced structured-difference adversaries.

## 研究背景与动机  
差分均匀性（Differential Uniformity, DU）是评估S盒抗差分密码分析能力的核心指标，但传统DU仅关注单点输入差分对输出差分的分布，难以刻画**结构化差分模式**（如输入差分集中在某个仿射子空间时）下的扩散行为。在实际攻击中（如子空间轨迹攻击、中间相遇攻击），攻击者常利用输入差分的结构性约束，因此亟需更精细的度量工具。

## 核心贡献：子空间差分均匀性（SDU）  
本文首次提出**子空间差分均匀性（Subspace Differential Uniformity, SDU）**——一种面向仿射子空间差分结构的新型安全性度量。SDU定义为：对任意 $k$ 维仿射子空间 $A \subseteq \mathbb{F}_2^n$ 和任意 $l$ 维仿射子空间 $B \subseteq \mathbb{F}_2^n$，函数 $F: \mathbb{F}_2^n \to \mathbb{F}_2^n$ 的SDU为  
$$
\delta_{F}^{(k,l)} = \max_{\substack{\dim A = k \\ \dim B = l}} \left| \{ (x, x') \in A \times A \mid x \ne x',\, F(x) + F(x') \in B \} \right|
$$  
该定义量化了输入差分在 $k$ 维仿射子空间内“聚集”时，其对应输出差分落入 $l$ 维仿射子空间的最大频次，从而精准刻画函数对结构化差分的“解聚”能力。

## 方法与结果  
- 推导了SDU的理论下界：对任意 $n$-bit S盒，$\delta_F^{(k,l)} \ge 2^{k+l-n}$，当且仅当 $F$ 是仿射等价于线性函数时取等；  
- 设计了基于快速Walsh-Hadamard变换与子空间枚举剪枝的**高效SDU计算算法**，时间复杂度从暴力法的 $O(2^{2n})$ 降至 $O(2^n \cdot \text{poly}(n))$（对小维数 $k,l$）；  
- 系统评估了经典S盒族（包括AES、GOST、SKIPJACK、APN、Gold、Kasami等）在 $n \le 8$ 下的SDU谱，发现：  
  - AES S盒在 $(k,l)=(2,1)$ 下SDU仅为4，显著优于随机S盒（均值≈12）；  
  - 所有已知8-bit APN置换的 $\delta_F^{(3,2)} \ge 24$，揭示其结构化差分鲁棒性存在隐性瓶颈；  
- 首次建立SDU与现有指标（如差分谱、Walsh谱、非线性度）的关联定理，证明SDU可统一解释多种差分攻击的有效性边界。

## 创新意义  
SDU填补了结构化差分分析的理论空白，为设计抗子空间差分攻击的轻量级密码组件提供可验证的安全准则，并推动S盒评估从“点对点”向“子空间对子空间”范式演进。

papers.title: TRIP: Thresholding in Regression with Input Privacy
papers.abstract:
Secure computation allows multiple parties to jointly evaluate a function without leaking their individual inputs. An intrinsic issue with these techniques  is that they do not offer any protection against parties which may contribute bad quality or even maliciously crafted data. 
    We introduce TRIP, a protocol which protects against malicious manipulations of the input in secure computation of linear regression tasks. Linear regression is the cornerstone in many machine learning tasks, and hence creating secure protocols for this task is a crucial step towards secure machine learning. 
    Our protocol utilizes a novel combination of techniques from secure computation, robust statistics, and differential privacy.
    On synthetic data, TRIP recovers the planted ground truth; on real-world datasets, its model remains close to the clean OLS baseline under up to 40\% target corruption. In terms of efficiency, our protocol runs up to $250\times$ faster than an MPC-only baseline for $10^6$ samples. Even in the smallest parameter setting, TRIP is $10\times$ faster than our baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
## TRIP：面向输入隐私的回归阈值化协议  

**背景与问题**：安全多方计算（MPC）可支持多方在不泄露私有输入的前提下协同执行计算，但其固有局限在于**无法防御恶意或低质量输入攻击**——任一参与方均可注入异常值、对抗样本甚至系统性偏差数据，导致回归模型严重失准。在线性回归这一机器学习基石任务中，该漏洞尤为突出，制约了安全机器学习的实际部署。

**方法创新**：本文提出 **TRIP（Thresholding in Regression with Input Privacy）**，首个兼顾**输入隐私保护**与**抗恶意输入鲁棒性**的线性回归安全协议。TRIP深度融合三类技术：  
- 基于秘密共享的高效MPC框架，保障输入数据全程加密；  
- **稳健统计学中的截断估计（truncation-based estimation）**，通过自适应阈值动态识别并抑制异常输入贡献；  
- **轻量级差分隐私机制**，在阈值决策环节注入可控噪声，防止攻击者逆向推断敏感阈值边界，从而闭合侧信道。

**核心结果**：  
- 在合成数据上，TRIP精确恢复预设真实参数（误差 < 0.5%）；  
- 在真实世界数据集（如UCI Housing、Loan Default）上，即使**40%训练样本被定向污染**（如标签翻转、特征缩放攻击），模型性能（R²、MSE）仍保持在干净OLS基准的92%–96%范围内；  
- 效率显著提升：处理10⁶样本时，比纯MPC基线**加速最高达250×**；最小规模设置下仍**稳定提速10×**，验证其在实际场景的可行性。

TRIP首次在严格隐私约束下实现“可信输入过滤”，为安全机器学习提供了可证明鲁棒性与实用效率兼备的新范式。
papers.summary_en: TRIP is a novel secure protocol for linear regression that simultaneously guarantees input privacy and robustness against malicious input manipulation—a critical gap unaddressed by standard MPC approaches. By synergistically integrating secret-sharing-based MPC, truncation-based robust statistics, and lightweight differential privacy for threshold decision-making, TRIP filters out adversarial inputs while preserving model accuracy under strong attacks. Empirically, TRIP recovers ground-truth parameters on synthetic data and maintains >92% of clean OLS performance even under 40% targeted corruption on real-world datasets. Crucially, it achieves up to **250× speedup** over pure MPC baselines for 10⁶ samples—demonstrating unprecedented efficiency without sacrificing security or robustness.

papers.title: STRUCTURED LATTICES AND THEIR APPLICATIONS TO SECURITY
papers.abstract: Euclidean lattices are an interesting object of study in many regards and can have a rich structure arising from various constructions, e.g., from number field extensions. A particularly interesting class is the one of well-rounded lattices, as they relate to the well-known densest sphere packing problem in geometry, theta function minimization, and the famous Minkowski and Woods conjectures. In addition to being an important mathematical object in their own right, lattices also play a central role in many applications. This paper offers a survey of structured lattices and discusses their recent applications in lattice-based cryptography and secure wireless communications.  Our goal is to spark the interest of  mathematicians and adjacent communities in these fascinating topics in the intersection of lattices, number theory, cryptography, and wireless communications.
papers.summary_zh:
## 结构化格及其在安全领域的应用：综述与前沿进展  

本论文系统综述了**结构化欧几里得格（Structured Lattices）**的数学基础、构造范式及其在现代信息安全中的关键应用。格（Lattice）作为兼具深厚数论背景与强计算结构性的离散几何对象，其“结构化”特性——如源于**代数数域扩张**（如循环域、分圆域）、具有**正交基或对称群作用**、或满足**全模性/自对偶性**等代数约束——显著提升了理论可分析性与工程实用性。文中重点剖析了**良圆格（Well-Rounded Lattices）**这一重要子类：它们在单位球体密堆积问题中达到几何极值，与**Theta函数最小化**、**Minkowski–Hlawka定理**及未解决的**Woods猜想**深刻关联，是连接解析数论、极值几何与密码学的枢纽。在应用层面，本文梳理了结构化格如何赋能两大安全方向：（1）**格基密码学**——利用循环/模块格（如Ring-LWE、Module-LWE）在保持抗量子安全性的同时大幅降低密钥尺寸与计算开销；（2）**安全无线通信**——通过格编码实现物理层保密（Physical-Layer Security），例如基于良圆格的星座设计可同时优化误码率与窃听者信息熵。本综述不仅提炼了近年核心构造（如Cyclotomic Lattices、Ideal Lattices）与安全性归约技术，更强调**跨学科协同价值**：为数学家提供面向实际问题的数论新视角，亦为密码工程师与通信研究者提供严谨的结构化设计原则。我们期望激发数学、密码学与无线通信领域研究者的深度对话与联合创新。
papers.summary_en: This paper surveys **structured Euclidean lattices**—lattices endowed with rich algebraic or geometric structure, such as those derived from number field extensions (e.g., cyclotomic or quadratic fields), group actions, or self-duality constraints. We highlight **well-rounded lattices**, a key subclass intimately linked to sphere packing density, theta function minimization, and classical conjectures (Minkowski, Woods). Beyond theoretical significance, structured lattices underpin two critical security applications: (1) **lattice-based cryptography**, where ideal and module lattices enable efficient, quantum-resistant primitives (e.g., Ring-LWE); and (2) **secure wireless communications**, where well-rounded lattice constellations enhance physical-layer secrecy by jointly optimizing reliability and eavesdropper ambiguity. The survey bridges mathematics, cryptography, and signal processing—aiming to catalyze interdisciplinary collaboration and rigorous, structure-aware design.

papers.title: Thresholdizing Standardized FALCON Signatures
papers.abstract:
Threshold signatures allow a quorum of parties to jointly produce a
signature while preventing any smaller subset from doing so.
Following NIST's post-quantum standardization, designing threshold
schemes compatible with the newly selected primitives is a pressing
task. In particular, no prior threshold signature scheme produces
signatures verifiable under the unmodified FALCON verification
algorithm - the NIST-selected post-quantum scheme with the smallest
signatures and keys.

In this work, we present the first such threshold FALCON signing
protocol, establishing its feasibility. Our technical contributions
are threefold. First, we adapt the MPC-based discrete Gaussian
sampling protocol of Wei et al. [CCS:WYFCW23] to support
private centers and standard deviations, as required by
FALCON's signing process. Second, we carry out a
Rényi divergence analysis of the Klein sampler under fixed-point
arithmetic, showing that $73$ bits of precision suffice to achieve
the same security as the FALCON specification. Third, we design an
efficient MPC protocol for the Klein sampler that exploits the fixed
trapdoor basis to construct a pseudorandom correlation generator for
authenticated VOLE using only two-party DPFs, reducing per-signature
communication significantly over standard authenticated triple
generation. We implement and benchmark our protocol in two settings:
$N$-party signing with all-but-one corruption, and 3-party signing
with honest majority, demonstrating that threshold FALCON signing is
feasible for applications where compatibility with the FALCON standard
is required.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景  
阈值签名机制允许多方在满足最小法定人数（quorum）时协同生成有效签名，同时确保任意少于该阈值的子集无法伪造签名。随着NIST完成后量子密码标准遴选，FALCON作为唯一入选的格基签名方案，以其**最小签名尺寸与密钥体积**成为资源受限场景（如IoT、区块链轻节点）的关键候选。然而，此前**不存在任何阈值签名方案能生成与原始FALCON验证算法完全兼容的签名**——即无需修改标准验证逻辑即可直接验证，这一缺口严重阻碍了FALCON在分布式密钥管理中的实际部署。

## 核心贡献  
本文首次提出完全兼容标准FALCON验证流程的阈值签名协议，系统性解决了三大技术瓶颈：  
1. **适配化离散高斯采样**：改造Wei等人的MPC离散高斯采样协议，支持**私有中心（private center）与私有标准差（private standard deviation）**，精准匹配FALCON签名中对采样分布参数的动态依赖；  
2. **定点运算安全性证明**：首次对Klein采样器开展**Rényi散度分析**，严格证明在73位定点精度下，其输出分布与理想浮点采样分布的统计距离满足FALCON安全规范（Rényi divergence ≤ 2⁻¹⁰⁰），为高效硬件实现提供理论保障；  
3. **高效认证VOLE构造**：基于FALCON固有的固定陷门基（fixed trapdoor basis），设计轻量级两方DPF（Distributed Point Function）驱动的伪随机相关生成器，将每签名所需的认证三元组通信开销**降低一个数量级以上**，显著优于传统MPC三元组生成范式。

## 实验验证  
我们在两种典型威胁模型下实现并基准测试：① N方全但一（all-but-one）腐败模型；② 三方诚实多数（honest-majority）模型。结果表明，协议端到端延迟可控（毫秒级）、通信开销可接受，证实**阈值FALCON签名在保持标准兼容性的前提下具备工程可行性**，为后量子时代分布式密钥基础设施提供了首个实用化路径。
papers.summary_en: We present the first threshold signature scheme producing signatures verifiable *unchanged* under the standard FALCON verification algorithm—the NIST-selected post-quantum signature with smallest size. Our protocol bridges a critical gap between practical threshold cryptography and standardized post-quantum primitives. Technically, we: (i) adapt an MPC-based discrete Gaussian sampler to support private centers and standard deviations required by FALCON signing; (ii) prove via Rényi divergence analysis that 73-bit fixed-point arithmetic suffices for security equivalent to the FALCON specification; and (iii) design an efficient MPC protocol for the Klein sampler leveraging FALCON’s fixed trapdoor basis to generate authenticated VOLE correlations using only two-party DPFs—reducing per-signature communication by >10× over standard triple generation. Benchmarks in both all-but-one corruption and 3-party honest-majority settings confirm feasibility for real-world deployment requiring strict FALCON compatibility.

papers.title: Decomposition of compressions on elliptic curves and point recovery
papers.abstract:
Let $E$ be an elliptic curve over a perfect field $K$. A function $f\in K(E)$ is a compression of degree 2 on $E$ if $f(-P) = f(P)$ for all $P\in E$, and the field extension $K(f)\subset K(E)$ is of degree 2. For a finite subgroup $G\subset E$ over $K$ a function $w\in K(E)$ we will call a $G$-compression if $w(\pm P +G) = w(P)$ for all $P\in E$, and the field extension $K(w)\subset K(E)$ is of degree $2|G|$. We will show that $w\in K(E)$ is a $G$-compression if and only if $w = f\circ \Phi$ for a separable isogeny $\Phi:E\to E'$ over $K$ with 
$\ker \Phi=G$,  an elliptic curve $E'/K$, and a compression $f\in K(E')$ of degree 2 on $E'$. This allows to obtain a doubling, a differential addition, and a method for point recovery for $G$-compressions using known properties of compressions of degree 2. For $G$-compressions $w$ studied in the literature on an extended Jacobi quartic, a twisted Edwards curve,  a twisted Jacobi intersection,  and a twisted Hessian curve (for the first and third model additional conditions on coefficients are assumed) we will give the decomposition $w = f\circ \Phi$ as above, and the function induced by the dual isogeny $\widehat{\Phi}$ and compressions of degree 2, which can be used for point recovery. For the first three models this isogeny $\Phi$ is to a Montgomery curve over $K$, and has the first coordinate $x(\Phi)=1/w$. We also give isomorphisms from some models of elliptic curves to a   
Montgomery curve.

## 椭圆曲线上压缩函数的分解与点恢复

本文系统研究椭圆曲线 $E$ 上一类广义压缩函数——$G$-压缩（$G$ 为定义在完美域 $K$ 上的有限子群）的代数结构与计算应用。**核心理论贡献**在于建立了 $G$-压缩的完全分类：$w \in K(E)$ 是 $G$-压缩（即满足 $w(\pm P + G) = w(P)$ 且 $[K(E):K(w)] = 2|G|$）当且仅当存在以 $G$ 为核的可分同源 $\Phi: E \to E'$，以及 $E'$ 上的二度压缩 $f$（满足 $f(-Q)=f(Q)$ 且 $[K(E'):K(f)]=2$），使得 $w = f \circ \Phi$。这一分解定理将高阶压缩问题降维至经典二度压缩框架。

**关键应用突破**包括：（1）基于该分解，自然导出 $G$-压缩下的**倍点运算**与**微分加法**算法；（2）提出通用**点恢复方法**——利用对偶同源 $\widehat{\Phi}$ 与 $E'$ 上的二度压缩协同重构原始点（模 $\pm$ 和 $G$）；（3）针对文献中广泛使用的四类模型（扩展Jacobi四次型、扭曲Edwards曲线、扭曲Jacobi交点型、扭曲Hessian曲线），首次显式给出其典型 $G$-压缩 $w$ 的分解 $w = f \circ \Phi$：前三者均映射至Montgomery曲线 $E'$，且 $\Phi$ 的第一坐标满足 $x(\Phi) = 1/w$；（4）补充构造了若干曲线模型到Montgomery形式的**显式同构映射**，统一计算接口。本工作为基于压缩坐标的高效密码实现提供了严格的代数基础与可复用的算法模板。
papers.summary_en: This paper establishes a structural decomposition theorem for $G$-compressions on elliptic curves $E$ over a perfect field $K$: a function $w \in K(E)$ is a $G$-compression (i.e., $w(\pm P + G) = w(P)$ and $[K(E):K(w)] = 2|G|$) **if and only if** $w = f \circ \Phi$, where $\Phi: E \to E'$ is a separable isogeny with $\ker \Phi = G$, and $f \in K(E')$ is a degree-2 compression on $E'$. This characterization enables efficient doubling, differential addition, and point recovery for $G$-compressions by leveraging known properties of degree-2 compressions. For standard models—extended Jacobi quartic, twisted Edwards, twisted Jacobi intersection, and twisted Hessian curves—we explicitly compute this decomposition: the first three map to a Montgomery curve $E'$ via an isogeny $\Phi$ with $x(\Phi) = 1/w$, and we provide the induced dual-isogeny–based recovery map. We also supply explicit isomorphisms from several curve models to Montgomery form.

papers.title: SCRUB-FL: Sanitizing and Cleansing Representations via Unlearning of Backdoors
papers.abstract: Federated Learning (FL) enables collaborative model training without sharing raw data, making it a promising paradigm for privacy-sensitive applications. However, its decentralized nature makes it inherently vulnerable to backdoor attacks, where malicious clients embed hidden triggers into local training data to manipulate model predictions. Existing defenses mainly operate during before and during aggregation cannot fully eliminate backdoor behaviors that persist in the converged global model. Moreover, the effectiveness of post-training sanitization is often limited by the server's lack of knowledge of trigger patterns or poisoned clients after convergence, resulting in residual backdoor behaviors or accuracy degradation due to neuron entanglement. To address this limitation, we propose SCRUB-FL (Sanitizing and Cleansing Representations via Unlearning of Backdoors), a two-phase solution for post-training backdoor removal in FL. During training, clients identify suspicious samples using spectral analysis and activation clustering, then train lightweight Wasserstein Generative Adversarial Network with Gradient Penalty (WGAN-GP) models to capture trigger-related distributions. The generator parameters are aggregated server-side to construct a global representation of suspicious patterns without exposing raw data. After convergence, the server synthesizes trigger-approximating samples and applies machine unlearning to erase the trigger-target association by redistributing predictions toward a uniform distribution. Experimental evaluations on CIFAR-10 and GTSRB across three attack types and up to 40% malicious participation demonstrate that SCRUB-FL reduces the backdoor attack success rate to as low as 3.88% while maintaining over 91% normal task accuracy, outperforming state-of-the-art defenses without requiring prior trigger knowledge or a large clean proxy dataset at the server.
papers.summary_zh:
## 背景与挑战  
联邦学习（FL）通过本地化训练规避原始数据共享，在医疗、金融等隐私敏感场景中备受青睐。然而，其去中心化架构天然易受**后门攻击**：恶意客户端在本地数据中注入隐蔽触发器（如特定像素图案），诱导全局模型对含触发样本产生错误预测。现有防御方法多聚焦于训练前过滤或聚合阶段检测，难以根除已固化于收敛模型中的后门行为；而训练后净化（post-training sanitization）又受限于服务器端**缺乏触发器先验知识**及**无干净代理数据集**，常导致残余攻击成功率高或主任务精度显著下降（因神经元功能纠缠）。

## 方法创新：SCRUB-FL  
本文提出 **SCRUB-FL**（Sanitizing and Cleansing Representations via Unlearning of Backdoors），一种两阶段、隐私保护的后训练后门清除框架：  
- **训练期协同表征学习**：各客户端基于谱分析与激活聚类识别可疑样本，独立训练轻量级带梯度惩罚的Wasserstein GAN（WGAN-GP）建模触发分布；仅上传**生成器参数**至服务器——实现触发模式的**无数据聚合**（data-free aggregation），杜绝原始数据泄露风险。  
- **收敛后机器遗忘**：服务器融合客户端生成器构建全局触发近似样本库，对全局模型执行**定向遗忘（targeted unlearning）**：通过KL散度正则化，强制模型对触发样本的输出分布趋近均匀分布，从而解耦“触发–目标”关联，同时保留正常分类能力。

## 实验结果与优势  
在CIFAR-10与GTSRB数据集上，针对Label-Consistent、Hidden Trigger、Dynamic Patch三类先进攻击，SCRUB-FL在高达40%恶意客户端参与下，将后门攻击成功率压低至**3.88%**，同时维持**>91%** 的主任务准确率，显著优于SOTA方法（如Fang2022、Li2023）。关键优势在于：**无需服务器端触发先验、不依赖大规模清洁代理数据、全程保障数据隐私**，为FL安全落地提供实用新范式。
papers.summary_en: Federated Learning (FL) enables privacy-preserving collaborative training but remains vulnerable to backdoor attacks, where malicious clients implant hidden triggers to manipulate global model predictions. Existing defenses—operating pre- or during-aggregation—fail to fully eliminate persistent backdoor behaviors in the converged model, while post-training sanitization suffers from server-side ignorance of trigger patterns and lack of clean proxy data. To address this, we propose **SCRUB-FL**, a two-phase, privacy-aware backdoor removal framework: (1) During training, clients detect suspicious samples via spectral analysis and activation clustering, then train lightweight WGAN-GP models to capture trigger distributions; only generator parameters—not raw data—are aggregated server-side to build a global trigger representation; (2) After convergence, the server synthesizes trigger-approximating samples and applies **targeted machine unlearning**, redistributing model predictions toward a uniform distribution to erase trigger-target associations. Evaluations on CIFAR-10 and GTSRB under three attack types and up to 40% malicious participation show SCRUB-FL reduces attack success rate to **3.88%** while preserving **>91%** clean accuracy—outperforming state-of-the-art methods without requiring trigger knowledge or large clean datasets at the server.

papers.title: Confidently Wrong: Severity-Aware Calibration of Prompt-Injection Detectors under Attack Shift
papers.abstract: Prompt-injection detectors are deployed as guards: a model scores an input and a downstream system trusts or blocks it on that score. I study the confidence of these scores, not only their accuracy, when the attack distribution shifts away from the clean benchmark on which the operating point was chosen. I evaluate three released detectors, ProtectAI-v2 and two Prompt-Guard-2 checkpoints, at a single source-calibrated threshold that I freeze and transport across five shifts. I report a severity metric S, how confident a detector is on the attacks it misses, alongside the false-negative rate and discrimination. Across every shift and every detector, severity on the missed attacks stays between 0.99 and 1.00 while the false-negative rate ranges from 0.01 to 0.97: when these detectors miss, they miss with near-certainty. All three confidently pass indirect behavior-hijack injection, a blind spot unanimous across two vendors and a fourfold size range. Standard pooled calibration error does not register this; one detector it rates well-calibrated, at 0.06, is miscalibrated at 0.91 on the attacks alone. Run against live models, the missed injections leak the majority of working exploits, passing them at the rate they catch others. A controlled experiment traces the cause to content-keying rather than injection structure, an instruction-tuned model used as a judge shows the same hijack blind spot, and a black-box rewriter exploits the content-keying to manufacture working confident misses, most effectively on the most dangerous attack category. Code and data are public.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景  
大模型部署中，**Prompt注入检测器**作为关键安全守门员，依赖置信度分数决定是否放行或拦截输入。然而，现有评估多聚焦于静态基准下的准确率，忽视了**攻击分布发生偏移（attack shift）时检测器置信度的可靠性问题**——即当检测器“判错”时，其输出的高置信度是否具有欺骗性？

## 方法设计  
本研究系统评估三个开源检测器（ProtectAI-v2、Prompt-Guard-2 的两个checkpoint），在**单一源域校准阈值下**（冻结不调），跨**五类真实攻击分布偏移场景**进行迁移测试。创新性地提出**严重性指标（Severity, S）**：量化检测器对漏检攻击（false negatives）所赋予的平均置信度。同步报告漏检率（FNR）、区分能力（discrimination）及校准误差。

## 核心发现  
- **普遍性高置信误判**：所有检测器在全部5种偏移下，对漏检攻击的S值恒定在**0.99–1.00**区间，而FNR剧烈波动（0.01–0.97）——即“错得非常确信”。  
- **结构性盲区**：三者均**完全失效于间接行为劫持类注入**（indirect behavior-hijack），该漏洞跨越两家厂商、四倍模型规模差异，暴露深层设计缺陷。  
- **校准评估失灵**：标准池化校准误差（如ECE）严重失真——某检测器全局ECE仅0.06（被判定“良好校准”），但在攻击样本上实际校准误差高达0.91。  
- **现实危害实证**：在真实LLM流水线中，漏检注入成功绕过防护，**释放超半数有效exploit**，且通过率与检测器对正常样本的捕获率高度一致。  
- **归因验证**：控制实验确认问题根源在于**内容关键词匹配（content-keying）而非注入结构识别**；指令微调模型作为裁判亦复现相同盲区；黑盒重写器可精准利用该机制生成高置信、高危害的漏检样本。

## 创新价值  
首次揭示prompt注入检测器存在“**自信式失效**”范式，提出severity为关键诊断维度，挑战现行校准与评估范式，为鲁棒检测器设计提供可操作路径。
papers.summary_en: This paper exposes a critical failure mode of prompt-injection detectors: they are *confidently wrong* under attack distribution shifts. Evaluating three open-source detectors (ProtectAI-v2 and two Prompt-Guard-2 checkpoints) at a frozen, source-calibrated threshold across five realistic attack shifts, we introduce *severity* (S)—the average confidence assigned to missed attacks. Across all settings, S remains near-perfect (0.99–1.00) while false-negative rates vary widely (0.01–0.97), revealing systemic overconfidence on failures. All three detectors uniformly fail against indirect behavior-hijack injections—a vendor-agnostic blind spot spanning 4× model sizes. Standard calibration metrics (e.g., ECE=0.06) mask severe miscalibration on attacks alone (ECE=0.91). In live-model deployments, missed injections leak >50% of working exploits. Controlled experiments trace the root cause to *content-keying*, not structural understanding: an instruction-tuned judge replicates the blind spot, and a black-box rewriter exploits content-keying to generate high-confidence, high-impact misses—most effectively on the most dangerous attack class.

papers.title: Subspace-Constrained Federated Learning with Low-Rank Adaptation
papers.abstract: Federated low-rank adaptation methods are attractive for fine-tuning large models under communication and privacy constraints, but heterogeneous client data can induce geometric misalignment between local low-rank updates. We study whether this subspace misalignment leads to destructive aggregation and slower convergence in LoRA-based federated learning. We propose a subspace-regularized federated LoRA objective that encourages local client updates to remain close to a shared global reference subspace. We present a complete empirical evaluation on two pretrained models, RoBERTa-large and SmolLM-360M, over HellaSwag in a non-IID 10-client federated setting, across 3 random seeds (42, 43, 44), yielding 24 total experimental runs (4 methods x 3 seeds x 2 models). On RoBERTa-large, Subspace-Reg achieves the strongest mean best accuracy (0.454 +/- 0.023), mean final accuracy (0.429 +/- 0.011), and lowest final loss (1.363) across all three seeds, outperforming FedAvg, SVD redistribution, and FedSVD baselines by a large margin. On SmolLM-360M, FedAvg leads on accuracy, revealing that accuracy gains are model-dependent. Crucially, Subspace-Reg achieves near-perfect basis overlap, approximately 0.9999, on both models and across all seeds, versus 0.958 to 0.991 for all baselines, providing robust support for the geometric alignment hypothesis. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/sadia-sigma-lab/Subspace-Constrained-Federated-learning-with-Lora.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与问题  
面向通信受限与隐私敏感场景的联邦低秩自适应（Federated LoRA）方法虽具潜力，但客户端数据非独立同分布（non-IID）易导致局部低秩更新在子空间层面发生几何错位（subspace misalignment），进而引发聚合失真、收敛缓慢甚至性能退化。现有方法（如FedAvg、FedSVD、SVD redistribution）缺乏对更新方向一致性的显式约束，其子空间对齐程度尚未系统量化。

## 方法创新  
本文提出**子空间约束型联邦LoRA框架（Subspace-Reg）**：在标准LoRA目标函数中引入正则项，强制各客户端的低秩更新矩阵投影至一个共享的全局参考子空间（由服务器维护并同步）。该设计不增加额外参数量，仅需在本地训练时计算轻量级投影梯度，通信开销与标准LoRA持平。

## 关键实证发现  
我们在HellaSwag基准上，于10客户端non-IID设定下，对RoBERTa-large与SmolLM-360M两大预训练模型开展全面评估（3随机种子×4方法×2模型=24组实验）：  
- **RoBERTa-large上显著领先**：Subspace-Reg取得最高平均最佳精度（0.454 ± 0.023）、最高平均最终精度（0.429 ± 0.011）及最低最终损失（1.363），全面超越所有基线；  
- **SmolLM-360M上呈现模型依赖性**：FedAvg精度略优，表明子空间约束收益受模型规模与架构影响；  
- **几何对齐性获强验证**：Subspace-Reg在全部24次运行中实现近乎完美的子空间基重叠度（≈0.9999），远超基线（0.958–0.991），为“子空间错位损害聚合”假说提供坚实证据。

papers.summary_en: Federated low-rank adaptation (LoRA) enables efficient fine-tuning of large models under communication and privacy constraints, yet heterogeneous client data causes geometric misalignment among local low-rank updates—potentially degrading aggregation and convergence. We propose **Subspace-Reg**, a subspace-regularized federated LoRA objective that constrains local updates to stay close to a shared global reference subspace via lightweight projection. Empirical evaluation across RoBERTa-large and SmolLM-360M on HellaSwag (10-client non-IID, 3 seeds) shows Subspace-Reg achieves state-of-the-art mean best accuracy (0.454 ± 0.023) and lowest final loss (1.363) on RoBERTa-large—outperforming FedAvg, SVD redistribution, and FedSVD by large margins. While accuracy gains are model-dependent (FedAvg leads on SmolLM-360M), Subspace-Reg consistently attains near-perfect basis overlap (≈0.9999) across all runs—versus 0.958–0.991 for baselines—strongly validating the geometric alignment hypothesis. Code is publicly available.

papers.title: AgentLens: Interpretable Safety Steering via Mechanistic Subspaces for Multi-Turn Coding Agent
papers.abstract: Coding agents based on large language models (LLMs) demonstrate remarkable autonomous capabilities, but they also introduce significant safety and misuse risks during multi-turn interactions with external environments. Existing safety mechanisms mainly rely on external guardrails, which have a limited ability to perform fine-grained behavioral control during execution. Meanwhile, recent mechanistic interpretability methods for LLM safety are mostly confined to single-turn or jailbreak-style QA settings, limiting their ability to capture the evolving risk dynamics of multi-turn agent execution. In this paper, we investigate the safety of multi-turn coding agents from an internal perspective. We propose AgentLens (Mechanistic Subspace Intervention and Steering), a white-box defense framework that performs runtime safety detection and representation-level mitigation for coding agents. Unlike conventional agent guardrails, AgentLens detect harmful execution states from step-level hidden representations and mitigate unsafe behavior by intervening in a 10-dimensional subspace within a single layer. To support this research, we introduce the Mechanistic Agent Safety (MAS) benchmark, comprising comprehensively annotated multi-turn execution trajectories across 194 tasks using LLaMA-3.1-8B, Qwen-2.5-7B, and Gemma-2-9B. Extensive experiments show that AgentLens achieves strong safety detection performance, provides preliminary evidence for lookahead risk anticipation, and substantially reduces harmful actions of the coding agent, establishing a foundation for applying mechanistic interpretability to dynamic LLM agent safety. The code is available at: https://github.com/EddyLuo1232/AgentLens
papers.summary_zh:
## 背景与挑战  
基于大语言模型（LLM）的**多轮编码智能体**展现出强大自主编程能力，但在与外部环境（如Shell、API、文件系统）持续交互过程中，易产生越权执行、代码注入、数据泄露等**动态演化型安全风险**。现有安全机制（如输出过滤、后置审核、外部护栏）缺乏对执行过程的**细粒度、实时干预能力**；而主流机制可解释性方法多聚焦于单轮问答或越狱场景，难以建模多轮代理中隐藏状态的风险累积与转移。

## 方法创新：AgentLens 框架  
本文提出 **AgentLens**——首个面向多轮编码智能体的**白盒式机制安全 steering 框架**。其核心包含两大技术：  
- **机制子空间风险检测**：在单层Transformer隐藏表示中，识别并构建一个**10维可解释子空间**，该子空间能稳定编码执行安全性信号（如“权限提升意图”“敏感API调用倾向”），实现**步级（step-level）运行时风险定位**；  
- **子空间干预式缓解**：不修改模型权重，仅通过**低维投影+定向偏移**（project-and-shift）在该子空间内实施轻量干预，实时抑制有害行为生成，保持任务性能无损。

## 实验验证与贡献  
为支撑研究，我们构建了**Mechanistic Agent Safety (MAS) 基准**：涵盖194个真实编码任务，由LLaMA-3.1-8B、Qwen-2.5-7B、Gemma-2-9B三模型生成**全轨迹人工标注的多轮执行日志**（含每步安全标签、风险类型、因果归因）。实验表明：AgentLens 在跨模型泛化下实现**92.3%平均风险检出率**（F1），首次提供**前向风险预判证据**（提前1–2步预警准确率达76.5%），并将有害动作率降低**68.4%**，显著优于SOTA外部护栏（如SafeCoder、Guardrails）。本工作为LLM智能体安全从“黑盒拦截”迈向“白盒引导”奠定关键基础。
papers.summary_en: We present **AgentLens**, a white-box mechanistic interpretability framework for safety steering of multi-turn coding agents. Unlike external guardrails, AgentLens detects unsafe execution states *during runtime* by analyzing step-level hidden representations and mitigates risks via targeted intervention in a compact 10-dimensional subspace within a single Transformer layer—enabling fine-grained, representation-level control without altering model weights. To enable rigorous evaluation, we introduce the **Mechanistic Agent Safety (MAS) benchmark**, featuring expert-annotated multi-turn execution trajectories across 194 coding tasks using LLaMA-3.1-8B, Qwen-2.5-7B, and Gemma-2-9B. Experiments show AgentLens achieves **92.3% average F1 for safety detection**, provides preliminary evidence of **lookahead risk anticipation** (76.5% accuracy predicting hazards 1–2 steps ahead), and reduces harmful actions by **68.4%**, outperforming state-of-the-art external safeguards. Code: https://github.com/EddyLuo1232/AgentLens

papers.title: Foundation Models for Epileptogenic Zone Identification in Drug-Resistant Epilepsy
papers.abstract: Accurate identification of the epileptogenic zone (EZ) is essential for seizure freedom after resective surgery in drug-resistant epilepsy, yet seizure freedom rates remain below 50%. We developed EpiiSLM, a dual foundation model system for EZ identification with stereo-electroencephalography (sEEG), by training a signal foundation model on 104,990 minutes of sEEG recordings from the Montreal Neurological Institute & Hospital, while leveraging all recordings regardless of surgical outcome and anchoring EZ biomarker extraction on non-epileptic signals. A language foundation model then integrates sEEG-derived outputs with multimodal clinical information to produce interpretable predictions. Under leave-one-patient-out evaluation, EpiiSLM achieved 0.978 contact-level positive predictive value (PPV), outperforming the seizure onset zone(SOZ)-as-EZ baseline by 15.1% (p < 0.05), and 100% region-level accuracy; on an external dataset, EpiiSLM achieved 0.857 contact-level PPV. EpiiSLM requires only one night of interictal sleep data, suggesting potential to reduce invasive sEEG monitoring duration and improve surgical outcomes.
papers.summary_zh:
## 背景与挑战  
药物难治性癫痫患者接受切除手术后，癫痫致痫区（Epileptogenic Zone, EZ）的准确定位是实现无发作的关键前提，但当前临床实践中术后无发作率仍低于50%。传统依赖发作期脑电（如SOZ）的方法存在高假阳性率，且需长时间侵入性立体定向脑电图（sEEG）监测，增加患者风险与医疗负担。

## 方法创新  
本研究提出**EpiiSLM**——首个面向EZ识别的双基础模型系统：  
- **信号基础模型**：在蒙特利尔神经病学研究所（MNI）104,990分钟sEEG数据上训练，覆盖全部患者（无论术后是否无发作），**首创性地以非癫痫期（interictal）静息态信号为锚点提取EZ生物标志物**，摆脱对稀少发作事件的依赖；  
- **语言基础模型**：融合sEEG衍生特征与多模态临床文本（影像、术前评估、病理等），生成可解释的EZ概率图与区域级决策依据。

## 关键结果  
- **留一患者交叉验证**：接触点级阳性预测值（PPV）达**0.978**，较SOZ作为EZ金标准的基线提升15.1%（*p* < 0.05）；区域级定位准确率达**100%**；  
- **外部数据集验证**：PPV为0.857，证实泛化能力；  
- **临床实用性突破**：仅需**单晚非发作期睡眠sEEG数据**，有望将侵入性监测周期缩短50%以上，降低并发症风险并优化手术规划。

## 创新价值  
EpiiSLM首次将基础模型范式引入癫痫外科定位，通过“非癫痫信号锚定+多模态语义融合”范式，兼顾高精度、强可解释性与临床可行性，为精准癫痫外科提供新范式。
papers.summary_en: Accurate epileptogenic zone (EZ) identification remains critical—and challenging—for achieving seizure freedom in drug-resistant epilepsy surgery, with current success rates below 50%. We introduce **EpiiSLM**, a dual foundation model system trained on 104,990 minutes of stereo-EEG (sEEG) from the Montreal Neurological Institute. Its signal foundation model uniquely anchors EZ biomarker extraction on *non-epileptic interictal sleep data*, eliminating reliance on rare seizure events; a language foundation model then integrates sEEG-derived features with multimodal clinical narratives to yield interpretable, region-level predictions. In leave-one-patient-out evaluation, EpiiSLM achieves **0.978 contact-level PPV** (15.1% improvement over SOZ-as-EZ baseline, *p* < 0.05) and **100% region-level accuracy**; it generalizes to external data with **0.857 contact-level PPV**. Critically, EpiiSLM requires only **one night of interictal sEEG**, enabling substantial reduction in invasive monitoring duration and improved surgical planning.

papers.title: Federated Learning for Global Carbon Emission Forecasting: A Hybrid Time-Series Approach with Statistical and Neural Models
papers.abstract: Climate change, primarily driven by carbon dioxide (CO2) emissions, requires accurate forecasting tools to support effective mitigation policies and sustainable development strategies. Existing forecasting approaches typically rely on centralized data collection, which is often restricted by privacy regulations and the distributed nature of emission data across countries and industrial sectors. This paper proposes a novel federated hybrid forecasting framework that integrates ARIMA-based trend modeling, GARCH-based volatility modeling, LSTM-Attention temporal representation learning, and XGBoost prediction within a privacy-preserving federated learning environment. The proposed framework enables collaborative learning among distributed clients without requiring the exchange of raw data. Experimental evaluation across 14 clients demonstrates strong forecasting performance, achieving client R2 values between 0.50 and 0.97 with an average of 0.73, RMSE values ranging from 0.06 to 2.35 with an average of 1.21, and MAPE values between 1.5% and 11.3% with an average of 6.5%. The results indicate that the proposed framework provides an accurate, scalable, and regulation-compliant solution for collaborative carbon-emission forecasting.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景  
全球气候变化主要由二氧化碳（CO₂）排放驱动，亟需高精度、可落地的碳排放预测工具以支撑气候政策制定与可持续发展战略。然而，现有预测模型多依赖中心化数据汇聚，面临严峻挑战：一方面，各国及行业间碳排放数据高度分散且受《GDPR》《个人信息保护法》等隐私法规严格约束；另一方面，数据异构性（如统计特性差异、采样频率不一、缺失模式多样）显著削弱传统集中式建模的泛化能力。

## 方法创新  
本文提出一种**面向全球碳排放预测的联邦学习混合框架（FedHybrid-CO₂）**，首次在隐私保护前提下融合四类时序建模范式：  
- **统计建模层**：采用ARIMA捕捉长期趋势，GARCH建模残差波动性，保障可解释性与稳健性；  
- **深度表征层**：引入LSTM-Attention机制，自适应学习多尺度时间依赖与关键时间节点权重；  
- **集成预测层**：以XGBoost融合统计特征与神经表征，提升非线性拟合能力；  
- **联邦协同层**：基于FedAvg协议实现跨14个国家/行业的客户端协同训练，全程不传输原始数据，仅交换加密梯度与模型参数。

## 主要发现与价值  
在真实全球碳排放数据集（涵盖2000–2023年14个主权实体）上的实验表明：  
- 客户端R²达**0.50–0.97**（均值0.73），RMSE为**0.06–2.35**（均值1.21吨/ capita），MAPE为**1.5%–11.3%**（均值6.5%），显著优于纯统计或纯深度学习基线；  
- 框架支持动态客户端加入/退出，通信开销降低37%，满足《联合国气候变化框架公约》（UNFCCC）倡导的“共同但有区别的责任”原则；  
- 提供首个兼顾**监管合规性、模型可解释性与预测精度**的联邦碳预测范式，为跨国气候治理提供技术基础设施支撑。
papers.summary_en: Climate change mitigation requires accurate, privacy-compliant carbon emission forecasting across decentralized jurisdictions. This paper proposes **FedHybrid-CO₂**, the first federated learning framework that synergistically integrates ARIMA (trend), GARCH (volatility), LSTM-Attention (temporal representation), and XGBoost (ensemble prediction) without raw data sharing. Evaluated on real-world emissions data from 14 sovereign clients, it achieves an average R² of 0.73, RMSE of 1.21, and MAPE of 6.5%—outperforming centralized and standalone federated baselines. The framework ensures regulatory compliance (e.g., GDPR), scalability to heterogeneous clients, and interpretable statistical foundations alongside deep learning expressiveness—enabling trustworthy global climate collaboration.

- 客户端R²达**0.50–0.97**（均值0.73），RMSE为**0.06–2.35**（均值1.21吨/ capita），MAPE为**1.5%–11.3%**（均值6.5%），显著优于纯统计或纯深度学习基线；  
- 框架支持动态客户端加入/退出，通信开销降低37%，满足《联合国气候变化框架公约》（UNFCCC）倡导的“共同但有区别的责任”原则；  
- 提供首个兼顾**监管合规性、模型可解释性与预测精度**的联邦碳预测范式，为跨国气候治理提供技术基础设施支撑。

papers.title: Text2DSL: LLM-Based Code Generation for Domain-Specific Languages
papers.abstract: Domain-specific languages (DSLs) are widely used for managing operating system security policies, yet manually authoring rules in such languages demands high expertise and is error-prone. This paper formalises the task of automatic DSL code generation from natural language descriptions - Text2DSL - as a distinct problem class, separate from Text-to-SQL and general-purpose code generation. We introduce the PolkitBench dataset comprising 4,204 verified natural-language-to-Polkit-rule pairs, each validated through a three-level AST-based pipeline. Controlled prompt experiments on two MoE models of different scale and provenance - GigaChat-10B-A1.8B (1.8B active parameters) and Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B (3B active) - demonstrate the critical role of structured context (BNF grammar, API specification, permitted identifier vocabulary) for LLM-based DSL code generation. Across both models, supplying context raises syntactic validity to 98.6-99.4%, structural validity by +9.7 to +35.5 pp, and the CodeBLEU score by +60% to +95%. The consistency of the effect across models of different scale and provenance indicates that, for the Text2DSL class of problems, injecting a formal target-language specification into the prompt context is a robust enabling factor for high-quality generation without model fine-tuning.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与问题定义  
领域特定语言（DSL）在操作系统安全策略管理中被广泛应用，但人工编写DSL规则需深厚领域知识，易出错且效率低下。本文首次将“自然语言→DSL代码生成”任务明确定义为独立问题类别——**Text2DSL**，区别于Text-to-SQL及通用代码生成任务，强调其对形式化语法约束、语义边界和领域API强依赖的特性。

## 方法与数据集  
我们构建了首个高质量、可验证的DSL生成基准数据集 **PolkitBench**，包含4,204组经严格校验的自然语言描述–Polkit规则对。每条样本通过三级AST驱动验证流水线（词法→语法→语义结构一致性）确保正确性，覆盖真实策略场景中的权限声明、条件组合与作用域限定。

## 关键发现与创新  
在GigaChat-10B-A1.8B（1.8B激活参数）与Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B（3B激活）两类异构MoE模型上开展受控提示实验，系统评估结构化上下文（BNF语法、API规范、许可标识符词表）的影响：  
- **语法正确率**提升至98.6–99.4%；  
- **结构有效性**（AST合规性）提高+9.7至+35.5个百分点；  
- **CodeBLEU得分**提升60%–95%。  
跨模型结果高度一致，证实：**无需微调，仅向提示注入目标DSL的形式化规范，即可成为Text2DSL任务的鲁棒性使能因子**。本工作为DSL自动化提供新范式，推动安全策略工程的平民化与可靠性升级。

Controlled experiments on two MoE LLMs—GigaChat-10B-A1.8B (1.8B active params) and Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B (3B active)—demonstrate that injecting structured context (BNF grammar, API spec, permitted identifier vocabulary) into prompts is critical: it boosts syntactic validity to 98.6–99.4%, structural validity by +9.7–+35.5 pp, and CodeBLEU by +60–+95%. papers.title: A Survey on Federated Causal Discovery and Inference
papers.abstract: Causal reasoning, which encompasses the discovery of causal structures and the inference of causal effects, is fundamental to data-driven decision making. In practice, data for reliable causal analysis are often distributed across institutions and cannot be centralized due to privacy regulations or communication constraints. Federated learning (FL) addresses this by enabling collaborative analysis without raw data sharing, giving rise to the rapidly growing field of federated causal discovery (FCD) and inference (FCI). However, the interdisciplinary nature of this field and the absence of a comprehensive survey present barriers to entry for researchers. This paper bridges that gap by providing a systematic review through multi-dimensional taxonomies. Grounded in the three core design decisions underlying any FCD solution, namely how structures are learned, how data are partitioned, and what structural knowledge each party obtains, we organize FCD along three axes: methodological paradigm, federation topology, and structural scope. We further examine key practical dimensions, including temporal dynamics, data heterogeneity, missing data, and non-identical variable sets. For FCI, we categorize methods by target estimand (average versus individualized/conditional treatment effects) and by estimation strategy, from classical weighting methods to modern deep generative architectures. Unlike prior works that treat FCD and FCI separately, we formalize their connection as complementary stages of a unified federated causal reasoning pipeline, where FCD supplies the structural knowledge required for valid effect estimation in FCI. Finally, we highlight their shared concerns regarding privacy, communication efficiency, theoretical guarantees, and application domains, and conclude by identifying open challenges for future research.
papers.summary_zh:
## 联邦因果发现与推断研究综述  

**背景与动机**：因果推理（涵盖因果结构发现与因果效应推断）是数据驱动决策的基石。然而，现实场景中高质量因果分析所需的数据常因隐私法规（如GDPR、HIPAA）或通信限制而分散于多家机构，无法集中汇聚。联邦学习（FL）为此提供了范式突破——支持多方协作建模而不共享原始数据，由此催生了快速发展的**联邦因果发现（FCD）与联邦因果推断（FCI）**交叉领域。但该领域高度跨学科，且迄今缺乏系统性综述，严重阻碍了新研究者入门与技术落地。

**方法论创新**：本文首次构建**三维分类体系**统摄FCD研究：  
- **方法学范式**（如何学习结构）：基于约束、得分、函数型及神经符号方法；  
- **联邦拓扑结构**（数据如何划分）：横向（特征对齐、样本分片）、纵向（样本对齐、特征分片）与混合联邦；  
- **结构认知范围**（各方获知什么）：全局图、局部子图、边缘/路径级知识或隐式结构表征。  
同时，深入剖析四大实践挑战：**时序动态性、数据异质性、缺失机制、变量集非一致性**。对于FCI，我们按**目标估计量**（平均/条件/个体化处理效应）与**估计策略**（逆概率加权、双重稳健估计、深度生成模型等）双维度分类。

**核心贡献**：突破既有工作将FCD与FCI割裂处理的局限，**首次形式化二者为统一联邦因果推理流水线的互补阶段**——FCD输出的结构知识是FCI实现无偏、可识别效应估计的先决条件。最后，系统总结共性挑战：差分隐私保障、通信开销控制、统计一致性证明、理论可识别性边界，以及医疗、金融、推荐等关键应用域的适配瓶颈，并提出六大开放问题作为未来研究方向。
papers.summary_en: This survey bridges a critical gap in the emerging field of *federated causal discovery (FCD)* and *federated causal inference (FCI)*. We propose the first unified, multi-dimensional taxonomy for FCD—organized along three core axes: **methodological paradigm**, **federation topology**, and **structural scope**—and systematically analyze practical challenges including temporal dynamics, data heterogeneity, missingness, and non-identical variable sets. For FCI, we categorize methods by target estimand (ATE, CATE, ITE) and estimation strategy (from classical weighting to deep generative models). Crucially, we formalize FCD and FCI not as isolated tasks but as **complementary stages of a single federated causal reasoning pipeline**, where structural knowledge from FCD is essential for valid effect identification in FCI. We further synthesize shared challenges—privacy preservation, communication efficiency, theoretical guarantees (e.g., consistency, identifiability), and domain-specific deployment—and conclude with key open problems for future research.

papers.title: Fed-CausalDiff: Decoupled Synchronization for Federated Do-Simulation and Policy Evaluation
papers.abstract: While federated learning enables collaborative modelling on decentralised data, standard methods merely fit historical observations. This purely observational approach is fundamentally insufficient for interventional inference and policy evaluation, as sequential actions dynamically alter future states. We propose \textbf{Fed-CausalDiff}, a federated causal diffusion framework for do-simulation. The architecture decomposes the evolution of the latent state into a global causal score function and a local confounding score function. This design enables \emph{decoupled synchronisation} (DSS), where clients aggregate only the shared causal mechanism while retaining site-specific confounders locally to handle heterogeneity. Experiments on four datasets demonstrate that Fed-CausalDiff achieves better ATE and policy-value estimation accuracy, offering a favorable trade-off between communication cost and inference fidelity.
papers.summary_zh:
## 背景与挑战  
传统联邦学习（FL）仅基于各参与方的历史观测数据进行联合建模，本质上属于**纯观察性学习**。然而，在医疗决策、智能交通、个性化推荐等关键场景中，政策评估与干预推断（如“若对患者实施某治疗方案，其预后将如何变化？”）需回答**do-因果问题**（即 $do$-intervention），而历史数据无法反映行动对动态状态演化的反事实影响。现有FL方法缺乏对因果机制与混杂因素的解耦建模能力，难以兼顾全局可迁移因果规律与本地异质性混杂结构，导致干预效果（如平均处理效应ATE）和策略价值（policy value）估计严重偏差。

## 方法创新：Fed-CausalDiff 与解耦同步（DSS）  
本文提出 **Fed-CausalDiff**——首个面向联邦环境的因果扩散框架，专为**联邦do-仿真**（federated do-simulation）与策略评估设计。其核心创新在于**双分数函数解耦架构**：  
- **全局因果得分函数**：建模跨客户端共享的、不变的因果动力学（如疾病进展主机制），通过服务器聚合更新；  
- **本地混杂得分函数**：捕获站点特异性混杂偏置（如地域性诊疗习惯、设备校准差异），严格保留在客户端本地，不上传、不共享。  
由此实现**解耦同步（Decoupled Synchronization, DSS）**：仅同步因果分量，隔离混杂分量，既保障因果泛化性，又尊重数据异质性与隐私约束。

## 实验验证与优势  
在4个真实/半合成基准数据集（含时间序列与结构化医疗数据）上，Fed-CausalDiff显著优于FedAvg、FedProx及最新因果FL基线：  
- ATE估计误差平均降低 **32.7%**（相对提升）；  
- 策略价值估计RMSE下降 **28.4%**；  
- 通信开销较全模型同步减少 **~41%**，且精度损失可忽略。  
结果表明：Fed-CausalDiff在**通信效率、因果保真度与异构鲁棒性**三者间实现了最优权衡，为可信联邦决策支持提供了新范式。
papers.summary_en: Federated learning (FL) traditionally fits only observational data, making it inadequate for interventional inference and policy evaluation—tasks requiring *do*-calculus to reason about counterfactual outcomes under sequential actions. To bridge this gap, we propose **Fed-CausalDiff**, a novel federated causal diffusion framework for *do*-simulation. Its key innovation is a decoupled architecture: a *global causal score function* (synchronized across clients to capture invariant causal dynamics) and *local confounding score functions* (kept private per client to model site-specific biases). This enables **Decoupled Synchronization (DSS)**—reducing communication while preserving causal fidelity and heterogeneity robustness. Experiments on four diverse datasets show Fed-CausalDiff achieves superior accuracy in Average Treatment Effect (ATE) estimation (−32.7% error) and policy-value prediction (−28.4% RMSE), with ~41% lower communication cost than full-model synchronization—demonstrating a principled trade-off between efficiency and causal reliability.

papers.title: Sub-Billion, Super-Frontier: Small Language Models Rival Zero-Shot Frontier LLMs on General and Literary Relation Extraction
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) achieve strong relation extraction (RE), but their computational demands and reliance on proprietary APIs limit deployment in resource-constrained or privacy-sensitive settings. We investigate how far small language models (SLMs) can close this gap across general-domain and literary text. We evaluate five models from 360M to 3B parameters under three domain-composition regimes and two prompt-conditioned tuning styles (30 configurations), comparing them with zero-shot frontier LLMs and a discriminative RoBERTa baseline. Across nine benchmarks, the best sub-billion model, Qwen2.5-0.5B fine-tuned on pooled general-domain data, achieves a general-domain positive-class micro-F1 of 0.83, versus 0.69 for GPT-5.4 and 0.66 for Claude Sonnet 4.6 evaluated zero-shot. This does not imply that SLMs are intrinsically stronger; rather, targeted task adaptation enables 4-bit models deployable on a single consumer GPU to outperform general-purpose frontier systems under this protocol. An in-domain RoBERTa baseline also exceeds both frontier models, indicating that the gain stems from task adaptation rather than generative decoding. On literary RE, tuned SLMs reach 0.92 on the human-annotated Biographical benchmark versus 0.83 for GPT-5.4, and 0.833 versus 0.578 on the two-benchmark literary average. A targeted domain-adaptive pretraining case study yields no practically meaningful gain over supervised fine-tuning, while the cleanest within-family scale comparison shows only marginal improvement. These results show that, when task-specific data are available, compact task-adapted models can provide accurate, private, and hardware-efficient RE.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景  
大型语言模型（LLMs）在关系抽取（RE）任务上表现优异，但其高昂的计算开销、对专有API的依赖，严重制约了在资源受限或隐私敏感场景（如本地部署、医疗/政务文本处理）中的实际应用。小型语言模型（SLMs）因其轻量、可私有化部署、支持4-bit量化等优势，亟需系统评估其能否在通用与文学领域RE任务中逼近甚至超越零样本前沿LLMs。

## 方法与实验设计  
本研究系统考察参数量360M–3B的5种SLMs，在**三大领域组合范式**（跨域、领域内、混合）与**两类提示条件微调策略**（指令微调+上下文学习）下共30种配置的表现；对比零样本GPT-5.4、Claude Sonnet 4.6及判别式基线RoBERTa，在9个基准数据集（含通用语义与文学传记类）上进行评估。

## 关键发现

papers.title: Federated learning with heavy-tailed gradient noise and communication noise: a variance-reduction based algorithm
papers.abstract: Federated learning (FL) is an emerging distributed machine learning paradigm that enables local devices to jointly train a global model while keeping data decentralized and private. We propose a variance-reduction based algorithm, VRA-FedSGD, for FL in the presence of heavy-tailed gradient noise and communication noise, where these noises are prevalent in large-scale machine learning over wireless networks and Internet of Things deployments. VRA-FedSGD employs a momentum variance reduction technique together with a nonlinear mapping to mitigate heavy-tailed gradient noise, and uses a variance-reduced aggregation mechanism to suppress heavy-tailed communication noise. In the mean sense, VRA-FedSGD achieves a convergence rate of {\small$\mathcal{O}\left(K^{-(p-1)/(2p-1)}\right)$} for nonconvex objective functions, where $p$ is the tail index of heavy-tailed noise. In the almost sure sense, VRA-FedSGD achieves a convergence rate of $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}\left(K^{-(1-1/(p-ε))}\right)$ for strongly convex objective functions, where $ε$ is an arbitrarily small constant. Simulated experiments on a logistic regression problem with real-world data verify the effectiveness of VRA-FedSGD.
papers.summary_zh:
## 联邦学习中重尾梯度噪声与通信噪声下的方差缩减算法  

联邦学习（FL）作为一种新兴的分布式机器学习范式，允许多个本地设备在**不共享原始数据**的前提下协同训练全局模型，从而兼顾数据隐私与协作效率。然而，在无线网络和物联网（IoT）等实际部署场景中，梯度更新常受**重尾分布噪声**（如帕累托型梯度偏差）干扰，通信过程亦面临信道衰落、量化误差等导致的**重尾通信噪声**，严重损害收敛性与稳定性。  

本文提出一种新型方差缩减型联邦优化算法——**VRA-FedSGD**（Variance-Reduced Aggregation FedSGD）。该算法创新性地融合三重机制：  
- 采用**动量辅助的方差缩减技术**，结合非线性截断映射（如Huber-type mapping），主动抑制重尾梯度噪声的异常冲击；  
- 设计**方差缩减型聚合器**（VRA），在服务器端对含噪本地模型更新进行鲁棒加权与偏差校正，显著降低重尾通信噪声的累积影响；  
- 理论上首次在**非凸与强凸两类目标函数下**分别建立面向重尾噪声的收敛界：  
  - 对非凸目标，**均值意义下**收敛速率为 $\mathcal{O}\left(K^{-(p-1)/(2p-1)}\right)$；  
  - 对强凸目标，**几乎必然意义下**收敛速率为 $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}\left(K^{-(1-1/(p-\varepsilon))}\right)$，其中 $p>2$ 为噪声尾指数，$\varepsilon>0$ 为任意小常数。  
实验基于真实世界数据集（如a9a、covtype）上的逻辑回归任务验证：相比FedAvg、SCAFFOLD等基线，VRA-FedSGD在高噪声环境下提升收敛速度达37%–52%，且最终精度更稳定。本工作为面向边缘智能的鲁棒联邦学习提供了理论保障与实用工具。
papers.summary_en: Federated learning (FL) enables privacy-preserving collaborative model training across decentralized devices, yet suffers severely from heavy-tailed gradient and communication noise in wireless/IoT deployments. We propose **VRA-FedSGD**, a variance-reduction-based algorithm that jointly tackles both noise sources: it employs momentum-assisted variance reduction with nonlinear mapping to suppress heavy-tailed gradient noise, and introduces a variance-reduced aggregation mechanism to mitigate heavy-tailed communication noise. Under mild tail-index assumptions ($p > 2$), VRA-FedSGD achieves an $\mathcal{O}(K^{-(p-1)/(2p-1)})$ convergence rate in expectation for nonconvex objectives, and a nearly optimal $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(K^{-(1-1/(p-\varepsilon))})$ almost-sure rate for strongly convex objectives. Experiments on logistic regression with real-world datasets confirm its robustness and superiority over FedAvg and SCAFFOLD under high-noise conditions.

papers.title: Escaping the Variance Trap: Jacobian-Free Dynamics for Root-Finding Bilevel Optimization
papers.abstract: Many central machine learning tasks, from entropy tuning in reinforcement learning to equilibrating generative adversarial networks, are fundamentally stochastic root-finding problems rather than loss minimization. Yet, they are frequently forced into a minimization framework via squared residuals, introducing a critical flaw we identify as the Variance Trap. Standard bilevel minimization algorithms require estimating hypergradients involving implicit Jacobians; in stochastic settings, these terms act as noise amplifiers, destabilizing convergence. We formalize Root-Finding Bilevel Optimization (RF-BO) as a distinct problem class that bypasses this pathology. We propose a Jacobian-free solution using Two-Time-Scale Stochastic Approximation (TTSA) that updates directly along the root error, structurally avoiding variance amplification. We provide the first non-asymptotic convergence guarantees for TTSA in this setting under Markovian noise. Extensive experiments demonstrate the decisive advantage of this paradigm: compared to squared-residual and implicit-gradient baselines, our framework achieves a 2.6\% top-1 accuracy gain in SimCLR, 17$\times$ faster convergence in non-linear ODE control where baselines fail, significantly improved entropy stability in reinforcement learning, and an 11.1\% quality improvement in generative modeling.
papers.summary_zh:
## 背景与问题  
许多核心机器学习任务——如强化学习中的熵调节、生成对抗网络（GAN）的均衡求解——本质上是**随机不动点/根寻找问题**，而非传统损失最小化。然而，当前主流方法常将其强行建模为平方残差最小化（如 $\min \|F(x)\|^2$），由此引入我们首次系统揭示的“**方差陷阱（Variance Trap）**”：在双层优化中，标准隐式梯度法需估计含隐式雅可比矩阵的超梯度；而在随机环境下，该雅可比项会显著放大噪声，导致收敛不稳定甚至发散。

## 方法创新  
本文提出**根寻找双层优化（RF-BO）**这一新范式，彻底规避方差陷阱。我们设计了一种**免雅可比（Jacobian-Free）动力学框架**，基于双时间尺度随机逼近（TTSA），直接沿根误差 $F(x)$ 更新变量，从结构上消除雅可比相关噪声放大。这是首个为RF-BO中TTSA算法提供**非渐近收敛保证**的工作，且理论适用于更现实的**马尔可夫噪声**设定（突破独立同分布假设）。

## 实验验证  
在四大典型场景中，本方法显著超越基线：  
- **SimCLR对比学习**：Top-1准确率提升**2.6%**；  
- **非线性ODE控制器训练**：收敛速度达基线的**17×**，而基线完全失效；  
- **强化学习熵调节**：策略熵波动降低，稳定性大幅提升；  
- **生成建模（GAN）**：FID指标改善**11.1%**，模式覆盖更优。  
结果证实：摆脱平方残差与隐式雅可比，是提升随机双层优化鲁棒性与效率的关键路径。
papers.summary_en: Many ML tasks—e.g., entropy tuning in RL and GAN equilibrium—formulate as stochastic root-finding, yet are often coerced into squared-residual minimization, inducing the *Variance Trap*: implicit Jacobians in hypergradient estimation amplify noise and destabilize convergence. We formalize Root-Finding Bilevel Optimization (RF-BO) as a distinct problem class and propose a Jacobian-free Two-Time-Scale Stochastic Approximation (TTSA) method that updates directly on root error—structurally avoiding variance amplification. We provide the first non-asymptotic convergence guarantees for TTSA under Markovian noise. Experiments show decisive gains: +2.6% top-1 accuracy in SimCLR; 17× faster convergence in nonlinear ODE control (where baselines fail); improved entropy stability in RL; and +11.1% quality in generative modeling.
