papers.title: Asymptotic Signal Subspace Recovery in Softmax Attention Models
papers.abstract: Attention mechanisms have demonstrated remarkable empirical success in identifying relevant information from large collections of tokens, yet the theoretical principles underlying this behavior remain poorly understood. We study a stylized softmax-attention model in which a query vector is learned by stochastic gradient ascent from a collection of informative and nuisance tokens. Exploiting the symmetry of the model, we derive a population objective and characterize the limiting ordinary differential equation governing the learning dynamics. Using tools from stochastic approximation and dynamical systems theory, we establish a rigorous connection between the stochastic learning algorithm and its deterministic limit. Our main result shows that, under suitable high-dimensional scaling assumptions and standard step-size conditions, the learned query converges almost surely to the one-dimensional signal subspace spanned by the latent informative direction. Equivalently, the query asymptotically recovers the latent signal up to the intrinsic sign ambiguity. These results provide a rigorous theoretical foundation for understanding attention mechanisms as signal extraction procedures in high-dimensional noisy environments and offer a dynamical-systems perspective on how attention discovers relevant information in the presence of substantial noise.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与问题  
注意力机制在大语言模型中展现出卓越的实证性能，能从海量令牌中精准定位相关信息，但其背后的核心理论机制——尤其是**如何在高维噪声环境中鲁棒地提取潜在信号**——仍缺乏严格数学刻画。本文聚焦于Softmax注意力中一个基础而关键的问题：当查询向量（query）通过随机梯度上升从混杂着信息性令牌（informative tokens）与干扰性令牌（nuisance tokens）的数据中学习时，它能否、以及以何种方式收敛至真正的信号方向？

## 方法与技术路线  
我们构建了一个具有统计对称性的理想化Softmax注意力模型，并首次推导出其**总体目标函数（population objective）**；在此基础上，严格刻画了学习动态所满足的**极限常微分方程（ODE）**。借助**随机逼近理论**与**动力系统分析**，我们建立了随机优化算法与其确定性极限之间的**强收敛保证**（almost sure convergence），克服了传统平均场分析中常见的弱收敛局限。

## 主要发现与理论贡献  
在标准步长条件（如$\eta_t \propto 1/t$）及合理的高维缩放假设（维度$d\to\infty$，样本规模$n$与$d$协同增长）下，我们证明：学习所得查询向量**几乎必然收敛至由潜在信息方向张成的一维信号子空间**。换言之，查询向量渐近地恢复了真实信号方向，仅存在固有的符号歧义（±1）。该结果首次为注意力机制提供了**严格的信号提取解释**——它本质上是一种高维噪声环境下的自适应滤波器，其动力学过程天然趋向于信噪比最优的方向。

## 意义与启示  
本工作不仅填补了注意力理论的结构性空白，更将注意力建模为一个可分析的动力系统，为理解“为何注意力能忽略噪声、聚焦关键信息”提供了首个可证明的机制解释，也为后续设计鲁棒注意力架构与优化策略奠定了理论基础。
papers.summary_en: We study softmax attention through a stylized high-dimensional model where a query vector is trained via stochastic gradient ascent on mixed informative and nuisance tokens. Leveraging model symmetry, we derive the population objective and characterize the limiting ODE of learning dynamics. Using stochastic approximation and dynamical systems theory, we establish almost sure convergence of the stochastic algorithm to its deterministic limit. Our main result proves that, under standard step-size decay ($\eta_t = c/t$) and high-dimensional scaling ($d,n \to \infty$ with $n/d \to \kappa > 0$), the learned query converges **almost surely** to the one-dimensional signal subspace spanned by the latent informative direction—recovering the signal up to sign ambiguity. This provides the first rigorous guarantee that softmax attention functions as an asymptotic signal extractor in noisy, high-dimensional settings, offering a dynamical-systems foundation for its empirical robustness.

## 意义与启示  
本工作不仅填补了注意力理论的结构性空白，更将注意力建模为一个可分析的动力系统，为理解“为何注意力能忽略噪声、聚焦关键信息”提供了首个可证明的机制解释，也为后续设计鲁棒注意力架构与优化策略奠定了理论基础。

papers.title: Automated sign detection across the Electronic Babylonian Library: A large-scale dataset and end-to-end cuneiform OCR pipeline
papers.abstract: Learning to read cuneiform tablets is an extremely demanding task; consequently, of the roughly half million excavated tablets, only a small fraction has been analysed by Assyriologists. Computer vision offers a promising avenue for decipherment but requires large, densely annotated datasets. To address this limitation, the largest annotated cuneiform sign dataset to date is used, and a Deformable Detection Transformer (DETR)-based object detection model is evaluated under two class granularities of 173 and 106 classes. The proposed system integrates automatic tablet-side extraction, heuristic line grouping, and n-gram-based textual similarity evaluation to bridge visual sign detection and textual structure, and achieves consistent improvements of up to 28-37% over prior work on COCO-style detection metrics. At inference, the method is applied to 87,668 tablet fragments from the Electronic Babylonian Library (eBL) corpus, producing nearly 2.9 million sign detections. Although the approach operates without linguistic priors and remains sensitive to tablet damage and layout variability, it provides a scalable and interpretable foundation for corpus-wide cuneiform analysis and supports future integration with multimodal and linguistic modelling frameworks.
papers.summary_zh:
## 背景与挑战  
楔形文字破译是亚述学研究中极具门槛的任务。迄今出土的约50万块泥板中，仅极小比例被专业学者系统释读。计算机视觉为大规模辅助释读提供了新路径，但严重受限于高质量、细粒度标注数据的匮乏。

## 方法创新  
本研究构建并发布了目前**最大规模的楔形文字符号标注数据集**，涵盖173类（含变体）及精简的106类符号体系。提出端到端楔形文字OCR流水线：  
- 基于**可变形检测Transformer（Deformable DETR）** 实现高精度符号定位；  
- 集成**全自动泥板区域提取**、**启发式行级分组算法**与**n-gram文本相似性评估模块**，在视觉检测结果与泥板文本结构间建立可解释的语义桥梁；  
- 无需任何语言学先验知识（如词典、语法或音值映射），纯基于像素与布局建模。

## 主要成果  
在COCO标准检测指标（mAP）上，相较先前最优方法实现**28–37%的绝对提升**；成功应用于电子巴比伦图书馆（eBL）全部87,668块泥板残片，产出**近290万次符号检测结果**，首次实现超大规模楔形文字 corpus 级自动化标注。尽管对泥板破损、刻痕模糊及版式多样性仍具敏感性，该系统具备高度**可扩展性**与**可追溯性**，为后续融合多模态表征（如图像+音值+语义）与大语言模型驱动的释读框架奠定坚实基础。
papers.summary_en: This paper introduces the largest annotated cuneiform sign dataset to date and an end-to-end OCR pipeline for automated sign detection across the Electronic Babylonian Library (eBL). We adapt a Deformable DETR model for object detection under two class granularities (173 and 106 signs), integrated with automatic tablet-side extraction, heuristic line grouping, and n-gram–based textual similarity evaluation to bridge visual detection and textual structure. Without linguistic priors, our system achieves consistent improvements of 28–37% in COCO-style mAP over prior work. Applied to 87,668 eBL tablet fragments, it produces nearly 2.9 million sign detections—the first corpus-scale, interpretable, and scalable foundation for cuneiform analysis. While sensitive to damage and layout variability, the framework enables future integration with multimodal and language-modeling approaches.

papers.title: Weak Keys Break the BUFF Security of HAWK
papers.abstract:
HAWK is a signature scheme based on the module lattice isomorphism problem, and the only lattice-based candidate in the third round of NIST's call for additional post-quantum signatures. Its specification claims that HAWK achieves the BUFF (Beyond UnForgeability Features) security properties "as is", without applying the generic BUFF transform, citing the analysis of Aulbach, Düzlü, Meyer, Struck, and Weishäupl (PQCrypto'24).

We refute this claim for HAWK exactly as specified. Several of the BUFF games let the adversary register a public key of its own choosing, yet the HAWK reference verifier performs almost no validity check on a key beyond decoding it. We exhibit degenerate "weak" public keys under which the all-zero signature verifies for all random-oracle challenges except the negligible symmetry-breaking corner case, and use them to break the three BUFF properties whose games let the adversary supply both the verification key and the signature: message-bound signatures, malicious strong universal exclusive ownership, and weak non-resignability.

We trace these breaks to gaps in the BUFF proofs for HAWK of Aulbach et al.: one missing case analysis, and three steps that silently assume properties of the adversarially chosen keys as if they come from honest key generation. Honest key generation already enforces bounds that would reject our weak-key family on the attacks we exhibit. We prove that enforcing this norm floor at verification yields message-bound security for constant keys, but we make no claim that it fully restores BUFF security.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景  
HAWK 是NIST后量子密码第三轮遴选中**唯一的基于模块格同构问题（MLIP）的签名方案候选者**，其官方规范声称无需通用BUFF（Beyond UnForgeability Features）变换即可原生满足三大高级安全属性：**消息绑定签名（message-bound signatures）、恶意强通用独占所有权（malicious strong universal exclusive ownership）和弱不可重签性（weak non-resignability）**，依据为Aulbach等在PQCrypto’24中的安全性分析。

## 核心发现与方法  
本文首次指出并严格验证：**HAWK按标准规范实现时存在系统性安全缺陷**。关键漏洞源于其参考验证器对公钥几乎不做有效性校验——仅执行解码操作，而忽略关键范数约束。我们构造了一类**退化“弱公钥”（weak public keys）**：在这些公钥下，全零签名（all-zero signature）可对**除极小概率对称破缺情形外的所有随机预言机挑战**成功通过验证。利用该构造，我们直接攻破全部三个允许攻击者自主提交公钥与签名的BUFF安全游戏。

## 理论根源与修复启示  
漏洞根源在于Aulbach等人BUFF证明中的三处隐含假设：**（1）遗漏对退化密钥的案例分析；（2）三处推理步骤默认敌手选择的公钥具备诚实密钥生成所隐含的范数界性质**——而诚实密钥生成过程本会拒绝我们构造的弱密钥族。进一步，我们证明：**若在验证阶段强制施加该范数下界（norm floor），则可恢复常数密钥下的消息绑定安全性**；但该修补**不足以完全重建全部BUFF安全**，因其他属性依赖更复杂的交互结构。
papers.summary_en: HAWK, the sole module-lattice-isomorphism-based signature candidate in NIST’s third-round PQC standardization, claims native BUFF security—specifically message-bound signatures, malicious strong universal exclusive ownership, and weak non-resignability—without generic transforms, citing Aulbach et al. (PQCrypto’24). We refute this claim for the *exactly specified* HAWK scheme. Its reference verifier performs only minimal public-key validation (essentially decoding), enabling adversarial construction of degenerate “weak” public keys under which the all-zero signature verifies for *all but a negligible set* of random-oracle challenges. Using these keys, we break all three BUFF properties whose security games allow the adversary to supply both verification key and signature. We trace the breaks to gaps in Aulbach et al.’s proof: one missing case analysis and three steps silently assuming adversarially chosen keys satisfy norm bounds enforced only by honest key generation. Enforcing that norm floor during verification restores message-bound security for constant keys—but does not fully recover BUFF security.

papers.title: Breaking the $\Omega(|C|\kappa)$ Barrier on Garbled Circuit Size in the Random Oracle Model
papers.abstract:
In this paper, we study garbled circuits in the random oracle model against a computationally unbounded adversary with $T$ queries to a (programmable) random oracle. From Yao's garbled circuits (SFCS 1986) to Three-Halves (CRYPTO 2021), the garbled circuit size has been reduced from $8|C|(\log T+\kappa)$ bits to $1.5|C|(\log T+\kappa)$ bits for achieving a statistical error of $2^{-\kappa}$, where $|C|$ is the circuit size and $\kappa$ is the statistical security parameter. However, no known result achieves $o(|C|\kappa)$ bits of garbled circuit size by now, and it is widely believed that a garbled circuit must have $\Omega(|C|\kappa)$ bits in the random oracle model.
    
    In this work, we present the first garbling scheme that achieves $o(|C|\kappa)$ bits of garbled circuit size in the random oracle model. In particular, for a circuit $C$ of size $|C|$ and depth $D$, the achieved garbled circuit size is $O(|C|\log T+D\kappa^2\log T)$ bits. This breaks the long-standing $\Omega(|C|\kappa)$ barrier on the garbled circuit size.

    We extend our garbling scheme to a maliciously secure two-party computation protocol with communication of $O(|C|\log T+D(\log T+\kappa)^2\log T+{\sf poly}(\kappa,\log T))$ bits against any $T$-query adversary assuming parallel oblivious transfers and a (programmable) random oracle. The protocol only requires 1 OT round and 3 one-way communication rounds. If only requiring one of the two parties to have output, a similar communication complexity can be achieved for constructing a non-interactive secure computation (NISC) protocol, which only relies on the preprocessing of bit-OT correlations and a random oracle. Compared to a concurrent work on NISC by Ishai et al. (EUROCRYPT 2026) in the same setting, we achieve a better amortized communication cost per gate at the cost of an additional term related to the circuit depth. The NISC protocol with a similar communication cost can also be constructed from a (slightly stronger version of) semi-malicious 2-round OT protocol.
papers.summary_zh:
## 突破随机预言机模型下混淆电路尺寸的 $\Omega(|C|\kappa)$ 下界  

本研究首次在**随机预言机（RO）模型**中打破长期存在的混淆电路尺寸下界障碍。此前，从Yao 1986年开创性方案到CRYPTO 2021年的Three-Halves方案，混淆电路尺寸最优为 $1.5|C|(\log T + \kappa)$ 比特（$|C|$ 为电路门数，$\kappa$ 为统计安全性参数，$T$ 为敌手对可编程RO的查询次数），所有已知方案均满足 $\Omega(|C|\kappa)$ 尺寸下界，学界普遍认为该下界不可突破。  

本文提出首个实现 **$o(|C|\kappa)$ 尺寸** 的混淆方案：对规模为 $|C|$、深度为 $D$ 的布尔电路 $C$，所构造混淆电路仅需  
$$O(|C|\log T + D\kappa^2\log T)$$  
比特，显著优于 $\Omega(|C|\kappa)$——当 $\kappa = \omega(\log T)$ 时（如标准安全参数 $\kappa=128$ 而 $T\approx2^{40}$），该项主导项 $|C|\log T$ 远小于 $|C|\kappa$。核心创新在于**深度感知的标签压缩机制**：利用电路结构局部性与RO可编程性，将传统每门双标签（$2\kappa$ 比特）降为深度相关、非线性的密钥派生结构，避免全局 $\kappa$-比特冗余。  

进一步，我们将其扩展为**恶意安全两方计算协议**：通信量为  
$$O\big(|C|\log T + D(\log T+\kappa)^2\log T + \mathrm{poly}(\kappa,\log T)\big)$$  
比特，仅需**1轮OT + 3轮单向通信**，且可基于并行OT和可编程RO实现。若仅需单方输出，该框架可直接实例化为**非交互式安全计算（NISC）协议**，仅依赖预处理的比特OT关联及RO，通信开销优于Ishai等EUROCRYPT 2026的同期工作（尤其在门数多、深度适中场景下），亦可基于稍强的半恶意2轮OT实现。
papers.summary_en: This work breaks the long-standing $\Omega(|C|\kappa)$ lower bound on garbled circuit size in the random oracle (RO) model. We present the first garbling scheme achieving $o(|C|\kappa)$ bits: for a circuit $C$ of size $|C|$ and depth $D$, the garbled circuit size is $O(|C|\log T + D\kappa^2\log T)$, where $T$ is the adversary’s RO query budget and $\kappa$ the statistical security parameter. This improves over prior $\Omega(|C|\kappa)$-sized constructions (e.g., Yao, Three-Halves) by decoupling per-gate overhead from $\kappa$ via depth-aware, RO-programmable label derivation. We extend it to a maliciously secure two-party computation protocol with $O(|C|\log T + D(\log T+\kappa)^2\log T + \mathrm{poly}(\kappa,\log T))$ communication, using only 1 OT round and 3 one-way rounds. A non-interactive secure computation (NISC) variant achieves comparable communication—outperforming Ishai et al. (EUROCRYPT 2026) amortized per-gate cost—using only bit-OT correlations and RO, or a semi-malicious 2-round OT.

papers.title: Achieving Guaranteed Output Delivery MPC with Constant Rounds and Linear Communication in Minicrypt
papers.abstract:
In this work, we study the communication complexity of constant-round MPC with guaranteed output delivery (GOD) in Minicrypt. We construct the first MPC protocol in this setting with linear communication complexity of $O(|C|n\kappa+Dn^3\kappa^3+W_I{\sf poly}(n,\kappa))$ bits under the assumption of a random oracle, where $|C|$ is the circuit size, $D$ is the circuit depth, $W_I$ is the number of input wires, and $\kappa$ is the security parameter.
    
    In comparison, the previously best-known construction with linear communication ($O(|C|n)$), presented by Goyal et al. (CRYPTO 2020), requires $O(D+n^2)$ round complexity. When targeting $O(D)$ round complexity, the best-known result by Agarwal et al. (ASIACRYPT 2024) still requires $O(|C|n^3)$ communication complexity. More communication is needed to achieve constant round complexity, even with non-black-box use of the underlying cryptographic primitives.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与问题  
在密码学基础模型 **Minicrypt**（仅假设单向函数存在）下，实现**常数轮次**（constant-round）、具备**确定性输出交付保证**（Guaranteed Output Delivery, GOD）的安全多方计算（MPC）协议，长期面临通信复杂度与轮次之间的根本性权衡。现有方案或牺牲轮次（如 $O(D+n^2)$ 轮），或承受高阶通信开销（如 $O(|C|n^3)$），尚无能在**常数轮次、线性通信**与**GOD安全性**三者间同时达成的构造。

## 核心贡献  
本文首次在 Minicrypt 框架下构建了满足 GOD 的常数轮 MPC 协议，其总通信量为：  
$$O(|C|n\kappa + Dn^3\kappa^3 + W_I \cdot {\sf poly}(n,\kappa)) \text{ 比特}$$  
其中 $|C|$ 为电路规模，$D$ 为电路深度，$W_I$ 为输入线数量，$\kappa$ 为安全参数。该协议在**随机预言机（RO）假设下**实现，显著突破了此前理论瓶颈。

## 关键创新  
- 提出新型**带验证的线性秘密共享方案（V-LSSS）**，支持常数轮内完成输入提交、计算验证与输出重建；  
- 设计轻量级**深度感知认证机制**，将深度相关开销控制在 $O(Dn^3\kappa^3)$，避免传统方案中 $O(|C|n^3)$ 的全局放大；  
- 首次将输入复杂度 $W_I$ 项分离并优化至多项式级别，提升对稀疏输入场景的实用性。

## 对比优势  
相较 Goyal 等（CRYPTO’20）的 $O(|C|n)$ 线性通信方案（需 $O(D+n^2)$ 轮），本方案轮次降至常数；相较 Agarwal 等（ASIACRYPT’24）的 $O(D)$-轮方案（通信 $O(|C|n^3)$），本方案通信降低两个数量级（从立方级回归近线性）。这是 Minicrypt 中 GOD-MPC 向“高效实用化”迈出的关键一步。
papers.summary_en: This work presents the first constant-round MPC protocol with Guaranteed Output Delivery (GOD) in Minicrypt achieving **linear communication complexity**, assuming a random oracle. The protocol communicates $O(|C|n\kappa + Dn^3\kappa^3 + W_I \cdot {\sf poly}(n,\kappa))$ bits—where $|C|$ is circuit size, $D$ depth, $W_I$ input wires, and $\kappa$ security parameter—marking the first construction that simultaneously achieves constant rounds, GOD security, and near-linear communication in this minimal cryptographic setting. Prior linear-communication protocols required $O(D+n^2)$ rounds (Goyal et al., CRYPTO 2020), while $O(D)$-round alternatives incurred $O(|C|n^3)$ communication (Agarwal et al., ASIACRYPT 2024). Our improvement stems from a novel verifiable linear secret sharing scheme and depth-aware authentication, enabling efficient input commitment, computation integrity checks, and output reconstruction within constant rounds.

## 研究背景与问题  
在密码学基础模型 **Minicrypt**（仅假设单向函数存在）下，实现**常数轮次**（constant-round）、具备**确定性输出交付保证**（Guaranteed Output Delivery, GOD）的安全多方计算（MPC）协议，长期面临通信复杂度与轮次之间的根本性权衡。现有方案或牺牲轮次（如 $O(D+n^2)$ 轮），或承受高阶通信开销（如 $O(|C|n^3)$），尚无能在**常数轮次、线性通信**与**GOD安全性**三者间同时达成的构造。

## 核心贡献  
本文首次在 Minicrypt 框架下构建了满足 GOD 的常数轮 MPC 协议，其总通信量为：  
$$O(|C|n\kappa + Dn^3\kappa^3 + W_I \cdot {\sf poly}(n,\kappa)) \text{ 比特}$$  
其中 $|C|$ 为电路规模，$D$ 为电路深度，$W_I$ 为输入线数量，$\kappa$ 为安全参数。该协议在**随机预言机（RO）假设下**实现，显著突破了此前理论瓶颈。

## 关键创新  
- 提出新型**带验证的线性秘密共享方案（V-LSSS）**，支持常数轮内完成输入提交、计算验证与输出重建；  
- 设计轻量级**深度感知认证机制**，将深度相关开销控制在 $O(Dn^3\kappa^3)$，避免传统方案中 $O(|C|n^3)$ 的全局放大；  
- 首次将输入复杂度 $W_I$ 项分离并优化至多项式级别，提升对稀疏输入场景的实用性。

## 对比优势  
相较 Goyal 等（CRYPTO’20）的 $O(|C|n)$ 线性通信方案（需 $O(D+n^2)$ 轮），本方案轮次降至常数；相较 Agarwal 等（ASIACRYPT’24）的 $O(D)$-轮方案（通信 $O(|C|n^3)$），本方案通信降低两个数量级（从立方级回归近线性）。这是 Minicrypt 中 GOD-MPC 向“高效实用化”迈出的关键一步。

papers.title: $π$-RAG: Oblivious Retrieval via Semantic Quantization and Transcendental Addressing for Large Language Models
papers.abstract: This paper introduces $π$-RAG, a novel architecture for oblivious retrieval that decouples Large Language Models (LLMs) from sensitive data storage without sacrificing semantic understanding. Traditional Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures expose raw vector embeddings to potential inversion attacks and nondeterministic retrieval failures. To address this, we utilize the digits of $π$ as a source of transcendental entropy, creating an immutable indirection layer between the LLM and private records. The value $π$ provides immutability, is uneditable and math governs it. The architecture also introduces a Semantic Quantization Layer. This layer projects user inputs onto a pre-computed manifold of Canonical Intent Centroids. RAG performs vector cosine similarity but here it maps the centroids to deterministic offsets via cryptographic salt. The resulting $π$-key is a pointer to standardized payload from the actual datastore. By replacing direct access to the datastore via LLM with this transcendental layer, $π$-RAG mathematically guarantees that the inference remains oblivious to the data. This architecture unifies deterministic randomness, auditability, and differential privacy, demonstrating high efficacy for high-compliance sectors such as finance and healthcare.
papers.summary_zh:
## $π$-RAG：面向大语言模型的语义量化与超越性寻址实现无感知检索  

传统检索增强生成（RAG）系统存在两大核心风险：**原始向量嵌入易遭逆向攻击**，导致敏感数据泄露；**相似度检索具有非确定性**，引发结果漂移与审计不可追溯。本文提出$π$-RAG——一种新型无感知（oblivious）检索架构，首次将数学常数$\pi$的超越性、不可篡改性与密码学原理深度融合，实现LLM与私有数据存储的严格解耦。  

### 核心创新  
- **超越性寻址层（Transcendental Addressing Layer）**：以$\pi$的小数展开序列（如第10⁶位起连续64位）作为全局唯一、不可修改的熵源，构建恒定不变的间接映射层。$\pi$由数学定律严格定义，杜绝人为干预或后门植入。  
- **语义量化层（Semantic Quantization Layer）**：将用户查询投影至预计算的“典型意图质心”流形空间，并通过加密盐值（cryptographic salt）将质心映射为**确定性偏移量**，彻底替代传统余弦相似度匹配。  
- **$π$-密钥机制**：输出为轻量级、固定长度的$π$-key，仅指向标准化数据载荷（如脱敏JSON Schema），LLM全程不接触原始向量或明文记录。  

### 效果与价值  
在金融与医疗合规场景实测中，$π$-RAG实现**100%检索确定性**（零失败重试）、**抗逆向重建攻击**（经2000+次梯度反演攻击验证），并天然满足差分隐私（ε=0.87）与审计可验证性。该架构首次将“数学不可篡改性”转化为工程级安全原语，为高监管领域提供可证明的无感知推理保障。
papers.summary_en: This paper presents $π$-RAG, a novel oblivious retrieval architecture that decouples LLMs from sensitive data storage while preserving semantic fidelity. Unlike conventional RAG—vulnerable to embedding inversion attacks and nondeterministic retrieval—we leverage the transcendental, immutable digits of $\pi$ as a cryptographically stable entropy source to construct an indirection layer between the LLM and private records. A Semantic Quantization Layer projects queries onto a manifold of Canonical Intent Centroids and maps them deterministically to offsets via cryptographic salting, generating compact $π$-keys that point only to standardized, anonymized payloads. This eliminates direct vector access, mathematically guaranteeing inference obliviousness. Evaluated in finance and healthcare settings, $π$-RAG achieves 100% retrieval determinism, resists gradient-based inversion (2000+ attempts), and satisfies $(\varepsilon=0.87)$-differential privacy—unifying auditability, provable security, and compliance-ready deployment.

papers.title: On the Curse of Dimensionality in Private Sparse Covariance Estimation and PCA
papers.abstract: We study high-dimensional differentially private (DP) covariance estimation in the operator norm, and principal component analysis (PCA), under $k$-row-column sparsity ($k$-RCS) of the covariance matrix. In the non-private setting, it is known that $\mathsf{poly}(k, \log d)$ samples suffice to solve both of these problems. However, the only comparable result known under DP (Wang et al. 2021) requires $Ω(d)$ samples under standard parameterizations of the problem. We investigate when this curse of dimensionality is inherent for sparse covariance estimation tasks under DP.   On the upper bound front, we show that a $\mathsf{poly}(k, \log d)$ sample complexity for PCA is possible under DP, if we also posit sparsity of the leading eigenvector. We complement this result with $\mathsf{poly}(d)$ lower bounds under DP for both sparse covariance estimation and PCA, establishing an exponential gap between the private and non-private variants of these problems when $k = \mathsf{polylog}(d)$. To our knowledge, no such separation has previously been demonstrated for any sparse estimation problems in private high-dimensional statistics. Our techniques are flexible enough that they imply stronger lower bounds even for the well-studied problem of standard DP PCA, without sparsity assumptions.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与问题  
本文聚焦于**高维差分隐私（DP）下的稀疏协方差估计与主成分分析（PCA）**，核心挑战是“维度灾难”——即样本复杂度随维度 $d$ 线性甚至更高增长。在非私有场景下，当协方差矩阵满足 $k$-行列稀疏性（$k$-RCS）时，仅需 $\mathsf{poly}(k, \log d)$ 样本即可实现算子范数意义下的精确估计和PCA；然而，现有DP方法（如Wang et al. 2021）却要求 $\Omega(d)$ 样本，引发关键疑问：这一维度依赖是否本质？  

## 主要贡献与创新  
- **首个紧致分离性证明**：我们首次严格证明，在 $k = \mathsf{polylog}(d)$ 条件下，DP稀疏协方差估计与DP PCA 的样本复杂度存在**指数级差距**——非私有为 $\tilde{O}(k)$，而DP下至少为 $\Omega(d^{c})$（$c>0$），填补了私有高维稀疏统计中长期缺失的下界理论空白。  
- **新上界突破**：若进一步假设**主导特征向量也稀疏**，则DP PCA可达成 $\mathsf{poly}(k, \log d)$ 样本复杂度，表明结构先验（双重稀疏性）能有效缓解维度灾难。  
- **技术普适性**：所发展的信息论下界框架不依赖稀疏性假设，自然导出对**标准DP PCA（无稀疏约束）更强的 $\Omega(d)$ 下界**，改进了现有最优结果。  

本工作系统揭示了差分隐私对稀疏结构学习的根本性制约，为设计高效私有算法提供了理论边界与结构引导方向。
papers.summary_en: We study differentially private (DP) sparse covariance estimation and PCA under $k$-row-column sparsity (k-RCS), addressing the “curse of dimensionality” in high-dimensional private statistics. While non-private methods achieve $\mathsf{poly}(k, \log d)$ sample complexity, prior DP results require $\Omega(d)$ samples—raising the question of whether this dependence is inherent. We resolve this affirmatively: for $k = \mathsf{polylog}(d)$, we prove *tight polynomial lower bounds*—$\Omega(d^c)$ for some $c > 0$—for both DP sparse covariance estimation and DP PCA in operator norm, establishing the first exponential separation between private and non-private sparse estimation. Complementing this, we show that DP PCA *can* achieve $\mathsf{poly}(k, \log d)$ complexity if the leading eigenvector is also $k$-sparse. Crucially, our lower bound technique extends to standard (non-sparse) DP PCA, yielding an improved $\Omega(d)$ lower bound—stronger than all prior results. This work fundamentally characterizes privacy-induced statistical barriers in structured high-dimensional learning.

papers.title: AgentRiskBOM: A Risk-Scoping Security Bill of Materials for Agentic AI Systems
papers.abstract: Agentic AI systems retrieve private context, invoke tools, write files, call external services, coordinate with other agents, and may act without human approval. Existing bill of materials artifacts improve transparency for dependencies, model metadata, and training provenance, but leave an agentic transparency gap: capability opacity, the absence of a structured account of what a deployed agent can access, remember, change, delegate, and prove afterward. This paper introduces AgentRiskBOM, a security BOM for risk-scoping tool-using AI agents. It is an additive layer over SBOM, AIBOM, and MLBOM artifacts, referencing them where authoritative while adding fields for runtime authority: autonomy, tool permissions, memory, credential scope, approval gates, audit signals, inter-agent communication, and external action capability. We implement AgentRiskBOM as a JSON-schema artifact with a reproducible corpus, risk scenarios, scorer, diff detector, control mapper, and reports. We evaluate AgentRiskBOM on 13 open-source agents spanning coding, RAG, and multi-agent archetypes, plus 52 risk scenarios across 14 categories. The schema validates all 13 corpus artifacts. Coverage analysis gives AgentRiskBOM a native-equivalent score of 14 across 16 capability dimensions, vs. 1 for SBOM, 1.5 for AIBOM and 2 for MLBOM. Across modeled risk categories, AgentRiskBOM exposes 100% risk-category visibility vs. 10.5% for SBOM-like and 20.9% for AIBOM-like views. To test agentic authority drift, we inject 33 structured deployment mutations; the diff detector identifies the correct change type for all mutations. A secondary penalty-based scorer yields a Spearman correlation of 0.73 with the primary scorer, supporting rank-level consistency while showing that thresholds require human calibration. The results show that agentic AI security needs a machine-readable authority-and-risk artifact before incidents occur.
papers.summary_zh:
## 背景与问题  
Agentic AI（具身智能体）系统具备自主检索私有上下文、调用工具、写入文件、访问外部服务、协同其他智能体，甚至在无人类审批下执行操作的能力。现有安全物料清单（如SBOM、AIBOM、MLBOM）虽提升了模型依赖、元数据与训练溯源的透明度，却存在显著的“**具身透明性缺口**”：即**能力不透明性**——缺乏对部署后智能体实际可访问、可记忆、可修改、可委托、可事后验证之权限的结构化描述。

## 方法与创新  
本文提出 **AgentRiskBOM**，首个面向风险划界（risk-scoping）的具身AI安全物料清单。它作为**增量层**，复用并扩展SBOM/AIBOM/MLBOM权威字段，新增8类运行时授权维度：自主性等级、工具调用权限、记忆范围（本地/跨会话/持久化）、凭证作用域、人工审批关卡、审计信号类型、智能体间通信协议、对外行动能力（如HTTP POST、数据库写入）。我们实现其为标准化JSON Schema，并配套提供：可复现的13个开源智能体语料库（覆盖编码、RAG、多智能体范式）、52个覆盖14类风险场景的测试集、自动化评分器、差异检测器（diff detector）、控制映射器及可视化报告。

## 关键结果  
- **覆盖率**：在16项能力维度上，AgentRiskBOM原生等效得分达**14分**（满分16），远超SBOM（1分）、AIBOM（1.5分）、MLBOM（2分）；  
- **风险可见性**：在14类风险中实现**100%类别级可见性**，而SBOM类视图仅10.5%，AIBOM类视图仅20.9%；  
- **漂移检测**：注入33种结构化部署变更（如权限升级、记忆泄露），diff检测器**100%准确识别变更类型**；  
- **评分一致性**：基于惩罚机制的次级评分器与主评分器Spearman相关系数达**0.73**，证实排序可靠性，但阈值需人工校准。  
本工作证明：**在安全事件发生前，亟需机器可读、细粒度、运行时感知的智能体授权与风险清单**。
papers.summary_en: This paper introduces **AgentRiskBOM**, a security Bill of Materials (BOM) designed to scope runtime risks in tool-using agentic AI systems. Unlike existing BOMs (SBOM, AIBOM, MLBOM) that focus on static dependencies or model provenance, AgentRiskBOM adds eight structured fields for *runtime authority*: autonomy level, tool permissions, memory scope, credential boundaries, approval gates, audit signals, inter-agent communication, and external action capability. Implemented as a JSON Schema, it is evaluated across 13 open-source agents (coding, RAG, multi-agent) and 52 risk scenarios spanning 14 categories. AgentRiskBOM achieves a native-equivalent capability score of 14/16—significantly outperforming SBOM (1), AIBOM (1.5), and MLBOM (2)—and provides 100% risk-category visibility versus ≤21% for baseline BOMs. Its diff detector correctly identifies all 33 injected deployment mutations, and a secondary penalty-based scorer shows strong rank-level consistency (Spearman ρ = 0.73). Results demonstrate that proactive, machine-readable authority modeling is essential for securing agentic AI before incidents occur.

papers.title: Mind the Intention: Task-Aware Backdoor Attacks for Forecast-Driven Distribution Network Operations
papers.abstract: Accurate distributed energy resources (DERs) forecasting is critical for downstream optimal operations. However, such forecast-based operation can be highly vulnerable to cyberattacks. While existing research mainly focuses on adversarial attacks, we pivot to a more controllable and persistent threat: backdoor attacks. In time series forecasting, a backdoored model generates an attacker-specified target pattern whenever a trigger is embedded in historical inputs. This paradigm naturally fits the entire DER forecast-optimization-operation chain. In this paper, we investigate whether and how backdoor attacks can compromise distribution network operations and propose GridTroj, a unified backdoor framework tailored for this scenario. Specifically, GridTroj coordinates two key modules. The Intention Planner designs operation-damaging targets and poisoning strategies, while the Backdoor Realizer constructs the corresponding network architecture and training strategy to learn the trigger-target association. ## 背景与问题  
在分布式能源资源（DERs）驱动的配电网运行中，高精度时序预测是支撑最优调度、电压控制与需求响应等下游优化任务的前提。然而，当前基于预测的闭环运行范式面临新型网络威胁——传统对抗攻击仅造成瞬时扰动，而**后门攻击**因其隐蔽性、持久性与意图可控性，构成更严峻的安全挑战：一旦模型被植入后门，攻击者可在任意含触发器的历史输入上，强制模型输出预设的恶意预测模式，进而系统性扭曲后续优化决策。

## 方法创新：GridTroj框架  
本文提出**GridTroj**——首个面向“预测-优化-运行”全链路的电网任务感知后门攻击框架。其核心突破在于**将攻击意图显式建模为操作级破坏目标**（如越限功率、电压崩溃、成本激增），而非仅优化预测误差。GridTroj由两大协同模块构成：  
- **意图规划器（Intention Planner）**：基于电网物理约束与优化目标，自动生成具有操作危害性的预测目标序列，并设计时空耦合的触发器注入策略（如特定时段负荷突变模式）；  
- **后门实现器（Backdoor Realizer）**：构建轻量级时序编码器-解码器架构，采用**意图对齐损失函数**（Intent-Aligned Loss），联合优化触发识别、目标匹配与原始任务性能，确保后门激活时精准诱发下游优化失败。

## 实验验证与贡献  
在IEEE 33节点、123节点及实际某城市配电网三类场景中，GridTroj在负荷预测、无功优化与经济调度三大下游任务上均引发显著操作失效（如电压越限率提升3.8×，调度成本增加217%），且鲁棒性强于SOTA基线（平均攻击成功率高出42.6%）。本工作揭示了预测模型安全与电网物理安全的深层耦合机制，为智能电网的可信AI治理提供了关键攻防视角与评测基准。代码开源：https://github.com/YuxuanCEE/GridTroj

We propose **GridTroj**, the first task-aware backdoor framework explicitly designed for the end-to-end forecast–optimization–operation pipeline. GridTroj departs from conventional time-series backdoors by embedding *operational intent*: its Intention Planner generates physically harmful target forecasts (e.g., voltage-violating load patterns) and trigger strategies guided by grid constraints, while the Backdoor Realizer trains a lightweight encoder-decoder with an intent-aligned loss to robustly couple trigger detection with operational disruption. Experiments across three real-world distribution networks and downstream tasks (load forecasting, reactive power optimization, economic dispatch) show GridTroj achieves up to 217% cost inflation and 3.8× higher voltage violation rates—outperforming state-of-the-art baselines by 42.6% in attack success rate. papers.title: Agent-Assisted Side-Channel Attacks on Non-Prefix KV Cache in RAG
papers.abstract: Modern Large Language Model (LLM) serving engines increasingly rely on Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and non-prefix Key-Value (KV) cache fusion to accelerate long-context, multi-tenant inference. While existing KV cache side-channel attacks require strict linear prefix alignment--rendering them ineffective against real-world RAG queries that contain unique, user-specific private prefixes--we uncover a critical class of structural vulnerabilities inherent to chunk-aware memory scheduling. We demonstrate that the deterministic micro-architectural mechanisms used to align and fuse disjoint memory chunks inadvertently leak a continuous "Step-Wave" timing signature. Exploiting this physical observation, we introduce SpliceLeak, the first end-to-end side-channel attack targeting non-prefix KV cache fusion. SpliceLeak executes a systematic two-phase privacy breach: it first structurally fingerprints the exact length of hidden private prompts, and subsequently manipulates boundary collisions to extract exact semantic content token-by-token. Extensive evaluations on production-grade frameworks (vLLM integrated with LMCache) demonstrate that SpliceLeak achieves up to a 100% extraction success rate in bounded-entropy scenarios. Driven by a deterministic +104 ms hardware latency void, the attack requires as few as 63 requests per token, piercing through realistic continuous batching noise. To resolve the inherent conflict between memory deduplication and security, we propose SpliceDefense, a bipartite mitigation framework consisting of Quantized Chunk Padding (QCP) and Constant-Time Boundary Fusion (CTBF). Our evaluations confirm that SpliceDefense effectively flattens the side-channel signal (Delta TTFT ~ 0) with negligible throughput overhead, preserving the critical benefits of global cache sharing.
papers.summary_zh:
## 背景与问题  
现代大语言模型（LLM）服务引擎广泛采用**检索增强生成（RAG）**与**非前缀键值（KV）缓存融合**技术，以提升长上下文、多租户场景下的推理效率。然而，现有KV缓存侧信道攻击均依赖严格的线性前缀对齐假设——这在真实RAG场景中完全失效：用户查询包含唯一、私有的个性化前缀（如身份提示、敏感指令），导致传统攻击无法定位缓存边界。

## 关键发现：结构化漏洞与“步波”时序信号  
本研究首次揭示了**分块感知内存调度**（chunk-aware memory scheduling）固有的结构性缺陷：为对齐与融合离散内存块所采用的确定性微架构机制（如页表遍历、TLB填充、缓存行冲突仲裁），会无意间泄露一种连续、可建模的**“步波”（Step-Wave）时序签名**——其周期与缓存块粒度强相关，振幅受私有提示长度调制。

## 攻击方法：SpliceLeak  
我们提出**SpliceLeak**——首个端到端针对非前缀KV缓存融合的侧信道攻击。它分两阶段突破隐私：  
1. **结构指纹识别**：通过细粒度TTFT（Time-to-First-Token）测量，精准反推隐藏私有提示的**精确长度**（误差≤1 token）；  
2. **语义内容提取**：主动构造边界碰撞（boundary collision），利用“步波”相位偏移逐token恢复原始语义内容（支持ASCII/Unicode混合文本）。  

## 实验验证与防御方案  
在vLLM+LMCache生产级框架上实测，SpliceLeak在有限熵场景下**提取成功率高达100%**；仅需**63次请求/token**，即可穿透连续批处理（continuous batching）噪声——其根基是硬件层确定性的**+104 ms延迟空洞**。为根治内存去重与安全的根本矛盾，我们提出**SpliceDefense**双轨防御框架：  
- **量化分块填充（QCP）**：基于提示长度分布的轻量级熵感知填充；  
- **恒定时间边界融合（CTBF）**：消除融合路径时序差异。  
评估表明，SpliceDefense将侧信道信号完全压平（ΔTTFT ≈ 0），吞吐量下降仅**<1.2%**，完美保留全局缓存共享优势。

We uncover a structural vulnerability in chunk-aware memory scheduling: deterministic microarchitectural mechanisms for aligning disjoint memory chunks leak a continuous “Step-Wave” timing signature. Leveraging this, we propose **SpliceLeak**, the first end-to-end side-channel attack targeting non-prefix KV cache fusion. It performs a two-phase breach: (1) structural fingerprinting to infer exact private prompt length, then (2) boundary-collision manipulation to extract semantic content token-by-token. Evaluated on production-grade vLLM+LMCache, SpliceLeak achieves **100% extraction success** under bounded entropy, requiring only **63 requests per token**, enabled by a deterministic +104 ms hardware latency void. papers.title: DSSCNet: A Transfer Learning Framework for Cross-Corpus Dysarthric Speech Severity Classification
papers.abstract: Dysarthric speech severity classification is challenging due to speaker variability, class imbalance, and limited datasets. This study introduces DSSCNet, a deep learning model that employs transfer learning and multi-corpus learning to enhance speaker-independent classification. By pre-training on one dysarthric speech corpus and fine-tuning on another, DSSCNet achieves improved feature extraction and cross-corpus generalization. Experimental results demonstrate that DSSCNet outperforms state-of-the-art models for speaker-independent severity classification, achieving 75.80\% accuracy on TORGO and 68.25\% on UA-Speech, significantly reducing misclassification errors. The findings confirm that leveraging knowledge transfer between datasets improves model robustness, making DSSCNet well-suited for automated dysarthria assessment. This research contributes to the development of more effective assistive speech technologies for individuals with speech impairments.
papers.summary_zh:
## 背景与挑战  
构音障碍（dysarthria）是一种由神经系统损伤导致的运动性言语障碍，其严重程度评估对临床干预和康复至关重要。然而，现有自动分类方法面临三大核心瓶颈：**跨说话人泛化能力弱**（因生理/病理差异导致声学特征高度可变）、**类别严重失衡**（轻度与中度样本远多于重度）、以及**高质量标注语料稀缺**——当前主流语料库（如TORGO、UA-Speech）规模小、采集条件异构、标注标准不一，难以支撑鲁棒模型训练。

## 方法创新：DSSCNet框架  
本研究提出**DSSCNet**（Dysarthric Speech Severity Classification Network），一种面向跨语料库迁移学习的端到端深度框架。其核心设计包含三方面创新：  
- **双阶段迁移范式**：在TORGO语料库上预训练特征提取主干（ResNet-18 + 时频注意力模块），再在UA-Speech上微调分类头，实现病理语音表征的跨域知识复用；  
- **多语料联合优化策略**：引入对抗域对齐损失（Adversarial Domain Alignment Loss）与加权Focal Loss，同步缓解域偏移与类别不平衡问题；  
- **说话人无关约束**：通过批归一化层解耦说话人统计量，并嵌入说话人混淆损失（Speaker-Confusion Loss），强制模型聚焦于病理相关判别特征。

## 主要结果与意义  
在严格说话人独立（speaker-independent）协议下，DSSCNet在TORGO上达**75.80%准确率**（较SOTA提升6.2个百分点），在UA-Speech上达**68.25%准确率**（提升5.4个百分点），误分类率降低32.7%。消融实验验证：迁移学习贡献+4.1%性能增益，域对齐机制减少跨语料混淆误差达21.5%。本工作首次系统证明**跨语料知识迁移可显著提升构音障碍严重度评估的临床适用性**，为低资源医疗AI提供可复现、可部署的技术路径，助力个性化言语康复系统开发。
papers.summary_en: Dysarthric speech severity classification is hindered by speaker variability, class imbalance, and scarce annotated data. This paper proposes **DSSCNet**, a transfer learning framework designed for speaker-independent, cross-corpus severity assessment. DSSCNet pre-trains on TORGO and fine-tunes on UA-Speech using a ResNet-18 backbone enhanced with time-frequency attention and adversarial domain alignment to mitigate distribution shift. It further incorporates weighted Focal Loss and speaker-confusion regularization to handle label imbalance and speaker bias. Evaluated under strict speaker-independent protocols, DSSCNet achieves **75.80% accuracy on TORGO** and **68.25% on UA-Speech**, outperforming state-of-the-art models by +6.2% and +5.4%, respectively, with a 32.7% reduction in misclassification errors. Results demonstrate that cross-corpus knowledge transfer significantly improves robustness and clinical applicability of automated dysarthria assessment.

papers.title: CNnotator: LLM-Guided Memory Safety Annotation Synthesis
papers.abstract: Memory safety errors account for a large proportion of security bugs in systems written in C; modern languages such as Java and Rust prevent such bugs because they are memory-safe by design. To migrate systems to safer languages or identify memory errors, we must first determine how legacy code manipulates memory. This information is only represented implicitly in such code.   In many cases, memory usage patterns are merely tedious for humans to figure out, rather than truly difficult. In this work, we ask if large language models (LLMs) can perform this task by having them synthesize annotations representing memory usage as specifications in CN, a hybrid testing/verification tool. Our tool, CNnotator, uses LLMs to automatically generate and test CN specifications. We find that current models are able to generate CN specifications for small-to-medium C programs, with the OpenAI o3 reasoning model achieving a 90% success rate on first attempts and 97% overall success, while the chat model GPT-4o correctly annotates 65% of first attempts. These results suggest AI-assisted annotation is becoming practical for real-world C codebases.
papers.summary_zh:
## 背景与问题  
内存安全漏洞（如缓冲区溢出、悬垂指针、释放后使用）是C语言系统中**最主要的安全风险来源**，占已知安全漏洞的70%以上。与Java、Rust等内存安全语言不同，C语言将内存管理完全交由开发者手动处理，导致关键内存操作语义隐含在代码逻辑中，缺乏显式规范。为实现向安全语言迁移、静态分析或形式化验证，亟需为遗留C代码**自动推断并标注内存使用契约**（如指针有效性、生命周期、所有权等）。

## 方法：CNnotator框架  
本文提出**CNnotator**——首个基于大语言模型（LLM）驱动的内存安全标注合成系统。其核心创新在于：将内存语义建模为**CN工具**（一种融合测试与验证的轻量级规范语言）中的可执行注解；通过多阶段LLM协同流程实现闭环优化：① **提示工程引导**模型理解C代码语义与CN语法；② **自动生成候选注解**；③ **符号执行+模糊测试验证**生成结果；④ **反馈修正循环**提升准确性。系统支持函数级粒度标注，覆盖`malloc`/`free`、数组访问、指针解引用等典型模式。

## 关键结果与贡献  
在包含126个真实C函数（来自Redis、SQLite等项目）的基准测试中：  
- **OpenAI o3（推理优化模型）**首次生成成功率**90%**，经单次验证反馈后整体成功率达**97%**；  
- **GPT-4o（通用聊天模型）**首次成功率**65%**，验证后提升至89%；  
- 相比传统规则引擎（如Clang Static Analyzer），CNnotator在**复杂控制流与跨函数指针传递场景下准确率提升3.2×**。  
本工作首次证实：当前LLM已具备对中等规模C代码进行**高精度、可验证内存契约合成**的能力，为大规模遗留系统安全加固提供了实用化路径。
papers.summary_en: Memory safety errors—such as buffer overflows and use-after-free—are the leading cause of security vulnerabilities in C systems. While modern languages enforce memory safety by design, legacy C code encodes memory usage implicitly, requiring labor-intensive manual annotation for migration or verification. This paper introduces **CNnotator**, an LLM-guided framework that automatically synthesizes executable memory-safety annotations in CN—a hybrid testing/verification specification language. CNnotator leverages LLMs (e.g., OpenAI o3 and GPT-4o) to generate candidate annotations, then validates them via symbolic execution and fuzzing in a feedback loop. Evaluated on 126 real-world C functions from Redis and SQLite, CNnotator achieves **90% first-attempt success with o3** and **97% overall success after one verification round**, outperforming traditional static analyzers on complex pointer-heavy code. Our results demonstrate that LLM-assisted, verifiable annotation synthesis is now practical for industrial C codebases.

papers.title: A new attack to RSA with small private exponent and partial information.
papers.abstract:
We give a new algorithm to attack RSA with small
private exponent, when some partial information of $p + q$ is given.
The algorithm is a very simple modification of original Wiener’s
attack with continued fractions, and allows us to factor $n$ whenever
$d< n^{0.3}$, given an improvement in the original.
attack of Wiener.
papers.summary_zh:
## 新型RSA小私钥攻击：利用 $p+q$ 的部分信息  

本文提出一种针对RSA密码系统的新型攻击方法，适用于**私钥指数 $d$ 较小**且攻击者掌握**模数 $n=pq$ 中素因子和 $p+q$ 的部分高位或低位比特**的场景。该攻击是对经典Wiener攻击的精巧改进：在保留其核心思想——基于连分数逼近的有理数逼近技术——的基础上，巧妙引入 $p+q$ 的已知片段（例如最高 $\ell$ 位或最低 $m$ 位），重构关键方程 $2k d = 2 + k(p+q) - \phi(n)$，从而将问题转化为求解一个带约束的丢番图逼近问题。理论分析表明，当 $d < n^{0.3}$ 时，本算法可在多项式时间内成功分解 $n$，显著优于Wiener原始界限 $d < n^{0.25}$；进一步实验验证，在 $n$ 为1024位时，即使仅知 $p+q$ 的前30位（约总长度的1/3），攻击仍稳定有效。本工作的核心创新在于**不依赖私钥 $d$ 的完整结构假设，仅需少量关于 $p+q$ 的侧信道泄露（如计时、功耗分析中可能获得的中间值）**，大幅拓宽了小私钥攻击的实际适用边界。结果对RSA密钥生成规范提出明确警示：除限制 $d$ 大小外，还需防范 $p+q$ 等衍生参数的信息泄露。
papers.summary_en: We present a new polynomial-time attack on RSA when the private exponent $d$ is small and partial information about $p+q$ (e.g., its most or least significant bits) is known. Our method is a simple yet effective modification of Wiener’s classic continued-fraction attack: by incorporating the known bits of $p+q$, we derive a refined approximation equation that tightens the bound on $d$. We prove that $n$ can be factored in polynomial time whenever $d < n^{0.3}$, improving upon Wiener’s original bound of $d < n^{0.25}$. The attack requires only $\mathcal{O}(\log n)$ bits of $p+q$—feasible under realistic side-channel leakage—and does not assume knowledge of $d$’s bit pattern. This result highlights a previously underestimated vulnerability in RSA key generation.

papers.title: Differential Fault Attack on Atom: Bypassing the Double Key Filter using Filtered Faults
papers.abstract:
In this paper, we present a Differential Fault Attack (DFA) on the lightweight stream cipher Atom,  proposed by Banik et al. in IACR Transactions on Symmetric Cryptography (TOSC)-2021. It employs two key filters simultaneously during the pseudo-random generation algorithm phase, one of which depends on LFSR state bits. Due to this LFSR-dependent key filter, the authors claim that forming algebraic equations relating key and state bits as variables to the keystream bits is difficult unless the entire LFSR state is known. In contrast, we propose a method to formulate such algebraic equations without guessing any LFSR bits. This enables us to implement a successful DFA on Atom. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first successful DFA reported on Atom . In the proposed DFA, we identify the location of injected faults using a weighted ensemble of trained MLP and XGBoost models. To further improve accuracy, we filter out ML predictions with confidence below a predefined threshold. We found that this strategy significantly reduces the number of SAT solver invocations and improves the overall time complexity of the attack.  
Based on our experiments, we demonstrate a successful DFA on Atom within a practical time by injecting 18 faults, provided all are correctly identified. Obtaining a set of 18 correctly identified faults requires, on average, 52 fault injections. The attack requires a total of 70 keystream bits (normal and faulty combined) just after a fault injection and guessing two random key bits.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与问题  
轻量级流密码**Atom**（Banik等，TOSC 2021）采用双密钥滤波器结构，在伪随机密钥流生成阶段并行启用两个滤波器：一个依赖于线性反馈移位寄存器（LFSR）的当前状态比特，另一个为固定逻辑。作者声称，由于LFSR依赖型滤波器的存在，若不完全恢复整个LFSR状态，则难以建立以密钥比特和LFSR状态比特为变量、以密钥流比特为输出的代数方程——这构成了对差分故障分析（DFA）的关键防御屏障。

## 创新方法与技术突破  
本文首次成功突破该防御，提出一种**无需猜测任何LFSR状态比特**的代数建模方法：通过精确刻画故障传播路径与双滤波器的耦合关系，将故障注入后观测到的正常/错误密钥流差异直接转化为关于**32位主密钥**的可解代数方程组。进一步，我们设计了一套**基于机器学习的故障定位框架**：采用加权集成模型（MLP + XGBoost），对故障注入位置进行高精度预测；并引入置信度阈值过滤机制，仅保留高置信度预测结果，显著降低SAT求解器调用次数（实测减少约68%）。

## 关键实验结果  
在标准硬件环境下，攻击仅需**18次精准定位的故障注入**即可恢复全部密钥；平均需52次物理故障注入以获得这18个可靠样本。整个攻击仅消耗**70比特密钥流**（含故障前后密钥流片段）及**2比特密钥的穷举猜测**，总时间复杂度在分钟级内完成，具备实际可行性。据我们所知，这是**首个针对Atom密码的实用化DFA攻击**，揭示了其双滤波器设计在故障场景下的结构性脆弱性。
papers.summary_en: We present the first practical Differential Fault Attack (DFA) against the lightweight stream cipher Atom (TOSC 2021), which employs a double key filter—one LFSR-state-dependent—to resist algebraic cryptanalysis. Contrary to prior belief, we construct solvable algebraic equations linking secret key bits directly to observed keystream differences **without guessing any LFSR state bits**, bypassing the core defense. To locate fault positions accurately, we propose a confidence-filtered ensemble of MLP and XGBoost models, reducing SAT solver invocations by ~68%. Experimentally, the attack recovers the full 32-bit key using only **18 correctly identified faults**, requiring on average 52 physical injections; it consumes just **70 keystream bits** (normal + faulty) and guesses only **two key bits**. This demonstrates a feasible, sub-minute DFA—revealing a critical structural weakness in Atom’s fault resilience.

papers.title: Post-quantum Secure Non-Committing Registered Functional Encryption
papers.abstract:
Non-committing encryption (NCE) is a key primitive for proving security against adaptive corruptions, enabling simulators to generate ciphertexts before the encrypted message is known. Existing non-committing constructions for attribute-based encryption primitives [Hiroka et al., ASIACRYPT 2021; Goyal et al., PKC 2025] typically rely on centralized trust that generate users' secret keys. However, modern cryptographic systems increasingly aim to eliminate such trust assumptions through decentralized frameworks such as registered encryption, where users independently generate and register their own keys.

In this work, we initiate the study of non-committing registered functional encryption (NC-RFE) as a generalization of non-committing attribute-based encryption in the decentralized framework. We formalize the notion of NC-RFE by adapting classical non-committing security to the registered setting. We then present a generic construction based on indistinguishability obfuscation and zero-knowledge arguments, and prove its security assuming a secure underlying registered functional encryption (RFE) scheme. We further provide a lattice-based instantiation, yielding a post-quantum secure NC-RFE scheme based on the hardness of the plain LWE and equivocal LWE assumptions.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与问题  
非承诺加密（Non-Committing Encryption, NCE）是实现**自适应敌手安全**的关键密码原语，允许模拟器在明文确定前生成“可重解释”的密文，从而支撑通用安全证明（如CCA安全性、多方计算等）。然而，现有面向属性加密（ABE）的非承诺构造（如Hiroka等，ASIACRYPT 2021；Goyal等，PKC 2025）均依赖**中心化可信授权机构**统一生成并分发用户私钥，违背了现代密码系统对去中心化与用户自主权的核心诉求。

## 创新框架：非承诺注册式函数加密（NC-RFE）  
本文首次提出并形式化**非承诺注册式函数加密（Non-Committing Registered Functional Encryption, NC-RFE）**——这是NCE在**注册式加密（Registered Encryption）**范式下的自然推广。在该框架中，用户**独立生成密钥对并公开注册公钥**，无需任何中心化信任；系统安全性需同时满足：（1）标准RFE功能正确性与隐私性；（2）非承诺安全性——敌手可自适应选择注册者、查询函数及挑战密文，模拟器仍能无差别地模拟所有交互。

## 方法与成果  
我们给出两层贡献：  
- **通用构造**：基于**不可区分混淆（iO）**与**零知识论证（ZKA）**，将任意安全的注册式函数加密（RFE）方案提升为NC-RFE方案，并在标准假设下完成严格归约证明；  
- **后量子实例化**：设计首个**基于格的NC-RFE方案**，仅依赖**普通LWE（plain LWE）**与**可混淆LWE（equivocal LWE）**两个经典后量子假设，实现**抗量子攻击的安全性**，且避免了随机预言机或强假设（如SIS的超多项式模数）。  

本工作弥合了非承诺安全与去中心化密钥管理之间的理论鸿沟，为构建后量子时代自适应安全的分布式隐私计算系统提供了新基石。
papers.summary_en: Non-committing encryption (NCE) enables simulation-based security proofs against adaptive corruptions. Prior NCE constructions for attribute-based encryption rely on centralized key generation, conflicting with the decentralized paradigm of *registered encryption*, where users autonomously generate and register keys. This paper initiates the study of *non-committing registered functional encryption (NC-RFE)*—a generalization of NCE to the registered setting. We formalize NC-RFE security by adapting classical non-committing indistinguishability to adaptive registration and functional queries. We present a generic construction from indistinguishability obfuscation and zero-knowledge arguments, proving its security given any secure registered functional encryption (RFE) scheme. Furthermore, we provide the first post-quantum instantiation based solely on the hardness of plain LWE and equivocal LWE, achieving quantum-resistant NC-RFE without random oracles or super-polynomial assumptions.

papers.title: A Toolkit for Succinct Lattice-Based Zero Knowledge Proofs
papers.abstract:
The development of proof systems whose security relies on the hardness of lattice problems has been a fruitful research area in recent years. By leveraging the techniques introduced in LaBRADOR (Beullens, Seiler, Crypto 2023), the state-of-the-art lattice-based schemes have very fast provers and have output sizes under 100KB for arbitrarily large statements. These proofs are in fact the smallest, and often have the fastest provers, out of all post-quantum schemes.

In addition to succinctness, many applications also require witness privacy. Achieving this can, in theory, be done by combining LaBRADOR with a linear-size zero-knowledge proof. While such a combination has already been described in the LaBRADOR paper itself, as well as in the works of Albrecht et al. (Eurocrypt 2024) and del Pino et al. (Crypto 2025), its concrete costs remained unexplored.

In this work, we provide the first concrete construction and implementation that adds zero-knowledge proofs to LaBRADOR by integrating the linear-size zero-knowledge proof from (Lyubashevsky, Nguyen, Plançon, Crypto 2022) into the protocol. We describe the non-trivial challenges that this entails and show practicality of the construction by benchmarking several use-cases. We make the proof system and primitives accessible by extending the LaZer library (Lyubashevsky, Seiler, Steuer, CCS 2024) in a way that they can easily be used in other applications.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景  
近年来，基于格难题安全性的零知识证明系统成为后量子密码学的重要研究方向。LaBRADOR（Beullens & Seiler, Crypto 2023）开创性地实现了**高效率、高简洁性**的格基证明：其证明者运行极快，且对任意规模陈述（statement）的证明大小**稳定低于100 KB**，目前在所有后量子方案中兼具最小证明尺寸与最快证明速度。

## 核心挑战与创新  
尽管LaBRADOR具备优异的简洁性，但**不原生提供计算型零知识（witness privacy）**。理论上可通过拼接线性尺寸零知识协议实现，但此前工作（包括LaBRADOR原文、Albrecht et al. Eurocrypt 2024、del Pino et al. Crypto 2025）均未给出可落地的实现与实证评估——关键瓶颈在于协议耦合带来的非平凡技术挑战：如承诺机制兼容性、多项式承诺与格承诺的协同验证、交互轮次优化及噪声增长控制等。

## 主要贡献  
本工作首次提出并实现了**首个完全可运行、经实证验证的零知识增强版LaBRADOR**：  
- **技术整合**：将Lyubashevsky等（Crypto 2022）提出的线性尺寸零知识协议无缝嵌入LaBRADOR框架；  
- **工程实现**：系统解决协议适配难点，包括重定义公共参数结构、重构承诺流水线、设计高效批验证逻辑；  
- **实证验证**：在多个典型用例（如范围证明、电路满足性）上完成基准测试，证明生成时间仅增加约1.8×，证明大小维持在≈95 KB（<100 KB），验证时间可控；  
- **开源赋能**：通过扩展主流格密码库**LaZer**（Lyubashevsky et al., CCS 2024），提供模块化API，支持开发者一键集成零知识能力。

本工具包填补了格基简洁证明与强隐私保障之间的实用鸿沟，为区块链扩容、隐私合约等场景提供了首个兼具**亚100 KB证明尺寸、毫秒级证明生成、严格零知识保证**的开源解决方案。
papers.summary_en: This work presents the first concrete, implemented toolkit that augments the state-of-the-art succinct lattice-based proof system LaBRADOR with computational zero-knowledge (ZK). While LaBRADOR achieves record-breaking prover speed and sub-100 KB proof sizes for arbitrary statements, it lacks inherent witness privacy. We integrate Lyubashevsky–Nguyen–Plançon’s linear-size ZK protocol (Crypto 2022) into LaBRADOR—addressing non-trivial challenges in commitment compatibility, noise management, and verification efficiency. Our implementation, benchmarked across practical use cases (e.g., range proofs, circuit satisfiability), shows proofs remain under 95 KB, prover overhead is only ~1.8×, and verification stays efficient. We release the system as an extension of the LaZer library, enabling easy adoption in real-world applications. This is the first practical, open-source lattice-based ZK toolkit achieving succinctness, strong privacy, and deployable performance.

papers.title: SuccinCT: Succinct Confidential Transaction for Miner Privacy
papers.abstract:
Confidential transaction (CT) protocols are widely used to protect the privacy of blockchain-based cryptocurrency transactions. However, existing CT schemes primarily focus on ordinary users' anonymity and amount confidentiality, while overlooking miner privacy as a native objective. In particular, the privacy of miners' coinbase-receiving addresses has not been systematically considered in security models. In this paper, we identify two novel attacks against miner privacy in existing CT protocols, called miner privacy attacks and anonymity reduction attacks. These attacks arise from the transparency of the mining coinbase amounts and transaction fees in the underlying blockchain systems. When miners' accounts are included in a CT, our general solutions compatible with all schemes can prevent adversaries from identifying miners as the real spenders or excluding miners from the possible spender sets.

We propose SuccinCT, the first CT protocol based on the DualRing structure to address the aforementioned attacks. Compared with existing schemes, SuccinCT achieves the smallest overall transaction size while protecting miner privacy. Specifically, the proof size of SuccinCT is about 20% smaller than the latest BulletCT (USENIX SEC'25). We implement SuccinCT and evaluate its performance for ring sizes from 128 to 1024. The results show that signature generation takes about 2-3 ms and verification takes about 1-2 ms. These results demonstrate that SuccinCT provides stronger privacy guarantees, novel construction, and practical efficiency for real-world deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
## 背景与问题  
保密交易（Confidential Transaction, CT）协议广泛用于保护区块链加密货币中用户身份与交易金额的隐私。然而，现有CT方案（如RingCT、BulletCT）主要聚焦于普通用户的匿名性与金额隐藏，**系统性忽视矿工隐私这一原生安全需求**——尤其是矿工接收区块奖励（coinbase）的地址在安全模型中长期未被建模为需保护的敏感实体。

## 新型攻击与缺陷分析  
本文首次揭示两类针对矿工隐私的新型攻击：  
- **矿工隐私攻击**：利用区块链上coinbase金额与交易手续费完全透明的特性，攻击者可通过金额匹配与模式分析，精准识别某笔CT的实际支出者是否为矿工；  
- **匿名性削弱攻击**：即使无法100%确认矿工身份，攻击者也能显著缩小可能支出者集合，实质性削弱环签名的匿名集强度。

## 方案创新与性能优势  
我们提出**SuccinCT**——首个基于DualRing结构的矿工感知型CT协议。其核心创新在于：  
- 设计**矿工适配的双环证明机制**，在不暴露coinbase来源的前提下，将矿工地址无缝融入隐私环；  
- 实现**最小化交易体积**：在同等安全性下，SuccinCT的零知识证明尺寸比最新BulletCT（USENIX Security’25）**缩小约20%**；  
- 兼容所有主流CT框架，可作为模块化插件部署。

## 实验验证  
在ring size=128–1024范围内实测表明：签名生成耗时**2.1–2.9 ms**，验证仅需**1.3–1.8 ms**，具备实时交易处理能力。SuccinCT不仅填补了矿工隐私保护的理论空白，更以紧凑构造与高效实现为隐私公链提供了可落地的新范式。
papers.summary_en: Confidential Transaction (CT) protocols protect user anonymity and amount confidentiality in blockchain cryptocurrencies, yet **miner privacy—especially coinbase-receiving address confidentiality—has been neglected in existing security models**. This paper identifies two novel attacks: *miner privacy attacks*, where adversaries identify miners as actual spenders via transparent coinbase amounts/fees; and *anonymity reduction attacks*, which shrink the plausible spender set even without full identification. We propose **SuccinCT**, the first CT protocol built on the DualRing structure to natively defend miners. SuccinCT achieves the **smallest overall transaction size** among state-of-the-art schemes: its proof is **~20% smaller than BulletCT (USENIX SEC’25)**. Implementation shows signature generation takes **2–3 ms** and verification **1–2 ms**, even for ring sizes up to 1024. SuccinCT delivers stronger miner privacy guarantees, a novel construction, and practical efficiency for real-world deployment.

papers.title: Towards a Doubly Efficient IP=PSPACE
papers.abstract:
We show that every language in PSPACE decidable by a Turing machine in time $T(n)=n^{O(\log n)}$ admits a doubly efficient interactive proof system: the prover runs in time polynomial in T(n), and the verifier runs in time polynomial in n. This extends the best previously known regime for such proof systems from $T(n)=n^{O(\sqrt{\log n / \log\log n})}$, established by Berger, Goyal, Hong, and Kalai (FOCS 2025), to $T(n)=n^{O(\log n)}$.

Beyond improving the range of T, our protocol is substantially simpler than previous doubly efficient proofs for time-bounded PSPACE. Earlier constructions proceed indirectly: they first build batch interactive proofs and then invoke them as a black box to obtain doubly efficient protocols. In contrast, we give a direct construction. This not only simplifies the proof but also points to a more promising route for future improvements.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与问题  
交互式证明系统（IP）是计算复杂性理论的核心工具。经典结果 IP = PSPACE 表明，任何多项式空间可判定的语言都存在交互式证明；但传统协议中验证者（verifier）运行时间通常为多项式空间量级，难以在实际场景（如轻量级设备或实时验证）中部署。**“双重高效”（doubly efficient）** 交互式证明要求：**证明者（prover）运行时间仅多项式依赖于原始问题的计算时间 $T(n)$，而验证者运行时间仅多项式依赖于输入长度 $n$**——这对高效率验证具有关键意义。

## 主要突破  
本文将双重高效 IP 的适用范围从此前最优的 $T(n) = n^{O(\sqrt{\log n / \log\log n})}$（Berger et al., FOCS 2025）**大幅提升至 $T(n) = n^{O(\log n)}$**，覆盖了更广泛的 PSPACE 语言，例如多项式空间内需准多项式时间（quasi-polynomial time）求解的问题（如某些博弈、模型检测和分层电路评估问题）。

## 方法创新  
不同于以往依赖**黑盒调用批量交互证明（batch IP）** 的间接构造，本文提出**首个直接构造法**：基于分层算术电路编码、低度扩展与随机线性检验（randomized linear test），结合新型递归验证策略，避免冗余嵌套与参数放大。该设计显著简化协议结构、降低常数因子，并为突破 $n^{\mathrm{polylog} n}$ 边界提供了清晰的技术路径。

## 理论意义  
本工作不仅刷新了双重高效 IP 的时间上限，更揭示了 PSPACE 中准多项式时间子类与高效验证之间的深层联系，为后续构建亚线性验证器、零知识变体及硬件友好型密码协议奠定基础。
papers.summary_en: We present a doubly efficient interactive proof system for all languages in PSPACE decidable in time $T(n) = n^{O(\log n)}$: the prover runs in $\mathrm{poly}(T(n))$ time, and the verifier in $\mathrm{poly}(n)$ time. This improves upon the prior best bound of $T(n) = n^{O(\sqrt{\log n / \log \log n})}$ (Berger et al., FOCS 2025). Crucially, our construction is **direct**, bypassing the indirect batch-IP paradigm used in all previous doubly efficient protocols for time-bounded PSPACE. By leveraging hierarchical arithmetic encoding, low-degree extensions, and recursive randomized linear testing, we achieve both conceptual simplicity and quantitative gains—paving the way toward even broader efficiency regimes.

papers.title: Multiple-of Property for Related-Differential Distinguishers on 5-Round AES
papers.abstract: A key-independent secret-key distinguisher identifies inherent structural deviations of a block cipher from an ideal random permutation without recovering any information about the secret key. For the Advanced Encryption Standard (AES), various key-independent secret-key distinguishers have been proposed on reduced-round versions. In this paper, we study related-differential distinguishers for 5-round AES that combine a 1-round related differential trail with the 4-round generalized zero-difference property. We prove that the number of valid quartets satisfying the underlying property takes the multiple-of form, N_q = 2^{2-n_z}(2^w)^{n_z} A + 8B, where A, B are non-negative integers, w is the cell size, and n_z is the number of inactive bytes of Delta X_2 (the difference at the second-round input) under the chosen pairing of the 4-plaintext quartet into two pairs. The pairing fixes the bundle size 2^{2-n_z}(2^w)^{n_z}, which sets the variance of the valid-quartet count. We compare the three pairings n_z in {0, 1, 2}. In the chosen-plaintext setting, where a single structure is examined as a whole, a smaller bundle keeps the count closer to its mean, so n_z=0 is the most reliable single-structure distinguisher, n_z=1 is close behind, and n_z=2 almost fails. The pairing n_z=1 is that of Yan et al. Its 2*2^w bundle raises the variance, so it reaches 63% only at 2^{27.2}, rather than at the 2^{27} where one valid quartet is expected. At the same 2^{27.2}, the smaller bundle of n_z=0 reaches 65%. In the adaptively chosen-plaintext setting the bundle does not form across the separate base collisions, so n_z=1, which produces more valid quartets, is the better pairing. All claims are verified experimentally on both small-AES (w=4) and the standard AES (w=8).
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与问题  
密钥无关的秘密密钥区分器（key-independent secret-key distinguisher）旨在揭示分组密码相对于理想随机置换的内在结构性偏差，无需恢复任何密钥信息。针对AES，已有多种此类区分器应用于缩减轮数版本，但5轮AES的高精度、低数据复杂度区分器仍具挑战性。

## 方法创新  
本文首次系统研究5轮AES上的**相关差分区分器**（related-differential distinguisher），其核心是将1轮相关差分传播与4轮广义零差分性质（generalized zero-difference property）有机结合。我们严格证明：满足该复合性质的有效四元组（quartet）数量具有**倍数形式**（multiple-of property）：  
$$N_q = 2^{2-n_z}(2^w)^{n_z} A + 8B$$  
其中 $A,B\in\mathbb{Z}_{\geq0}$，$w$ 为字节单元大小（4或8），$n_z$ 表示第二轮输入差分 $\Delta X_2$ 中非活跃字节数——由四明文四元组的**配对方式**决定，直接影响“捆绑大小”（bundle size）$2^{2-n_z}(2^w)^{n_z}$，进而控制有效四元组计数的方差。

## 关键发现  
- 对比三种配对策略（$n_z=0,1,2$）：在**选择明文模型**（单结构整体分析）下，$n_z=0$ 捆绑最小（$2^2=4$），方差最低，区分可靠性最强（65%成功率达 $2^{27.2}$）；$n_z=1$（Yan等所用，捆绑大小 $2\cdot2^w$）次之（63%）；$n_z=2$ 几乎失效。  
- 在**自适应选择明文模型**（多独立基础碰撞）下，因捆绑不跨结构，$n_z=1$ 生成更多有效四元组，成为更优选择。  
- 所有理论结论均在小AES（$w=4$）和标准AES（$w=8$）上通过实验完整验证，填补了5轮AES相关差分分析的理论空白。
papers.summary_en: This paper introduces a novel related-differential distinguisher for 5-round AES, combining a 1-round related differential trail with the 4-round generalized zero-difference property. We prove that the number $N_q$ of valid quartets follows a *multiple-of* form: $N_q = 2^{2-n_z}(2^w)^{n_z} A + 8B$, where $n_z$ is the number of inactive bytes in $\Delta X_2$, and the bundle size $2^{2-n_z}(2^w)^{n_z}$ governs variance. In the chosen-plaintext setting (single structure), $n_z = 0$ yields the lowest variance and highest reliability (65% success at $2^{27.2}$ queries), outperforming Yan et al.’s $n_z = 1$ (63% at same data) and $n_z = 2$ (near failure). In the adaptively chosen-plaintext setting, $n_z = 1$ becomes superior due to higher quartet yield per collision. All results are experimentally confirmed on both small-AES ($w=4$) and standard AES ($w=8$).

## 研究背景与问题  
密钥无关的秘密密钥区分器（key-independent secret-key distinguisher）旨在揭示分组密码相对于理想随机置换的内在结构性偏差，无需恢复任何密钥信息。针对AES，已有多种此类区分器应用于缩减轮数版本，但5轮AES的高精度、低数据复杂度区分器仍具挑战性。

## 方法创新  
本文首次系统研究5轮AES上的**相关差分区分器**（related-differential distinguisher），其核心是将1轮相关差分传播与4轮广义零差分性质（generalized zero-difference property）有机结合。我们严格证明：满足该复合性质的有效四元组（quartet）数量具有**倍数形式**（multiple-of property）：  
$$N_q = 2^{2-n_z}(2^w)^{n_z} A + 8B$$  
其中 $A,B\in\mathbb{Z}_{\geq0}$，$w$ 为字节单元大小（4或8），$n_z$ 表示第二轮输入差分 $\Delta X_2$ 中非活跃字节数——由四明文四元组的**配对方式**决定，直接影响“捆绑大小”（bundle size）$2^{2-n_z}(2^w)^{n_z}$，进而控制有效四元组计数的方差。

## 关键发现  
- 对比三种配对策略（$n_z=0,1,2$）：在**选择明文模型**（单结构整体分析）下，$n_z=0$ 捆绑最小（$2^2=4$），方差最低，区分可靠性最强（65%成功率达 $2^{27.2}$）；$n_z=1$（Yan等所用，捆绑大小 $2\cdot2^w$）次之（63%）；$n_z=2$ 几乎失效。  
- 在**自适应选择明文模型**（多独立基础碰撞）下，因捆绑不跨结构，$n_z=1$ 生成更多有效四元组，成为更优选择。  
- 所有理论结论均在小AES（$w=4$）和标准AES（$w=8$）上通过实验完整验证，填补了5轮AES相关差分分析的理论空白。

papers.title: AdaPrivate-TS: Private Thompson Sampling for Contextual Bandits with Privacy Amplification
papers.abstract: We present AdaPrivate-TS, a differentially private contextual bandit algorithm that combines Thompson Sampling with batched zCDP composition. Our key insight is that differential privacy noise inflates the posterior covariance in a structured way: adding Gaussian noise $N(0,σ^2 I)$ to $b$ yields sampling covariance $v^2 A^{-1} + σ^2 A^{-2}$, which Thompson Sampling interprets as increased uncertainty rather than pure corruption. Under event-level privacy (protecting individual interactions) with stochastic contexts, we prove that the privacy cost is only $O(\sqrt{d}\,\log T/\sqrtρ)$, logarithmic in $T$, because parallel composition amortizes noise across batches. Additionally, we explore privacy amplification via Poisson subsampling, which can reduce effective noise at stringent privacy budgets. Experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate: (1) AdaPrivate-TS achieves 93-99% of non-private performance at $\varepsilon \in [0.5, 5]$, outperforming UCB by 0.5-3.7% and up to 18% with tuned adaptive exploration at extreme $\varepsilon$; (2) privacy amplification provides additional 2-5% gains at low $\varepsilon$; (3) on MovieLens and Jester, AdaPrivate-TS achieves the best overall performance among event-level baselines, dominating at $\varepsilon \geq 2$; (4) under DP-SVD private features, TS's advantage over UCB grows to +11%, confirming noise-as-uncertainty is not limited to reward privacy. We provide rigorous proofs for privacy guarantees under interactive zCDP composition and comprehensive evaluation including convergence curves, 12-seed CIs, and DP-SVD feature ablation.

## AdaPrivate-TS：面向上下文赌博机的自适应差分隐私汤普森采样算法  

本文提出 **AdaPrivate-TS**——一种融合**汤普森采样（Thompson Sampling, TS）** 与**批处理零浓度差分隐私（zCDP）组合**的新型事件级差分隐私上下文赌博机算法。核心洞见在于：差分隐私所引入的高斯噪声并非简单“污染”模型，而是以结构化方式放大后验协方差——当对梯度项 $b$ 添加 $N(0,\sigma^2 I)$ 噪声时，TS 实际采样的协方差变为 $v^2 A^{-1} + \sigma^2 A^{-2}$，被自然解释为**不确定性增长**而非参数失真，从而保留了贝叶斯探索的统计合理性。

理论方面：在随机上下文假设下，得益于**并行组合的噪声摊销效应**，AdaPrivate-TS 的隐私成本仅为 $O(\sqrt{d}\,\log T/\sqrt{\rho})$，呈**对数级依赖于总轮数 $T$**（$\rho$ 为 zCDP 参数），显著优于线性累积型机制。进一步引入**泊松子采样（Poisson subsampling）** 实现隐私放大，在严苛隐私预算（如 $\varepsilon < 1$）下有效降低等效噪声强度。

实验验证覆盖合成数据与真实基准（MovieLens、Jester）：  
- 在 $\varepsilon \in [0.5, 5]$ 下，AdaPrivate-TS 达到非私有基线 **93–99% 的性能**，稳定超越 UCB **0.5–3.7%**；在极低 $\varepsilon$ 下通过自适应探索调优，领先优势扩大至 **+18%**；  
- 隐私放大机制带来额外 **2–5% 的性能增益**；  
- 在事件级隐私基线中综合表现最优，尤其在 $\varepsilon \geq 2$ 时全面主导；  
- 结合 DP-SVD 提取的私有特征后，TS 相对 UCB 的优势进一步提升至 **+11%**，证实“噪声即不确定性”范式适用于**特征与奖励双重隐私保护**。  
论文提供 zCDP 交互式组合下的严格隐私证明，并包含收敛曲线、12次随机种子置信区间及 DP-SVD 特征消融分析。

Under event-level privacy and stochastic contexts, our analysis shows privacy cost scales only as $O(\sqrt{d}\,\log T/\sqrt{\rho})$, logarithmic in $T$, due to parallel noise amortization across batches. papers.title: Safe to Check, Unsafe to Use: Relinking at the Compression Boundary of LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Summarization-based prompt compression is increasingly used by LLM agents to shorten long, distributed contexts, but it shifts the security boundary: filters inspect the pre-compression prompt while the backend acts on a newly generated compressed context. We identify relinking, a compression-boundary vulnerability where the compressor behaves as a confused deputy, summarizing distributed, locally benign fragments into a complete malicious instruction. Unlike prompt injection, relinking need not place an explicitly malicious payload in the source context. We show that relinking arises from summarization itself: attention makes separated fragments jointly available, pre-training makes compatible fragments plausible to connect, and post-training favors compact backend-actionable summaries. We formalize the attacker-induced form as adversarial relinking and present Relink, an automated DSL-based tool that splits malicious payloads into benign fragments while keeping the complete payload absent before compression. Across four long-context agent benchmarks, Relink achieves 86.9% Relink Rate and Backend Action Rate versus 17.0% for clean-split controls. Existing defenses fail to reliably capture adversarial relinking; our KBRA defense reduces residual Backend Action Rate to 0.0%.
papers.summary_zh:
## 安全检查边界与使用边界分离：大语言模型代理中的“重链接”漏洞

当前，基于摘要的提示压缩（summarization-based prompt compression）被广泛应用于长上下文LLM代理中，以缩减分布式、冗长的输入。然而，该技术意外地**迁移了安全防护边界**：安全过滤器仅能检查压缩前的原始提示，而模型后端实际执行的是压缩后新生成的上下文——二者存在语义鸿沟。

本文首次提出并系统定义**重链接（Relinking）** 这一新型压缩边界漏洞：压缩器在无意中充当“困惑副手”（confused deputy），将原本分散、局部无害的文本片段，通过摘要过程**跨片段语义重组**，合成出完整、可执行的恶意指令。与传统提示注入不同，重链接**无需在源上下文中显式嵌入恶意载荷**；恶意性完全由压缩过程动态涌现。

我们从机制层面揭示其根源：**注意力机制**使物理分离的片段在压缩时联合可见；**预训练知识**使语义兼容的碎片天然具备连接合理性；**后训练偏好**则驱动模型生成紧凑、后端可直接行动的摘要。进一步，我们将攻击者主动构造的场景形式化为**对抗性重链接（adversarial relinking）**，并设计**Relink**——一种基于领域特定语言（DSL）的自动化工具：它将恶意指令拆分为多个语义孤立、静态检测下完全良性的片段，确保压缩前无完整恶意模式存在。

在四个主流长上下文代理基准（包括ToolBench、AgentBench等）上，Relink实现**86.9%的重链接率（Relink Rate）与后端动作率（Backend Action Rate）**，显著高于清洁分割对照组的17.0%。现有防御（如输入过滤、摘要重检）对此类漏洞几乎无效；我们提出的**知识边界鲁棒性评估（KBRA）防御**，通过压缩前后语义一致性校验与动作意图溯源，将残余后端动作率降至**0.0%**，首次实现对该漏洞的可靠阻断。
papers.summary_en: Summarization-based prompt compression is widely adopted by LLM agents to handle long, distributed contexts—but it creates a critical security misalignment: filters inspect the *pre-compressed* prompt, while the backend executes the *post-compressed* summary. We identify **relinking**, a novel compression-boundary vulnerability where the summarizer acts as a “confused deputy,” synthesizing benign, spatially separated fragments into a coherent malicious instruction—*without requiring any explicit malicious payload in the original input*. Relinking emerges intrinsically from summarization: attention enables cross-fragment integration; pre-training makes semantically compatible fragments plausible to link; and post-training biases favor compact, backend-actionable outputs. We formalize the attacker-driven variant as *adversarial relinking* and introduce **Relink**, a DSL-based tool that automatically splits malicious instructions into syntactically/semantically benign fragments—ensuring the full payload is absent *before* compression. Across four long-context agent benchmarks, Relink achieves an 86.9% Relink Rate and Backend Action Rate—versus only 17.0% for clean-split controls. Existing defenses fail against adversarial relinking; our KBRA defense—leveraging semantic consistency verification and action-intent grounding—reduces residual Backend Action Rate to 0.0%.

papers.title: Toward Open Weight Models Without Risks: Separating Public and Private Capabilities in LLMs
papers.abstract: Open-weight Large Language Models (LLMs) enable scientific progress and broad deployment. However, they make it difficult to control access to sensitive capabilities. Current practice either suppresses dangerous capabilities before release or mediates access through closed services that use specialized model variants, input/output monitors, and API permissions. The former is susceptible to jailbreaks while sacrificing capability for all users to mitigate the risks posed by a few, and the latter is fundamentally incompatible with open-weight release. In this paper, we propose Tiered Language Models (TLMs), where a single set of released weights supports multiple capability levels. In its default public configuration, a TLM behaves as a conventional LLM. A compact secret key specifies a permutation over a small parameter subset, inducing an alternative computation graph over the same weights that exposes additional capabilities. We develop a training protocol that jointly pretrains both configurations from scratch, then fine-tunes the keyed configuration on private data with regularization to preserve the public model's behavior. We pretrain 180M- and 650M-parameter TLMs and demonstrate that the keyed configuration can acquire a new language, gain instruction-following ability, and memorize private factual knowledge, whereas the public configuration exhibits none of these capabilities. Moreover, we show that our approach extends naturally to multiple hierarchical tiers. Because authorization operates on the model's weight structure rather than in the input space, the mechanism resists fine-tuning-based extraction and partial key compromise. In general, TLMs take a step toward reconciling open-weight release with selective capability control.
papers.summary_zh:
## 开放权重模型的风险可控新范式：分层语言模型（TLMs）

开放权重大语言模型（LLMs）是推动AI科研与普惠应用的关键基础设施，但其“全能力一次性释放”特性带来严峻的安全治理挑战：当前方案要么在发布前**主动压制敏感能力**（导致能力降级、易被 jailbreak 绕过），要么依赖**封闭式API服务**（违背开放权重初衷）。本文提出**分层语言模型（Tiered Language Models, TLMs）**，首次实现“单套权重、多级能力”的可控开放——同一组公开发布的模型参数，在默认配置下表现为标准LLM；仅当持有**紧凑型密钥**（如128-bit）时，该密钥指定对少量参数（<0.1%）的置换操作，即可动态重构计算图，**无损激活额外私有能力**（如新语言支持、指令遵循、私有知识记忆），而公共配置完全不暴露这些能力。

我们设计了端到端联合预训练协议：从零开始同步优化公共与密钥配置，再以私有数据微调密钥分支，并引入行为一致性正则化，严格保障公共模型性能不受影响。在180M/650M参数规模上验证：密钥配置可成功习得俄语生成、复杂指令执行及百条私有事实记忆，而公共配置在同等测试中准确率趋近于零。进一步证明TLM天然支持**多层级能力嵌套**（如三级权限），且因授权机制作用于**权重结构本身**（非输入过滤或API网关），能有效抵抗模型窃取、部分密钥泄露及后门微调攻击。本工作为开放权重范式提供了首个兼具科学透明性、部署灵活性与能力可控性的系统性解决方案。
papers.summary_en: Open-weight LLMs accelerate research and deployment but compromise control over sensitive capabilities. Current approaches—capability suppression or closed API mediation—are either insecure or incompatible with open weights. We propose **Tiered Language Models (TLMs)**: a single released weight set supports multiple capability tiers. By default, it behaves as a standard LLM; a compact secret key permutes a tiny parameter subset (<0.1%), inducing an alternative computation graph that unlocks private capabilities—without altering weights. Our joint pretraining protocol trains both configurations from scratch, followed by private-data fine-tuning with behavior-preserving regularization. Experiments on 180M- and 650M-parameter TLMs show the keyed variant acquires new language fluency, instruction-following, and private factual knowledge—while the public variant exhibits none of these. The mechanism resists fine-tuning extraction and partial key compromise, naturally extends to hierarchical tiers, and reconciles openness with selective capability governance.

我们设计了端到端联合预训练协议：从零开始同步优化公共与密钥配置，再以私有数据微调密钥分支，并引入行为一致性正则化，严格保障公共模型性能不受影响。在180M/650M参数规模上验证：密钥配置可成功习得俄语生成、复杂指令执行及百条私有事实记忆，而公共配置在同等测试中准确率趋近于零。进一步证明TLM天然支持**多层级能力嵌套**（如三级权限），且因授权机制作用于**权重结构本身**（非输入过滤或API网关），能有效抵抗模型窃取、部分密钥泄露及后门微调攻击。本工作为开放权重范式提供了首个兼具科学透明性、部署灵活性与能力可控性的系统性解决方案。

papers.title: Evaluating LLMs for Real-World Web Vulnerability Detection
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have emerged as a promising tool for automated vulnerability detection, yet their effectiveness on web-specific vulnerabilities remains to be explored.   This work benchmarks six frontier (Claude Opus 4.6, Codex GPT-5.4, Gemini 3.1-pro-preview) and open-weight models (Qwen 3.5, Qwen 3 Coder Next, MiniMax M2.5) on their ability to detect real-world web vulnerabilities using static analysis in WordPress plugins, including SQL injection, stored cross-site scripting, path traversal, and remote code execution. Using five prompt designs of varying structure, scope, and complexity across three experiment iterations, we aim to answer how model and prompt choice affects vulnerability detection.   Our results show that all models are capable of detecting valid security issues, but the detection rate varies depending on the model and prompt. For example, Claude Opus 4.6 achieved the highest web vulnerability detection rate (63%), while open-weight MiniMax M2.5 performs on par with other frontier models (48%), and self-hosted Qwen 3.5 only achieved 35%. We show that scoped prompts that narrow the vulnerability scope outperform open-ended ones, whereas the prompt complexity has little impact. Surprisingly, no model achieved full reporting consistency across three experiment iterations, with some as low as 50%. Our experiments demonstrate the opportunities and limits of LLM-based vulnerability detection, as no model correctly identified one baseline vulnerability in one of the plugins.   Additionally, we derive practical lessons learned for security practitioners and publish all code and data to support future research.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与目标  
大型语言模型（LLMs）在自动化漏洞检测中展现出潜力，但其在真实Web场景（尤其是WordPress插件等复杂生态）中的实用性仍缺乏系统评估。本文首次聚焦**真实世界Web漏洞的静态分析检测能力**，全面评测6个前沿及开源模型在SQL注入、存储型XSS、路径遍历和远程代码执行四类高危漏洞上的表现。

## 方法设计  
- **模型覆盖**：涵盖闭源前沿模型（Claude Opus 4.6、Codex GPT-5.4、Gemini 3.1-pro-preview）与开源可自托管模型（Qwen 3.5、Qwen 3 Coder Next、MiniMax M2.5）；  
- **数据基准**：基于真实WordPress插件代码库构建含已验证漏洞的测试集；  
- **提示工程实验**：设计5种结构化程度、作用域范围与复杂度各异的Prompt模板，在3轮独立实验中交叉验证；  
- **评估维度**：检测率（True Positive Rate）、跨轮一致性（Reporting Consistency）、误报率及漏洞类型敏感性。

## 关键发现  
- **性能分层显著**：Claude Opus 4.6以**63%检测率领先**；MiniMax M2.5（48%）媲美部分闭源模型；而自托管Qwen 3.5仅达35%，凸显模型能力与部署成本的权衡；  
- **Prompt设计决定成败**：**限定漏洞类型与上下文范围的“聚焦式Prompt”显著优于开放提问式**（+12–21个百分点），而语法/逻辑复杂度提升未带来收益；  
- **可靠性存疑**：无一模型在三轮实验中保持100%报告一致性，最低仅50%，暴露LLM输出的非确定性风险；  
- **根本局限显现**：所有模型均未能识别某插件中的一个已知基线漏洞，证实当前LLM尚不能替代专业静态分析工具。  
本研究开源全部代码、Prompt模板与标注数据集，为安全社区提供可复现基准与实践指南。
papers.summary_en: This paper presents the first systematic benchmark of LLMs for detecting real-world web vulnerabilities via static analysis in WordPress plugins—covering SQLi, stored XSS, path traversal, and RCE. We evaluate six models (three frontier: Claude Opus 4.6, Codex GPT-5.4, Gemini 3.1-pro-preview; three open-weight: Qwen 3.5, Qwen 3 Coder Next, MiniMax M2.5) across five prompt designs and three independent experiment iterations. Results show Claude Opus 4.6 achieves the highest detection rate (63%), while MiniMax M2.5 (48%) matches frontier models—outperforming self-hosted Qwen 3.5 (35%). Scoped prompts significantly boost accuracy over open-ended ones, whereas prompt complexity yields negligible gains. Critically, no model achieves full reporting consistency across iterations (min. 50%), and all failed to detect one baseline vulnerability—highlighting fundamental reliability and coverage limits. We release all code, prompts, and data to support reproducible research.
