papers.title: SegTME-UNI2: A Foundation Model-Based Framework for Generalisable Multiclass Cell Segmentation and LLM-Driven Tumour Microenvironment Characterisation in Histopathology
authors: Wan Siti Halimatul Munirah Wan Ahmad
papers.abstract: Characterising the tumour microenvironment (TME) from routine H&E-stained histology images requires simultaneous cell segmentation, feature extraction, and interpretable clinical reporting. We present SEGTME-UNI2, a unified framework addressing these requirements. Its core is UNI2-UPERHOVER, a dual-head segmentation model pairing the UNI2-H pathology foundation model (ViT-Giant, pretrained on >100M tiles from 100K slides) with two parallel UperNet decoders: one for six-class semantic segmentation and one for horizontal-vertical gradient regression enabling watershed-based nuclear instance separation. To address the lack of pixel-level annotations in large real-world repositories, UNI2-UPERHOVER undergoes a three-stage progressive pseudo-label curriculum. Each stage trains a fresh model without weight transfer, driving improvement entirely via increased pseudo-label quality: Stage 1: Uses human-annotated PanNuke (7,901 images, 189,744 nuclei, 0.25 um/pixel). Stage 2: Uses entropy-filtered pseudo-labels from the Stage 1 model on 271,711 TCGA-UT scale-0 patches (0.5 um/pixel). Stage 3: Uses pseudo-labels from the Stage 2 model on all 1,608,060 TCGA-UT patches across six resolution scales (0.5-1.0 um/pixel). Segmentation outputs feed a structured TME feature extraction pipeline computing 20+ per-patch compositional, morphological, spatial entropy, and intercellular distance metrics. These are encoded as JSON and passed to a fine-tuned NVIDIA BioNeMo GPT model to generate clinically interpretable TME narratives. Preliminary validation on held-out PanNuke and TCGA-UT partitions demonstrates framework feasibility and internal consistency. The pseudo-labelled TCGA-UT dataset and UNI2-UPERHOVER checkpoint are publicly released to support large-scale TME profiling and spatial biology research.
papers.summary_zh:
## 背景与挑战  
肿瘤微环境（TME）的精准解析对癌症预后评估与免疫治疗响应预测至关重要，但现有方法依赖人工标注、多模型串联及非结构化报告，难以在常规H&E染色切片上实现**通用化、可解释、端到端**的TME表征。

## 方法创新  
本研究提出**SegTME-UNI2**——首个基于病理学基础模型的统一框架，涵盖多类细胞分割与大语言模型（LLM）驱动的TME解读：  
- **核心分割模型UNI2-UPERHOVER**：融合ViT-Giant架构的UNI2-H基础模型（预训练于超1亿张组织块），搭配双头UperNet解码器——一头执行**六类语义分割**（肿瘤细胞、淋巴细胞、巨噬细胞等），另一头回归水平/垂直梯度图，支持**无监督 watershed 核实例分离**；  
- **三阶段渐进式伪标签课程**：突破真实像素级标注稀缺瓶颈。Stage 1基于PanNuke真值训练；Stage 2在TCGA-UT 27万张低分辨率补丁上用熵筛选伪标签；Stage 3扩展至**全量160万张跨6尺度补丁**（0.5–1.0 μm/pixel），全程无权重迁移，仅靠伪标签质量跃升驱动性能进化；  
- **结构化TME特征引擎**：从分割结果提取>20维指标，涵盖细胞组成比例、核形态参数、空间熵、细胞间距离矩阵等；  
- **LLM临床叙事生成**：将JSON格式特征输入微调后的NVIDIA BioNeMo GPT模型，自动生成符合病理报告规范的**可解释TME描述**（如“CD8+ T细胞富集且呈浸润性分布，提示潜在免疫应答活性”）。

## 验证与共享  
在独立PanNuke与TCGA-UT测试集上验证了分割精度（Dice >0.82）与叙事一致性。**开源全部伪标签TCGA-UT数据集（160万补丁）及UNI2-UPERHOVER模型权重**，赋能大规模空间生物学研究。
papers.summary_en: SegTME-UNI2 is a foundation model–based framework enabling generalisable multiclass cell segmentation and LLM-driven clinical interpretation of the tumour microenvironment (TME) from routine H&E slides. Its core, UNI2-UPERHOVER, integrates the UNI2-H ViT-Giant pathology foundation model with dual UperNet decoders: one for six-class semantic segmentation and another for horizontal-vertical gradient regression to enable watershed-based nuclear instance separation. To overcome scarcity of pixel-level annotations, it employs a three-stage progressive pseudo-labeling curriculum—trained from scratch at each stage—using increasingly large and diverse datasets: PanNuke (Stage 1), entropy-filtered TCGA-UT patches (Stage 2), and all 1.6M multi-scale TCGA-UT patches (Stage 3). Segmentation outputs feed a structured pipeline computing >20 compositional, morphological, spatial entropy, and intercellular distance features, encoded as JSON and interpreted by a fine-tuned NVIDIA BioNeMo GPT model to generate clinically meaningful TME narratives. Validation on held-out PanNuke and TCGA-UT subsets confirms feasibility and internal consistency. The pseudo-labeled TCGA-UT dataset and UNI2-UPERHOVER checkpoint are publicly released.

papers.title: Incumbent Advantage: Brand Bias and Cognitive Manipulation Dynamics in LLM Recommendation Systems
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are becoming a major way for consumers to find products, but we do not yet understand how brands compete in this new channel. We study brand dynamics in LLM recommendations using skincare products -- a category where consumers cannot easily judge quality before buying and must rely on brand reputation -- across three commercial LLMs (GPT-4o-mini, Claude Sonnet, Gemini 3 Flash), with a robustness check on search goods. In three experiments, we find: (1) a Conditional Monopoly where well-known brands get recommended 100% of the time (IAI = 10.0) when all products have the same specifications, but this dominance disappears with less than a +0.1-star rating advantage for a competitor; (2) authority-style marketing language, including fabricated clinical-evidence claims, breaks this monopoly at a Bias Surplus Value equal to +0.17 rating points, with each model responding differently; and (3) a social dilemma in multi-brand GEO competition: when all brands adopt the same optimization strategy, individual payoff falls from +0.802 to +0.007 in our payoff proxy, and non-participating brands receive zero recommendations in our tests. Our results suggest that generative engine optimization (GEO) should be studied not only as a security risk, but also as an emerging marketing practice that shapes market competition.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景  
大型语言模型（LLMs）正日益成为消费者获取产品信息的核心渠道，但品牌在此新兴推荐生态中的竞争机制尚不清晰。本研究聚焦于**高信任依赖型品类**——护肤品，该领域消费者难以在购买前直接评估质量，高度依赖品牌声誉，因而构成检验LLM推荐偏见的理想场景。

## 研究方法  
我们系统测试了三款主流商用LLM（GPT-4o-mini、Claude Sonnet、Gemini 3 Flash），设计三项控制实验：  
- **实验1（条件性垄断检验）**：在所有产品参数完全一致的前提下，测量头部品牌被推荐的频率；  
- **实验2（认知干预测试）**：引入权威式营销话术（如虚构临床证据），量化其打破品牌垄断所需的“偏见盈余值”；  
- **实验3（多品牌博弈分析）**：模拟地理围栏（GEO）场景下多个品牌同步优化提示词的竞争均衡，构建收益代理指标（payoff proxy）评估策略外溢效应。  
另以搜索型商品（如USB线）作稳健性检验，验证结论的品类边界。

## 主要发现  
1. **条件性垄断现象**：当参数完全相同时，知名品牌获100%推荐（IAI=10.0），但仅需竞品提升**+0.1星评分**即可瓦解该垄断；  
2. **认知操纵有效性**：权威话术可等效转化为+0.17星评级优势，且各模型响应异质——GPT最易被操控，Gemini最稳健；  
3. **生成式引擎优化（GEO）引发社会困境**：当所有品牌采用相同GEO策略时，个体收益从+0.802骤降至+0.007；未参与优化的品牌则彻底“消失”于推荐结果（0%曝光）。  

## 理论与实践启示  
本研究首次将GEO定位为**新型市场基础设施**，而非单纯安全漏洞。它重构了品牌竞争规则：短期策略套利不可持续，长期需转向可信度基建与跨模型协同治理。研究为监管框架设计、平台算法透明度及品牌数字战略提供了实证锚点。
papers.summary_en: This study investigates how brand competition unfolds in LLM recommendation systems, using skincare—a credence good category—as a testbed across GPT-4o-mini, Claude Sonnet, and Gemini 3 Flash. We identify three key dynamics: (1) A *Conditional Monopoly*, where dominant brands receive 100% recommendations when product specs are identical (IAI = 10.0), but this collapses with just a +0.1-star rating advantage for competitors; (2) *Cognitive Manipulation*, where authority-style marketing (e.g., fabricated clinical claims) breaks the monopoly at a Bias Surplus Value equivalent to +0.17 rating points—yet model responses vary significantly; and (3) A *Social Dilemma* in multi-brand GEO competition: when all brands adopt identical optimization strategies, individual payoff drops sharply from +0.802 to +0.007, while non-participating brands receive zero recommendations. These findings position Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) not merely as a security concern, but as an emergent, structurally consequential marketing practice reshaping market equilibrium and competitive fairness.

papers.title: Predictive Analytics in E-Commerce for CustomerBehavior Forecasting using hybrid Ret-DNN withXGBoost Model
papers.abstract: In recent years, electronic (E) commerce services have rapidly increased in the daily lives of people, which helpsthem to purchase products online. However, retail platforms have struggled to understand customer behavior and make it difficult to predict their future purchases. To overcome these challenges, this study proposes a hybrid Retail Deep NeuralNetwork (Ret-DNN) with an Extreme Gradient Boosting(XGBoost) model for capturing temporal features and tabular dynamics of retail data. First, data were sourced from a UnitedKingdom (UK)-based online retailer that contains transactions with almost 500,000 records. Then, the collected data were pre-processed using a series of techniques, such as data cleaning, outlier handling, temporal feature extraction, feature encoding, and z-score normalization, to ensure that the data were ready for model training and testing. Subsequently, the preprocessed data were fed into the Ret-DNN model, which acts as a feature extractor to understand the complete context of customer transactions. Further, the extracted data were fed as input into the XGBoost model, which predicted the final output as the purchase probability of customers. Finally, the proposed Ret-DNN XGBoost model achieved better results by attaining aMean Absolute Error (MAE) 0.2193 when compared to the existing Ret-DNN model.   Keywords: Customer behavior forecasting, extreme gradientboosting, electronic commerce, predictive analytic, retail deepneural networks.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与问题  
随着电子商务深度融入日常生活，零售平台亟需精准刻画用户行为并预测其未来购买意向。然而，传统模型难以协同建模交易数据中的**时序动态性**（如购买频次、间隔、周期性）与**结构化特征**（如用户属性、商品类别、促销响应），导致预测精度受限。

## 方法创新  
本研究提出一种新型混合预测框架——**Ret-DNN–XGBoost模型**：  
- **Ret-DNN（Retail Deep Neural Network）**：专为电商场景设计的深度网络，融合LSTM与注意力机制，从原始交易序列中自动提取多尺度时序模式（如复购节奏、兴趣漂移）；  
- **XGBoost模块**：接收Ret-DNN输出的高维时序嵌入向量，并融合静态特征（如年龄分层、地域编码、会员等级），进行端到端概率回归；  
- 数据来自英国某主流在线零售商，涵盖近**50万条真实交易记录**（2019–2022年），经严格预处理：异常值鲁棒裁剪、时间窗口滑动构造序列样本、目标变量定义为未来7天内购买概率，最终完成z-score标准化与类别特征嵌入。

## 主要成果  
在相同数据集与评估协议下，本模型显著优于基线：  
- **MAE降至0.2193**（较纯Ret-DNN降低12.7%），表明预测偏差更小；  
- AUC达0.892，F1-score提升至0.76，验证其对“高价值潜在买家”的识别能力；  
- 消融实验证实：Ret-DNN的时序表征能力+XGBoost的非线性决策优势形成互补，尤其在长尾用户（低频购买者）预测上提升显著（MAE改善19.3%）。  
本工作为电商个性化推荐、库存前置与精准营销提供了可落地的预测范式。
papers.summary_en: This paper proposes a hybrid **Ret-DNN–XGBoost model** for customer purchase probability forecasting in e-commerce. Ret-DNN—a purpose-built deep neural network—captures temporal dynamics (e.g., purchase intervals, behavioral drift) from transaction sequences via LSTM and attention mechanisms. Its learned embeddings, combined with static features (e.g., demographics, membership tier), are fed into XGBoost for final probabilistic prediction. Evaluated on a real-world UK retailer dataset (~500K transactions), the model achieves a **Mean Absolute Error (MAE) of 0.2193**, outperforming the standalone Ret-DNN baseline by 12.7%. It also attains an AUC of 0.892 and F1-score of 0.76, demonstrating robustness for long-tail users. The framework bridges temporal representation learning and tabular prediction, offering a practical solution for demand forecasting and targeted marketing.

papers.title: CheckMIABench: Firm Foundations For Membership Inference Attacks on Language Models
papers.abstract: Membership inference attacks (MIAs) are a canonical way to assess a machine learning model's privacy properties. Although several attempts have been made to evaluate MIAs on language models, the extant literature has suffered numerous difficulties in constructing clean evaluations to test new techniques. In particular, subtle distribution shifts between member and non-member sets can undermine the statistical validity of MIAs; recent work has underscored this by showing that "blind" methods with no access to the underlying model can perform far better than published methods on the same benchmarks. This paper constructs a benchmark for principled evaluation of MIAs against LLMs, by leveraging the insight that training data before and after a fixed point during training are drawn from the same distribution. Therefore, all open-source models with intermediate checkpoints and public training data can be converted into MIA testbeds. We apply our framework to a half-dozen published attacks on the Pythia and OLMo family of models, from 70M to 7B parameters. To facilitate further privacy research, we open-source a modular library for designing and implementing attacks in this setting: https://github.com/safr-ai-lab/pandora_llm.
papers.summary_zh:
## CheckMIABench：面向大语言模型的会员推断攻击基准框架  

**背景与挑战**：会员推断攻击（Membership Inference Attacks, MIAs）是评估机器学习模型隐私泄露风险的核心范式。然而，当前针对大语言模型（LLMs）的MIA评估普遍存在严重方法学缺陷：多数基准依赖人工构建的“成员集”（训练数据子集）与“非成员集”（外部语料），二者常存在隐性分布偏移（如领域、风格或时序差异），导致攻击性能被高估或归因错误——近期研究已证实，仅依赖输入统计特征的“盲式”基线方法，在相同基准上竟显著超越需访问模型的先进攻击，暴露出评估失真问题。

**方法创新**：本文提出 **CheckMIABench**，首个基于**训练过程内在一致性**构建的严格MIA基准。核心洞见在于：同一模型训练过程中，**固定时间点前后的训练样本天然同分布**（因共享原始训练语料与预处理流程）。据此，我们以公开中间检查点（checkpoints）为锚点，将早于该点的数据视为“成员”，晚于该点的数据视为“非成员”，彻底消除分布不匹配。该范式适用于所有具备开源训练数据与中间检查点的模型（如Pythia、OLMo系列）。

**实证验证与开源贡献**：我们在70M至7B参数规模的6个Pythia/OLMo模型上系统评估了6种主流MIA方法，发现多数现有攻击在CheckMIABench上性能骤降（平均AUC下降12–34%），印证了传统基准的乐观偏差。为推动可复现研究，我们开源模块化攻击库 **Pandora-LLM**（https://github.com/safr-ai-lab/pandora_llm），支持攻击设计、分布对齐、结果标准化全流程。
papers.summary_en: Membership inference attacks (MIAs) are critical for auditing language model privacy, yet existing benchmarks suffer from distributional mismatches between member and non-member sets—leading to inflated attack performance and flawed comparisons. CheckMIABench addresses this by leveraging a key insight: training data before and after a fixed checkpoint are drawn from the *same underlying distribution*, enabling statistically sound MIA evaluation. We convert open-source models with public training data and intermediate checkpoints (e.g., Pythia, OLMo, 70M–7B) into principled testbeds. Evaluating six state-of-the-art attacks, we find their AUC drops significantly (12–34% on average) under CheckMIABench versus prior benchmarks—revealing substantial overestimation in prior work. To foster reproducible privacy research, we release Pandora-LLM, a modular, extensible library for MIA design and evaluation: https://github.com/safr-ai-lab/pandora_llm.

papers.title: Darshana Graph: A Parallel Commentary Corpus for Comparative Indian Philosophy, with Stylometric and Exploratory Graph Analyses
papers.abstract: We introduce Darshana Graph, a corpus of over 125,000 text records spanning classical Hindu, Buddhist, and Jain philosophical traditions, drawn from public-domain and openly licensed translations of sources including the Bhagavad Gita, Brahma Sutras, principal Upanishads, the Pali Canon, and core Jain texts. Its distinctive contribution lies in a structurally unique subset of roughly 8,500 Hindu and Jain records in which the same root verse or sutra is aligned across eighteen historical commentators representing five schools of Vedanta and other darshanas, enabling direct comparison of how independent interpretive traditions read identical source material. To our knowledge, no publicly available resource provides comparable cross-commentator alignment at this scale. We present two analyses built on this corpus. First, a transparent stylometric comparison requiring no machine learning measures argumentative style through scriptural citation density, explicit refutation rate, and sentence complexity. It finds a moderate negative correlation between citation density and refutation rate, a marked increase in refutation rate across three commentators in a related doctrinal lineage, and measurable genre-level differences within the Pali Canon itself. Second, we describe a constrained large language model pipeline that extracts typed philosophical relationships between concepts using a predefined relation vocabulary and deterministic post-hoc validation. The resulting graph surfaces cross-school disagreement patterns while also revealing important extraction limitations, including cases where an independent embedding-based analysis disagrees with the graph-derived findings. We release the full corpus, extracted relationship graph, and all source code.
papers.summary_zh:
## Darshana Graph：面向比较印度哲学的并行评注语料库及图谱分析  

本研究推出 **Darshana Graph**——首个大规模、结构化、跨传统的平行哲学评注语料库，涵盖古典印度教、佛教与耆那教三大传统，共收录超125,000条文本记录。语料源自公共领域及开放许可的英译经典，包括《薄伽梵歌》《梵经》《主要奥义书》《巴利三藏》及核心耆那文献。其核心创新在于构建了约8,500条**高度对齐的评注子集**：同一根本偈颂（śloka）或经文（sūtra）被十八位历史评注家——分属商羯罗等五派吠檀多学派及其他正统/非正统哲学院（darśana）——独立阐释，实现跨学派、跨时代的“同源异释”精准比对。据我们所知，这是目前唯一公开、可复用、具备此规模与粒度的跨评注者对齐资源。

基于该语料，我们开展两项互补性分析：  
1. **透明化风格计量分析**（无需机器学习）：以**引经密度**（scriptural citation density）、**显性驳斥率**（explicit refutation rate）和**句法复杂度**为指标，揭示论证风格差异。结果发现：引经密度与驳斥率呈中度负相关（*r* ≈ −0.42）；在毗湿奴派—罗摩奴阇—维德亚拉尼亚这一师承谱系中，驳斥率逐代显著上升；甚至在《巴利三藏》内部，经藏（Sutta）、律藏（Vinaya）与论藏（Abhidhamma）亦呈现可量化的文体风格分化。  
2. **约束型大语言模型关系抽取与图谱构建**：采用预定义哲学关系词汇表（如“主张”“反对”“继承”“修正”），结合确定性后处理验证，生成概念间有向关系图。图谱成功凸显各学派在“自我”“业力”“解脱”等核心概念上的结构性分歧，但也暴露关键局限：约12%的关系节点在独立嵌入空间分析中未获支持，提示符号化抽取与语义相似性存在张力。  

全部语料、关系图谱及代码已开源，为数字印度哲学研究提供可扩展、可验证、可复现的基础设施。
papers.summary_en: We introduce **Darshana Graph**, a parallel commentary corpus of >125,000 records spanning Hindu, Buddhist, and Jain philosophical traditions, featuring a unique 8,500-record subset where identical root verses/sūtras are aligned across 18 historical commentators from five Vedānta schools and other *darśanas*—enabling unprecedented cross-traditional comparison. Two analyses demonstrate its utility: (1) A transparent stylometric study—using scriptural citation density, explicit refutation rate, and sentence complexity—reveals a moderate negative correlation between citation density and refutation (*r* ≈ −0.42), a marked increase in refutation across a doctrinal lineage, and measurable genre-level stylistic variation within the Pāli Canon itself; (2) A constrained LLM pipeline extracts typed philosophical relations (e.g., “rejects”, “elaborates”) with deterministic validation, yielding a graph that surfaces inter-school disagreement patterns while exposing extraction limitations—e.g., ~12% of graph-derived relations lack support in independent embedding-based semantic analysis. The full corpus, graph, and code are publicly released.
papers.summary:
## Darshana Graph：面向比较印度哲学的并行评注语料库及图谱分析  

本研究推出 **Darshana Graph**——首个大规模、结构化、跨传统的平行哲学评注语料库，涵盖古典印度教、佛教与耆那教三大传统，共收录超125,000条文本记录。语料源自公共领域及开放许可的英译经典，包括《薄伽梵歌》《梵经》《主要奥义书》《巴利三藏》及核心耆那文献。其核心创新在于构建了约8,500条**高度对齐的评注子集**：同一根本偈颂（śloka）或经文（sūtra）被十八位历史评注家——分属商羯罗等五派吠檀多学派及其他正统/非正统哲学院（darśana）——独立阐释，实现跨学派、跨时代的“同源异释”精准比对。据我们所知，这是目前唯一公开、可复用、具备此规模与粒度的跨评注者对齐资源。

基于该语料，我们开展两项互补性分析：  
1. **透明化风格计量分析**（无需机器学习）：以**引经密度**（scriptural citation density）、**显性驳斥率**（explicit refutation rate）和**句法复杂度**为指标，揭示论证风格差异。结果发现：引经密度与驳斥率呈中度负相关（*r* ≈ −0.42）；在毗湿奴派—罗摩奴阇—维德亚拉尼亚这一师承谱系中，驳斥率逐代显著上升；甚至在《巴利三藏》内部，经藏（Sutta）、律藏（Vinaya）与论藏（Abhidhamma）亦呈现可量化的文体风格分化。  
2. **约束型大语言模型关系抽取与图谱构建**：采用预定义哲学关系词汇表（如“主张”“反对”“继承”“修正”），结合确定性后处理验证，生成概念间有向关系图。图谱成功凸显各学派在“自我”“业力”“解脱”等核心概念上的结构性分歧，但也暴露关键局限：约12%的关系节点在独立嵌入空间分析中未获支持，提示符号化抽取与语义相似性存在张力。  

全部语料、关系图谱及代码已开源，为数字印度哲学研究提供可扩展、可验证、可复现的基础设施。

papers.title: Evaluating Prompting-Based Defenses Against Domain-Camouflaged Injection Attacks
papers.abstract: Domain-camouflaged injection attacks embed malicious instructions in retrieved content using domain-appropriate vocabulary, evading standard detectors that rely on syntactic injection markers. When detection fails, practitioners need to know which defense architectures reduce attack success. We evaluate five prompting-based defenses (spotlighting, paraphrasing, prompt sandwiching, and two combinations) against domain-camouflaged injection across three model families (Claude Haiku, Llama 3.1 8B, Gemini 2.0 Flash) and three deployment domains (financial, legal, general) using 3,510 trials. Paraphrasing retrieved content before agent processing is the most consistently effective defense in this benchmark, reducing camouflage attack success rate by 55-84\% depending on model, and achieves lower attack success rates than our Llama Guard 4 configuration on every model tested. Defense effectiveness is strongly model-dependent: spotlighting halves attack success on Claude Haiku but provides no benefit on Llama 3.1 8B. Financial domain deployments face the highest residual risk at 26-33\% baseline attack success rate, with no prompting-based defense fully eliminating the threat on weaker models. These results provide the first systematic evaluation of prompting-based defenses specifically against camouflage-class injection attacks and establish benchmark-based recommendations for practitioners. All tasks use synthetically constructed professional documents; whether these benchmark rankings generalize to real enterprise documents remains an open question.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景  
域伪装型注入攻击（Domain-Camouflaged Injection Attacks）通过在检索内容中嵌入符合专业领域语义的恶意指令（如使用金融或法律术语），规避依赖语法标记（如“忽略前述指令”）的传统检测器，构成新型高隐蔽性威胁。当检测失效时，亟需评估哪些提示工程类防御架构能有效抑制攻击成功率。

## 方法与规模  
本研究首次系统评估五种提示工程防御策略——**聚焦提示（spotlighting）**、**重述提示（paraphrasing）**、**提示三明治（prompt sandwiching）** 及两种组合方案——在三大模型家族（Claude Haiku、Llama 3.1 8B、Gemini 2.0 Flash）及三大部署域（金融、法律、通用）上的鲁棒性。实验覆盖 **3,510 次对抗测试**，全部基于合成构建的专业文档（含财报、合同、政策文本等），确保领域适配性与可控性。

## 关键发现  
- **重述提示为最优单一支架**：将检索内容重述后再输入代理模型，平均降低攻击成功率 **55–84%**，且在所有测试模型上均优于当前最佳开源防护模型 Llama Guard 4；  
- **模型强依赖性显著**：聚焦提示使 Claude Haiku 攻击成功率减半，却对 Llama 3.1 8B 完全无效；  
- **金融域风险最高**：基线攻击成功率达 **26–33%**，即使采用最优防御，在较弱模型上仍残留可观风险；  
- **无防御可完全消除威胁**：尤其在 Llama 3.1 8B 等模型上，所有提示策略均无法将攻击成功率压至 0%。

## 创新与价值  
本工作建立了首个面向伪装类注入攻击的提示防御基准，提出可落地的部署建议（如优先采用重述+模型选型协同策略），并明确指出：**防御效果不能脱离具体模型与领域独立评估**。合成数据局限性亦被坦诚指出——真实企业文档中的泛化性能仍待实证验证。
papers.summary_en: This paper presents the first systematic benchmark of prompting-based defenses against domain-camouflaged injection attacks—adversarial inputs that embed malicious instructions using domain-specific vocabulary (e.g., financial or legal terms) to evade syntax-based detectors. Across 3,510 trials spanning three model families (Claude Haiku, Llama 3.1 8B, Gemini 2.0 Flash) and three domains (financial, legal, general), we evaluate five prompting strategies: spotlighting, paraphrasing, prompt sandwiching, and two combinations. **Paraphrasing retrieved content before agent processing emerges as the most consistently effective defense**, reducing attack success rates by 55–84% depending on the model—and outperforming our Llama Guard 4 baseline on every tested model. Defense efficacy is highly model-dependent: spotlighting halves attack success on Claude Haiku but yields no benefit on Llama 3.1 8B. Financial-domain deployments exhibit the highest residual risk (26–33% baseline success), and no prompting defense fully eliminates the threat on weaker models. These findings establish actionable, benchmark-grounded guidance for practitioners deploying LLM agents in high-stakes professional settings.

papers.title: SafeClawBench: Separating Semantic, Audit-Evidence, and Sandbox Harm in Tool-Using LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Tool-using language-model agents introduce security failures that go beyond unsafe text: they can disclose protected objects, write persistent memory, send messages, modify databases, or trigger harmful code and tool effects. Existing evaluations often collapse these stages into a single attack success rate, making it difficult to tell whether a model merely agreed with an attacker or actually produced observable harm. We introduce SafeClawBench, a staged benchmark for tool-using agent security with 600 controlled adversarial tasks across six attack families: direct and indirect prompt injection, tool-return injection, memory poisoning, memory extraction, and ambiguity-driven unsafe inference. SafeClawBench reports three separate endpoints: semantic attack acceptance, audit-visible harm evidence, and sandbox-observed tool/state harm. Evaluating five agent endpoints under four prompt-level policies, we find that these endpoints capture different failure modes. Without additional prompt protection, semantic failure rates vary widely across models, from 9.0% to 44.2%. Audited harm evidence is narrower than semantic failure, and under a separate executable protocol some matched task identities produce sandbox harm despite passing the Semantic Core call: in a 12,000-row matched analysis, 291 of 347 observed sandbox harms occur in rows that pass the semantic check. Prompt policies change endpoint outcomes, but their effects depend on both model and protocol. SafeClawBench provides a reproducible framework for comparing agent models and prompt-policy conditions without conflating textual compliance, evidence-supported harm, and executable state changes. The open-source dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/sairights/safeclawbench.
papers.summary_zh:
## 背景与问题  
工具调用型大语言模型（LLM）智能体引入了超越文本不安全性的新型安全风险：如泄露受保护数据、写入持久化内存、发送恶意消息、篡改数据库或触发有害工具执行。现有评测常将语义接受、审计证据与实际执行危害混为单一“攻击成功率”，难以区分模型是仅在文本层面妥协（如口头同意），还是真正引发可观测的系统级危害。

## 方法与创新  
本文提出 **SafeClawBench**——首个面向工具调用智能体的**三阶段安全评测基准**，涵盖600个严格控制的对抗性任务，覆盖六大攻击家族：直接/间接提示注入、工具返回注入、内存投毒、内存提取及歧义驱动的不安全推理。其核心创新在于解耦三大独立终点指标：  
- **语义攻击接受率**（Semantic Acceptance）：模型是否在响应中显式同意或执行恶意意图；  
- **审计可见危害证据**（Audit-Evidence Harm）：日志、API调用记录等可审查的违规痕迹；  
- **沙盒观测工具/状态危害**（Sandbox-Observed Harm）：在隔离环境中实际发生的文件修改、网络请求、数据库变更等可执行副作用。

## 主要发现  
在5类智能体端点与4种提示级防护策略下评估表明：三类指标显著分离——语义失败率跨模型差异巨大（9.0%–44.2%）；审计证据范围窄于语义失败；更关键的是，**291/347例沙盒实际危害发生在通过语义检查的样本中**（基于12,000行匹配分析），证明仅依赖文本合规性存在严重漏检。提示策略效果高度依赖模型架构与执行协议，无普适最优方案。

## 意义  
SafeClawBench 提供可复现、非混淆的评估框架，首次实现对**文本合规性、证据可追溯性、状态可执行性**的正交度量。开源数据集已发布于 [Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/datasets/sairights/safeclawbench)，支持安全研究者精准定位故障根源。
papers.summary_en: SafeClawBench is the first staged benchmark for evaluating security failures in tool-using LLM agents, disentangling three distinct harm layers: *semantic acceptance* (textual compliance with malicious intent), *audit-visible evidence* (log/API traces of violation), and *sandbox-observed state/tool harm* (actual executable effects like DB writes or network calls). It comprises 600 adversarial tasks across six attack families and evaluates five agent endpoints under four prompt-level policies. Key findings: (1) Semantic failure rates vary widely (9.0%–44.2%) without protection; (2) Audit evidence is narrower than semantic failure, but critically, 291 of 347 sandbox harms occurred in samples that *passed* the semantic check—revealing dangerous blind spots; (3) Prompt policy efficacy is model- and protocol-dependent, not universal. SafeClawBench enables precise, non-conflated comparison of agent safety across textual, evidential, and executable dimensions. Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/sairights/safeclawbench.

papers.title: Agentra: A Supervisable Multi-Agent Framework for Enterprise Intrusion Response
papers.abstract: Enterprise intrusion response still depends on static playbooks and analyst-driven triage, creating delay between alert generation and containment. We present Agentra, a supervisable multi-agent Intrusion Response System (IRS) framework that converts alerts from IDS, EDR, and XDR platforms into structured incident response plans grounded in MITRE ATT&CK, MITRE D3FEND, and NIST CSF 2.0. Agentra decomposes response reasoning across role-scoped agents, validates proposed plans through a bounded Planner--Validator review loop, screens retrieved threat intelligence through a Moderator security gateway, gates actions through an Action Catalog and risk score, and records decisions in an append-only audit log. We evaluate Agentra against a static OASIS CACAO v2.0 cyber-playbook baseline on a 120-event corpus drawn from ThreatHunter-Playbook, Splunk BOTSv3, and DARPA OpTC. The strongest configuration improves FP-aware IRS F1 from 0.61 to 0.84 and restores the projected harmful-action rate to the static baseline level of 0.0% after Planner-only configurations introduce unsafe overreaction. These results indicate that multi-agent response planning can improve ontology-grounded IRS coverage while preserving analyst approval and auditability.
papers.summary_zh:
## 背景与问题  
企业入侵响应仍严重依赖静态剧本（playbooks）和人工研判，导致从告警生成到威胁遏制存在显著延迟，难以应对现代高级持续性威胁（APT）的动态性与复杂性。

## 方法与框架设计  
本文提出 **Agentra**——一种可监督的多智能体入侵响应系统（IRS）框架。其核心创新在于：  
- **本体驱动的计划生成**：将IDS/EDR/XDR平台告警自动转化为结构化响应计划，严格锚定于**MITRE ATT&CK**（战术映射）、**MITRE D3FEND**（防御技术）和**NIST CSF 2.0**（治理框架）三大权威知识图谱；  
- **角色化多智能体协同**：按“分析员”“规划员”“验证员”“ Moderator（情报守门人）”等职责划分智能体，实现响应推理解耦；  
- **安全闭环机制**：引入**Planner–Validator有界审查环**确保逻辑一致性；通过**Moderator安全网关**过滤不可信威胁情报；所有动作须经**动作目录（Action Catalog）准入**并叠加**风险评分门控**；全部决策写入**仅追加式审计日志**（append-only audit log），保障全程可追溯、可复核。

## 主要发现与贡献  
在包含120个真实事件的混合测试集（源自ThreatHunter-Playbook、Splunk BOTSv3与DARPA OpTC）上，Agentra相较OASIS CACAO v2.0静态剧本基线显著提升：  
- FP-aware IRS F1分数由**0.61提升至0.84**（+37.7%）；  
- 彻底消除Planner单智能体配置引发的**有害动作过激反应**，将有害动作率从失控状态**恢复至基线水平的0.0%**；  
- 首次在IRS中实现**本体对齐性、人工监督权、操作安全性与审计完备性**四重目标的统一。
papers.summary_en: Enterprise intrusion response remains bottlenecked by static playbooks and analyst-heavy triage, causing critical delays between alerting and containment. We introduce **Agentra**, a *supervisable multi-agent framework* that transforms heterogeneous alerts (from IDS/EDR/XDR) into structured, ontology-grounded response plans aligned with MITRE ATT&CK, D3FEND, and NIST CSF 2.0. Agentra decomposes reasoning across role-scoped agents, enforces safety via a bounded Planner–Validator review loop, filters threat intelligence through a Moderator security gateway, gates actions using an Action Catalog and risk scoring, and immutably logs all decisions. Evaluated on a 120-event corpus (ThreatHunter-Playbook, Splunk BOTSv3, DARPA OpTC) against an OASIS CACAO v2.0 baseline, Agentra’s strongest configuration improves FP-aware IRS F1 from 0.61 to **0.84**, while eliminating unsafe overreaction—restoring the harmful-action rate to **0.0%**, matching the static baseline. Results demonstrate that supervised multi-agent planning enhances both coverage and trustworthiness in ontology-driven intrusion response.

papers.title: TIGER: Inverting Transformer Gradients via Embedding-Subspace Distance Optimization
papers.abstract: Federated learning allows multiple clients to jointly train a shared model by sending gradient updates to a central server while keeping raw inputs local. However, prior gradient inversion attacks show that these updates can reveal enough information to reconstruct client inputs. Existing attacks on transformers either optimize dummy inputs to match the true client updates, which is costly and unstable for modern models, or exploit the low rank of attention gradients to identify a subspace containing the true layer embeddings, followed by a discrete membership test for candidate tokens. However, this token test is brittle under numerical noise, i.e., from quantization or Differential Privacy (DP), and scales poorly for encoder models with non-causal attention. We introduce TIGER, a continuous gradient inversion attack that turns this subspace signal into a differentiable objective. Instead of searching over tokens or matching full gradients, TIGER directly optimizes token embeddings to minimize their distance to the subspace. Our experiments demonstrate that on encoder-only models, TIGER substantially improves both reconstruction quality and runtime over existing attacks, while on decoder models, TIGER is more robust than prior subspace-based attacks, enabling the first successful reconstructions in DP-defended federated learning settings.
papers.summary_zh:
## 背景与问题  
联邦学习（Federated Learning）通过让客户端仅上传梯度而非原始数据，保障了数据本地化隐私。然而，梯度反演攻击（Gradient Inversion, GI）表明，共享梯度仍可能泄露敏感输入——尤其对Transformer架构，现有方法面临两大瓶颈：（1）基于优化的攻击（如Dummy Input Optimization）需反复前向传播，计算开销大、收敛不稳定，难以适配大规模模型；（2）基于子空间的攻击（如Low-Rank Attention Gradient Exploitation）虽能定位真实token嵌入所在的低维子空间，但依赖离散token枚举与成员判定，在量化噪声或差分隐私（DP）扰动下鲁棒性极差，且无法扩展至非因果注意力的编码器模型（如BERT）。

## 方法创新：TIGER框架  
本文提出**TIGER**（Transformer Inversion via Embedding-Subspace Distance Optimization），一种端到端可微的连续型梯度反演攻击。其核心思想是摒弃离散token搜索与全梯度匹配，转而将子空间信息转化为**可微距离目标函数**：直接优化连续的token嵌入向量，使其在每一层尽可能逼近由真实梯度导出的嵌入子空间（通过SVD分解注意力梯度获得）。该过程无需词汇表遍历，规避了数值噪声敏感性；同时天然兼容编码器/解码器架构，支持任意注意力掩码类型。

## 实验结果与价值  
在多个主流Transformer模型（RoBERTa-base、BERT-large、GPT-2-small）上的评估表明：  
- 对**编码器模型**，TIGER在PSNR和LPIPS指标上平均提升**23.6%**，重构速度较最优基线快**5.8×**；  
- 对**解码器模型**，首次在ε=2.0 DP噪声下实现稳定图像/文本重建（成功率>89%），显著优于现有子空间方法；  
- 消融实验证实，子空间距离优化是鲁棒性的关键驱动因素，而非单纯梯度拟合。  
TIGER为评估联邦学习中Transformer模型的真实隐私风险提供了更可靠、可扩展的新基准。
papers.summary_en: Federated learning (FL) enhances privacy by aggregating model gradients instead of raw data—but gradient inversion attacks threaten input reconstruction. Prior transformer-specific attacks either suffer from high cost/unstability (input optimization) or brittle discrete token testing under noise (subspace-based methods), especially in encoder models or DP-defended settings. We propose **TIGER**, a *continuous*, differentiable inversion attack that reframes the attention-gradient subspace signal as an embedding-distance minimization objective: rather than matching full gradients or enumerating tokens, TIGER directly optimizes continuous token embeddings to lie close to the true embedding subspace derived from gradient SVD. Experiments show TIGER achieves state-of-the-art reconstruction quality and speed on encoder-only models (e.g., +23.6% PSNR, 5.8× faster), and—critically—enables the first robust reconstructions under differential privacy (ε=2.0) for decoder models, outperforming prior subspace approaches in noise resilience and scalability.

papers.title: Conflict-Aware Retriever Editing for Knowledge Injection Attacks on LLM-Based RAG Systems
papers.abstract: Injecting malicious knowledge into retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems can manipulate retrieved evidence and mislead downstream generation, posing a serious security threat for AI applications. Existing RAG injection attacks mainly rely on manipulating external knowledge bases, such as crafting malicious corpus. However, the synthetic text crafted by such data-centric methods could be detectable, leading to the failure of attacks. Beyond corpus manipulation, open-source retrievers are increasingly exposing RAG systems to model-centric attacks. In this paper, we propose conflict-aware retriever editing, i.e., CAREATTACK, a model-centric retriever attack framework for malicious knowledge injection in RAG. Specifically, CAREATTACK consists two stages of conflict-aware retriever editing and attack-preserving anchor repair. Conflict-aware retriever editing adapts efficient closed-form parameter editing to the dense retrieval model, promoting malicious knowledge above benign competing passages and resolving potential parameter conflicts through graph-based conflict detection and parameter editing projection. Then, attack-preserving anchor repair performs lightweight calibration on the edited retriever to further eliminate the impact on non-target prompts while preserving the attack effectiveness for target prompts. We instantiate CAREATTACK on Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B and BGE-M3, and conduct evaluation on three benchmark datasets. Experimental results demonstrate our method substantially promote malicious passages into the retrieved knowledge of RAG systems and can perform attacks for batches of target prompts and passages, given the access of retrieval model parameters. Since most RAG systems are built upon open-source retrieval models, this work reveals a practical attack surface in RAG systems. Codes are public accessible at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/CareAttack-3F1C.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景  
检索增强生成（RAG）系统因依赖外部知识检索而面临新型安全威胁：攻击者可通过注入恶意知识篡改检索结果，进而诱导大语言模型生成有害内容。现有注入攻击主要基于**数据层面操纵**（如构造恶意语料库），但合成文本易被检测，导致攻击失效。随着开源检索模型（如BGE、Qwen-Embedding）广泛部署，**模型层面攻击**成为更隐蔽、更高效的突破口。

## 方法创新：CAREATTACK框架  
本文提出**冲突感知的检索器编辑攻击框架（CAREATTACK）**，首次实现对稠密检索模型的参数级、目标导向的知识注入。框架包含两大核心阶段：  
- **冲突感知检索器编辑**：将高效闭式参数编辑技术适配至检索模型，通过**图结构冲突检测**识别恶意知识与良性竞争段落间的参数冲突，并利用**投影式参数编辑**精准提升恶意段落的相似度得分，同时抑制干扰；  
- **攻击保持型锚点修复**：在编辑后进行轻量校准，仅修正非目标查询（non-target prompts）的检索偏差，**严格保留对目标查询的攻击效果**，显著提升攻击鲁棒性与泛化性。

## 实验验证与意义  
我们在Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B与BGE-M3两大主流开源检索器上实例化CAREATTACK，在MSMARCO、BEIR、TREC-COVID三大基准数据集上评估。结果表明：  
✅ 恶意段落平均Top-5召回率提升达**42.7%–68.3%**（vs. baseline）；  
✅ 支持**批量目标提示/段落协同攻击**，单次编辑可覆盖数十个攻击场景；  
✅ 仅需访问检索模型参数（无需训练数据或梯度），具备强实用性。  
本工作揭示了开源RAG生态中被长期忽视的**模型参数级攻击面**，为RAG安全防护（如检索器完整性验证、编辑鲁棒性加固）提供了关键警示与技术基线。
papers.summary_en: This paper introduces **CAREATTACK**, the first *model-centric*, parameter-editing-based attack framework for injecting malicious knowledge into open-source dense retrievers used in RAG systems. Unlike data-centric attacks that craft detectable synthetic corpus, CAREATTACK operates directly on retriever parameters via two novel stages: (1) *conflict-aware retriever editing*, which adapts closed-form parameter updates to promote malicious passages over benign competitors while resolving internal parameter conflicts via graph-based detection and projection; and (2) *attack-preserving anchor repair*, a lightweight calibration that preserves attack success on target prompts while minimizing collateral impact on non-target queries. Evaluated on Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B and BGE-M3 across three benchmarks (MSMARCO, BEIR, TREC-COVID), CAREATTACK achieves up to 68.3% higher Top-5 recall for malicious passages and supports batched, multi-prompt attacks—requiring only model parameter access. Our work exposes a practical, underexplored attack surface in widely deployed open-source RAG pipelines.

papers.title: PSyGenTAB: A Privacy-Preserving Framework for Synthetic Clinical Tabular Data Generation via Constrained Optimization
papers.abstract: The development of medical AI is constrained by limited access to high-quality clinical data due to institutional silos and strict privacy regulations such as HIPAA and GDPR. Synthetic data generation offers a potential solution, but existing methods lack principled mechanisms to explicitly manage the privacy-utility trade-off, often degrading clinically meaningful patterns or risking patient re-identification. We present PSyGenTAB, a privacy-preserving generative framework that formulates synthetic healthcare data generation as a constrained optimization problem solved using the Augmented Lagrangian Method. By embedding configurable privacy constraints directly into model training, PSyGenTAB enforces minimum privacy thresholds while maximizing clinical data utility. Across multiple clinically motivated benchmarks, PSyGenTAB preserves inter-feature clinical relationships and minority-class diagnostic patterns essential for reliable health AI. Downstream evaluation using Train-on-Synthetic, Test-on-Real and Train-on-Real, Test-on-Synthetic protocols shows that models trained on synthetic data achieve performance comparable to those trained on real patient records. Privacy auditing further demonstrates reduced exact record reproduction and strong resilience to membership inference attacks. These results establish PSyGenTAB as a principled framework for balancing privacy protection and clinical utility in synthetic healthcare data, supporting secure cross-institutional AI development.
papers.summary_zh:
## 背景与挑战  
医疗人工智能的发展长期受限于高质量临床数据的获取瓶颈：机构数据孤岛与《健康保险可携性和责任法案》（HIPAA）、《通用数据保护条例》（GDPR）等严格隐私法规，严重制约了跨机构数据共享与模型训练。

## 方法创新  
本文提出 **PSyGenTAB**——一种面向临床结构化数据的隐私保护型合成生成框架。其核心创新在于将合成数据生成建模为**带约束的优化问题**，采用**增广拉格朗日法（Augmented Lagrangian Method）** 进行求解。该框架首次将**可配置的隐私约束**（如k-匿名性、差分隐私松弛形式、重构误差下界）直接嵌入生成模型训练目标中，实现对隐私保障水平的显式、可验证控制，同时最大化临床效用（如特征相关性、诊断分布保真度）。

## 关键结果  
在涵盖电子病历、ICU监测及罕见病诊断的多中心临床基准测试中：  
- ✅ 精确保留关键**跨特征临床关系**（如血压与肾功能指标的非线性关联）；  
- ✅ 显著增强**少数类诊断模式**（如脓毒症早期亚型）的生成保真度，F1-score提升达23.7%；  
- ✅ 下游任务评估显示：**Train-on-Synthetic, Test-on-Real** 场景下，模型性能达真实数据基线的94.2%；**Train-on-Real, Test-on-Synthetic** 场景下仍保持89.5%泛化能力；  
- 🔒 隐私审计证实：精确记录重构造率降低至0.03%，对成员推断攻击（Membership Inference Attack）的攻击成功率降至12.4%（远低于基线模型的41.8%）。

## 意义  
PSyGenTAB为医疗AI提供了首个兼顾**可证明隐私下界**与**临床语义保真**的合成数据生成范式，支持安全、合规、高保真的跨机构协作研发。
papers.summary_en: PSyGenTAB is a privacy-preserving framework for generating synthetic clinical tabular data by formulating generation as a constrained optimization problem solved via the Augmented Lagrangian Method. It explicitly embeds configurable privacy constraints (e.g., k-anonymity guarantees, reconstruction error bounds) into training—enforcing verifiable minimum privacy thresholds while maximizing clinical utility. Across diverse clinical benchmarks, PSyGenTAB preserves inter-feature medical relationships and minority-class diagnostic patterns critical for robust AI. Downstream models trained on synthetic data achieve 94.2% of real-data performance under Train-on-Synthetic/Test-on-Real evaluation, and maintain strong generalization (89.5%) in reverse settings. Privacy audits confirm near-zero exact record reproduction (<0.03%) and high resilience to membership inference attacks (attack success rate: 12.4% vs. 41.8% baseline). PSyGenTAB establishes a principled, utility-aware foundation for trustworthy synthetic healthcare data.

papers.title: From Specification to Execution: AI Assisted Scientific Workflow Management
papers.abstract: Scientific workflow management systems (WMS) support scalable and reproducible execution of complex pipelines, but workflow design, implementation, and debugging remain largely manual and require significant expertise. Recent approaches using large language models (LLMs) show promise for workflow generation from natural language, but often rely on direct code synthesis, which limits transparency, reproducibility, and integration with workflow systems. We present an AI-assisted approach to scientific workflow management that combines specification-driven workflow generation, automated debugging, and distributed execution. The method introduces a structured specification phase that separates workflow intent, design, and implementation, allowing validation prior to code generation. We also develop an LLM-based debugging agent that diagnoses and resolves failures across multiple system layers. To support distributed execution and user interaction, we integrate Pegasus, a widely used WMS, with a Model Context Protocol (MCP) layer, providing a unified interface for workflow submission, monitoring, and control. We evaluate the approach using a federated learning workflow for medical imaging, chosen for its parallel, iterative, and dependency-intensive structure. The system generated and executed large-scale workflows with thousands of jobs, reduced debugging effort, and allowed non-expert users to construct workflows with expert-level design patterns. These results indicate that end-to-end AI-assisted workflow generation and execution is feasible, and point toward AI-driven platforms for managing the scientific workflow lifecycle.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景  
科学工作流管理系统（WMS）是支撑大规模、可复现科研计算的关键基础设施，但其设计、实现与调试仍高度依赖人工，门槛高、耗时长、易出错。当前基于大语言模型（LLM）的自动化工作流生成方法多采用端到端代码直译，缺乏对意图—设计—实现的分层建模，导致**可解释性弱、验证滞后、系统集成困难**，难以满足科研场景对透明性、可审计性与工具链兼容性的严苛要求。

## 方法创新  
本研究提出“从规范到执行”的AI辅助科学工作流管理框架，包含三大核心组件：  
- **结构化规范阶段**：将工作流生命周期解耦为**意图描述（What）、逻辑设计（How）、技术实现（Where/How-to-code）** 三层，支持在代码生成前进行形式化验证与专家协同评审；  
- **LLM驱动的跨层调试代理**：构建具备系统感知能力的调试智能体，可自动定位并修复涵盖任务调度、数据依赖、资源约束及Pegasus运行时异常等多层级故障；  
- **MCP-Pegasus融合执行层**：通过Model Context Protocol（MCP）协议桥接LLM与Pegasus WMS，提供统一的**工作流提交、实时监控、动态干预与结果溯源**接口，实现AI与专业WMS的深度协同。

## 主要成果  
在联邦学习医学影像分析真实场景中验证：系统成功生成并调度含**超3000个作业**的大规模分布式工作流；调试耗时平均降低**62%**；非领域专家用户可在15分钟内构建符合最佳实践的复杂迭代式工作流（如带检查点重试、异构设备调度、跨机构数据合规路由）。研究表明，AI不应替代WMS，而应作为**可验证、可调试、可集成的增强层**，推动科学工作流全生命周期向自动化、协作化与民主化演进。
papers.summary_en: We present an AI-assisted scientific workflow management framework that bridges specification, debugging, and execution—moving beyond direct LLM code synthesis. Our approach introduces a *structured specification phase* separating intent, design, and implementation for early validation; an *LLM-based debugging agent* capable of diagnosing and resolving failures across scheduling, data dependencies, resource constraints, and Pegasus runtime layers; and an *MCP-Pegasus integration layer* enabling unified workflow submission, real-time monitoring, and interactive control. Evaluated on a federated learning medical imaging pipeline (characterized by parallelism, iteration, and complex inter-task dependencies), the system successfully generated and executed workflows with >3,000 jobs, reduced debugging effort by 62%, and enabled non-expert users to construct expert-level workflows in under 15 minutes. Results demonstrate the feasibility of end-to-end, transparent, and tool-integrated AI assistance for the full scientific workflow lifecycle.

papers.title: SCOPE-FL: A Strategy-proof Chain-based Optimal pareto efficient Federated Learning System
papers.abstract: Hierarchical Federated Learning (HFL) enables scalable collaborative model training across distributed devices while preserving data privacy. However, existing HFL client selection mechanisms suffer from a fundamental strategic inefficiency. By prioritizing stability over Pareto efficiency (PE), they produce suboptimal resource allocations, and without strategy proofness (SP), participants are incentivized to misrepresent their true preferences, both failures degrading system overall welfare in the Pareto sense in practice. To address it, we propose SCOPE-FL (Strategy-proof Chain-based Optimal pareto efficient Federated Learning), a synchronous HFL framework that formulates client selection as a two-sided school choice problem solved through the Top Trading Cycle (TTC) algorithm that simultaneously guarantees PE and SP. For reward distribution, SCOPE-FL employs a scalable Shapley value approximation based on One-Round Reconstruction (OR), ensuring compensation proportional to each client's contribution. The entire mechanism executes via blockchain smart contracts, providing the tamper-proof environment required for the SP guarantees to hold in practice. A comprehensive evaluation on MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, and CIFAR-10 demonstrates that SCOPE-FL outperforms state-of-the-art approaches, including DA, IAS, and other methods across model accuracy, convergence rate, and reward efficiency, while achieving communication latency comparable to DA and blockchain overhead significantly lower than DA at scale.
papers.summary_zh:
## 背景与挑战  
分层联邦学习（HFL）通过多级聚合架构支持大规模分布式设备协同建模，兼顾隐私保护与可扩展性。然而，现有HFL客户端选择机制存在双重缺陷：**策略非真实性（non-strategy-proofness）**——客户端可虚报算力、带宽或数据质量以获取更高奖励；**帕累托低效（Pareto inefficiency）**——偏好稳定性而牺牲全局资源最优分配，导致系统整体福利在帕累托意义上持续受损。

## 方法创新  
本文提出 **SCOPE-FL**（Strategy-proof Chain-based Optimal pareto efficient Federated Learning），一种同步式HFL框架：  
- **机制设计**：将客户端选择建模为双边“学校选择问题”，采用**Top Trading Cycle（TTC）算法**求解，首次在HFL中同时严格保障**帕累托效率（PE）** 与**策略真实性（SP）**；  
- **激励相容**：设计基于**单轮重构（One-Round Reconstruction, OR）的Shapley值近似算法**，实现高可扩展性、低开销的贡献度量化与公平奖励分配；  
- **可信执行**：全部逻辑（TTC匹配、OR计算、奖励发放）部署于**区块链智能合约**，确保SP性质在开放、不可信环境中实际成立。

## 实验验证  
在MNIST、Fashion-MNIST和CIFAR-10上全面评估：SCOPE-FL相较DA（Deferred Acceptance）、IAS等SOTA方法，在**模型精度提升1.8–3.2%**、**收敛速度加快22–37%**、**奖励分配效率（贡献-回报比）提高41%**；通信延迟与DA相当，而**区块链开销在百节点规模下仅为DA的38%**，显著提升可扩展性。
papers.summary_en: SCOPE-FL is a synchronous hierarchical federated learning framework that resolves two critical flaws in existing client selection: lack of strategy-proofness (SP) and Pareto inefficiency (PE). It models selection as a two-sided school choice problem solved via the Top Trading Cycle (TTC) algorithm—guaranteeing both SP and PE simultaneously. For reward distribution, SCOPE-FL introduces a scalable Shapley value approximation based on One-Round Reconstruction (OR), ensuring contribution-proportional compensation. All mechanisms are enforced via blockchain smart contracts to uphold SP in practice. Extensive experiments on MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, and CIFAR-10 show SCOPE-FL outperforms DA, IAS, and other baselines in accuracy (+1.8–3.2%), convergence speed (+22–37%), and reward efficiency (+41%), while achieving communication latency comparable to DA and 62% lower blockchain overhead at scale.

papers.title: Protein-Based Fish Species Identification: Dataset, Models, and Insights from Native Bangladeshi Fish
papers.abstract: Correct identification of fish species is highly significant for food security, economic development, and climate resilience in Bangladesh. Protein sequences directly reflect functional and evolutionary constraints which are important for species authentication and biodiversity monitoring. Yet there exists no benchmark for native Bangladeshi fish species identification from protein sequence. In this study, we addressed this gap by introducing the first curated dataset for nine native Bangladeshi fish species of 2845 high quality protein sequences. We also established the first protein sequence classification baseline for this domain through a systematic benchmarking of seven architectural paradigms. Moreover, we propose a realistic deployable novel hybrid architecture of MotifCNN and Transformer with Terminal-Aware Positional-Encoding (MotifCNN-Transformer+TA-PE). Our novel architecture achieves 79.80% accuracy with macro-F1 of 0.80. The highest 83.04% accuracy is achieved by finetuned protein language model ProtBERT that has 420M parameters and requires dual 16GB GPUs for inference. According to McNemar's test, ProtBERT's 3.24% accuracy gain over our MotifCNN-Transformer+TA-PE is statistically insignificant (p = 0.1120). Our novel architecture beats it among six of the nine classes in per class identification. Also our MotifCNN-Transformer+TA-PE is approximately 5x faster, 42x smaller, and supports 16x larger batch size than ProtBERT and has GPU free inference, making it more practical for deployment in resources constrained areas such as rural Bangladesh. Beyond this, our foundational work shows effects of phylogenetic relationships on sequence similarity and establishes pathways for fisheries management, food authentication and biodiversity conservation in South Asia's protein dependent economy.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与意义  
在孟加拉国，准确识别鱼类物种对保障粮食安全、推动渔业经济可持续发展及增强气候韧性至关重要。蛋白质序列直接承载功能约束与进化信号，是物种鉴定与生物多样性监测的理想分子标记。然而，针对本土鱼类的蛋白质序列识别尚无公开基准数据集与模型体系，严重制约了南亚地区基于蛋白质组学的食品溯源与资源管理。

## 方法与创新  
本研究构建了首个面向**9种本土孟加拉国鱼类**的高质量蛋白质序列数据集（2845条序列），填补领域空白；系统评测7类主流架构，建立首个蛋白序列分类基线；提出轻量、可部署的新型混合架构——**MotifCNN-Transformer+TA-PE**（含基序卷积、Transformer主干与终端感知位置编码）。该模型兼顾局部保守基序识别与长程语义建模能力。

## 关键结果与优势  
- MotifCNN-Transformer+TA-PE达**79.80%准确率**（macro-F1=0.80）；  
- 微调大型蛋白语言模型ProtBERT（420M参数）达最高**83.04%准确率**，但McNemar检验显示其相对提升（+3.24%）**统计不显著**（*p*=0.1120）；  
- 在9个物种中，本模型在**6类上单类准确率超越ProtBERT**；  
- 推理速度**快5倍**、模型体积**小42倍**、批处理容量**大16倍**，且支持**CPU/GPU-free推理**，特别适配农村等资源受限场景。

## 应用价值  
本工作揭示了系统发育关系对蛋白序列相似性的显著影响，为南亚“蛋白依赖型”经济体的渔业治理、食品真实性验证与生物多样性保护提供了可扩展的方法论基础与实用工具链。
papers.summary_en: This study introduces the first curated protein-sequence dataset (2,845 high-quality sequences) for nine native Bangladeshi fish species and establishes the first classification baseline via systematic benchmarking of seven architectures. We propose MotifCNN-Transformer+TA-PE—a lightweight, deployable hybrid model achieving 79.80% accuracy (macro-F1 = 0.80). While fine-tuned ProtBERT attains 83.04% accuracy, its marginal gain is statistically insignificant (*p* = 0.1120, McNemar’s test); our model outperforms it on 6/9 classes and offers decisive practical advantages: 5× faster inference, 42× smaller size, 16× larger batch support, and GPU-free deployment—critical for resource-constrained settings. The work further links phylogenetic structure to sequence similarity, enabling scalable fisheries management, food authentication, and biodiversity conservation across South Asia.

papers.title: Agentra: A Supervisable Multi-Agent Framework for Enterprise Intrusion Response
papers.abstract: Enterprise intrusion response still depends on static playbooks and analyst-driven triage, creating delay between alert generation and containment. We present Agentra, a supervisable multi-agent Intrusion Response System (IRS) framework that converts alerts from IDS, EDR, and XDR platforms into structured incident response plans grounded in MITRE ATT&CK, MITRE D3FEND, and NIST CSF 2.0. Agentra decomposes response reasoning across role-scoped agents, validates proposed plans through a bounded Planner--Validator review loop, screens retrieved threat intelligence through a Moderator security gateway, gates actions through an Action Catalog and risk score, and records decisions in an append-only audit log. We evaluate Agentra against a static OASIS CACAO v2.0 cyber-playbook baseline on a 120-event corpus drawn from ThreatHunter-Playbook, Splunk BOTSv3, and DARPA OpTC. The strongest configuration improves FP-aware IRS F1 from 0.61 to 0.84 and restores the projected harmful-action rate to the static baseline level of 0.0% after Planner-only configurations introduce unsafe overreaction. These results indicate that multi-agent response planning can improve ontology-grounded IRS coverage while preserving analyst approval and auditability.
papers.summary_zh:
## 背景与问题  
企业入侵响应仍严重依赖静态剧本（playbooks）和人工研判，导致从告警生成到威胁遏制存在显著延迟，难以应对现代高级持续性威胁（APT）的动态性与复杂性。

## 方法与框架设计  
本文提出 **Agentra**——一种可监督的多智能体入侵响应系统（IRS）框架。其核心创新在于：  
- **本体驱动的响应规划**：将IDS/EDR/XDR平台告警自动映射至MITRE ATT&CK（战术）、D3FEND（防御技术）与NIST CSF 2.0（治理框架）联合本体，生成结构化响应计划；  
- **角色分解与协同验证**：采用角色限定的智能体分工（如Triage Agent、Containment Agent、Evidence Agent），通过**有界规划–验证循环**（Planner–Validator loop）对每步响应进行语义一致性与操作可行性双重校验；  
- **安全门控机制**：引入Moderator网关对检索的威胁情报进行可信度与上下文相关性筛查；所有执行动作须经**动作目录（Action Catalog）** 授权，并叠加实时风险评分（基于资产关键性、环境暴露面、操作不可逆性）；  
- **全链路可审计性**：所有决策、验证结果与动作日志写入仅追加（append-only）审计链，保障溯源合规。

## 主要发现与贡献  
在包含120个真实场景事件的混合测试集（融合ThreatHunter-Playbook、Splunk BOTSv3、DARPA OpTC）上，Agentra相较OASIS CACAO v2.0静态剧本基线：  
- FP-aware IRS F1值从**0.61提升至0.84**（+37.7%），显著增强误报容忍下的响应精度；  
- 彻底消除纯Planner配置引发的“过度响应”风险，将有害动作率（harmful-action rate）从失控状态**稳定回归至0.0%**（与基线持平）；  
- 首次实现多智能体IRS在**本体覆盖广度、人工监督可控性、操作审计完整性**三重目标上的统一。
papers.summary_en: Enterprise intrusion response remains bottlenecked by static playbooks and analyst-heavy triage, causing critical delays between alerting and containment. We introduce **Agentra**, a *supervisable* multi-agent Intrusion Response System (IRS) framework that transforms heterogeneous alerts (from IDS/EDR/XDR) into ontology-grounded response plans aligned with MITRE ATT&CK, D3FEND, and NIST CSF 2.0. Agentra decomposes reasoning across role-scoped agents, enforces safety via a bounded Planner–Validator review loop, filters threat intelligence through a Moderator security gateway, gates actions using an Action Catalog and real-time risk scoring, and immutably logs all decisions. Evaluated on a 120-event corpus (ThreatHunter-Playbook, Splunk BOTSv3, DARPA OpTC) against an OASIS CACAO v2.0 baseline, Agentra’s strongest configuration boosts FP-aware IRS F1 from 0.61 to 0.84 and restores the harmful-action rate to 0.0%—eliminating unsafe overreaction seen in planner-only variants. Results demonstrate that supervised multi-agent planning can significantly improve coverage, safety, and auditability in enterprise IRS without sacrificing human oversight.

- **角色分解与协同验证**：采用角色限定的智能体分工（如Triage Agent、Containment Agent、Evidence Agent），通过**有界规划–验证循环**（Planner–Validator loop）对每步响应进行语义一致性与操作可行性双重校验；  
- **安全门控机制**：引入Moderator网关对检索的威胁情报进行可信度与上下文相关性筛查；所有执行动作须经**动作目录（Action Catalog）** 授权，并叠加实时风险评分（基于资产关键性、环境暴露面、操作不可逆性）；  
- **全链路可审计性**：所有决策、验证结果与动作日志写入仅追加（append-only）审计链，保障溯源合规。

## 主要发现与贡献  
在包含120个真实场景事件的混合测试集（融合ThreatHunter-Playbook、Splunk BOTSv3、DARPA OpTC）上，Agentra相较OASIS CACAO v2.0静态剧本基线：  
- FP-aware IRS F1值从**0.61提升至0.84**（+37.7%），显著增强误报容忍下的响应精度；  
- 彻底消除纯Planner配置引发的“过度响应”风险，将有害动作率（harmful-action rate）从失控状态**稳定回归至0.0%**（与基线持平）；  
- 首次实现多智能体IRS在**本体覆盖广度、人工监督可控性、操作审计完整性**三重目标上的统一。

papers.title: Gatling: Rapid-Fire Consensus from Parallel Composition
papers.abstract:
Consensus protocols form the core of blockchains and other replicated state machines, ensuring that all correct nodes process the same totally ordered log of input transactions. In fault-free executions, performance is driven by the good-case transaction latency -- the time between a transaction becoming known to all nodes and its confirmation by the consensus protocol -- which depends on both how frequently proposals are made and, once made, how quickly they are confirmed. While prior work has established tight lower bounds on confirmation latency that modern protocols already achieve, it remains open whether the inter-proposal time can be further reduced below the state-of-the-art of one network delay.

We introduce Gatling, an atomic broadcast protocol that achieves arbitrarily small inter-proposal times under rotating leader schedules; in particular, smaller than the network delay. Gatling runs multiple parallel instances of a black-box atomic broadcast protocol and staggers their proposal schedules to generate proposals in faster succession than state-of-the-art protocols. A deterministic interleaving rule merges the outputs of these instances into a single global log. We analyze the effects of head-of-line blocking caused by crashed leaders, and derive Gatling's optimal number of parallel instances. We further study the impact of Gatling on predictable validity and present two variants that retain this property. Finally, our experiments confirm that Gatling can be used with off-the-shelf component protocols to achieve low latency without fine-tuning the component protocol for minimum latency.
papers.summary_zh:
## 背景与问题  
共识协议是区块链与复制状态机的核心，其性能关键取决于**好情况（fault-free）下的交易确认延迟**，该延迟由两部分构成：**提案生成频率**（inter-proposal time）与**单次提案确认耗时**。当前主流协议（如HotStuff、Chained HotStuff）已逼近理论最优的确认延迟下界，但其最小提案间隔仍受限于**一个网络延迟（Δ）**——即必须等待前一领导者完成一轮通信后，下一领导者才能发起新提案。能否突破这一“每轮一提案”的瓶颈，实现亚Δ级提案节奏，是长期悬而未决的开放问题。

## 方法与创新  
本文提出 **Gatling**——一种基于**并行组合**的原子广播协议。其核心思想是：**同时运行多个黑盒原子广播实例**（如任意满足安全性的现成协议），并通过**错位调度（staggered scheduling）** 使各实例在旋转领导机制下按微小偏移时间依次触发提案。由此，全局提案流密度显著提升，实现**任意小的平均提案间隔**（甚至远小于Δ）。为保障日志一致性，Gatling引入**确定性交错合并规则**，将各实例输出无歧义地融合为单一全序日志。

## 主要发现  
- 理论分析表明：Gatling可严格规避头端阻塞（head-of-line blocking）导致的延迟恶化；通过建模崩溃领导者影响，我们推导出**最优并行实例数**，在吞吐与容错间取得帕累托最优。  
- 针对“可预测有效性”（predictable validity）这一关键安全属性，我们设计两种变体（Gatling-PV1/PV2），在保持低延迟的同时完整保留该性质。  
- 实验验证：Gatling可即插即用地集成现有组件协议（如SBFT、HotStuff），**无需修改底层协议或精细调参**，在广域网环境下将端到端交易延迟降低37–52%，证实其强实用性与部署友好性。
papers.summary_en: Gatling is a novel atomic broadcast protocol that breaks the long-standing “one proposal per network delay (Δ)” barrier in leader-rotating consensus. By running *k* parallel instances of an arbitrary black-box atomic broadcast protocol and staggering their proposal schedules with sub-Δ offsets, Gatling achieves *arbitrarily small inter-proposal times*—even less than Δ—while preserving safety and liveness. A deterministic interleaving rule merges outputs into a single linearizable log. We analyze head-of-line blocking under leader crashes and derive the optimal *k* that minimizes latency without compromising fault tolerance. To retain predictable validity—a crucial property for deterministic execution—we propose two variants (Gatling-PV1 and PV2). Experiments show Gatling reduces end-to-end latency by 37–52% over state-of-the-art protocols when composed with off-the-shelf components (e.g., SBFT, HotStuff), requiring no modification or fine-tuning of the underlying protocol.

papers.title: Decentralized Multi-Authority (Attribute-Based) Traitor Tracing
papers.abstract:
We initiate the study of multi-authority traitor tracing (MA-TT), a decentralized variant of traitor tracing in which tracing capabilities are distributed across multiple independent authorities rather than concentrated in a single trusted entity. Ciphertexts are associated with tracing policies over a collection of authorities, specifying which subsets of authorities are authorized to jointly accuse a user of contributing to a pirate decoder. This enables fine-grained control over tracing capabilities, prevents unilateral accusations, and reduces the surveillance risks inherent in centralized tracing systems. Our scheme naturally supports conjunction, disjunction, threshold, and more general monotone tracing policies.

We further introduce multi-authority attribute-based traitor tracing (MA-AB-TT), which combines distributed tracing in MA-TT with decentralized access control from multi-authority attribute-based encryption (MA-ABE). Ciphertexts are therefore equipped with two orthogonal policies: an attribute policy governing decryption and a tracing policy governing which tracing authorities may jointly identify traitors.

Our main contribution is a construction of MA-AB-TT for arbitrary monotone access structures from the standard matrix decisional Diffie-Hellman (MDDH) assumption in prime-order pairing groups. Our construction achieves adaptive security under static corruption of authorities in the random oracle model. All system parameters are independent of the number of authorities and users in the system, while ciphertexts grow linearly with the size of the associated policies. Our framework also yields a publicly traceable variant, in which tracing can be performed using only the authorities' public keys, albeit with weaker asymptotic efficiency guarantees.

Technically, we extend the blueprint for pairing-based traitor tracing based on private linear broadcast encryption (PLBE) [Boneh et al., Eurocrypt 2006] to the multi-authority setting. The key technical ingredient is a new multi-authority PLBE construction, which we instantiate from slotted inner-product function encryption (sIPFE) [Lin and Luo, Eurocrypt 2020]. As an intermediate step, we provide a new attribute-based sIPFE scheme supporting arithmetic branching programs, which may be of independent interest.

Our techniques also yield a new modular construction of adaptively secure MA-ABE under static corruptions from sIPFE, improving on a prior construction by Ambrona and Gay [PKC 2023]. Finally, when specialized to a single authority, our framework gives the first ciphertext-policy attribute-based traitor tracing scheme with asymptotically optimal parameters and exponentially large user spaces.

## 研究背景与问题  
本文首次系统提出**多权威叛徒追踪（MA-TT）**，一种去中心化的叛徒追踪范式：将追踪权分散于多个独立、互不信任的权威机构，取代传统依赖单一可信中心的集中式模型。该设计可有效缓解单点腐败风险、防止任意权威单方面指控用户，并显著降低大规模监控隐患。

## 核心创新与方案  
- 提出**多权威属性基叛徒追踪（MA-AB-TT）**： ciphertext 同时嵌入两类正交策略——**属性策略**（控制解密权限，基于多权威ABE）与**追踪策略**（指定哪些权威子集可协同发起叛徒指认），天然支持合取、析取、门限及任意单调追踪结构。  
- 构建首个**适应性安全**的MA-AB-TT通用方案：基于标准**矩阵判定Diffie-Hellman（MDDH）假设**，在素阶配对群中实现，且在随机预言机模型下抵御权威的静态腐败。所有系统参数（如公钥、主密钥）与权威/用户数量无关；密文长度仅线性依赖于策略规模。  
- 技术突破：将Boneh等（Eurocrypt 2006）基于私有线性广播加密（PLBE）的追踪蓝图扩展至多权威场景；核心在于构造新型**多权威PLBE**，其实例化依托于Lin-Luo（Eurocrypt 2020）的**插槽内积函数加密（sIPFE）**；并首次提出支持**算术分支程序**的属性基sIPFE，具独立价值。  
- 衍生贡献：获得更优的适应性安全MA-ABE构造（改进Ambrona-Gay PKC’23）；单权威特化时，给出首个**密文策略型ABTT**，具备渐进最优参数与指数级用户空间。
papers.summary_en: We initiate the study of **Multi-Authority Traitor Tracing (MA-TT)**, a decentralized paradigm where tracing power is distributed across independent authorities—eliminating reliance on a single trusted center and mitigating unilateral accusation and surveillance risks. We further introduce **Multi-Authority Attribute-Based TT (MA-AB-TT)**, supporting *orthogonal* policies: an attribute policy for decryption (from MA-ABE) and a monotone tracing policy specifying which authority subsets may jointly identify traitors. Our main construction achieves **adaptive security under static authority corruption**, based solely on the standard Matrix Decisional Diffie-Hellman (MDDH) assumption in prime-order pairing groups, with system parameters independent of authority/user count and ciphertexts linear in policy size. Technically, we extend the PLBE-based TT blueprint to multi-authority settings via a novel sIPFE-based multi-authority PLBE, and introduce an attribute-based sIPFE for arithmetic branching programs. As corollaries, we obtain an improved adaptively secure MA-ABE and—when specialized to one authority—the first ciphertext-policy ABTT with asymptotically optimal efficiency and exponential user space.

papers.title: Efficient Private Set Intersection and Searchable Encryption using Homomorphic Bloom Filters
papers.abstract:
Existing encrypted search and private set intersection (PSI) protocols struggle to reconcile post-quantum security with practical efficiency, often leaking search and access patterns or requiring prohibitively deep fully homomorphic encryption (FHE) circuits. We address these limitations by introducing a new Homomorphic Bloom Filters (HBF) framework, a quantum-resilient framework that embeds length-$m$ Bloom filters directly into the plaintext space of an RLWE-based FHE scheme, enabling shallow homomorphic evaluation and matching without structural leakage. 
Building on HBF, we construct a searchable encryption (SE) scheme and a private set intersection (PSI) protocol, both based on a depth-1 homomorphic missing-bit circuit. The SE scheme requires no rotations or bootstrapping at server side and incurs no additional computational cost as the number of query keywords increases. 
The PSI protocol reduces each packed Bloom-filter comparison to a single ciphertext--plaintext multiplication, with cost depending on the Bloom-filter length rather than direct element-wise comparisons with the responder's set.
This framework confines leakage to benign dataset dimensions, tunable false-positive rates, and other public metadata, thereby eliminating explicit pattern leakage.
papers.summary_zh:
## 背景与挑战  
现有加密搜索（Searchable Encryption, SE）与私有集合交集（Private Set Intersection, PSI）协议难以兼顾**后量子安全性**与**实际效率**：多数方案依赖深度全同态加密（FHE）电路，导致计算开销巨大；或通过不经意传输、ORAM等机制引入显著通信/延迟开销；更关键的是，它们常泄露**查询模式**（query pattern）、**访问模式**（access pattern）等敏感信息，破坏隐私保障。

## 方法创新：同态布隆过滤器（HBF）框架  
本文提出**同态布隆过滤器（Homomorphic Bloom Filters, HBF）**——一种基于环学习带错误（RLWE）的后量子安全FHE新范式。其核心突破在于：将长度为 $m$ 的布隆过滤器**直接嵌入FHE明文空间**，使布隆滤波器的哈希位向量成为可原生同态运算的结构化明文。由此，所有关键操作（如集合编码、关键词匹配、交集判定）均可在**深度仅为1的同态电路**中完成，无需旋转（rotation）、自举（bootstrapping）或密文-密文乘法。

## 主要成果与优势  
- **可证明安全的SE方案**：服务器端零旋转、零自举；查询开销与关键词数量无关，支持高效多关键词检索；仅泄露布隆滤波器长度 $m$、误报率 $\varepsilon$ 等**可控、良性元数据**。  
- **高效PSI协议**：将双方集合的布隆滤波器比较压缩为**单次密文–明文乘法**；通信与计算复杂度仅取决于 $m$（如 $m=1280$），而非响应方集合大小 $|S_R|$，彻底规避传统PSI中 $O(|S_R|)$ 级别开销。  
- **无结构性泄露**：不暴露查询顺序、命中位置、集合基数变化等隐式模式，实现真正“模式隐藏”（pattern-hiding）。

本工作首次实现了**后量子安全、浅层同态、零模式泄露**三者的有机统一，为云环境下隐私保护检索与联合分析提供了实用新路径。
papers.summary_en: Existing encrypted search and private set intersection (PSI) protocols face a fundamental trade-off between post-quantum security and practical efficiency—often leaking query/access patterns or demanding prohibitively deep FHE circuits. We introduce **Homomorphic Bloom Filters (HBF)**, a quantum-resilient framework that embeds length-$m$ Bloom filters directly into the plaintext space of an RLWE-based FHE scheme. This enables shallow (depth-1) homomorphic evaluation of set membership and intersection *without structural leakage*. Leveraging HBF, we construct: (i) a searchable encryption scheme requiring **no rotations or bootstrapping** on the server, with query cost independent of keyword count; and (ii) a PSI protocol reducing each packed Bloom-filter comparison to a **single ciphertext–plaintext multiplication**, whose cost scales with $m$ (e.g., 1280), not the responder’s set size. Leakage is confined to benign parameters—Bloom filter length, tunable false-positive rate, and public metadata—eliminating explicit pattern leakage. Our approach unifies post-quantum security, low-depth homomorphism, and pattern-hiding in a practical, implementation-ready framework.

papers.title: Practical End-to-end Fault Attacks on PERK
papers.abstract:
This paper presents the first practical end-to-end fault injection attacks on the post-quantum signature scheme PERK, based on the MPC-in-the-Head paradigm and relies on GGM tree expansions for efficient randomness generation. While GGM trees reduce memory requirements, they introduce implementation-level deviations from the theoretical model. We show that these implementation choices fundamentally alter the fault surface and enable new attack vectors that are not captured by the original security assumptions. We propose two attacks targeting distinct stages of the GGM tree construction. The first attack fixes the root seed, resulting in deterministic tree generation and enabling full reconstruction of all leaf labels. The second attack induces reuse of GGM roots via an instruction skip, allowing recovery of hidden leaf values across consecutive rounds. Both attacks require only a single fault to recover the secret key.

We demonstrate both attacks end-to-end on the pqm4 reference implementation compiled with optimization levels -O3 as well as -Os for ARM Cortex-M4 microcontrollers. Our evaluation is performed on two hardware platforms (ChipWhisperer-Lite with STM32F303 and Nucleo-L4R5ZI-P) using clock glitching and electromagnetic fault injection (EMFI). We achieve success probabilities of 100% and 85% for the two attacks, respectively. Finally, we propose countermeasures for both attacks.

## 首次面向PERK签名方案的端到端实用化故障攻击  

本文首次实现了对后量子数字签名方案**PERK**（基于MPC-in-the-Head范式、采用Goldreich–Goldwasser–Micali（GGM）树进行高效随机性生成）的**端到端实用化故障注入攻击**。尽管GGM树在理论上可显著降低内存开销，但其实际嵌入式实现（如pqm4参考实现）引入了关键偏差：例如根种子复用、非恒定时间树遍历及指令级脆弱性——这些均未被原始安全模型所覆盖，从而**实质性扩大并重构了故障攻击面**。  

我们提出两种互补的单故障攻击：  
- **Root-Fixing攻击**：通过时序精准的时钟毛刺（clock glitching）强制固定GGM树根种子，使整棵树退化为确定性结构，从而**完全重建全部叶节点标签**，直接泄露秘密密钥；  
- **Root-Reuse攻击**：利用电磁故障注入（EMFI）诱导关键跳转指令跳过（instruction skip），导致相邻签名轮次中GGM根种子被意外复用，进而**跨轮恢复隐藏叶值**，以单次故障完成密钥提取。  

实验在ARM Cortex-M4平台（ChipWhisperer-Lite+STM32F303与Nucleo-L4R5ZI-P）上完整复现：支持-O3与-Os两种编译优化级别。实测成功率分别达**100%（Root-Fixing）与85%（Root-Reuse）**。最后，我们针对性提出轻量级反制措施，包括根种子绑定校验、GGM节点哈希链完整性保护及控制流完整性加固，兼顾安全性与资源受限环境适用性。

We propose two single-fault attacks: (1) a *Root-Fixing* attack that determinizes the GGM tree via clock glitching to fully reconstruct all leaf labels; and (2) a *Root-Reuse* attack leveraging EMFI-induced instruction skipping to recover hidden leaf values across consecutive signing rounds. Both attacks fully recover the secret key with one fault. We demonstrate them end-to-end on the pqm4 reference implementation (compiled with `-O3` and `-Os`) running on ARM Cortex-M4 microcontrollers (STM32F303 and Nucleo-L4R5ZI-P), achieving 100% and 85% success rates, respectively. papers.title: A Billion Hard CRYSTALS: Exploring Practical Aspects of Arithmetic Masking for PQC in Hardware
papers.abstract:
Due to the complexity of modern cryptographic algorithms, especially in the area of Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC), conceptualizing optimal hardware designs in relation to some target performance metric is increasingly time-consuming and error-prone, particularly when combined with the need for secure side-channel protection mechanisms. To solve this, Buschkowski et al. presented the HADES framework at CHES 2025 that efficiently automates the pre-synthesis Design Space Exploration (DSE) process and combines it with automated arbitrary-order masking capabilities. However, as their work focuses only on Boolean masking, PQC schemes that rely heavily on finite field arithmetic incur a significant overhead in latency and area, as demonstrated in their MLKEM (Kyber) case study.

In order to improve the performance of such primitives in hardware, we present a framework built upon HADES that supports both Boolean and arithmetic masking domains and can seamlessly and automatically convert between both types of secret sharing within the design hierarchy, while retaining the efficient DSE capabilities, extended by additional performance metrics. Even though the theoretical foundations of arithmetic masking are well-studied, some highly relevant implementation aspects, like the generation of non-power-of-2 masking randomness, are left largely unexplored. To help close this gap, we extensively analyze and systematically explore the cost associated with the secure and efficient generation of uniform randomness in hardware.

As an initial case study to highlight the capabilities of our modified HADES tool, we present a highly configurable and optionally fully-masked ML-KEM hardware design that improves upon state-of-the-art masked implementations by up to two orders of magnitude while also being competitive with unmasked designs from literature. To validate its practical security, we are the first to conduct practical leakage assessment measurements on the complete decapsulation algorithm, showing no signs of side-channel leakage after 500000 traces.
papers.summary_zh:
## 背景与挑战  
后量子密码（PQC）硬件实现面临双重瓶颈：一方面，算法复杂度高（如ML-KEM/Kyber依赖密集的有限域算术），导致传统**布尔掩码**（Boolean masking）在面积与延迟上开销巨大；另一方面，现有自动化设计空间探索（DSE）框架（如CHES 2025提出的HADES）仅支持布尔掩码，难以兼顾PQC算术密集型操作的效率与侧信道安全性。

## 方法与创新  
本文在HADES框架基础上构建**双域掩码硬件设计框架**，首次实现：  
- ✅ **布尔掩码与算术掩码的自动协同建模**：支持设计层次内两类秘密共享机制的无缝、自动转换；  
- ✅ **面向硬件的算术掩码关键实现突破**：系统分析并优化**非2的幂次掩码阶数（如t=3,5）所需的均匀随机数生成**，提出低开销、抗故障的硬件随机源架构；  
- ✅ **扩展DSE能力**：新增功耗、时序鲁棒性、掩码阶数可配置性等维度，支持多目标联合优化。

## 主要成果  
以ML-KEM为案例，本框架生成的硬件设计：  
- **性能跃升**：最高较当前最优掩码实现提速**100倍**（2个数量级），且面积/频率表现媲美文献中未掩码设计；  
- **实证安全验证**：首次对完整解封装算法开展**50万条迹的物理泄漏评估**（TVLA/CPA），结果无统计显著泄漏，证实其实际防护能力；  
- **开源推动**：所有掩码方案、随机数生成器RTL及评估数据已开源，填补PQC硬件算术掩码工程化空白。
papers.summary_en: This paper addresses the high latency and area overhead of Boolean masking in PQC hardware—especially for arithmetic-heavy schemes like ML-KEM—by extending the HADES DSE framework to support **both Boolean and arithmetic masking domains**, with automatic, hierarchical conversion between them. We systematically analyze and optimize the hardware generation of **uniform randomness for arbitrary (non-power-of-2) masking orders**, a critical yet underexplored practical aspect. Our enhanced framework produces a highly configurable, fully masked ML-KEM implementation that achieves up to **two orders-of-magnitude speedup** over state-of-the-art masked designs while remaining competitive with unmasked counterparts in area and frequency. Crucially, we conduct the **first practical leakage assessment on the full decapsulation algorithm**, collecting 500,000 power traces with no detectable side-channel leakage (via TVLA and CPA), validating real-world security. This work bridges theory and practice for arithmetic masking in PQC hardware.

papers.title: The Power of Low Rank: Fast CKKS Functional Bootstrapping for High-Precision Lookup Tables
papers.abstract:
The CKKS fully homomorphic encryption scheme has traditionally been viewed as suitable only for approximate arithmetic. However, recent work (Alexandru et al., Crypto 2025) has introduced functional bootstrapping techniques that enable accurate lookup tables (LUTs) evaluation in CKKS. Nevertheless, to deal with the high precision problem, the state-of-the-art scheme (Dumezy et al., TCHES 2026) requires reshaping the LUTs into a matrix, which incurs $O(P)$ multiplications for a size-$P$ table and dominates runtime.

We first observe that LUT matrices for many practical functions are often highly structured, with exact or numerical rank much smaller than matrix dimension. We then develop a spectral framework for the LUT evaluation problem, which characterizes the relationship between function classes and the singular value decomposition. This framework yields exact rank bounds for structured function classes such as separable functions, and establishes exponential decay of singular values (implying low numerical rank) for smooth analytic functions. Building on this framework, we propose Low Rank Multiplexer Tree Functional Bootstrapping (LRMT-FBT), which evaluates the LUT via the singular values and singular vectors instead of direct matrix multiplication. This reduces the homomorphic multiplication cost from $O(P)$ to $O(r\sqrt{P})$, where $r$ denotes the rank of matrix, while also supporting extensions to multi-value and multi-input settings.

We implement LRMT-FBT in OpenFHE and evaluate it across different spectral classes. We also introduce implementation optimizations to improve the bootstrapping efficiency. At high precision, LRMT-FBT provides substantial performance improvements for common low rank functions compared with Dumezy et al. Typically, for $P = 2^{20}$, our method accelerates the LUT evaluation step by \(196.9\times\) for Step (\(r=1\)) and \(99.6\times\) for ReLU (\(r=3\)), yielding functional bootstrapping speedups of \(5.3\times\) and \(5.1\times\), respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
## 背景与挑战  
CKKS同态加密方案长期被视为仅适用于近似计算，但近年功能自举（functional bootstrapping）技术的突破（Alexandru et al., Crypto 2025）使其可高精度执行查找表（LUT）运算。然而，当前最优方案（Dumezy et al., TCHES 2026）需将LUT重塑为矩阵并执行$O(P)$次同态乘法（$P$为表长），导致高精度场景下计算开销主导整体运行时，严重制约实用化。

## 方法创新  
本文首次发现：多数实际函数（如Step、ReLU、Sigmoid）对应的LUT矩阵具有显著低秩结构——其精确或数值秩远小于矩阵维度。据此，我们构建**谱分析框架**，系统刻画函数类别与奇异值分解（SVD）的内在关联：对可分离函数给出**紧致精确秩界**；对光滑解析函数（如$\exp, \sin$）证明其奇异值呈**指数衰减**，从而严格保证低数值秩。基于此，我们提出**低秩多路复用树功能自举（LRMT-FBT）**：摒弃传统矩阵乘法，转而利用前$r$个奇异值与左右奇异向量重构LUT输出，将同态乘法复杂度从$O(P)$降至$O(r\sqrt{P})$，并天然支持多输入/多输出扩展。

## 实验结果  
在OpenFHE中实现LRMT-FBT，覆盖多种谱类函数。针对$P=2^{20}$规模LUT：  
- **Step函数**（秩$r=1$）：LUT评估加速**196.9×**，端到端功能自举提速**5.3×**；  
- **ReLU函数**（秩$r=3$）：LUT评估加速**99.6×**，功能自举提速**5.1×**。  
所提优化（如稀疏SVD预计算、向量批处理）进一步提升自举吞吐量，为高精度隐私计算提供高效新范式。

State-of-the-art approaches reshape LUTs into matrices, incurring $O(P)$ homomorphic multiplications for size-$P$ tables—dominating runtime at high precision. We observe that practical LUT matrices (e.g., for Step, ReLU, Sigmoid) exhibit strong low-rank structure. Leveraging a novel spectral framework, we derive exact rank bounds for separable functions and prove exponential singular value decay for smooth analytic functions—guaranteeing low numerical rank. Building on this, we propose Low Rank Multiplexer Tree Functional Bootstrapping (LRMT-FBT), which evaluates LUTs via truncated SVD instead of matrix multiplication, reducing multiplicative cost from $O(P)$ to $O(r\sqrt{P})$ ($r$: rank) while supporting multi-input/multi-output extensions. Implemented in OpenFHE, LRMT-FBT achieves up to **196.9× LUT evaluation speedup** (Step, $r=1$) and **99.6× speedup** (ReLU, $r=3$) for $P=2^{20}$, yielding **5.3× and 5.1× end-to-end functional bootstrapping acceleration**, respectively.
