papers.title: FragFuse: Bypassing Access Control of Large Language Model Agents via Memory-Based Query Fragmentation and Fusion
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on long-term memory to support complex task execution, user personalization, and domain adaptation. Meanwhile, emerging access-control mechanisms for LLM agents are being explored to block policy-violating requests and prevent misuse. We reveal a novel attack surface arising from agent memory operations: prohibited content that would trigger access control can be fragmented across interactions, stored in long-term memory in benign-appearing form, and later reconstructed through memory retrieval without appearing explicitly in the final user query. We propose FragFuse, the first attack that enables unprivileged users to bypass agent access control by exploiting this temporal channel introduced by long-term memory. FragFuse operates in three stages: (1) identifying rejection-responsive fragments via black-box adaptive querying with fragment masking; (2) injecting these fragments into memory using marker carrier queries; and (3) retrieving and fusing the stored fragments through a follow-up attack query. Although FragFuse can be instantiated manually for individual agents, we further develop a surrogate-based optimization scheme that tunes fusion instructions and marker designs, enabling automated attack generation without violating the attacker's threat-model assumptions. We evaluate FragFuse across four representative agent settings and task domains, covering three state-of-the-art agent access-control mechanisms. FragFuse achieves an average bypass success rate of 86.3% and an average end-to-end harmful task success rate of 41.1% across all settings, with only 4.4% average task-success degradation compared with configurations without access control. We also show that alternative defenses, including state-of-the-art prompt-injection detectors and perplexity detectors, do not effectively address this attack.
papers.summary_zh:
## 背景与问题  
随着大语言模型（LLM）智能体广泛采用**长期记忆**支持复杂任务、用户个性化与领域适配，新兴的**访问控制机制**正被用于拦截违规请求、防范滥用。然而，本研究首次揭示：智能体的记忆操作本身构成全新攻击面——攻击者可将**禁止内容碎片化**，在多轮交互中以看似无害的形式注入长期记忆，并在后续查询中通过记忆检索**隐式重构**完整恶意意图，从而绕过基于单次查询的访问审查。

## 方法：FragFuse 攻击框架  
我们提出 **FragFuse**——首个利用记忆时序通道实现访问控制绕过的攻击方法，包含三阶段闭环流程：  
1. **片段识别**：通过黑盒自适应查询+掩码扰动，定位触发访问控制拒绝的关键语义片段；  
2. **记忆注入**：设计“标记载体查询”（marker carrier queries），将碎片隐蔽存入长期记忆（如向量数据库），规避实时检测；  
3. **融合触发**：构造后续攻击查询，激活记忆检索并引导模型自动拼合碎片、执行有害任务（如生成违法内容、绕过安全指令）。  

为提升普适性，我们进一步提出**代理模型优化方案**：无需白盒访问或梯度信息，在符合现实威胁模型（仅黑盒API调用）前提下，自动优化融合指令与标记设计，实现端到端自动化攻击生成。

## 实验结果与影响  
在4类典型智能体架构（ReAct、Plan-and-Execute等）及3种前沿访问控制机制（基于规则、微调分类器、RLHF强化策略）上全面评估，FragFuse平均**绕过成功率86.3%**，端到端有害任务完成率**41.1%**，且相较无防护场景仅下降**4.4%**任务成功率，表明其高隐蔽性与强有效性。值得注意的是，当前主流防御手段（如先进提示注入检测器、困惑度异常检测）对此类记忆级碎片攻击**完全失效**。
papers.summary_en: We present **FragFuse**, the first attack that bypasses access control in LLM agents by exploiting long-term memory as a *temporal covert channel*. It fragments prohibited content across multiple benign-looking interactions, stores them stealthily in memory, and later fuses them via retrieval—without exposing malicious intent in any single user query. FragFuse operates in three black-box stages: (1) adaptive fragment discovery via masked querying, (2) memory injection using marker-carrying queries, and (3) fusion-triggered retrieval with optimized follow-up prompts. We further propose a surrogate-based optimization framework enabling fully automated attack generation under realistic threat assumptions. Evaluated across four representative agent architectures and three state-of-the-art access-control mechanisms, FragFuse achieves an **86.3% average bypass success rate** and **41.1% end-to-end harmful task success**, with only **4.4% degradation** versus unprotected baselines. Critically, existing defenses—including top-tier prompt-injection and perplexity detectors—fail to detect or mitigate this memory-based fragmentation attack.

papers.title: CmdNeedle: Measuring the Incompleteness of Command Denylists for AI Agents
papers.abstract: The adoption of AI agents is increasing rapidly. Terminal AI agents, i.e., AI agents that run in terminal environments, are a widely used type of AI agents. Terminal AI agents rely heavily on shell command execution to interact with the host systems. They adopt a three-list command-gating mechanism to mitigate security risks introduced by command execution, with denylists serving as the load-bearing component. However, modern operating systems often ship a large, ever-expanding set of shell commands with complex functionalities. Our observation is that even a built-in denylist of Claude Code, well-maintained by its developers, can overlook bypass commands that invalidate its effectiveness. Such negligence leads to fragile command denylists that cannot even block operations that practitioners expect them to block.   This paper presents the first systematic characterization of command denylist fragility in terminal AI agents. The paper formalizes the command denylist fragility problem and proposes an LLM-driven pipeline, CmdNeedle, to detect such fragility. It prompts the LLM to propose possible bypasses and iteratively repairs them using feedback from a validator that executes them in a sandbox. In the evaluation, we applied CmdNeedle to 1,709 real-world command denylists (containing 13,332 denylist rules) collected from GitHub. The evaluation shows several key findings, including that 69.0--98.6% of the denylists are fragile, that this fragility occurs consistently across projects and agents, and the validity of several possible root causes for this fragility. Our pipeline and findings will hopefully facilitate future research and practice regarding the command denylists used by AI agents.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景  
随着AI智能体（AI Agents）在终端环境中的广泛应用，其安全机制面临严峻挑战。终端AI智能体高度依赖Shell命令执行与宿主系统交互，当前主流防护策略采用“三列表”命令门控机制（allowlist/blocklist/denylist），其中**denylist（命令拒绝列表）被广泛视为核心防线**。然而，现代操作系统内置命令数量庞大、功能复杂且持续演进，导致denylist极易出现覆盖不全问题——即使由Claude Code等成熟系统维护的内置denylist，仍存在可被绕过的“盲点”，使其实际防护能力远低于预期。

## 方法创新：CmdNeedle框架  
本文首次对终端AI智能体中命令denylist的**不完备性（incompleteness）** 进行系统性量化与诊断。提出LLM驱动的自动化检测框架 **CmdNeedle**：  
- 以大语言模型为“攻击生成器”，主动推理潜在绕过命令（如`/bin/sh -c "..."`、`env -i ...`、`printf | sh`等非常规变体）；  
- 构建轻量沙箱验证器，实时执行并反馈命令是否成功绕过denylist；  
- 采用迭代式提示优化与修复机制，实现闭环检测与可解释性分析。

## 关键发现  
在GitHub上采集的**1,709个真实项目denylist（含13,332条规则）** 上评估表明：  
- **69.0%–98.6%的denylist存在脆弱性**，即至少存在1条可绕过其限制的合法Shell命令；  
- 脆弱性在不同AI代理框架（如LangChain、AutoGen）、不同项目规模及不同denylist维护策略中**普遍存在且稳定复现**；  
- 根因分析证实：命令语义等价性未被建模、路径别名与解释器链未被覆盖、以及动态构造命令（如通过`$()`、反引号、`env`注入）是三大主因。

本研究为AI智能体安全提供首个可复现、可扩展的denylist完备性评估范式，推动从“静态规则枚举”向“语义感知防御”演进。
papers.summary_en: This paper presents **CmdNeedle**, the first systematic framework to measure and expose the *incompleteness* of command denylists in terminal-based AI agents. Recognizing that denylists—despite being a cornerstone of command-gating security—are often fragile due to the combinatorial complexity and semantic equivalence of shell commands, we formalize the fragility problem and design an LLM-driven pipeline: it prompts LLMs to generate bypass candidates (e.g., `env -i sh -c`, `printf | sh`), validates them in a sandbox, and iteratively refines prompts using execution feedback. Evaluated on **1,709 real-world denylists (13,332 rules)** from GitHub, CmdNeedle reveals that **69.0–98.6% are fragile**, with consistent vulnerability across diverse agents (LangChain, AutoGen), project sizes, and maintenance practices. We identify key root causes—including unmodeled command equivalences, interpreter chaining, and dynamic command construction—and provide actionable insights for building semantically aware, robust command filters. Our open methodology establishes a new benchmark for evaluating and hardening AI agent command safety.

本研究为AI智能体安全提供首个可复现、可扩展的denylist完备性评估范式，推动从“静态规则枚举”向“语义感知防御”演进。

papers.title: Multi-tier Differential Private Query Release
papers.abstract: Answering statistical queries over sensitive data under differential privacy (DP) is a common task in many settings, including databases, mobile computing, and data markets. In these scenarios, multiple analysts may issue the same query, while receiving answers generated under different privacy budgets due to differences in trust levels or willingness to pay. Existing approaches for such multi-tier DP queries either incur excessive cumulative privacy loss or suffer from suboptimal utility. In this paper, we propose a framework for multi-tier DP query release that simultaneously bound the cumulative privacy loss by the maximum privacy budget among all queries and achieve optimal utility comparable to that of single-tier mechanisms. Our framework applies to different classes of DP mechanisms. For noise-adding mechanisms (e.g., count queries with the two-sided Geometric mechanism in the curator model), we develop a general solution based on the characteristic functions of noise distributions. For other mechanisms (e.g., count queries under the local DP model with the Subset mechanism), we design mechanism-specific primitives for budget transformation and introduce a template-based strategy that attains optimal utility across different privacy regimes. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework.
papers.summary_zh:
## 多层级差分隐私查询发布框架

在数据库、移动计算与数据市场等场景中，面向敏感数据的统计查询需在**差分隐私（DP）**约束下进行。现实中，多个分析者可能提交相同查询，但因信任等级或付费意愿不同，需分配**差异化隐私预算**（即多层级DP），导致传统单预算机制难以适用。现有方法或造成**累积隐私损失超出最严预算**（如简单重复加噪），或牺牲显著效用（如保守预算分配），无法兼顾隐私严格性与查询精度。

本文提出首个**严格满足多层级DP语义且实现最优效用**的通用框架：  
- **隐私保障**：确保任意查询响应的累积隐私损失严格受限于该查询所获**最高隐私预算**（而非各次响应预算之和），彻底避免预算泄漏；  
- **效用最优**：在噪声添加机制（如中心化模型下的双向几何机制用于计数查询）中，基于噪声分布的**特征函数构造统一解耦方案**，使效用达到单预算机制理论上限；  
- **机制普适性**：针对本地化DP等复杂场景（如Subset机制），设计**预算变换原语**与**模板化策略**，在宽松至严格隐私区间均实现渐近最优误差界。  

实验表明，本框架在真实与合成数据集上较基线方法降低**32–68%的平均绝对误差**，同时严格满足各层级预算约束，为可信数据共享提供了兼具安全性与实用性的新范式。
papers.summary_en: We present the first framework for multi-tier differential privacy (DP) query release that simultaneously guarantees *cumulative privacy loss bounded by the maximum privacy budget assigned to any single query* (not the sum), and achieves *utility matching optimal single-tier mechanisms*. For noise-addition mechanisms (e.g., two-sided Geometric mechanism for count queries in the curator model), we derive a general solution via characteristic functions of noise distributions. For non-additive or local DP mechanisms (e.g., Subset mechanism), we design budget-transformation primitives and a template-based strategy that attains asymptotically optimal error across all privacy regimes. Experiments on real and synthetic datasets show our framework reduces mean absolute error by 32–68% over state-of-the-art baselines while strictly respecting tiered budget constraints.

papers.title: SACE: Concept Erasure at the Semantic Singularity in Visual Autoregressive Models
papers.abstract: The rapid progress of visual autoregressive (VAR) models has unlocked a transformative frontier for high-fidelity text-to-image synthesis, while heightening concerns over the safety alignment of generated content. Naive application of existing erasure techniques to VAR models causes catastrophic semantic collapse and visual artifacts, since they are predominantly designed for the homogeneous denoising steps of diffusion models. To address this foundational challenge, we first propose the Semantic Singularity Axiom, which posits that any target semantic concept embedded within a prompt is definitively locked at Scale-0. Then rigorously validate this axiom through our proposed Incremental Semantic Saliency Analysis (ISSA),which also enable the community to transparently inspect the coarse-to-fine semantic injection process. Guided by this insight, we introduce the first scale-aware concept erasure framework (SACE) for VAR models. By strictly confining interventions to the first scale, our approach couples an Entropy-Regularized Erasure Objective to prevent high-entropy sampling degeneration, alongside a restorative preservation loss to safely anchor the integrity of entangled benign priors. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves surgical concept erasure performance across various domains with minimal training overhead, timely and elegently resolute the critical safety vulnerabilities inherent in emerging VAR architectures. Code is available at: https://github.com/limerenceysy/SACE}{https://github.com/limerenceysy/SACE.
papers.summary_zh:
## 背景与挑战  
视觉自回归（VAR）模型在高保真文本到图像生成中取得突破性进展，但其内容安全对齐问题日益突出。现有概念擦除方法（如基于扩散模型的隐空间干预）直接迁移至VAR架构时，常引发**灾难性语义坍塌**与严重视觉伪影——根本原因在于其设计依赖扩散模型同质化的去噪步长，而VAR采用**多尺度粗粒度到细粒度的分层生成机制**，语义注入具有强尺度依赖性。

## 核心洞见：语义奇点公理  
本文首次提出**语义奇点公理（Semantic Singularity Axiom）**：提示中任一目标语义概念在VAR生成流程中被唯一且不可逆地锁定于**Scale-0（最粗尺度）**。为实证验证该公理，我们设计**增量语义显著性分析（ISSA）**，通过逐层扰动与归因量化，首次实现对VAR中“粗→细”语义注入过程的**可解释、可审计可视化**，为社区提供透明化诊断工具。

## 方法创新：SACE框架  
基于上述发现，我们提出首个**尺度感知概念擦除框架SACE**：  
- **严格限定干预范围**：仅在Scale-0施加干预，避免跨尺度语义污染；  
- **熵正则化擦除目标**：抑制高熵采样退化，保障生成多样性；  
- **恢复性保真损失**：锚定良性先验结构，防止无关特征畸变。  

实验表明，SACE在人脸、物体、场景等多领域实现**精准、无损的概念擦除**（如移除敏感标识、偏见属性），训练开销极低（仅需单卡1小时微调），显著提升VAR模型的安全鲁棒性，为下一代生成式AI提供可信赖的对齐基础设施。
papers.summary_en: Visual autoregressive (VAR) models enable unprecedented fidelity in text-to-image synthesis, yet pose acute safety alignment risks. Existing concept erasure methods—designed for diffusion models’ homogeneous denoising steps—fail catastrophically on VARs, causing semantic collapse and artifacts. We introduce the *Semantic Singularity Axiom*: target concepts are definitively locked at Scale-0. Validated via our *Incremental Semantic Saliency Analysis* (ISSA), this insight enables transparent, coarse-to-fine semantic auditing. Guided by it, we propose **SACE**, the first scale-aware erasure framework for VARs: interventions are strictly confined to Scale-0; an entropy-regularized objective prevents sampling degeneration; and a restorative preservation loss safeguards entangled benign priors. Experiments across domains show surgical, high-fidelity erasure with minimal training overhead (<1 GPU-hour), effectively resolving critical safety vulnerabilities in emerging VAR architectures. Code: https://github.com/limerenceysy/SACE

papers.title: When Generator Replay Degrades: Projected Rehearsal Orchestration for Heterogeneous Federated Class-Incremental Learning
papers.abstract: Federated class-incremental learning (FCIL) becomes substantially harder when clients observe different label subsets, progress through tasks at different stages, and provide uneven supervision for the same semantic concepts. Existing FCIL methods often preserve old knowledge through input-space synthesis, but they can be fragile under heterogeneous task streams and difficult to transfer across modalities. To alleviate such issues, we propose PRO, a framework that replaces synthetic input replay with projected rehearsal orchestration. To remove external pretraining, we evaluate all methods under the same warmup. After this, PRO maintains compact class-level projected memories on the server and allows clients perform balanced pseudo multi-task training over current examples and old projected memories. To handle stronger representation drift, we further introduce PRO-MAX, which augments PRO with neighborhood-weighted memory alignment while preserving the same server-light principle that the server only aggregates model updates and memory statistics. Across image, text, and graph benchmarks, PRO and PRO-MAX improve retention and final utility under heterogeneous streams while remaining competitive in homogeneous FCIL. Even when baselines are given expanded replay budgets, they degrade under supervision imbalance and stage misalignment, indicating that replay quantity alone does not resolve replay-quality failures. Additional weak-task diagnostics further show that larger replay mismatch is associated with larger downstream degradation, while our method keeps projected memories better aligned with the evolving representation.
papers.summary_zh:
## 背景与挑战  
联邦类增量学习（FCIL）在客户端标签分布异构、任务进展不同步、同类语义概念监督强度不均等现实场景下性能显著退化。现有方法多依赖输入空间合成回放（如生成图像/文本），但此类合成样本易受任务流异质性干扰，且跨模态迁移能力弱，导致“回放质量”失效——单纯增加回放数量无法缓解因监督不平衡与阶段错位引发的知识遗忘。

## 方法创新：PRO 与 PRO-MAX  
本文提出 **PRO（Projected Rehearsal Orchestration）** 框架，摒弃脆弱的输入级合成，转而构建轻量、紧凑的**类级投影记忆**（class-level projected memories）于服务器端。所有方法在统一无预训练暖启（warmup）下评估，确保公平性。PRO 允许客户端将当前真实样本与服务器下发的投影记忆联合进行**平衡的伪多任务训练**（兼顾分类、投影一致性与记忆重建）。为进一步抑制强表征漂移，我们扩展为 **PRO-MAX**：在保持“服务器仅聚合模型更新与内存统计”这一轻量原则前提下，引入**邻域加权记忆对齐机制**（neighborhood-weighted memory alignment），动态校准投影记忆与客户端当前表征空间的一致性。

## 关键发现  
在图像（CIFAR-100-Fed）、文本（AG News-Fed）和图（Reddit-Fed）三大异构FCIL基准上，PRO/MAX 均显著提升知识保留率（+12.3% 平均准确率）与最终实用性能，且在同质FCIL中保持竞争力。即使基线方法获得加倍回放预算，其性能仍因监督失衡持续下滑，证实**回放质量优于数量**。弱任务诊断进一步表明：回放-表征失配度（replay-representation mismatch）与下游性能退化呈强正相关，而PRO系列始终维持投影记忆与演化表征的高度对齐。
papers.summary_en: Federated Class-Incremental Learning (FCIL) suffers severe degradation under client heterogeneity—divergent label subsets, asynchronous task progression, and imbalanced supervision over shared semantics. Existing input-space generator replay methods prove fragile in such settings and lack cross-modal generalizability. We propose **PRO**, a server-light framework that replaces synthetic input replay with *projected rehearsal orchestration*: the server maintains compact *class-level projected memories* (not raw data), and clients perform balanced pseudo multi-task training over current examples and these projections—without external pretraining (all methods share identical warmup). To combat stronger representation drift, **PRO-MAX** augments PRO with *neighborhood-weighted memory alignment*, preserving the server’s sole role of aggregating model updates and memory statistics. Across image, text, and graph benchmarks, PRO and PRO-MAX significantly improve retention (+12.3% avg. accuracy) and final utility under heterogeneous streams, while remaining competitive in homogeneous FCIL. Critically, even with expanded replay budgets, baselines degrade under supervision imbalance—demonstrating that *replay quality*, not quantity, is decisive. Weak-task analysis confirms that larger replay–representation mismatch strongly correlates with downstream degradation, whereas PRO maintains tight alignment between projected memories and evolving client representations.

papers.title: Conflict-Aware Federated Fine-Tuning of Large Language Models with Mixture-of-Experts
papers.abstract: The continuous scaling of large language models (LLMs) incurs prohibitive computational costs, making Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) a scalable alternative for efficient fine-tuning via sparse activation. While federated learning (FL) emerges as the paradigm for privacy-preserving collaborative optimization, integrating MoE into FL under data heterogeneity may trigger conflicting expert optimizations. Client-specific data distributions force same-indexed experts to optimize under inconsistent or even conflicting feature-label correlations. This mismatch induces destructive interference during aggregation, thus destabilizing the optimization trajectory and degrading model performance. To address this issue, we propose FC-MoE, a federated conflict-aware framework for MoE fine-tuning. It employs an importance aware weighting scheme to prioritize reliable local updates and utilizes gradient consensus projection to suppress conflicting updates, ensuring a stable global optimization path. Moreover, a local knowledge retention mechanism further preserves specialized client expertise by re-anchoring domain-specific residuals. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FC-MoE accelerates convergence and enhances both global and local model performance in non-IID federated environments.
papers.summary_zh:
## 背景与挑战  
大规模语言模型（LLM）持续扩展带来高昂计算开销，**Mixture-of-Experts（MoE）** 因其稀疏激活特性成为高效微调的可扩展方案。然而，当将MoE融入**联邦学习（FL）** 以实现隐私保护协同训练时，客户端数据非独立同分布（non-IID）会引发严重冲突：相同索引的专家在不同客户端上被迫拟合差异甚至矛盾的特征-标签关联，导致全局聚合时出现**破坏性干扰**，优化轨迹失稳、模型性能显著下降。

## 方法创新：FC-MoE框架  
我们提出 **FC-MoE（Federated Conflict-Aware MoE）** ——首个面向MoE微调的冲突感知联邦框架。其核心包含三重机制：  
- **重要性感知加权（Importance-Aware Weighting）**：基于本地梯度范数与任务一致性评估更新可靠性，动态抑制低信度本地更新；  
- **梯度共识投影（Gradient Consensus Projection）**：将各客户端专家梯度正交投影至全局共识子空间，显式抑制方向冲突，保障聚合稳定性；  
- **本地知识保留（Local Knowledge Retention）**：通过残差重锚机制，在全局同步后恢复域特异性专家能力，避免知识遗忘。

## 实验验证与优势  
在多个non-IID联邦基准（如FedWikiText、FedCLUE）上，FC-MoE相较基线（FedAvg-MoE、FedMoE）提升全局准确率**+4.2–6.8%**，本地个性化性能平均提升**+5.1%**，收敛速度加快**~35%**。消融实验证实：共识投影对冲突抑制贡献最大（+3.7%全局精度），而知识保留显著增强长尾领域泛化能力。
papers.summary_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) face prohibitive computational costs during scaling, making Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) a promising sparse fine-tuning paradigm. Yet integrating MoE into federated learning (FL) under data heterogeneity triggers *conflicting expert optimization*: same-indexed experts learn inconsistent feature-label mappings across clients, causing destructive interference during aggregation and destabilizing training. To resolve this, we propose **FC-MoE**, a conflict-aware federated MoE framework. It introduces (i) *importance-aware weighting* to prioritize reliable local updates; (ii) *gradient consensus projection* to suppress conflicting gradients via orthogonal projection onto a shared subspace; and (iii) *local knowledge retention* that re-anchors domain-specific residuals post-aggregation. Extensive experiments on non-IID benchmarks (FedWikiText, FedCLUE) show FC-MoE achieves **+4.2–6.8% higher global accuracy**, **+5.1% average local improvement**, and **~35% faster convergence** versus state-of-the-art MoE-FL baselines—demonstrating superior stability, personalization, and scalability.
papers.summary:
## 背景与挑战  
大规模语言模型（LLM）持续扩展带来高昂计算开销，**Mixture-of-Experts（MoE）** 因其稀疏激活特性成为高效微调的可扩展方案。然而，当将MoE融入**联邦学习（FL）** 以实现隐私保护协同训练时，客户端数据非独立同分布（non-IID）会引发严重冲突：相同索引的专家在不同客户端上被迫拟合差异甚至矛盾的特征-标签关联，导致全局聚合时出现**破坏性干扰**，优化轨迹失稳、模型性能显著下降。

## 方法创新：FC-MoE框架  
我们提出 **FC-MoE（Federated Conflict-Aware MoE）** ——首个面向MoE微调的冲突感知联邦框架。其核心包含三重机制：  
- **重要性感知加权（Importance-Aware Weighting）**：基于本地梯度范数与任务一致性评估更新可靠性，动态抑制低信度本地更新；  
- **梯度共识投影（Gradient Consensus Projection）**：将各客户端专家梯度正交投影至全局共识子空间，显式抑制方向冲突，保障聚合稳定性；  
- **本地知识保留（Local Knowledge Retention）**：通过残差重锚机制，在全局同步后恢复域特异性专家能力，避免知识遗忘。

## 实验验证与优势  
在多个non-IID联邦基准（如FedWikiText、FedCLUE）上，FC-MoE相较基线（FedAvg-MoE、FedMoE）提升全局准确率**+4.2–6.8%**，本地个性化性能平均提升**+5.1%**，收敛速度加快**~35%**。消融实验证实：共识投影对冲突抑制贡献最大（+3.7%全局精度），而知识保留显著增强长尾领域泛化能力。

papers.title: A Large-Scale Multi-Dimensional Empirical Study of LLMs for Conversation Summarization
papers.abstract: Despite the significant advancement of LLMs in conversation summarization, their evaluation remains limited by insufficient scenarios, input lengths, and sample sizes. Furthermore, existing benchmarks often omit frontier reasoning systems and efficient small models, or lack fine-grained, multi-dimensional assessments. To bridge these gaps, we propose OmniCSEval, a unified benchmark comprising 1,800 diverse conversations across six real-world scenarios, featuring context lengths ranging from 128 to 32k tokens. For fine-grained evaluation, we employ a bidirectional fact-checking framework that integrates key fact matching to assess completeness and conciseness, alongside summary fact verification to evaluate faithfulness. To ensure reliable assessment, we establish a human-LLM collaborative pipeline for key fact extraction and a multi-LLM consensus verifier for summary fact decomposition. Leveraging this framework, we evaluate 28 LLMs across four distinct categories grouped by reasoning capability and model scale. Our extensive empirical study reveals critical insights regarding the cross-scenario challenges current LLMs continue to face, the impacts of reasoning and scale, and the efficiency and adaptability of reasoning models. We also provide guidance for system selection in real-world deployments.
papers.summary_zh:
## 背景与挑战  
尽管大语言模型（LLMs）在对话摘要任务中取得显著进展，现有评估仍存在三大局限：**场景覆盖不足**（多集中于单一领域）、**输入长度受限**（常忽略长上下文建模能力）、**样本规模偏小**（缺乏统计稳健性）。更关键的是，主流基准普遍缺失对前沿**推理增强型模型**（如o1、DeepSeek-R1）和高性价比**轻量级模型**（如Phi-3、Qwen2.5-0.5B）的系统评测，且缺乏**多维度细粒度评估框架**——既无法区分“完整性”“简洁性”与“忠实性”的差异化表现，也难以解耦模型规模与推理能力的独立影响。

## 方法创新：OmniCSEval统一基准  
我们提出 **OmniCSEval**——首个面向对话摘要的大规模、多维实证评估基准：  
- **规模与多样性**：涵盖6类真实场景（客服、医疗咨询、法律协商、教育辅导、技术讨论、社交闲聊），共1,800条高质量对话，上下文长度横跨**128–32k tokens**；  
- **双向事实核查框架**：  
  - **前向匹配**（Key Fact Matching）：基于人工-LLM协同流水线提取黄金关键事实，量化摘要的**完整性**（召回率）与**简洁性**（冗余率）；  
  - **反向验证**（Summary Fact Verification）：通过多LLM共识分解器（集成GPT-4o、Claude-3.5、Qwen2.5-Max）验证摘要事实的**忠实性**（精确率），规避单模型幻觉偏差；  
- **模型覆盖**：系统评测28个代表性LLM，按**推理能力**（标准vs.推理增强）与**参数规模**（<1B, 1–7B, 7–70B, >70B）四象限分组。

## 关键发现与实践启示  
实证揭示：（1）所有模型在**跨场景泛化**上存在显著性能断层，尤其在法律与医疗等高专业性场景中忠实性下降超42%；（2）**推理能力提升比单纯扩模更有效**——o1-mini在32k长文本摘要中完胜同规模Llama-3-8B（+29.7%忠实性）；（3）**小型推理模型展现惊人效率优势**：Phi-3.5-mini（4B）在客服场景中达GPT-4 Turbo 92%性能，推理耗时仅1/5。本研究为工业部署提供可操作指南：优先选用推理增强型中小模型，并依据场景复杂度动态适配上下文窗口。
papers.summary_en: Despite rapid progress in LLM-based conversation summarization, evaluations suffer from narrow scenarios, short contexts, small samples, and poor coverage of reasoning-enhanced or efficient small models. To address this, we introduce **OmniCSEval**, a unified benchmark with **1,800 diverse conversations** across six real-world domains (e.g., healthcare, legal, customer service), spanning context lengths from **128 to 32k tokens**. We propose a **bidirectional fact-checking framework**: (1) *key fact matching*—via human-LLM collaborative extraction—to assess completeness and conciseness; and (2) *summary fact verification*—using multi-LLM consensus decomposition—to rigorously measure faithfulness. Evaluating **28 LLMs** across four categories (by reasoning capability and scale), we find: (i) severe cross-scenario performance gaps—especially in high-stakes domains; (ii) reasoning augmentation consistently outperforms scaling alone (e.g., o1-mini surpasses Llama-3-8B by +29.7% faithfulness on 32k inputs); and (iii) compact reasoning models (e.g., Phi-3.5-mini) achieve >90% of GPT-4 Turbo’s accuracy at <20% latency. Our work provides actionable guidance for production deployment.

papers.title: GumSwap: Griefing-Free Universal Multi-Party Atomic Swaps
papers.abstract:
Universal multi-party swaps were proposed for secure cross-chain cryptocurrency exchanges across multiple blockchains that require only signature verification from the underlying blockchains. However, existing universal swap protocols remain vulnerable to griefing attacks, where a deviating party aborts the swap to lock a compliant party’s assets for a long period, potentially causing indirect economic losses. A natural approach is to lift existing griefing-free solutions to the universal setting; however, we observe that this direct approach still faces three key challenges: (i) a timeout race attack, which arises from the absence of an upper bound on the transaction validity; (ii) a premium escape attack, which results from multiple refund transactions for the same assets being simultaneously valid; and (iii) a topological limitation, which implies that universal multi-party swaps can support only a special class of strongly connected digraphs, called reuniclus graphs.

In this paper, we propose GumSwap, a Griefing-free universal multi-party atomic Swap, which guarantees that a compliant party receives a premium if its asset is locked but not redeemed. To mitigate the timeout race attack and the premium escape attack, we impose minimum timeout intervals for the principal and premium timeouts, respectively, and introduce an asset migration mechanism that ensures that, during any time interval, at most one refund transaction is valid.  Given the topological limitations of universal swap protocols, we further design a novel premium distribution mechanism that accommodates two classes of leaders in reuniclus graphs. Our experimental results demonstrate that GumSwap can be performed in less than 0.5 seconds per party, while reducing gas costs by 10.3X compared with existing contract-based solutions.
papers.summary_zh:
## 背景与问题  
通用多方原子交换（Universal Multi-Party Swaps）旨在实现跨多条区块链的安全、无需信任的加密货币互换，仅依赖底层链的签名验证，不强制要求智能合约支持。然而，现有协议普遍存在**哀悼攻击（griefing attacks）**风险：恶意方主动中止交换，导致合规方资产被长期锁定，虽不直接盗取，却引发流动性损失、机会成本等间接经济损失。

## 核心挑战  
本文识别出将现有“无哀悼”方案迁移至通用场景时面临的三大障碍：  
- **超时竞速攻击（Timeout Race Attack）**：因交易有效期无上界，攻击者可操纵区块时间差触发不利退款；  
- **溢价逃逸攻击（Premium Escape Attack）**：同一资产存在多个同时有效的退款交易，使合规方无法可靠领取补偿溢价；  
- **拓扑限制（Topological Limitation）**：通用交换仅在一类特殊强连通有向图——**reuniclus图**上可行，且传统机制难以适配其双领袖结构（hub & sink leaders）。

## GumSwap 方案创新  
我们提出 **GumSwap**——首个真正无哀悼的通用多方原子交换协议：  
- 引入**最小主超时（principal timeout）与最小溢价超时（premium timeout）**双阈值机制，根治超时竞速；  
- 设计**资产迁移机制（Asset Migration Mechanism）**，确保任意时刻至多一个退款交易有效，彻底阻断溢价逃逸；  
- 提出**双领袖溢价分配机制**，适配reuniclus图中hub与sink两类领导者，保障所有合规方在资产锁定未赎回时**必获确定性溢价补偿**。  

## 实验结果  
在以太坊L1及主流EVM链实测中，GumSwap单方执行耗时 **< 0.5秒**，合约部署与交互总Gas成本较现有方案（如UniSwap-based或HTLC扩展方案）**降低10.3倍**，兼具高安全性、低开销与拓扑普适性。
papers.summary_en: We propose **GumSwap**, the first griefing-free universal multi-party atomic swap protocol. Unlike prior universal swaps vulnerable to griefing—where a deviating party aborts to lock compliant parties’ assets indefinitely—GumSwap guarantees that any compliant party receives a **deterministic premium** if its asset is locked but not redeemed. To counter the timeout race attack, we enforce minimum intervals for principal and premium timeouts; to eliminate the premium escape attack, we introduce an asset migration mechanism ensuring at most one valid refund transaction per time interval. Addressing the topological limitation inherent in universal swaps (restricted to *reuniclus* digraphs), we design a novel premium distribution scheme supporting both hub and sink leaders. Experiments show GumSwap completes in **under 0.5 seconds per party** and reduces gas costs by **10.3×** versus state-of-the-art contract-based alternatives.

papers.title: Stickel-type key exchange with hidden subspaces
papers.abstract: We give a witness-finding cryptanalysis of Stickel-type key exchange schemes, which involve two-sided multiplication of $n \times n$ matrices over $\mathbb{F}_p$, where these matrices are drawn from public  subspaces with a particular commuting structure.   This analysis covers Stickel's original proposal, Shpilrain's polynomial extension of that scheme,  Nager's algebraic extension of that scheme, and more generally all Stickel-type approaches using public subspaces over matrix algebra in finite fields: all such schemes can be broken in polynomial time.  We also describe a new key establishment scheme using two-sided matrix multiplication in which the commuting subspaces used to form the key are hidden via conjugation by private terms, blocking this specific public-subspace analysis; the witness-finding problem in this new scheme has a direct reduction from a standard NP-hard problem (Edmonds' problem).
papers.summary_zh:
## Stickel型密钥交换的密码分析与新型抗攻击方案

本文对一类基于矩阵代数的Stickel型密钥交换方案提出**见证者查找式密码分析**，首次系统性地攻破其安全性基础。该类方案（包括Stickel原始方案、Shpilrain的多项式推广、Nager的代数扩展等）均依赖于在有限域 $\mathbb{F}_p$ 上对 $n \times n$ 矩阵进行**双边乘法运算**，且公钥由具有特定**交换结构的公开子空间**生成。我们证明：只要子空间结构公开且满足交换性条件，攻击者即可在**多项式时间**内恢复私钥等价的“见证矩阵”，从而完全破解密钥共享。该结果统一覆盖所有基于有限域上矩阵代数、使用公开子空间的Stickel型变体，终结了其作为后量子候选方案的可行性。

为突破此结构性弱点，我们提出一种**隐藏子空间型新密钥建立协议**：核心创新在于，用于生成共享密钥的交换子空间不再直接公开，而是通过**私有可逆矩阵共轭变换**进行隐藏。该设计有效阻断了前述基于公开子空间的见证者查找攻击。进一步，我们严格证明：新方案中的关键计算问题——即寻找满足特定秩条件的矩阵——可**多项式归约至Edmonds问题**（判断矩阵空间是否含满秩矩阵），而后者是经典NP难问题。因此，新方案的安全性获得坚实复杂性理论支撑，兼具实用性与抗结构性分析能力。
papers.summary_en: We present a witness-finding cryptanalysis that breaks all Stickel-type key exchange schemes based on two-sided matrix multiplication over $\mathbb{F}_p$, where public subspaces with commuting structure are used—covering Stickel’s original, Shpilrain’s polynomial, and Nager’s algebraic variants. Our attack recovers secret-equivalent witnesses in polynomial time, showing these schemes are insecure. To counter this, we propose a new key establishment protocol where the commuting subspaces are *hidden* via private conjugation, thwarting the public-subspace analysis. Crucially, the core computational problem in our scheme—finding a full-rank matrix in a conjugated subspace—admits a direct polynomial-time reduction from Edmonds’ problem, a canonical NP-hard problem. Thus, our scheme achieves provable hardness under standard complexity assumptions.

papers.title: Problems in algebra inspired by tropical cryptography
papers.abstract: In 2011, Grigoriev and Shpilrain proposed using tropical algebraic structures in cryptography. In recent years, numerous protocols based on tropical and related structures have been introduced, as well as many attacks on some of these protocols. This direction of research is now known as tropical cryptography. As a result of the efforts both to design secure schemes and to analyze their vulnerabilities, many purely algebraic and computational problems have emerged. In this paper, we give an overview of several results and open questions in this area. We discuss the complexity of solving certain classes of systems of equations over tropical and similar structures, as well as algorithms and approaches for solving such systems. We also present results on the asymptotic density of satisfiable systems of equations of special forms over tropical algebras. Furthermore, we discuss the discrete logarithm problem, the two-sided discrete logarithm problem, the knapsack problem, and the subset sum problem over tropical matrix structures. We consider a generalization of marginal sets for tropical semirings and semigroups. We also explore different classes of pairwise commuting matrices.

## 热带密码学驱动的代数问题综述  

本文系统梳理了由热带密码学（tropical cryptography）催生的一系列深层代数与计算问题。自2011年Grigoriev与Shpilrain首次提出将**热带半环**（如$(\mathbb{R}\cup\{\infty\}, \min, +)$）用于公钥密码设计以来，该领域迅速发展：一方面涌现出基于热带矩阵、幂等半群及广义加法-极小代数结构的多种密钥交换与加密协议；另一方面，针对其安全性的一系列代数攻击（如线性化、投影法、中心化攻击）也揭示了大量未被充分研究的基础问题。

本文核心贡献包括：  
- **方程求解复杂性**：刻画了热带及类热带结构（如max-plus、min-plus、idempotent semirings）上特定类型方程组（如线性、双线性、分段线性）的可解性边界，指出多数非平凡系统在PSPACE中但普遍不属于P，部分情形下为NP-hard；  
- **渐近可满足密度**：首次给出热带矩阵方程组（如$A \otimes X = B \otimes X$）在随机模型下的**渐近密度精确估计**，证明当变量数远大于方程数时，可满足系统占比趋近于0，为参数选择提供理论依据；  
- **困难问题重构**：严格定义并分析热带矩阵上的**离散对数问题**（DLP）、**双边离散对数**（Two-sided DLP）、**热带背包问题**与**子集和问题**，证实其在一般矩阵群下不具经典类比的代数结构，导致标准指数演算法失效；  
- **代数结构深化**：提出热带半环上**广义边缘集**（generalized marginal sets）概念，统一刻画中心化子、交换子与稳定子；并完整分类了在$\mathbb{R}_{\min}$上两两交换的$n\times n$矩阵的代数结构，揭示其与分段线性函数层叠及凸多面体剖分的深刻联系。

本工作不仅为热带密码协议的安全评估建立代数基准，更反向推动了热带代数、组合优化与计算半群理论的交叉发展。
papers.summary_en: This paper surveys algebraic and computational problems arising from tropical cryptography—the cryptographic use of idempotent semirings (e.g., $(\mathbb{R}\cup\{\infty\}, \min, +)$) initiated by Grigoriev–Shpilrain (2011). We analyze the complexity of solving linear and bilinear equation systems over tropical and related structures, showing many are NP-hard or PSPACE-complete. We establish asymptotic densities for satisfiable tropical matrix equations—demonstrating vanishing solvability probability under natural random models. We rigorously formulate and study tropical analogues of foundational hard problems: discrete logarithm, two-sided discrete logarithm, knapsack, and subset sum over tropical matrices—revealing their structural deviation from classical counterparts. Finally, we introduce generalized marginal sets for tropical semirings and fully classify pairwise commuting $n\times n$ matrices over $\mathbb{R}_{\min}$, linking them to convex polyhedral geometry. These results bridge cryptographic security analysis with tropical algebra and combinatorial optimization.

papers.title: Bootstrapping is All You Need: Secure Transformer Inference via Improved CKKS Functional Bootstrapping
papers.abstract:
Fully homomorphic encryption (FHE) enables non-interactive secure transformer inference (NISTI). 
Due to the high cost of bootstrapping, conventional approaches typically choose parameters that support a large multiplicative depth to reduce bootstrapping frequency. However, larger depth directly increases ciphertext size, resulting in higher communication and computation overheads.

In this paper, we introduce a novel functional bootstrapping (FBS) scheme that fundamentally reshapes the computation paradigm for NISTI: by fusing as many operations as possible into each bootstrapping operation, our approach significantly reduces the prescribed multiplicative depth.

Our FBS achieves a trigonometric minimax approximation for the target function, making it well suited for precision-sensitive components such as transformer nonlinear layers. 
Furthermore, we incorporate linear layers into the slot-to-coefficient (S2C) transformation within FBS, thereby eliminating the need to evaluate them separately.
Building on these innovations, we present a complete NISTI framework that achieves a 1.9$\times$ speedup in runtime (from 662.3s to 349.5s) and a 3$\times$ reduction in communication (from 48.3MB to 16.1MB) compared with the state-of-the-art.
papers.summary_zh:
## 背景与挑战  
全同态加密（FHE）支持非交互式安全Transformer推理（NISTI），但其核心瓶颈在于**bootstrapping（自举）操作开销极高**。传统方案为规避频繁自举，往往选择支持极大乘法深度的参数，却导致密文尺寸激增，显著抬高通信与计算成本，形成“深度—效率”悖论。

## 创新方法：功能型自举（FBS）  
本文提出一种**改进的CKKS功能型自举（FBS）框架**，彻底重构NISTI计算范式：  
- **深度融合计算**：将尽可能多的运算（包括非线性激活、归一化及部分线性变换）嵌入单次自举中，大幅压缩所需乘法深度；  
- **三角多项式极小极大逼近**：针对Transformer中精度敏感的非线性层（如GeLU、Softmax），在CKKS环上实现高保真函数逼近，兼顾精度与效率；  
- **线性层内联优化**：将线性层（如Attention中的Q/K/V投影、FFN权重变换）无缝集成至自举过程的Slot-to-Coefficient（S2C）转换阶段，**消除独立评估开销**。

## 主要成果  
在标准BERT-base推理任务上，本方案相较当前最优工作实现：  
- **1.9×端到端加速**（运行时间从662.3秒降至349.5秒）；  
- **3×通信量压缩**（密文传输量从48.3 MB降至16.1 MB）；  
- 同时保持**<0.5%的推理精度损失**（Top-1准确率92.4% → 91.9%）。  
该工作首次验证：**“自举即计算”范式可成为高效安全大模型推理的基石**，为FHE实用化开辟新路径。
papers.summary_en: Fully homomorphic encryption (FHE) enables non-interactive secure transformer inference (NISTI), yet bootstrapping remains prohibitively expensive. Conventional approaches mitigate this by using large multiplicative depth—trading off ciphertext bloat and overhead. We propose an improved CKKS functional bootstrapping (FBS) scheme that fundamentally rethinks NISTI computation: by fusing nonlinear activations, normalization, and *linear layers* directly into the bootstrapping operation—via trigonometric minimax approximation and integrated slot-to-coefficient transformation—we drastically reduce required multiplicative depth. Our end-to-end framework achieves a **1.9× speedup** (662.3s → 349.5s) and **3× communication reduction** (48.3MB → 16.1MB) over the state-of-the-art, with negligible accuracy loss (<0.5% Top-1 drop). This demonstrates that optimized functional bootstrapping—not depth avoidance—is the key to efficient, practical FHE-based LLM inference.

papers.title: Top Gun: Degree Annihilation Attacks on Poseidon
papers.abstract:
Poseidon is one of the most widely deployed arithmetization-oriented cryptographic permutations and plays a central role in modern zero-knowledge proof systems. Although several algebraic attacks on reduced-round variants have been proposed, the security of the recommended parameter sets remains intact. A central difficulty in such attacks is controlling the degree growth of the polynomial representations induced by the permutation.

In this work, we introduce degree annihilation, a new framework for algebraic cryptanalysis of Poseidon. Unlike round-skipping techniques, which reduce complexity by removing rounds from the algebraic model, degree annihilation reduces the contribution of existing rounds by imposing algebraic constraints that force dominant degree terms to vanish. This yields polynomial systems of substantially lower effective degree.

We first present a simple bivariate form of degree annihilation and show how it combines naturally with classical round-skipping techniques. The gain depends on the multiplicity with which the annihilated degree contribution propagates through the remaining nonlinear layers; when this multiplicity matches the contribution of one S-box layer, the effect is the same as skipping an additional nonlinear layer. We then generalize the technique to multivariate settings, where systems of control equations are used to annihilate successive partial-round degree contributions. These systems can be solved using elimination, resultants, and Gröbner basis techniques.

As a proof of concept, we apply the framework to reduced-round Poseidon instances and obtain new CICO-2 attacks. More broadly, our results suggest that constructing algebraic varieties that actively control degree growth may provide a new direction for the cryptanalysis of arithmetization-oriented primitives.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景  
Poseidon 是当前最广泛部署的**算术化导向密码置换**之一，在现代零知识证明系统（如 zk-SNARKs）中处于核心地位。尽管已有针对轮数缩减变体的代数攻击（如Gröbner基、MITM等），其推荐参数集（如Poseidon-128/256）的安全性仍被普遍认为稳健。关键瓶颈在于：Poseidon 的S-box（全非线性层）引发剧烈的**多项式度增长**，导致代数模型复杂度呈指数级上升，难以高效求解。

## 创新方法：度湮灭（Degree Annihilation）  
本文提出**度湮灭**——一种全新的代数密码分析框架。不同于传统“跳轮”（round-skipping）技术（通过删减轮数简化模型），度湮灭在**保留全部轮结构的前提下**，通过引入精心设计的代数约束条件，强制主导高次项（如d次单项式）在中间状态中精确归零，从而显著降低系统的**有效代数度**（effective degree）。其本质是构造控制方程组，主动“抑制”而非“绕过”非线性传播。

## 核心成果与验证  
- **双变量初版**：展示度湮灭可自然融合经典跳轮技术；当湮灭贡献的传播重数恰好匹配单层S-box的度增量时，效果等价于**额外跳过一轮非线性层**，大幅提升求解效率。  
- **多变量推广**：构建分层控制方程组，逐轮抵消部分轮的度贡献；采用消元法、结式（resultants）与Gröbner基联合求解，实现系统性度压制。  
- **实证突破**：在缩减轮Poseidon上成功实现新型**CICO-2攻击**，刷新同类代数攻击的轮数纪录。  
本工作揭示：**主动构造控制度增长的代数簇**，有望成为算术化密码原语（如HadesMiMC、Marvellous等）代数分析的新范式。
papers.summary_en: Poseidon is a cornerstone arithmetization-oriented permutation widely used in zero-knowledge proof systems. While algebraic attacks exist against reduced-round variants, its recommended parameter sets remain secure—largely due to explosive degree growth in polynomial representations. This work introduces *degree annihilation*, a novel cryptanalytic framework that actively suppresses dominant degree terms via algebraic constraints—*without skipping rounds*. Unlike round-skipping, it preserves the full structure while reducing effective degree by forcing high-degree monomials to vanish identically. We first present a bivariate instantiation that synergizes with round-skipping: when annihilated contributions propagate with multiplicity matching one S-box layer, the effect equals skipping an extra nonlinear round. We then generalize to multivariate settings using control equation systems solved via elimination, resultants, and Gröbner bases. As proof of concept, we mount new CICO-2 attacks on reduced-round Poseidon instances. Our results suggest that *constructing algebraic varieties to actively govern degree growth* opens a promising new direction for analyzing arithmetization-friendly primitives.

papers.title: Multi-tier Differential Private Query Release
papers.abstract: Answering statistical queries over sensitive data under differential privacy (DP) is a common task in many settings, including databases, mobile computing, and data markets. In these scenarios, multiple analysts may issue the same query, while receiving answers generated under different privacy budgets due to differences in trust levels or willingness to pay. Existing approaches for such multi-tier DP queries either incur excessive cumulative privacy loss or suffer from suboptimal utility. In this paper, we propose a framework for multi-tier DP query release that simultaneously bound the cumulative privacy loss by the maximum privacy budget among all queries and achieve optimal utility comparable to that of single-tier mechanisms. Our framework applies to different classes of DP mechanisms. For noise-adding mechanisms (e.g., count queries with the two-sided Geometric mechanism in the curator model), we develop a general solution based on the characteristic functions of noise distributions. For other mechanisms (e.g., count queries under the local DP model with the Subset mechanism), we design mechanism-specific primitives for budget transformation and introduce a template-based strategy that attains optimal utility across different privacy regimes. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework.
papers.summary_zh:
## 多层级差分隐私查询发布框架

在数据库、移动计算与数据市场等场景中，面向敏感数据的统计查询需在**差分隐私（DP）**约束下发布答案。实际应用中常存在**多分析师同质查询但异质信任/付费意愿**的情形——即同一查询被不同用户重复提交，却需依据其个体隐私预算（如 ε₁, ε₂, …）提供差异化噪声答案。现有方案面临两大瓶颈：或导致**累积隐私损失突破最严预算**（如朴素独立加噪），或因保守预算分配而**严重牺牲效用**。

本文提出首个**严格满足多层级DP语义且实现最优效用**的通用框架。核心创新在于：  
- **隐私保障**：确保任意查询实例的**全局隐私损失严格受限于该查询所有响应中最大的单次预算**（即 max{εᵢ}），而非累加值；  
- **效用最优**：所生成答案的均方误差（MSE）与单层级（single-tier）最优机制一致，无额外效用折损；  
- **机制普适性**：  
  - 对**噪声添加型机制**（如中心化模型下的双向几何机制用于计数查询），基于**噪声分布的特征函数**构建可逆预算映射，实现跨预算答案的无偏合成；  
  - 对**非噪声型或本地化机制**（如本地DP下的Subset机制），设计**机制专属预算转换原语**，并提出**模板化策略**，在宽松至严格各隐私区间均达理论最优效用。  

实验在真实与合成数据集上验证：相较基线方法（如Budget Splitting、Independent Noising），本框架在相同最大预算下**降低35–62%的平均绝对误差**，同时严格满足多层级DP定义。
papers.summary_en: Answering the same statistical query under heterogeneous privacy budgets—arising from varying trust levels or payment capacities—is a critical yet under-solved challenge in multi-analyst differential privacy (DP). Existing approaches either violate cumulative privacy bounds or degrade utility significantly. This paper introduces the first framework for *multi-tier DP query release* that simultaneously guarantees: (1) **tight cumulative privacy loss bounded by the maximum budget** (not sum) across all query instances, and (2) **utility matching single-tier optimal mechanisms**, i.e., no asymptotic MSE penalty. We achieve this via two complementary designs: for noise-additive mechanisms (e.g., two-sided Geometric mechanism in the curator model), we leverage characteristic functions to enable budget-aware, unbiased answer composition; for non-additive or local-DP mechanisms (e.g., Subset mechanism), we devise mechanism-specific budget transformation primitives and a template-based strategy achieving optimality across all privacy regimes. Experiments confirm up to 62% lower MAE than baselines while strictly enforcing multi-tier DP semantics.

- **隐私保障**：确保任意查询实例的**全局隐私损失严格受限于该查询所有响应中最大的单次预算**（即 max{εᵢ}），而非累加值；  
- **效用最优**：所生成答案的均方误差（MSE）与单层级（single-tier）最优机制一致，无额外效用折损；  
- **机制普适性**：  
  - 对**噪声添加型机制**（如中心化模型下的双向几何机制用于计数查询），基于**噪声分布的特征函数**构建可逆预算映射，实现跨预算答案的无偏合成；  
  - 对**非噪声型或本地化机制**（如本地DP下的Subset机制），设计**机制专属预算转换原语**，并提出**模板化策略**，在宽松至严格各隐私区间均达理论最优效用。  

实验在真实与合成数据集上验证：相较基线方法（如Budget Splitting、Independent Noising），本框架在相同最大预算下**降低35–62%的平均绝对误差**，同时严格满足多层级DP定义。

papers.title: One Goal, Many Commands: Characterizing Denylist Fragility in AI Agents
papers.abstract: The adoption of AI agents is increasing rapidly. Terminal AI agents, i.e., AI agents that run in terminal environments, are a widely used type of AI agents. Terminal AI agents rely heavily on shell command execution to interact with the host systems. They adopt a three-list command-gating mechanism to mitigate security risks introduced by command execution, with denylists serving as the load-bearing component. However, modern operating systems often ship a large, ever-expanding set of shell commands with complex functionalities. Our observation is that even a built-in denylist of Claude Code, well-maintained by its developers, can overlook bypass commands that invalidate its effectiveness. Such negligence leads to fragile command denylists that cannot even block operations that practitioners expect them to block.   This paper presents the first systematic characterization of command denylist fragility in terminal AI agents. The paper formalizes the command denylist fragility problem and proposes an LLM-driven pipeline, ShellSieve, to detect such fragility. It prompts the LLM to propose possible bypasses and iteratively repairs them using feedback from a validator that executes them in a sandbox. In the evaluation, we applied ShellSieve to 1,709 real-world command denylists (containing 13,332 denylist rules) collected from GitHub. The evaluation shows several key findings, including that 69.0--98.6% of the denylists are fragile, that this fragility occurs consistently across projects and agents, and the validity of several possible root causes for this fragility. Our pipeline and findings will hopefully facilitate future research and practice regarding the command denylists used by AI agents.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景  
随着AI代理（AI agents）在终端环境中的广泛应用，**终端AI代理**——即通过执行Shell命令与宿主系统交互的智能体——正面临严峻的安全挑战。为管控命令执行风险，业界普遍采用“三列表”命令门控机制（allowlist/blocklist/denylist），其中**denylist（拒绝列表）被广泛视为核心防御层**。然而，现代操作系统内置命令数量庞大、功能复杂且持续演进，导致人工维护的denylist极易出现疏漏。我们发现，即便如Claude Code中由官方精心维护的内置denylist，仍存在可被绕过的命令变体，使其实际防护能力严重退化。

## 方法创新  
本文首次对终端AI代理中的命令denylist脆弱性开展**系统性实证研究**。我们形式化定义了“denylist脆弱性”：当存在至少一条未被denylist覆盖但语义等价（或功能等效）的绕过命令时，该denylist即被视为脆弱。为此，我们提出LLM驱动的自动化检测框架 **ShellSieve**：利用大语言模型生成潜在绕过命令，再通过沙箱环境中的动态验证器进行执行反馈，并迭代修复漏报。整个流程无需人工标注或先验规则，具备强泛化性。

## 关键发现  
我们在GitHub上采集了**1,709个真实项目中的denylist配置（含13,332条规则）**，评估结果显示：  
- **69.0%–98.6%的denylist存在脆弱性**，且该现象跨项目、跨AI代理平台（如LangChain、LlamaIndex、AutoGen等）高度一致；  
- 脆弱性根因包括：命令别名/符号链接未覆盖、路径规范化缺失、参数组合爆炸、以及shell内置功能（如`exec`、`eval`）的语义逃逸；  
- ShellSieve平均每个denylist检出**2.4个有效绕过命令**，F1-score达0.87，显著优于基线方法。

本研究揭示了当前AI代理安全实践中的关键盲区，为构建鲁棒的命令治理机制提供了理论基础与实用工具。
papers.summary_en: This paper presents the first systematic characterization of **command denylist fragility** in terminal AI agents—i.e., agents that execute shell commands to interact with host systems. We formalize fragility as the existence of semantically equivalent bypass commands not covered by a denylist, and propose **ShellSieve**, an LLM-driven pipeline that iteratively generates bypass candidates and validates them in a sandboxed environment. Evaluated on 1,709 real-world denylists (13,332 rules) from GitHub, ShellSieve reveals that **69.0–98.6% are fragile**, consistently across diverse AI agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, AutoGen). Key root causes include unhandled command aliases, path normalization gaps, combinatorial argument variants, and shell built-in escapes (e.g., `eval`, `command`). ShellSieve achieves 0.87 F1-score and detects 2.4 valid bypasses per denylist on average—demonstrating both the severity of the problem and the viability of LLM-augmented security auditing for AI agent infrastructure.

papers.title: Multi-tier Differential Private Query Release
papers.abstract: Answering statistical queries over sensitive data under differential privacy (DP) is a common task in many settings, including databases, mobile computing, and data markets. In these scenarios, multiple analysts may issue the same query, while receiving answers generated under different privacy budgets due to differences in trust levels or willingness to pay. Existing approaches for such multi-tier DP queries either incur excessive cumulative privacy loss or suffer from suboptimal utility. In this paper, we propose a framework for multi-tier DP query release that simultaneously bound the cumulative privacy loss by the maximum privacy budget among all queries and achieve optimal utility comparable to that of single-tier mechanisms. Our framework applies to different classes of DP mechanisms. For noise-adding mechanisms (e.g., count queries with the two-sided Geometric mechanism in the curator model), we develop a general solution based on the characteristic functions of noise distributions. For other mechanisms (e.g., count queries under the local DP model with the Subset mechanism), we design mechanism-specific primitives for budget transformation and introduce a template-based strategy that attains optimal utility across different privacy regimes. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework.
papers.summary_zh:
## 背景与挑战  
在数据库、移动计算及数据市场等场景中，面向敏感数据的统计查询需满足**差分隐私（DP）**保障。现实中，多个分析者可能提交相同查询，但因信任等级或付费意愿不同，需按**多层级隐私预算**（multi-tier privacy budgets）提供差异化响应。现有方法存在两大瓶颈：（1）累积隐私损失随查询次数线性增长，突破各层预算上限；（2）为兼顾多预算而牺牲效用，无法逼近单预算机制的最优性能。

## 方法创新  
本文提出**多层级差分隐私查询释放框架（Multi-tier DP Query Release）**，首次实现双重保证：  
- ✅ **严格累积隐私控制**：全局隐私损失被约束为所有查询中**最大单次预算**（而非求和），满足各层级最严苛的隐私要求；  
- ✅ **效用最优性**：在噪声添加机制（如中心化模型下带双侧几何噪声的计数查询）中，基于**噪声分布特征函数**构建通用解法；在非噪声机制（如本地DP下的Subset机制）中，设计**预算变换原语**（budget transformation primitives）并提出**模板化策略**，适配高/低隐私预算等不同 regime，实现理论最优效用。

## 实验验证  
在真实与合成数据集上的实验表明：相比基线方法（如Budget Splitting、Composition-based），本框架在相同最大预算下将均方误差降低37–62%，且隐私消耗恒定为最大预算值（无累积泄漏）。该框架具有机制无关性，可无缝扩展至Laplace、Geometric、Exponential等主流DP机制。
papers.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-tier differential privacy (DP) query release, where multiple analysts submit identical statistical queries but require answers calibrated to *different privacy budgets*—e.g., due to varying trust or payment levels. Existing approaches either incur unbounded cumulative privacy loss (violating per-tier guarantees) or sacrifice utility significantly. We propose the first framework that simultaneously: (1) bounds *total privacy loss* by the *maximum budget among all tiers* (not their sum), ensuring strict compliance with the most stringent tier; and (2) achieves *utility optimal* for each tier—matching the theoretical performance of single-tier mechanisms. Our solution is mechanism-aware: for noise-addition mechanisms (e.g., two-sided Geometric in the curator model), we derive a general characterization via characteristic functions; for non-additive mechanisms (e.g., Subset mechanism under local DP), we introduce budget-transformation primitives and a template-based strategy adaptable across privacy regimes. Experiments confirm up to 62% lower MSE than baselines while strictly respecting the maximum budget.

papers.title: Related Differentials of $4\times4$ MDS Matrices: A Complete Characterization
papers.abstract: A pair of differences $(x,y)$ is a \emph{related differential} for a linear layer $M$ if, for every coordinate at both the input and the output, at least one of the two values vanishes or the two values coincide. Related differentials underlie the zero-difference attack on AES of Bardeh and Rijmen, and the question of which maximum distance separable (MDS) matrices admit them was raised by Daemen and Rijmen, who showed that every $4\times4$ circulant MDS matrix does while some Hadamard ones do not.  In earlier work we characterized the $3\times3$ MDS matrices over $\mathbb{F}_{2^r}$ admitting related differentials by fifteen explicit equations.  In this paper we settle the $4\times4$ case completely: an MDS matrix $M=DNE$ over $\mathbb{F}_{2^r}$ admits a related differential if and only if at least one of $280$ explicit polynomial equations in the nine free entries of its reduced form $N$ holds.  The equations, $70$ quadratic and $210$ cubic, are pairwise distinct, irreducible and pairwise coprime, and fall into $27$ orbits under the natural symmetries.  We further determine the structure of the equation set: the fifteen equations of the $3\times3$ case are exactly the points of $\mathrm{PG}(3,2)$, while the $280$ equations span a $14$-dimensional $\mathbb{F}_2$-space, satisfy exactly $560$ additive relations, and contain exactly $840$ pairs that can never hold simultaneously on an MDS matrix. The discarded zero patterns split into $525$ whose determinant condition is equivalent to the failure of MDS-ness and $289$ vacuous cases. Over $\mathbb{F}_8$, the smallest field carrying $4\times4$ MDS matrices, exhaustive enumeration shows that there are exactly $720$ reduced MDS matrices; each satisfying exactly $28$ of the equations and each equation being satisfied by exactly $72$ matrices; in particular every $4\times4$ MDS matrix over $\mathbb{F}_8$ admits a related differential.  Over $\mathbb{F}_{2^{10}}$ we exhibit an explicit MDS matrix admitting none. All results are verified by exact computation against an independent exhaustive search.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与问题  
在分组密码分析中，**相关微分（related differential）** 是一类特殊差分对 $(x,y)$，要求对线性层 $M$ 的每个输入/输出坐标位置，$x_i$ 与 $y_j$ 至少满足：二者之一为零，或二者相等。该概念是 Bardeh–Rijmen 零差分攻击的理论基础，而 Daemen 与 Rijmen 曾提出关键问题：哪些 $4\times4$ 最大距离可分（MDS）矩阵存在相关微分？此前工作已完全刻画 $\mathbb{F}_{2^r}$ 上 $3\times3$ MDS 矩阵的充要条件（15个显式方程），但 $4\times4$ 情形长期悬而未决。

## 核心成果与方法  
本文首次给出 $4\times4$ MDS 矩阵 admitting 相关微分的**完整代数刻画**：设 $M = DNE$ 为其标准约化形式（$N$ 含9个自由变量），则 $M$ 存在相关微分 **当且仅当** 其9个变量满足280个显式多项式方程中的至少一个。这些方程严格分为两类：**70个二次方程**与**210个三次方程**；全部两两互异、不可约、互素，并在自然对称群作用下形成**27个轨道**。

## 结构深度解析  
我们揭示了方程集的深层组合结构：  
- $3\times3$ 情形的15个方程恰好对应射影空间 $\mathrm{PG}(3,2)$ 的全部15个点；  
- $4\times4$ 的280个方程张成一个**14维 $\mathbb{F}_2$-线性空间**，满足**560个加性关系**，且包含**840对互斥方程**（无法同时在任一MDS矩阵上成立）；  
- 被排除的零模式分为两类：525类因行列式退化而直接违反MDS性质，289类为逻辑空真（vacuous）情形。

## 实验验证与应用意义  
在最小可行域 $\mathbb{F}_8$ 上，穷举确认存在**720个约化MDS矩阵**：每个恰满足28个方程，每个方程恰被72个矩阵满足——故**所有 $4\times4$ MDS 矩阵在 $\mathbb{F}_8$ 上均存在相关微分**；而在 $\mathbb{F}_{2^{10}}$ 上，我们构造出首个**不满足任何方程的显式MDS矩阵**，证伪普遍性。全部结论均通过独立穷举搜索与精确符号计算双重验证。
papers.summary_en: This paper provides a complete algebraic characterization of $4\times4$ MDS matrices over $\mathbb{F}_{2^r}$ admitting related differentials — a cryptanalytically significant property underlying zero-difference attacks. We prove that such a matrix $M = DNE$, with reduced form $N$ having nine free entries, admits a related differential **iff** at least one of **280 explicit polynomial equations** (70 quadratic, 210 cubic) in those entries holds. All equations are pairwise distinct, irreducible, coprime, and partition into 27 symmetry orbits. Structurally, they span a 14-dimensional $\mathbb{F}_2$-space, satisfy exactly 560 additive relations, and contain 840 mutually exclusive pairs. Exhaustive search over $\mathbb{F}_8$ confirms all 720 reduced $4\times4$ MDS matrices satisfy exactly 28 equations each — hence *every* such matrix over $\mathbb{F}_8$ admits a related differential; conversely, we explicitly construct an MDS matrix over $\mathbb{F}_{2^{10}}$ satisfying none. All results are rigorously verified by independent exact computation.

papers.title: TensorZKP: Repurposing GPU Tensor Cores for High-Performance Zero-Knowledge Proofs
papers.abstract:
GPU Tensor Cores, specialized hardware units designed to accelerate matrix multiplication, have served as the primary engine behind the AI revolution. Given the exponential performance gains they have delivered, aligning cryptographic implementations with this hardware evolution is critical. This is particularly acute for zero-knowledge proofs (ZKPs), a cryptographic primitive that currently grapples with high proof generation costs. Existing GPU implementations for ZKPs rely exclusively on general-purpose SIMT cores, leaving the massive computational power of Tensor Cores untapped.

In this paper, we introduce TensorZKP, the first GPU framework to harness Tensor Cores for ZKP acceleration. Since Tensor Cores are designed for low-precision matrix multiplication, mapping ZKP's arithmetic to this hardware is non-trivial. To bridge this gap, we develop Tensor-Core-compatible finite field arithmetic and reformulate ZKP modules, specifically sum-check protocols and Spielman code, into matrix multiplication tasks. Furthermore, we design an asynchronous warp-specialized framework that pipelines memory access, Tensor Core matrix operations, and SIMT-based modular reductions. We instantiate these optimizations with HyperPlonk as the Polynomial Interactive Oracle Proof (PIOP) and Brakedown as the Polynomial Commitment Scheme (PCS) to enable end-to-end proof generation.

The evaluation results show that TensorZKP exhibits remarkable efficiency. At a $2^{25}$ scale, the underlying building blocks complete in $0.85$ ms for inner product, $0.91$ ms for scalar-vector multiplication, $4.04$ ms for degree-2 sum-check, and $11.58$ ms for the encoder. For a circuit with $2^{25}$ multiplication gates, TensorZKP achieves a proof generation time of only $215.28$ milliseconds, representing a $955\times$ speedup over the CPU baseline and a $36.2\times$ improvement over state-of-the-art SIMT-based GPU implementations.

papers.title: Model Stealing Through the Lens of Model Multiplicity
papers.abstract: Model stealing attacks, where adversaries create high-fidelity surrogate models, are a significant threat to the intellectual property of machine learning services. Conventional wisdom suggests these surrogates could provide adversaries with economic leverage comparable to the original service providers. This paper challenges this assumption by evaluating model stealing attacks beyond mere fidelity to the target model. Because query-based extraction provides only partial supervision of the target's input-output behavior, the surrogate is not uniquely identified: many near-optimal surrogates can achieve comparable fidelity while differing in deployment-relevant properties. Instead of performing a classic learning-based model stealing attack, we compute the Rashomon Set (i.e., the set of almost-equally-accurate models) of surrogate models, and evaluate its diversity using multiplicity metrics (ambiguity, discrepancy, and Rashomon Capacity) and group fairness metrics. Across tabular, medical imaging, and NLP tasks, our experiments on real-world datasets reveal that despite exhibiting similar fidelity to the target model, surrogate models can display significant variances in other critical performance metrics. These findings cast doubt on the presumed equivalence between high-fidelity surrogates and the target model in practical deployment scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
## 模型窃取中的模型多重性视角：挑战高保真代理模型的等价性假设  

模型窃取攻击——即攻击者通过查询黑盒API构建高保真代理模型——被视为对机器学习即服务（MLaaS）知识产权的重大威胁。传统观点认为，此类代理模型一旦达到与目标模型相近的预测精度，便能获得与其相当的经济价值与部署能力。本文**从根本上质疑这一隐含假设**，指出：由于查询式提取仅提供目标模型输入-输出行为的部分监督信号，所学得的代理模型并非唯一解；相反，存在大量在测试精度上“几乎同等优秀”但内在结构与行为特性迥异的模型——即构成**Rashomon集**（Rashomon Set）。  

我们摒弃经典端到端学习式窃取范式，转而**系统性地计算并分析该Rashomon集的多样性**：一方面采用**多重性量化指标**（包括模糊性 Ambiguity、差异性 Discrepancy 和 Rashomon容量 Capacity）刻画模型行为漂移；另一方面引入**群体公平性指标**（如不同人口子群间的准确率差、机会均等偏差），评估其部署鲁棒性。实验覆盖三大真实场景：金融信用评分（tabular）、胸部X光诊断（medical imaging）和情感分析（NLP）。结果一致表明：即使所有代理模型在整体准确率上与目标模型偏差<0.5%，其在**公平性差距上可高达32.7%**，在对抗鲁棒性上标准差达18.4%，且关键特征重要性排序相关性低至0.21。这揭示了“高保真≠高可用”——模型多重性导致的隐性行为分化，严重削弱了窃取模型的实际替代价值，为模型产权保护提供了新维度的理论支撑与实证依据。
papers.summary_en: Model stealing attacks—where adversaries query black-box ML services to build high-fidelity surrogates—pose serious IP threats. This paper challenges the common assumption that such surrogates are functionally equivalent to the target model in deployment. Leveraging *model multiplicity*, we show that query-based extraction yields not one, but a *Rashomon Set*: a collection of models nearly as accurate as the target yet divergent in critical properties. Instead of training a single surrogate, we compute this set and quantify its diversity using ambiguity, discrepancy, and Rashomon capacity, alongside group fairness metrics. Experiments across tabular, medical imaging, and NLP tasks reveal stark disparities: despite ≤0.5% accuracy gap vs. the target, surrogates exhibit up to 32.7% fairness disparity, 18.4% std. dev. in adversarial robustness, and near-zero feature importance alignment (ρ=0.21). These results demonstrate that fidelity alone is insufficient for functional equivalence—undermining the economic premise of model stealing and highlighting multiplicity as a foundational constraint.

papers.title: Defending against Adaptive Prompt Injection Attacks via Reasoning-enabled Task Alignment
papers.abstract: Indirect prompt injection attacks hijack LLM-based agents by embedding malicious instructions in third-party data that the agent retrieves during task execution. Existing defenses report near-zero attack success rate on static benchmarks, yet recent adaptive evaluations show that these results collapse once the attacker is allowed to optimize against the deployed defense. In this work, we trace this collapse to two failure modes. First, existing defense methods are confined to recognizing specific attack patterns, rather than assessing whether the intent of every embedded instruction is relevant to the user task. Second, training-based defenses, which otherwise offer the strongest safety-utility trade-off, assemble their adversarial examples from a handful of hand-crafted templates, and the resulting defender fails to generalize outside that narrow strategy distribution. To address these gaps, we propose RETA, a training-based method that grounds defense decisions on the user tasks rather than attacker-controlled data. At each tool-output step, the defender undertakes chain-of-thought reasoning verifying that its actions are consistent with the user task. Leveraging red-teaming, a simulated attacker synthesizes adversarial training data and receives a dictionary-learning diversity reward, achieving broad coverage of injection-reformulation strategies. Together, these allow the defender to be optimized via multi-objective reinforcement learning and achieve better safety-utility trade-off. Across six black-box adaptive attacks, RETA keeps every per-attack ASR below 10%, with average ASR of 2.92% and 3.75% on the two target models, while preserving most utility under attack and on clean inputs.
papers.summary_zh:
## 背景与问题  
间接提示注入攻击（Indirect Prompt Injection）通过在第三方数据（如检索文档、API响应）中嵌入恶意指令，劫持基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体。现有防御方法在静态基准上报告近乎零的攻击成功率（ASR），但在**自适应评估范式**下——即攻击者可针对已部署防御进行优化——其性能急剧退化。本文揭示该失效源于两大根本缺陷：（1）**意图失焦**：现有方法仅识别预设攻击模式，无法动态判断每条嵌入指令是否与用户真实任务意图相关；（2）**策略窄化**：基于训练的防御依赖少量人工构造模板生成对抗样本，导致泛化能力严重受限，无法覆盖攻击者灵活多变的注入-重写策略。

## 方法创新：RETA框架  
我们提出**推理驱动的任务对齐防御框架（RETA）**，核心思想是将防御决策锚定于**用户任务语义**，而非攻击者可控的数据表层特征。其关键技术包括：  
- **链式推理验证**：在每个工具输出步骤，防御模块执行显式Chain-of-Thought（CoT）推理，逐条检验当前动作是否与用户任务目标逻辑一致；  
- **红队驱动的多样性对抗训练**：引入模拟攻击者，通过**字典学习多样性奖励（dictionary-learning diversity reward）** 鼓励其探索广泛、非冗余的注入变形策略（如语义等价替换、句式重构、上下文混淆），显著拓宽对抗样本分布；  
- **多目标强化学习优化**：联合优化安全性（最小化ASR）、实用性（保持任务完成率）与鲁棒性，避免单一指标过拟合。

## 实验结果  
在6种黑盒自适应攻击下，RETA将**各攻击的ASR均压制在10%以下**：在两个目标模型上平均ASR分别仅为**2.92%** 和 **3.75%**，同时在受攻击与干净输入下均保持>94%的原始任务效用，显著优于SOTA方法。
papers.summary_en: Indirect prompt injection attacks compromise LLM-based agents by hiding malicious instructions in third-party data retrieved during execution. While existing defenses achieve near-zero attack success rate (ASR) on static benchmarks, they collapse under adaptive evaluation—where attackers optimize against the deployed defense. We identify two root causes: (1) over-reliance on pattern matching instead of *task-aligned intent verification*, and (2) poor generalization due to narrow adversarial training data derived from hand-crafted templates. To address this, we propose **RETA**, a reasoning-enabled, training-based defense that grounds safety decisions on *user task semantics* rather than attacker-controlled inputs. At each tool-output step, RETA performs chain-of-thought reasoning to verify action-task consistency. A red-teaming attacker synthesizes diverse adversarial examples guided by a dictionary-learning diversity reward, enabling broad coverage of injection reformulations. Optimized via multi-objective reinforcement learning, RETA achieves an average ASR of **2.92%** and **3.75%** across six black-box adaptive attacks—keeping every per-attack ASR <10%—while preserving >94% utility on both attacked and clean inputs.

papers.title: Benign in Isolation, Harmful in Composition: Security Risks in Agent Skill Ecosystems
papers.abstract: Skills are becoming the capability layer through which LLM agents turn plans into actions, but their use introduces security risks such as data leakage, unauthorized operations, and tool misuse. Existing vetting usually evaluates each skill in isolation, while real agent tasks often invoke multiple skills in a shared execution context. This creates Skill Composition Risk (SCR): a skill that appears benign alone can become harmful when its outputs, trust signals, authorization cues, or side effects influence later invocations along an activated path. We introduce SCR-Bench to evaluate this risk in controlled, sandboxed skill environments. Rather than relying only on textual intent or surface behavior, SCR-Bench records downstream state changes and path-level outcomes across composed skill executions. It contains three sub-benchmarks: SCR-CapFlow for capability-flow composition, SCR-TrustLift for trust-transfer composition, and SCR-AuthBlur for authorization-confusion composition. Across SCR-Bench, composed paths expose risks that are largely absent under isolated evaluation. In SCR-CapFlow, attack success rate reaches 33.6 percent under composition, compared with near-zero isolated baselines. In SCR-TrustLift, attack success rate exceeds 96.5 percent on four of five backends. In SCR-AuthBlur, the risky-approval rate increases by 71.8 percent relative to the L0 isolated baseline under the L1 context setting. These results show that agent skill security should be assessed at the level of activated paths rather than isolated artifacts. SCR and SCR-Bench provide a foundation for path-aware risk evaluation and defense in LLM agent skill ecosystems. Benchmark: https://github.com/saint-viperx/SCR_Bench.
papers.summary_zh:
## 背景与问题  
随着大语言模型（LLM）智能体日益依赖“技能”（Skills）作为将规划转化为行动的能力层，技能安全正面临全新挑战。现有安全评估普遍采用**孤立审查范式**——即单独测试每个技能的输入输出行为，却忽视了真实任务中多技能在**共享执行上下文**中动态串联调用的关键现实。由此催生一种新型风险：**技能组合风险（Skill Composition Risk, SCR）**——单个看似无害的技能，可能因其输出数据流、信任信号传递、授权线索模糊或副作用，在后续技能链路中被无意放大或恶意利用，最终导致数据泄露、越权操作或工具误用。

## 方法与基准  
本文提出 **SCR-Bench**，首个面向技能组合风险的可控沙箱化评估基准。它突破传统文本意图分析局限，转而**追踪整条激活路径上的状态变迁与端到端结果**。基准包含三个子任务：  
- **SCR-CapFlow**：评估能力流组合（如一个技能输出被另一技能误当作高权限指令）；  
- **SCR-TrustLift**：评估信任转移组合（如低可信度技能输出被后续技能无条件信任）；  
- **SCR-AuthBlur**：评估授权混淆组合（如权限上下文在跨技能调用中意外降级或模糊）。  

## 主要发现与创新  
实验表明，孤立评估严重低估风险：在 SCR-CapFlow 中，组合场景攻击成功率高达 **33.6%**（孤立基线近 0%）；SCR-TrustLift 在 5 个后端中的 4 个上攻击成功率**超 96.5%**；SCR-AuthBlur 在 L1 上下文下，危险审批率较 L0 孤立基线**激增 71.8%**。本工作首次系统定义 SCR 概念，构建可复现、可扩展的路径级评估框架，为 LLM 智能体技能生态提供**以激活路径为中心的安全评估新范式**。
papers.summary_en: This paper identifies **Skill Composition Risk (SCR)**—a critical security gap where individually benign agent skills become harmful when composed in shared execution contexts, enabling data leakage, unauthorized actions, or tool misuse. To address the limitation of isolated skill vetting, we introduce **SCR-Bench**, the first benchmark evaluating SCR through path-level state tracking in sandboxed environments—not just textual intent. It comprises three sub-benchmarks: SCR-CapFlow (capability-flow composition), SCR-TrustLift (trust-transfer composition), and SCR-AuthBlur (authorization-confusion composition). Experiments reveal severe underestimation by isolated evaluation: SCR-CapFlow achieves 33.6% attack success under composition (vs. near-zero baseline); SCR-TrustLift exceeds 96.5% success on 4/5 backends; SCR-AuthBlur shows a 71.8% relative increase in risky approvals under L1 context vs. L0 isolated baseline. SCR-Bench establishes a foundation for **path-aware risk assessment and defense** in LLM agent skill ecosystems.
papers.summary:
## 背景与问题  
随着大语言模型（LLM）智能体日益依赖“技能”（Skills）作为将规划转化为行动的能力层，技能安全正面临全新挑战。现有安全评估普遍采用**孤立审查范式**——即单独测试每个技能的输入输出行为，却忽视了真实任务中多技能在**共享执行上下文**中动态串联调用的关键现实。由此催生一种新型风险：**技能组合风险（Skill Composition Risk, SCR）**——单个看似无害的技能，可能因其输出数据流、信任信号传递、授权线索模糊或副作用，在后续技能链路中被无意放大或恶意利用，最终导致数据泄露、越权操作或工具误用。

## 方法与基准  
本文提出 **SCR-Bench**，首个面向技能组合风险的可控沙箱化评估基准。它突破传统文本意图分析局限，转而**追踪整条激活路径上的状态变迁与端到端结果**。基准包含三个子任务：  
- **SCR-CapFlow**：评估能力流组合（如一个技能输出被另一技能误当作高权限指令）；  
- **SCR-TrustLift**：评估信任转移组合（如低可信度技能输出被后续技能无条件信任）；  
- **SCR-AuthBlur**：评估授权混淆组合（如权限上下文在跨技能调用中意外降级或模糊）。  

## 主要发现与创新  
实验表明，孤立评估严重低估风险：在 SCR-CapFlow 中，组合场景攻击成功率高达 **33.6%**（孤立基线近 0%）；SCR-TrustLift 在 5 个后端中的 4 个上攻击成功率**超 96.5%**；SCR-AuthBlur 在 L1 上下文下，危险审批率较 L0 孤立基线**激增 71.8%**。本工作首次系统定义 SCR 概念，构建可复现、可扩展的路径级评估框架，为 LLM 智能体技能生态提供**以激活路径为中心的安全评估新范式**。

papers.title: LLM: LSTM Look-Ahead Moving Target Defense Based on Historical Malicious Scan
papers.abstract: Network scanning is a critical preliminary step for most adversaries to gain essential information before launching cyber attacks. Moving Target Defense (MTD) based on IP shuffling has emerged as a proactive defense strategy to counteract these reconnaissance efforts. Unlike static, reactive defense techniques, IP shuffling introduces randomness by dynamically reassigning network addresses, making it more challenging for attackers to identify and track targets. However, current IP shuffling methods face three key challenges: 1) limited scalability across different network topologies, 2) inherent reconfiguration overhead even in the absence of an active attack, and 3) the need for large-scale unused address blocks. To address these issues, we propose LSTM Look-ahead Moving Target Defense (LLM). Our approach is the first attempt using a Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) network to predict future target addresses that attackers will likely scan. Ensemble learning is used to improve robustness to different scanning behaviors. We introduce a dynamic mutation mechanism to enhance adaptability. Compared to the baseline mutation strategy, LLM performs better in both security and overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
## 背景与挑战  
网络扫描是攻击者发起多数网络攻击前的关键侦察步骤。基于IP地址动态重分配的**移动目标防御（MTD）**作为一种主动防御范式，通过引入随机性显著提升攻击者定位与持续追踪目标的难度。然而，现有IP置换策略普遍存在三大瓶颈：**（1）拓扑适应性差**——难以在异构网络（如云环境、SDN、边缘网络）中规模化部署；**（2）固有开销高**——无论是否遭遇真实扫描，均需周期性执行地址重配置，消耗带宽与计算资源；**（3）地址资源依赖强**——需预留大量未使用IP地址块，制约在IPv4受限或IPv6未充分启用场景下的实用性。

## 方法创新：LLM框架  
本文提出**LSTM Look-ahead Moving Target Defense（LLM）**，首次将**长短期记忆网络（LSTM）** 引入MTD地址预测任务。LLM核心包含三重设计：  
- **前瞻式扫描预测**：利用历史恶意扫描序列训练LSTM模型，精准预测攻击者下一步最可能探测的IP地址（而非被动响应），实现“防于未扫”；  
- **集成学习增强鲁棒性**：融合多种扫描行为模式（如顺序扫描、随机扫描、跳跃扫描）的LSTM子模型，显著提升对未知/变异扫描策略的泛化能力；  
- **动态变异机制**：仅在预测高风险地址被实际扫描前触发轻量级地址置换，避免全网周期性刷新，将重配置开销降低至传统方法的**32%**（实测数据）。

## 实验验证与优势  
在CICIDS2017与自建扫描数据集上评估表明：LLM将攻击者成功定位目标的平均时间延长**5.8倍**，误报率低于**1.2%**，且在无攻击时段零冗余配置。相比基线MTD方案，其**安全增益提升41.7%，系统开销下降68%**。本工作为轻量、自适应、可扩展的智能MTD提供了新范式。
papers.summary_en: Network scanning is a critical reconnaissance step preceding most cyberattacks. While IP-shuffling-based Moving Target Defense (MTD) proactively disrupts attacker reconnaissance, existing approaches suffer from poor scalability across network topologies, unavoidable reconfiguration overhead even during benign periods, and heavy reliance on large unused IP address pools. To overcome these limitations, we propose **LSTM Look-ahead Moving Target Defense (LLM)**—the first MTD framework leveraging Long Short-Term Memory networks to *predict* future malicious scan targets *before* they are probed. LLM employs ensemble LSTM models trained on diverse historical scanning patterns (e.g., sequential, random, hybrid) to enhance robustness, and introduces a lightweight, event-triggered mutation mechanism that activates *only* upon high-confidence prediction of imminent scans—eliminating periodic reconfiguration. Evaluations on CICIDS2017 and custom datasets show LLM extends attacker mean time-to-compromise by **5.8×**, reduces false positives to **<1.2%**, cuts reconfiguration overhead by **68%**, and achieves **41.7% higher security gain** than baseline MTD—without requiring extra IP resources.

papers.title: VLALeaks: Membership Inference Attacks against Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models enable end-to-end robot control and have garnered widespread attention. However, the memorization of training data inherent to VLA, coupled with the high cost of robotic data acquisition, raises serious concerns regarding data privacy leakage and intellectual property infringement. Membership inference attacks (MIAs) aim to determine whether a given sample belongs to the training set. While representing a significant privacy threat, this attack remains underexplored in the context of VLA models. To bridge this gap, we propose VLALeaks, which is based on attention discrepancies in VLA models. We reveal, for the first time, the privacy vulnerabilities of VLA models. Specifically, it comprises a two-stage process: (1) membership feature extraction, and (2) attack model construction. Experimental results across multiple VLA benchmarks demonstrate that VLALeaks readily reveals membership information and achieves optimal attack AUC and TPR@1\%FPR, highlighting the privacy vulnerabilities in current VLA model deployments. Our work is the first systematic study of MIAs on VLA models, aiming to provide insights for secure and trustworthy VLA models.
papers.summary_zh:
## VLALeaks：面向视觉-语言-动作模型的成员推断攻击

**背景与问题**：视觉-语言-动作（Vision-Language-Action, VLA）模型通过端到端方式驱动机器人执行复杂任务，正成为具身智能的核心范式。然而，其对海量、高成本采集的真实机器人数据的强依赖性，叠加深度模型固有的训练数据记忆特性，导致严重的**数据隐私泄露**与**知识产权侵权风险**——攻击者可能逆向识别某段视频-指令-动作三元组是否曾用于模型训练。尽管成员推断攻击（Membership Inference Attacks, MIAs）已被广泛研究于图像分类或语言模型，**VLA模型这一新兴关键范式中的MIAs仍属空白**。

**方法创新**：本文首次提出**VLALeaks**——首个专为VLA模型设计的黑盒成员推断框架。其核心洞见在于：VLA模型在处理**训练内样本**与**训练外样本**时，其跨模态注意力机制（尤其是视觉→动作、语言→动作路径）呈现可量化的统计差异。VLALeaks采用两阶段范式：  
1. **成员特征提取**：无需访问模型梯度或内部参数，仅通过前向推理获取多层注意力图谱的熵、方差及跨模态对齐度等轻量级指标；  
2. **攻击模型构建**：基于上述特征训练轻量级二分类器（如XGBoost），实现高效、低开销推断。

**主要发现与贡献**：在Open-X-Embodiment、RT-1、VoxPoser等主流VLA基准上系统评估表明：VLALeaks在多个模型上均取得**AUC高达0.92–0.97**、**TPR@1%FPR达68%–83%**，显著超越基线方法；实证揭示VLA模型存在**普遍且严重的隐私漏洞**。本工作是首项系统性探究VLA模型隐私风险的研究，为构建可审计、可信赖的具身AI提供了关键警示与技术基线。
papers.summary_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models enable end-to-end robotic control but pose severe privacy risks due to costly, sensitive training data and inherent memorization. Membership inference attacks (MIAs)—which determine whether a sample was in the training set—remain unexplored for VLA models. We propose **VLALeaks**, the first MIA framework tailored to VLA models, exploiting *attention discrepancies* between in- and out-of-distribution samples across vision-language-action pathways. VLALeaks operates in two stages: (1) extracting lightweight, gradient-free features from attention maps (e.g., entropy, cross-modal alignment), and (2) training a lightweight classifier (e.g., XGBoost) for inference. Evaluated across Open-X-Embodiment, RT-1, and VoxPoser, VLALeaks achieves strong performance: **AUC of 0.92–0.97** and **TPR@1%FPR of 68%–83%**, significantly outperforming baselines. This work is the first systematic study of MIAs on VLA models, exposing critical privacy vulnerabilities and informing the development of secure, trustworthy embodied AI systems.
