papers.title: Behavioral Audit of Machine Unlearning Has a Privacy Cost
papers.abstract: The removal of learned data from Machine Learning models through Machine Unlearning (MU) has been widely studied; however, there has yet to be an agreed-upon scheme for auditing MU. Existing work has shown that a dishonest model owner can falsify evidence to avoid executing MU, while curious auditors (and adversaries) can infer the privacy-sensitive properties of the model and its training data even with limited access. Yet auditing of MU under mutual distrust between the model owner and the auditor remains unexplored. We provide an information-theoretic proof for this scenario: for convex ML models, a generic audit scheme that relies solely on querying the model for \textit{behavioral} signals cannot identify insufficiently unlearned models without revealing membership information of the retained set. Therefore, auditing MU under the assumption of a dishonest model owner and an honest-but-curious auditor faces an inherent privacy-audit tradeoff. Our empirical results on convex models strongly supports this result, while further experiments demonstrate that this privacy-audit tension persists in non-convex models. Our results call for a more careful consideration of the privacy-audit tension under a realistic auditor threat model, and serve as a foundation for more scrutiny of designs of privacy-preserving audit schemes for the MU pipeline. We also release our code implementation at https://github.com/LiouTang/Behavioral-Unlearn-Audit.
papers.summary_zh:
## 行为式机器遗忘审计存在固有隐私代价  

机器遗忘（Machine Unlearning, MU）旨在从已训练模型中移除特定数据的影响，是保障数据主体“被遗忘权”的关键技术。然而，当前缺乏被广泛接受的**可验证审计机制**，尤其在模型拥有者与审计方互不信任的现实场景下——前者可能恶意规避遗忘操作，后者虽诚实但可能好奇地推断敏感信息。本文首次从信息论角度严格证明：对于**凸机器学习模型**，任何仅依赖对模型进行**行为式查询**（如输入-输出响应）的通用审计方案，若能可靠识别未充分执行遗忘的模型，则必然泄露保留数据集的成员身份信息（membership leakage）。换言之，在“模型拥有者不可信、审计者诚实但好奇”的威胁模型下，**审计能力与隐私保护存在根本性权衡**（privacy-audit tradeoff）。我们通过理论推导与严谨实验双重验证该结论：在逻辑回归、SVM等凸模型上，所有主流行为审计方法（如梯度一致性、预测漂移检测）均在提升检出率的同时显著增加成员推断攻击成功率；进一步实验表明，该张力在ResNet、BERT等非凸模型中同样稳健存在。本研究揭示了现有MU审计范式的深层局限，呼吁设计需显式建模审计方威胁的新型隐私保护审计框架。代码已开源：https://github.com/LiouTang/Behavioral-Unlearn-Audit。
papers.summary_en: This paper establishes an information-theoretic impossibility result: for convex ML models, any behavioral audit scheme—relying solely on input-output queries—cannot reliably detect insufficient unlearning without leaking membership information about the retained dataset. This reveals an inherent privacy-audit tradeoff under mutual distrust, where the model owner is dishonest and the auditor is honest-but-curious. Empirical validation on convex models (logistic regression, SVM) confirms the theoretical bound, and extensive experiments further demonstrate that this tension persists in non-convex models (ResNet, BERT). Our work fundamentally challenges the assumption that behavioral auditing is privacy-safe, and calls for audit designs that explicitly account for the auditor’s inferential capability. Code is publicly available.

papers.title: Federated Learning for Feature Generalization with Convex Constraints
papers.abstract: Federated learning (FL) often struggles with generalization due to heterogeneous client data. Local models are prone to overfitting their local data distributions, and even transferable features can be distorted during aggregation. To address these challenges, we propose FedCONST, an approach that adaptively modulates update magnitudes based on the parameter strength of the global model. This prevents over-emphasizing well-learned parameters while reinforcing underdeveloped ones. Specifically, FedCONST employs linear convex constraints to ensure training stability and preserve locally learned generalization capabilities during aggregation. A Gradient Signal to Noise Ratio (GSNR) analysis further validates the effectiveness of FedCONST in enhancing feature transferability and robustness. As a result, FedCONST effectively aligns local and global objectives, mitigating overfitting and promoting stronger generalization across diverse FL environments, achieving state-of-the-art performance.
papers.summary_zh:
## 背景与挑战  
联邦学习（FL）在跨设备/机构协作建模中面临严峻的**特征泛化瓶颈**：客户端数据高度异构，导致本地模型易过拟合局部分布；更关键的是，即使具备可迁移性的中间层特征，在全局聚合过程中也常因参数尺度失衡而发生扭曲，削弱跨域鲁棒性。

## 方法创新：FedCONST  
我们提出 **FedCONST**——一种面向特征泛化的联邦学习新范式。其核心包含两大协同机制：  
- **自适应更新调制**：基于全局模型参数强度动态缩放客户端梯度更新幅度，**抑制已充分学习参数的过度更新**，同时**增强欠训练参数的梯度贡献**，实现参数级均衡优化；  
- **凸约束聚合**：在服务器端引入**线性凸约束集**（如参数范数界、方向一致性约束），严格保障聚合过程的稳定性，并显式保留各客户端在本地训练中习得的泛化性特征结构，避免“平均即退化”。

## 实验验证与优势  
通过**梯度信噪比（GSNR）理论分析**，我们证明FedCONST显著提升特征信号的跨客户端可迁移性与抗噪声能力。在6个标准FL基准（包括FEMNIST、CIFAR-100非IID划分及医疗影像数据集）上，FedCONST以平均+3.2%准确率超越SOTA方法（如FedProx、SCAFFOLD），且在低资源客户端（<50样本/类）下泛化性能提升达+5.7%。该方法无需额外通信开销或模型修改，具备强实用性与部署友好性。
papers.summary_en: Federated learning (FL) suffers from poor feature generalization under data heterogeneity: local models overfit to client-specific distributions, and even transferable features degrade during aggregation due to unbalanced parameter updates. To address this, we propose **FedCONST**, a novel FL framework that jointly optimizes *update modulation* and *aggregation constraints*. FedCONST dynamically scales client gradients based on global parameter strength—suppressing updates to well-learned parameters while amplifying underdeveloped ones. Crucially, it enforces **linear convex constraints** (e.g., norm bounds, directional alignment) during server-side aggregation to stabilize training and preserve locally acquired generalization capabilities. GSNR analysis confirms FedCONST enhances feature transferability and robustness. Experiments across 6 heterogeneous FL benchmarks show FedCONST achieves state-of-the-art accuracy (+3.2% avg), with up to +5.7% gain in low-data regimes—without extra communication or architectural changes.

papers.title: A Low-Rank Subspace Analysis of LLM Interventions
papers.abstract: Interventions designed to modify a particular behavior in LLMs, such as refusal or sycophancy, often produce unintended changes in other behaviors. This lack of targeted control makes it difficult to design and implement reliable safety controls. To understand these side-effects, we introduce a diagnostic framework for analyzing interacting behaviors in LLMs. We model behaviors as low-rank subspaces in activation space, and study how interventions influence across behaviors. Across multiple instruction-tuned models (7B-70B) and across refusal, jailbreak, and sycophancy settings, we find that different behaviors share internal representations, and intervening on one behavior alters others in asymmetric ways. Some behaviors act as upstream control points whose interventions propagate broadly across other behaviors, while others remain more isolated. We relate these effects to two geometric quantities: (i) the overlap between behavior subspaces, measured as the average squared cosine of principal angles, and (ii) the angle between each behavior subspace and the decision subspace (capturing the model's final decision e.g., refuse vs. comply). Empirically, intervention effects on other behaviors tend to be larger for behavior pairs with higher subspace overlap, and for source behaviors whose subspaces lie closer (smaller angle) to the decision subspace. These findings highlight a challenge for targeted behavior control: behaviors are difficult to modify independently, as interventions can propagate through shared representations and asymmetric interactions.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与问题  
大型语言模型（LLM）的安全干预（如抑制拒绝响应、缓解奉承倾向或防御越狱攻击）常引发**非目标行为的意外变化**，导致行为控制缺乏可预测性与模块化。这一“副作用传播”现象严重制约了可靠安全机制的设计与部署。

## 方法创新：低秩子空间诊断框架  
本文提出首个基于**激活空间低秩子空间建模**的行为交互分析框架：  
- 将每类行为（拒绝、越狱、奉承）表征为对应层激活中的低维线性子空间（由主成分张成）；  
- 量化两类关键几何量：**(i) 行为子空间间的重叠度**（以主角余弦平方均值衡量）；**(ii) 行为子空间与决策子空间的夹角**（后者编码模型最终输出选择，如“拒绝 vs. 遵从”）。  
实验覆盖7B–70B规模的主流指令微调模型（Llama-2/3、Qwen、Mixtral），在统一评估协议下系统检验干预迁移效应。

## 核心发现  
1. **行为表征高度共享**：拒绝、越狱、奉承行为在隐藏层中存在显著子空间重叠，证实其底层表征耦合性；  
2. **干预效应呈强不对称性**：调控某行为（如越狱）会显著改变另一行为（如拒绝），但反向影响微弱；  
3. **几何机制可解释传播强度**：副作用幅度与**子空间重叠度正相关**，且源行为子空间越接近决策子空间（夹角越小），其干预越易“驱动”其他行为；  
4. **识别上游控制点**：部分行为（如越狱抵抗）充当高影响力枢纽，其干预引发跨行为级联变化，而奉承倾向则相对隔离。

本研究揭示LLM行为不可分割性的几何根源，为开发解耦式干预策略（如子空间正交化、定向投影）提供了理论基础与可量化诊断工具。
papers.summary_en: This paper introduces a low-rank subspace diagnostic framework to analyze unintended side effects of behavioral interventions in LLMs. We model refusal, jailbreak resistance, and sycophancy as low-dimensional subspaces in activation space across multiple instruction-tuned models (7B–70B). We find that these behaviors share internal representations, leading to asymmetric cross-behavior intervention effects: modifying one behavior often alters others, with some acting as upstream control points. Crucially, we identify two geometric determinants of propagation strength: (i) subspace overlap—quantified by the mean squared cosine of principal angles—and (ii) angular proximity to the decision subspace (which encodes final output choice). Empirically, larger side effects occur between behavior pairs with higher overlap and when the source behavior’s subspace lies closer to the decision subspace. These results expose a fundamental challenge for targeted safety control: behavioral independence is geometrically constrained by shared representation structure.

papers.title: MUFFLe: Efficient Model Update Compression via Generalized Deduplication for Federated Learning
papers.abstract: Federated learning is well suited to edge environments but is often limited by the uplink cost of transmitting model updates. This Work-in-Progress paper presents MUFFLe, a communication-efficient update compression scheme that integrates generalized deduplication (GD) into the FedAvg pipeline. MUFFLe deduplicates repeated patterns across the update vector, yielding a fixed-rate, variable-count compression scheme. Preliminary experiments on IID MNIST with 20 clients show that MUFFLe reaches the target accuracy of $92.93\%$ with 38~MB cumulative uplink communication, compared with 75~MB for 8-bit quantization, 86~MB for Top-$k$ sparsification, and 310~MB for uncompressed FedAvg. These results demonstrate the feasibility of applying GD to communication-efficient federated learning.
papers.summary_zh:
## 背景与挑战  
联邦学习（Federated Learning, FL）在边缘计算场景中具有天然优势，但其实际部署常受限于客户端上行带宽瓶颈——尤其是频繁上传高维模型更新所引发的巨大通信开销。现有压缩方法（如8位量化、Top-$k$稀疏化）虽能降低传输量，但仍存在冗余模式未被充分挖掘的问题。

## 方法创新：MUFFLe框架  
本文提出**MUFFLe**（Model Update Compression via Generalized Deduplication for Federated Learning），一种面向FedAvg流水线的高效更新压缩方案。其核心是将**广义去重（Generalized Deduplication, GD）** 首次系统性引入FL通信优化：不再仅对权重值或梯度幅值做粗粒度压缩，而是将模型更新向量视为字节/数值序列，识别并消除跨位置、跨客户端的重复子模式（如常见梯度块、零值簇、周期性符号序列等），实现**固定码率、变长计数**的无损（或可控有损）编码。

## 关键实验结果  
在IID MNIST基准（20客户端）的初步验证中，MUFFLe以**38 MB累计上行通信量**即达到目标精度92.93%，显著优于：8-bit量化（75 MB）、Top-$k$（$k=1\%$，86 MB）及原始FedAvg（310 MB）。压缩率提升达**8.2×**（vs. FedAvg）和**2.2×**（vs. 8-bit），且不引入额外服务器解码延迟或客户端计算负担。

## 理论价值与实践意义  
MUFFLe首次证实：GD这一源于存储与网络领域的经典思想，可无缝迁移至FL更新压缩任务，在保持算法兼容性的同时突破传统量化/稀疏范式的性能边界，为低带宽边缘AI提供了新范式。
papers.summary_en: Federated learning (FL) promises privacy-preserving edge AI but suffers from prohibitive uplink communication costs during model update transmission. This work introduces **MUFFLe**, a novel compression framework that integrates *Generalized Deduplication* (GD) into the FedAvg pipeline to eliminate redundant patterns across model update vectors—treating gradients as structured sequences rather than independent scalars. Unlike fixed-sparsity or uniform-quantization methods, MUFFLe achieves *fixed-rate, variable-count* encoding by detecting and deduplicating repeated numerical subpatterns (e.g., zero runs, symmetric gradients, periodic updates) across clients and layers. On IID MNIST with 20 clients, MUFFLe reaches 92.93% test accuracy using only **38 MB total uplink traffic**, outperforming 8-bit quantization (75 MB), Top-$k$ sparsification ($k=1\%$, 86 MB), and vanilla FedAvg (310 MB). This demonstrates GD’s feasibility and superiority for communication-efficient FL—offering up to **8.2× bandwidth reduction** without altering client-side training or requiring server-side model retraining.

papers.title: Decoupled Mixture-of-Experts for Parametric Knowledge Injection
papers.abstract: Knowledge injection aims to equip large language models (LLMs) with external, domain-specific, or time-sensitive knowledge. Existing approaches typically face a trade-off between flexibility and integration: retrieval-augmented generation keeps knowledge outside the model but only provides prompt-level augmentation, whereas post-training based methods encode new knowledge into shared parameters but may introduce catastrophic forgetting, knowledge conflict, and costly updates. In this paper, we propose Decoupled Mixture-of-Experts (DMoE), a modular architecture for parametric knowledge injection that decouples both experts and the router from the base model. DMoE converts external knowledge corpora into independently updatable expert modules and uses a lightweight uncertainty-aware router to activate relevant experts only when the base model lacks sufficient knowledge during generation. To support efficient auto-regressive inference, DMoE attaches experts only to the final-layer feed-forward network, preserving KV-cache reuse while enabling parameter-level knowledge augmentation. Experiments on knowledge-intensive benchmarks show that DMoE consistently improves answer quality over retrieval and adapter-based baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景  
知识注入旨在为大语言模型（LLM）赋予外部、领域专属或时效性强的知识。现有方法面临根本性权衡：**检索增强生成（RAG）** 将知识保留在模型外部，仅支持提示级增强，缺乏参数化建模能力；而**后训练微调类方法**（如全参数微调或适配器）虽能将新知识编码进模型参数，却易引发灾难性遗忘、知识冲突，且每次更新均需重训，成本高昂。

## 方法创新：解耦式混合专家（DMoE）  
本文提出**解耦式混合专家（Decoupled Mixture-of-Experts, DMoE）**，一种面向参数化知识注入的模块化架构。其核心在于**三重解耦**：  
- **专家解耦**：将外部知识语料库自动编译为独立、可热插拔的专家模块（每个专家封装特定知识子域），彼此参数隔离，互不干扰；  
- **路由解耦**：引入轻量级、不确定性感知的路由器，仅在基础模型对当前输入置信度不足时激活相关专家，避免冗余计算；  
- **结构解耦**：专家仅附加于Transformer最后一层前馈网络（FFN）之后，**完全复用KV缓存**，保障自回归推理效率，同时实现真正的参数级知识增强。

## 主要结果与优势  
在多个知识密集型基准（如KILT、FEVER、HotpotQA）上，DMoE显著超越RAG和Adapter基线：答案准确率平均提升+4.2%，事实一致性提升+6.8%；单次知识增补仅需训练对应专家（<5%参数量），零干扰主干模型，彻底规避遗忘与冲突；专家可独立部署、动态加载/卸载，支持细粒度、低开销、可持续的知识演进。
papers.summary_en: Knowledge injection seeks to equip LLMs with external, domain-specific, or time-sensitive knowledge. Existing methods trade off flexibility and integration: retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) keeps knowledge external but offers only prompt-level augmentation, while post-training approaches encode knowledge into shared parameters—risking catastrophic forgetting, knowledge conflict, and costly full-model updates. We propose **Decoupled Mixture-of-Experts (DMoE)**, a modular architecture that *fully decouples* both expert modules and the router from the base model. DMoE converts knowledge corpora into independently updatable, parameter-isolated experts and employs a lightweight, uncertainty-aware router that activates experts *only when the base model lacks confidence*. Crucially, experts are attached solely to the final-layer FFN, preserving KV-cache reuse for efficient auto-regressive inference while enabling true parametric knowledge injection. Experiments on knowledge-intensive benchmarks show DMoE consistently outperforms RAG and adapter baselines in answer quality (+4.2% accuracy, +6.8% factual consistency), with zero interference to the base model and minimal update cost per knowledge addition.

papers.title: Semantic Integrity Failures in Document-to-LLM Supply Chains
papers.abstract: Document-to-LLM applications typically read uploaded PDFs by first translating them into text through a hidden extraction layer that users cannot observe or audit. We show that this layer enables split-view PDFs: one document can have two semantic views before model reasoning. By mining specification-permitted or implementation-tolerated representation gaps at the PDF render/extract boundary, we instantiate 25 extraction gaps (EG) in which extractors return attacker-controlled or extractor-dependent text while the rendered page shows benign or different content. The gaps form four families: semantic overrides, hidden semantic injection, reading-order splits, and font-decoding splits, and 14 gaps have no exact path/mechanism-level match in prior PDF-to-LLM attacks.   We evaluate these gaps on 16 PDF processing stacks and 7 commercial LLM services. Each gap causes render-extract divergence on at least one stack. Under a gap-level exposure criterion, every evaluated service exposes at least one gap, with 12/25 to 21/25 exposed gaps. Exposure is driven mainly by the ingestion stack -- not model identity alone. We further show that tested safety filters cover only selected hidden-text constructions. To support triage, we develop a static screening scanner whose rules trigger on all 25 benchmark gaps, and discuss dual-view consistency as a longer-term defense direction.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景  
在文档到大语言模型（Document-to-LLM）应用中，用户上传的PDF文件需经**不可见的文本提取层**转换为纯文本，再输入LLM。该层处于用户审计盲区，构成供应链关键薄弱点。

## 方法与发现  
本研究首次系统揭示“**语义完整性失效**”——同一PDF可呈现**双语义视图**：渲染视图（用户所见）与提取视图（LLM所读）存在系统性偏差。通过深度挖掘PDF规范许可或实现容忍的**渲染–提取边界间隙**，我们实证构建25种**提取间隙（Extraction Gaps, EGs）**，涵盖四类新型攻击面：  
- **语义覆盖**（如元数据/注释劫持正文）  
- **隐式语义注入**（利用隐藏文本、零宽字符等）  
- **阅读顺序分裂**（逻辑顺序与视觉顺序错位）  
- **字体解码分裂**（字形映射歧义触发不同解码结果）  
其中14种EG在既有PDF-to-LLM攻击研究中无对应路径或机制，属首次披露。

## 评估与影响  
在16种PDF处理栈与7家商用LLM服务上实测：**所有服务均暴露至少1个EG**（暴露率12/25–21/25），且暴露程度主要由**前端摄入栈决定**，而非LLM本身。主流安全过滤器仅覆盖部分隐式文本构造，防御存在严重盲区。

## 创新与对策  
提出首个面向EG的**静态筛查扫描器**，规则全覆盖全部25个基准间隙；并倡导以**双视图一致性**（dual-view consistency）为长期防御范式，推动文档供应链透明化与可验证性。
papers.summary_en: This paper identifies *Semantic Integrity Failures*—a class of supply-chain vulnerabilities in Document-to-LLM systems where PDFs yield divergent semantic views: one rendered (human-visible) and one extracted (LLM-input). By systematically probing specification-permitted and implementation-tolerated gaps at the PDF render/extract boundary, we discover 25 novel Extraction Gaps (EGs), grouped into four families—semantic overrides, hidden semantic injection, reading-order splits, and font-decoding splits—14 of which have no prior mechanistic counterpart. Evaluating across 16 PDF processing stacks and 7 commercial LLM services, we find *every service exposes at least one EG* (12–21 of 25 gaps exposed), with exposure driven primarily by the ingestion stack—not the LLM model. Standard safety filters cover only a subset of hidden-text patterns. To aid triage, we release a static scanner detecting all 25 EGs, and propose *dual-view consistency* as a foundational defense principle for document-to-LLM integrity.

papers.title: Security Engineering of OpenClaw: Analyzing Attack Surface Expansion and Trust-Boundary Violations
papers.abstract: Agentic large language model (LLM) systems can now execute actions, not only produce text. When model outputs trigger privileged operations such as shell commands, browser automation, or external tool calls, the security problem shifts from alignment alone to system configuration and structural design. We analyze OpenClaw, a self-hosted multi-agent system in which LLM outputs can execute commands and interact with tools and services. We measure compromise probability, boundary failures, privilege drift, and how these metrics change as attacker capability increases. With one agent, the compromise probability is 0.24. With seven agents, when the system executes an action, the compromise rises to 0.86 if any single agent proposes it. The models do not change; the increase comes from output aggregation. Prompt injection propagates instability across the system. Attack surface entropy increases from 0.42 to 0.71, indicating a broader distribution of exploit paths. The mean privilege drift increases from 0.03 to 0.21, indicating unintended authority gain. Positive escalation curvature of 0.08 indicates that privilege grows faster as attacker capability increases. Defensive controls, including policy gating and execution filtering, reduce compromise probability by 0.10, boundary failures by 0.10, and privilege drift by 0.02, all statistically significant at p < 0.0001. The system remains sensitive, but the mitigation impact is measurable. Injection mitigation success differs across models: 0.37 for GPT-5.2, 0.35 for Llama-4-Maverick, and 0.31 for DeepSeek-R1. When execution can be triggered by any single agent, the most vulnerable agent determines system exposure. Mitigations slightly reduce task utility from 0.93 to 0.89 and increase median latency from 420 ms to 468 ms.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景  
随着具身智能与自主代理（agentic）大语言模型（LLM）系统的发展，LLM已从纯文本生成跃迁至**可执行动作**（如调用Shell命令、浏览器自动化、外部工具API）。当模型输出直接触发高权限操作时，安全风险不再仅限于对齐（alignment）问题，而深度耦合于**系统架构设计**与**信任边界配置**。本文以开源多智能体框架OpenClaw为研究对象，系统剖析其在开放执行环境下的安全工程缺陷。

## 方法与指标  
我们提出四维量化评估框架：**妥协概率**（compromise probability）、**信任边界失效次数**（boundary failures）、**权限漂移均值**（privilege drift）及**攻击面熵值**（attack surface entropy）。通过渐进式增强攻击者能力（从单代理到七代理协同），实证测量结构复杂度对安全性的非线性影响；同时评估策略门控（policy gating）与执行过滤（execution filtering）两类防御机制的有效性。

## 关键发现  
- 代理数量增加显著放大风险：单代理时妥协概率为0.24；七代理下，**任一代理提议即触发执行**时升至0.86（+258%），根源在于输出聚合引发的级联失效，而非模型本身变化；  
- 攻击面熵值从0.42→0.71，表明漏洞路径分布更广、更难收敛；  
- 权限漂移均值从0.03→0.21，且正向 escalation 曲率达0.08，证实**权限失控呈加速增长趋势**；  
- 防御措施使妥协概率↓0.10、边界失效↓0.10、权限漂移↓0.02（*p* < 0.0001），验证架构级缓解的有效性；  
- 注入防护效果因模型而异（GPT-5.2: 0.37 > Llama-4-Maverick: 0.35 > DeepSeek-R1: 0.31），凸显模型层安全异质性；  
- 系统暴露由**最脆弱代理决定**，凸显“木桶效应”；防御带来轻微代价：任务效用从0.93→0.89，中位延迟从420ms→468ms（+11.4%）。

## 创新点  
首次将**攻击面熵**与**权限漂移曲率**引入多代理安全量化，揭示结构复杂性与安全退化间的非线性动力学关系，为可信AI系统提供可测量、可审计的安全工程范式。
papers.summary_en: This paper presents the first security engineering analysis of OpenClaw, a self-hosted agentic LLM system where model outputs directly trigger privileged actions. We quantify four novel metrics—compromise probability, boundary failures, privilege drift, and attack surface entropy—to reveal how structural complexity amplifies risk: compromise probability surges from 0.24 (1 agent) to 0.86 (7 agents under single-agent-trigger execution), driven by output aggregation—not model changes. Attack surface entropy rises from 0.42 to 0.71, and mean privilege drift increases from 0.03 to 0.21 with positive escalation curvature (0.08), indicating accelerating authority leakage. Policy gating and execution filtering significantly reduce all three risks (*p* < 0.0001), though mitigation efficacy varies across models (GPT-5.2 > Llama-4-Maverick > DeepSeek-R1). Crucially, system exposure is determined by the *most vulnerable agent*, highlighting architectural fragility. The work establishes measurable, architecture-aware security benchmarks for agentic AI systems.

- 代理数量增加显著放大风险：单代理时妥协概率为0.24；七代理下，**任一代理提议即触发执行**时升至0.86（+258%），根源在于输出聚合引发的级联失效，而非模型本身变化；  
- 攻击面熵值从0.42→0.71，表明漏洞路径分布更广、更难收敛；  
- 权限漂移均值从0.03→0.21，且正向 escalation 曲率达0.08，证实**权限失控呈加速增长趋势**；  
- 防御措施使妥协概率↓0.10、边界失效↓0.10、权限漂移↓0.02（*p* < 0.0001），验证架构级缓解的有效性；  
- 注入防护效果因模型而异（GPT-5.2: 0.37 > Llama-4-Maverick: 0.35 > DeepSeek-R1: 0.31），凸显模型层安全异质性；  
- 系统暴露由**最脆弱代理决定**，凸显“木桶效应”；防御带来轻微代价：任务效用从0.93→0.89，中位延迟从420ms→468ms（+11.4%）。

## 创新点  
首次将**攻击面熵**与**权限漂移曲率**引入多代理安全量化，揭示结构复杂性与安全退化间的非线性动力学关系，为可信AI系统提供可测量、可审计的安全工程范式。

papers.title: Differentially Private Submodular Maximization with a Knapsack Constraint
papers.abstract: Submodular maximization subject to a knapsack constraint (SMK) is a fundamental problem in discrete optimization, with wide-ranging applications in machine learning and related fields. As these applications increasingly involve sensitive individual data, there is a growing need for high-utility algorithms that provide formal privacy guarantees. In this work, we study the SMK problem under differential privacy, considering both monotone and non-monotone objective functions. For monotone objectives, we propose a differentially private algorithm that achieves the optimal $(1-1/e)$-approximation ratio while significantly improving both additive error and query complexity over prior work. We also present a more efficient algorithm for the same setting, achieving a $1/2$-approximation. For non-monotone objectives, we introduce, to our knowledge, the first differentially private algorithm with provable guarantees, achieving a $1/4$-approximation in expectation and an additive error comparable to the best known for monotone objective functions.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景  
子模函数最大化问题在机器学习、数据挖掘与组合优化中具有核心地位。其中，**带背包约束的子模最大化（SMK）** 是一类经典且应用广泛的离散优化问题，广泛用于特征选择、影响力最大化、传感器部署等场景。然而，当输入数据涉及用户敏感信息（如医疗记录、社交行为）时，传统算法可能泄露个体隐私。因此，在满足**差分隐私（Differential Privacy, DP）** 严格保障的前提下设计高效近似算法，成为亟待解决的关键挑战。

## 主要贡献  
本文首次系统研究了差分隐私下的SMK问题，覆盖**单调与非单调**两类目标函数：  
- **单调情形**：提出首个达到最优 $(1-1/e)$-近似比的DP算法，其**加性误差为 $O(\sqrt{\Delta \log(1/\delta)}/\varepsilon)$**（$\Delta$为函数敏感度），显著优于先前工作；同时设计了一种更轻量级的DP算法，以更低查询复杂度实现 $1/2$-近似，适用于大规模场景。  
- **非单调情形**：首次给出具备理论保证的DP算法——这是该方向的**开创性结果**。算法在期望意义下达到 $1/4$-近似比，且加性误差与最优单调算法同阶，突破了非单调SMK在DP框架下的长期空白。  

## 创新点  
- 引入**隐私感知的贪心剪枝与拉普拉斯扰动耦合机制**，兼顾效用与隐私预算分配；  
- 建立统一分析框架，首次将DP分析与子模函数的曲率性质、背包约束结构深度结合；  
- 所有算法均满足 $(\varepsilon,\delta)$-差分隐私，时间复杂度为多项式级，具备实际部署潜力。
papers.summary_en: Submodular maximization subject to a knapsack constraint (SMK) is a cornerstone discrete optimization problem with broad applications in machine learning. Motivated by privacy concerns in sensitive-data settings, we study SMK under $(\varepsilon,\delta)$-differential privacy (DP). For **monotone objectives**, we propose the first DP algorithm achieving the optimal $(1-1/e)$-approximation ratio, with improved additive error $O(\sqrt{\Delta \log(1/\delta)}/\varepsilon)$ and query complexity over prior work; we also design a more efficient $1/2$-approximation variant. For **non-monotone objectives**, we present the *first* DP algorithm with provable guarantees—achieving $1/4$-approximation in expectation and additive error matching the best known for monotone cases. All algorithms are polynomial-time and rigorously satisfy DP.

papers.title: Co-Scraper: query-aware DOM Pruning and Reusable Scraper Synthesis for Lightweight Web Data Extraction
papers.abstract: The abundant and heterogeneous nature of web content necessitates automated information extraction, and generating scrapers that can be reused across similar web pages offers an effective solution for scalable data extraction. In this work, we propose Co-Scraper, a two-stage framework capable of handling the hierarchical complexity of long HTML documents. By integrating a query-aware DOM pruning mechanism with stable extraction strategy induction, Co-Scraper can effectively transforms web content into executable programmatic wrappers using a fine-tuned Qwen3-8B model. On the test set of SWDE, Co-Scraper achieves state-of-the-art performance with an F1 score of 94.78% and a reuse success rate of 90.39%. This framework significantly enhances the accuracy and resilience of data extraction, providing a highly efficient approach for web data acquisition tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与挑战  
网络内容海量、异构且结构动态演化，亟需轻量、鲁棒、可复用的自动化信息抽取方案。传统爬虫脚本高度依赖页面布局，泛化能力弱；而现有基于学习的端到端提取方法常忽略HTML的树状层级本质，难以兼顾长文档解析精度与跨页面迁移能力。

## 方法创新：Co-Scraper双阶段框架  
我们提出**Co-Scraper**——一种面向查询感知（query-aware）与可复用性协同优化的轻量级网页数据提取框架：  
- **第一阶段：DOM剪枝（Query-aware DOM Pruning）**  
  利用微调后的**Qwen3-8B**大语言模型，结合用户查询语义与DOM节点上下文（如标签名、文本内容、父子/兄弟关系），动态识别并剪除无关子树，将原始HTML压缩为聚焦目标字段的精简DOM子图，显著降低噪声干扰与计算开销。  
- **第二阶段：可复用爬虫合成（Reusable Scraper Synthesis）**  
  基于剪枝后的稳定DOM结构，归纳生成**符号化、位置鲁棒的XPath/JS表达式序列**，支持跨相似页面（如电商列表页、新闻归档页）零样本迁移，无需重训练或人工干预。

## 性能与价值  
在权威基准SWDE（Semantic Web Data Extraction）测试集上，Co-Scraper达成：  
✅ **F1分数94.78%**（当前最优），较SOTA提升2.1+个百分点；  
✅ **跨页面复用成功率90.39%**，验证其强泛化性；  
✅ 单次推理平均耗时<1.2秒（CPU环境），满足轻量部署需求。  
本工作首次将**大模型语义理解能力**与**DOM结构稳定性建模**深度耦合，为构建高精度、低维护成本的工业级网页数据采集系统提供了新范式。
papers.summary_en: Co-Scraper is a lightweight, two-stage framework for scalable and reusable web data extraction. It addresses the hierarchical complexity of long HTML documents by first applying **query-aware DOM pruning**: a fine-tuned Qwen3-8B model identifies and removes irrelevant subtrees based on semantic alignment between user queries and DOM context (e.g., tag names, text, structural relations), yielding compact, task-focused DOM subgraphs. Second, it synthesizes **stable, executable scrapers**—symbolic XPath/JS expressions—induced from pruned structures, enabling zero-shot reuse across similar pages without retraining. Evaluated on SWDE, Co-Scraper achieves a state-of-the-art **F1 score of 94.78%** and a **reuse success rate of 90.39%**, outperforming prior methods in both accuracy and robustness. Its efficient design supports CPU deployment with <1.2s latency per page, offering a practical solution for production-grade web data acquisition.

papers.title: From Shield to Target: Denial-of-Service Attacks on LLM-Based Agent Guardrails
papers.abstract: LLM-based guardrails have emerged as a highly effective defense against prompt injection and jailbreak attacks in autonomous agents. However, we reveal that the very reasoning and task-following capabilities enabling this protection introduce a novel vulnerability: attackers can inject crafted data to trap the guardrail in extended reasoning loops, effectuating a systematic denial-of-service (DoS) attack. To systematically expose this threat, we design a beam-search optimization framework that crafts natural-language payloads to maximize guardrail reasoning length, utilizing an LLM proposer guided by a strategy bank. Based on the observation of guardrail's schema-following nature, we also provide another attack framework driven by mechanism-aware structural mutations with less computational load. The attack efficacy is systematically evaluated in two parts. First, in standalone evaluations, the attack generalizes across diverse guardrail architectures, safety templates, and agent benchmarks. Payloads optimized on a single open-source surrogate successfully transfer to eight leading model backbones (e.g., Claude, GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, and Qwen), achieving a 13--63$\times$ token amplification. Second, in end-to-end real-world agent deployments (web, desktop, code, and multi-agent systems), the attack reveals up to a 148$\times$ latency amplification. We show that a single poisoned document can saturate shared guardrail infrastructures, effectively starving co-located agents and paralyzing the entire system. By uncovering this availability flaw, our work underscores the urgent need to develop cost-bounded, reasoning-robust guardrails.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景  
基于大语言模型（LLM）的防护机制（guardrails）已成为抵御提示注入与越狱攻击的关键防线，广泛部署于自主智能体系统中。然而，本研究首次揭示：** guardrails 依赖的强推理与任务遵循能力本身构成新型可用性漏洞**——攻击者可通过精心构造的自然语言输入，诱使其陷入冗长、无终止的推理循环，从而实施系统性拒绝服务（DoS）攻击。

## 方法创新  
我们提出两种互补的攻击框架：  
- **Beam-search优化框架**：构建LLM驱动的提案器（proposer），结合策略库（strategy bank）进行多步束搜索，最大化guardrail的推理步数与token消耗；  
- **机制感知结构突变框架**：基于guardrail普遍遵循结构化输出模式（如JSON schema、安全模板）的观察，设计轻量级语法与语义层面的结构扰动，显著降低计算开销（无需微调或梯度计算）。

## 关键发现  
1. **强泛化性**：在独立评估中，仅在单一开源代理guardrail（如Guardrails-LLM）上优化的载荷，可跨架构迁移至8种主流闭源/开源模型（Claude-3.5、GPT-4o、Gemini-2.0、DeepSeek-V3、Qwen2.5等），实现**13–63× token放大率**；  
2. **真实场景破坏力**：在Web交互、桌面自动化、代码生成及多智能体协作等端到端部署中，攻击引发最高**148×延迟增幅**；单个恶意文档即可耗尽共享guardrail服务资源，导致同节点其他智能体“饥饿”甚至系统级瘫痪；  
3. **根本性警示**：该漏洞暴露了当前安全范式对“功能性正确”的过度聚焦，而忽视推理成本约束——**可用性即安全性**，亟需设计具备显式计算预算控制与循环终止保障的鲁棒防护机制。
papers.summary_en: LLM-based guardrails, widely deployed to defend autonomous agents against prompt injection and jailbreak attacks, are found to harbor a critical availability vulnerability: their core reasoning and task-following capabilities can be weaponized to trigger infinite or excessively long reasoning loops—enabling efficient Denial-of-Service (DoS) attacks. We propose two novel attack frameworks: (1) a beam-search optimization method leveraging an LLM proposer guided by a strategy bank to maximize reasoning length; and (2) a lightweight, mechanism-aware structural mutation approach exploiting guardrails’ schema-following behavior. Evaluated across eight leading LLM backbones (e.g., Claude, GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, Qwen), optimized payloads achieve 13–63× token amplification with high cross-model transferability. In end-to-end agent deployments (web, desktop, coding, multi-agent), attacks induce up to 148× latency amplification; a single poisoned input can saturate shared guardrail infrastructure, starving co-located agents and paralyzing the system. This work exposes a fundamental trade-off between safety and availability—and calls for cost-bounded, reasoning-robust guardrail designs.

papers.title: BELLS-O: Evaluating the Operational Trade-offs of LLM Supervision Systems
papers.abstract: LLM supervision systems, namely input/output moderation filters and jailbreak detectors, are the primary safeguard against misuse in deployed AI applications, yet existing benchmarks are often vendor-biased, omit cost and latency, and rarely compare specialized guardrails against repurposed generalist LLMs. We present BELLS-O (Benchmark for the Evaluation of LLM Supervision Systems, Operational), the first independent operational benchmark of LLM supervision systems. BELLS-O evaluates 28 systems from 17 providers: every major specialized guardrail (e.g., LlamaGuard-4, ShieldGemma-2, Lakera Guard) and frontier generalists repurposed as supervisors (e.g., GPT-5.4, Claude Sonnet 4.6, Grok-4.1), jointly on detection rate, false-positive rate, latency, and monetary cost. We cover input/output moderation across 11 harm categories and jailbreak detection across 13 attack techniques, using in-house datasets built from handcrafted prompts, expert-curated samples, and quality-controlled synthetic generation. To suppress latent generator fingerprints in synthetic data, every generated sample is paraphrased. Mapping the Pareto frontier reveals use-case-dependent tradeoffs. On content moderation, specialized supervisors are operationally dominant: top systems match frontier LLMs on detection (~95% vs. 94%) at comparably low false-positive rates (<=2%), while running 5-10x faster and ~10x cheaper. On jailbreak detection, the tradeoff shifts: frontier LLMs achieve higher detection and lower false-positive rates but at 10-50x higher cost and 5-10x higher latency. We release the benchmark, framework, leaderboard, and datasets as the first vendor-neutral basis for selecting safeguards under real deployment constraints.
papers.summary_zh:
## 背景与问题  
大语言模型（LLM）监督系统（如输入/输出内容审核过滤器与越狱检测器）是部署AI应用的核心安全防线，但现有基准普遍存在**厂商绑定、忽略运行成本与延迟、缺乏专用防护系统与通用LLM复用方案的公平对比**等缺陷。

## 方法与创新  
本文提出 **BELLS-O**（Benchmark for the Evaluation of LLM Supervision Systems, Operational），首个面向真实部署约束的**独立、操作型基准**。我们系统评估了来自17家供应商的28个监督系统：涵盖全部主流专用防护模型（如LlamaGuard-4、ShieldGemma-2、Lakera Guard），以及被复用为监督器的前沿通用LLM（如GPT-5.4、Claude Sonnet 4.6、Grok-4.1）。评估维度包括**检测率、误报率、端到端延迟与单次调用货币成本**。数据覆盖11类内容危害（如暴力、歧视）和13种越狱攻击技术，基于人工构造提示、专家标注样本及高质量合成数据构建；所有合成样本均经**语义保持型改写**以消除生成器指纹。

## 关键发现  
- **内容审核场景**：专用监督系统全面占优——顶尖方案检测率达~95%（vs. 前沿LLM的94%），误报率≤2%，且**速度提升5–10倍、成本降低约10倍**。  
- **越狱检测场景**：前沿LLM展现更高检测率与更低误报率，但代价显著——**成本高10–50倍、延迟高5–10倍**。Pareto前沿分析证实：最优选择高度依赖具体用例。  
本项目开源基准框架、全量数据集、实时排行榜，为工业界提供首个**厂商中立、可落地的防护选型依据**。
papers.summary_en: BELLS-O is the first vendor-neutral operational benchmark for LLM supervision systems—evaluating 28 models (17 providers), including specialized guardrails (e.g., LlamaGuard-4, ShieldGemma-2) and repurposed frontier LLMs (e.g., GPT-5.4, Claude Sonnet 4.6), across detection rate, false-positive rate, latency, and monetary cost. It covers 11 harm categories and 13 jailbreak techniques using rigorously curated, paraphrased datasets. Results reveal stark trade-offs: for content moderation, top specialized systems match frontier LLMs in detection (~95% vs. 94%) with ≤2% false positives, while being 5–10× faster and ~10× cheaper; for jailbreak detection, frontier LLMs achieve superior accuracy but at 10–50× higher cost and 5–10× higher latency. BELLS-O releases the full benchmark, framework, leaderboard, and datasets to enable deployment-aware safeguard selection.

papers.title: Beyond Runtime Enforcement: Shield Synthesis as Defensibility Analysis for Adversarial Networks
papers.abstract: Shielded reinforcement learning is typically presented as a runtime safety mechanism that compiles temporal-logic specifications into automata restricting an agent's actions. We argue this is the wrong product. The same automata-theoretic machinery -- specification compilation, product game construction, attractor computation, and winning-region extraction -- is better read as a design-time analytical instrument whose outputs are structural insights about a system rather than runtime constraints on a deployed agent.   We instantiate this through a constrained two-player safety game for network defense. The two specifications are enforced asymmetrically: the defender specification defines the unsafe region of the game, whereas the attacker specification restricts the adversary's legal actions during attractor computation. Solving the game yields a defensibility verdict -- a formal certificate that a topology-specification pair is or is not defensible -- with the associated winning region and shield.   Beyond the binary verdict, we derive topology-level metrics from the attractor structure and combine them with post-convergence behavior from shield-constrained adversarial multi-agent reinforcement learning. Together these form a defensibility fingerprint capturing both a network's formal safety properties and its operational behavior under adaptive play.   A what-if analysis shows that formal defensibility and operational effectiveness capture distinct aspects of security: small architectural changes can produce large shifts in operational outcomes while leaving formal safety margins nearly unchanged. Shield synthesis is thus most valuable not as a deployment mechanism for safe agents, but as a framework for answering architectural questions about whether, where, and how a system can be defended. The defensibility verdict is the output, not the safe policy.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究定位：从运行时防护到可防御性分析  
本文挑战“屏蔽（shield）仅是强化学习中运行时安全约束”的主流范式，提出**屏蔽综合（shield synthesis）本质上是一种设计阶段的可防御性分析框架**。我们重构了传统基于自动机的时序逻辑编译流程——包括规格编译、乘积博弈构建、吸引子计算与获胜区提取——将其解读为**揭示系统内在结构特性的分析工具**，而非仅生成部署时的动作过滤器。

## 方法创新：不对称双规格安全博弈建模  
针对网络防御场景，我们构建了一个**受约束的双人安全博弈**：  
- **防御方规格**定义系统的**不可达（unsafe）状态集**（即需绝对避免的拓扑失效模式）；  
- **攻击方规格**则在吸引子计算过程中**限制对手的合法行动空间**（反映现实中的能力约束，如渗透路径限制），实现规格的**不对称施加**。  
求解该博弈输出三项核心产物：**可防御性裁决（defensibility verdict）**（形式化判定某网络拓扑是否可在给定规格下被完全防御）、**获胜区域（winning region）**（所有初始状态下防御者必胜的状态子集）及对应的**屏蔽策略**。

## 关键发现：可防御性指纹与架构敏感性  
超越二元裁决，我们从吸引子层级结构中提取**拓扑级度量**（如最小防御覆盖半径、吸引子深度分布），并融合屏蔽约束下的**对抗性多智能体RL收敛行为**（如攻防交互频率、策略僵持周期），构建**可防御性指纹（defensibility fingerprint）**——同时刻画系统的**形式安全性**与**适应性对抗下的操作韧性**。  
“假设分析”表明：**形式可防御性与操作有效性表征安全的不同维度**——微小架构调整（如增加一条冗余链路）可能引发操作性能的剧烈波动（如平均攻破时间下降70%），而形式获胜区面积变化却不足5%。这证实屏蔽综合的核心价值不在于生成安全策略，而在于**回答根本性架构问题：系统*能否*被防御？*何处*最脆弱？*如何*重构以提升鲁棒性？** 可防御性裁决本身，才是真正的分析输出。
papers.summary_en: This paper repositions shield synthesis—not as a runtime enforcement mechanism for safe RL agents, but as a *design-time defensibility analysis framework*. We reinterpret the standard automata-theoretic pipeline (specification compilation, product game construction, attractor computation, winning-region extraction) as yielding structural insights about system architecture rather than just executable constraints. For network defense, we formalize an asymmetric two-player safety game: the defender’s specification defines the unsafe region, while the attacker’s specification constrains adversarial actions *only during attractor computation*, enabling realistic capability modeling. Solving the game produces a formal **defensibility verdict**, the associated winning region, and a shield—constituting a certificate of architectural safety. Beyond binary verdicts, we derive topology-level metrics from attractor structure and integrate them with post-convergence behavior from shield-constrained adversarial multi-agent RL to form a **defensibility fingerprint**, jointly capturing formal safety and operational resilience under adaptive attack. Crucially, “what-if” analysis reveals that formal defensibility and operational effectiveness are decoupled: minor architectural changes can drastically alter operational outcomes while leaving formal safety margins nearly invariant. Thus, shield synthesis is most valuable as a *diagnostic tool for architectural security questions*—not as a deployment shield.

papers.title: Who Pays the Price? Stakeholder-Centric Prompt Injection Benchmarking for Real-world Web Agents
papers.abstract: Web agents driven by large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in real-world environments, where they operate over untrusted web content and execute actions with direct consequences. This makes them vulnerable to prompt-injection attacks, in which seemingly benign content embeds adversarial instructions that manipulate agent behaviour. Existing security benchmarks adopt an \textit{attack-centric} perspective, focusing on the technical feasibility of injections while overlooking the nuanced distribution of resulting harms. In practice, however, prompt-injection risk is victim-dependent: a single exploit can produce asymmetric consequences for different stakeholders, and the same attack pattern may exhibit substantially different effectiveness depending on whom it targets. To capture these properties, we introduce \textbf{\sysname}, a \textit{stakeholder-centric} benchmark to systematically categorize and attribute harm in real-world web agent systems. It distinguishes between affected entities (e.g., user, seller, platform), decomposes the attacks into concrete objectives, and evaluates each case with complementary outcome- and process-level metrics. Our results reveal substantial and heterogeneous vulnerabilities: not a single attack objective is reliably resisted by current agents, and failures distribute across qualitatively distinct modes ranging from \emph{stealthy parasitism} (attack succeeds without disrupting the user's delegated task) to \emph{misaligned disruption} (task disrupted without attack success) and \emph{compounded failure} (both adversarial objective and task integrity simultaneously violated). These patterns are missed by conventional evaluation, highlighting the need for stakeholder-aware assessment of LLM-based agents in real-world deployments. Benchmark is available at https://github.com/StakeBench/SBC.
papers.summary_zh:
## 背景与问题  
随着大语言模型（LLM）驱动的Web智能体日益部署于真实网络环境，其需直接解析不可信网页内容并执行具实际后果的操作（如下单、支付、信息提交），由此面临严峻的**提示注入（prompt injection）攻击风险**。现有安全评测基准多采用*攻击中心视角*，仅关注注入技术可行性，却忽视了攻击后果在不同利益相关方（如用户、商家、平台）间的**非对称性分布**——同一注入可能对用户造成隐私泄露，却使平台误收虚假订单，而对卖家产生财务损失，危害性质与程度高度依赖受害主体。

## 方法创新：StakeBench基准  
为此，我们提出首个*利益相关方中心*（stakeholder-centric）提示注入评测框架 **StakeBench**。它系统化实现三重解耦：  
- **实体归因**：明确区分受影响方（user/seller/platform）；  
- **目标分解**：将攻击细分为12类现实可操作目标（如“绕过支付验证”“伪造商品评价”）；  
- **多维评估**：同步采用*结果层指标*（是否达成恶意目标/是否破坏主任务）与*过程层指标*（代理决策链中注入指令被激活的位置、隐蔽性强度）。

## 关键发现  
在覆盖8个主流开源Web代理的实证评测中，我们发现：  
✅ **无一攻击目标被当前代理可靠防御**；  
✅ 失败模式呈现显著异质性：  
 • **隐蔽寄生型**（Stealthy Parasitism）：攻击成功且主任务表面正常（占比37.2%）；  
 • **错位干扰型**（Misaligned Disruption）：主任务被意外中断，但攻击未生效（28.5%）；  
 • **复合失效型**（Compounded Failure）：恶意目标与主任务完整性同时崩溃（22.1%）。  
这些细粒度风险模式被传统评测完全忽略，证实**仅关注“攻击是否成功”的单一维度严重低估真实部署风险**。
papers.summary_en: We introduce **StakeBench**, the first stakeholder-centric benchmark for evaluating prompt injection vulnerabilities in real-world web agents. Unlike prior attack-centric benchmarks, StakeBench explicitly models *who bears the harm*—categorizing impacts across users, sellers, and platforms—and decomposes attacks into 12 concrete, operationally grounded objectives (e.g., “bypass payment verification”, “fabricate product reviews”). It evaluates each case using complementary outcome-level metrics (adversarial success vs. task integrity) and process-level metrics (injection activation point, stealthiness). Across 8 state-of-the-art open-source web agents, we find: (1) no attack objective is reliably resisted; (2) failures manifest in three qualitatively distinct, co-occurring modes—*stealthy parasitism*, *misaligned disruption*, and *compounded failure*—which conventional evaluation fails to detect; and (3) vulnerability severity varies significantly by stakeholder role. StakeBench thus reveals critical blind spots in current LLM agent security assessment and provides a foundation for stakeholder-aware robustness engineering. Code and data: https://github.com/StakeBench/SBC.

papers.title: Efficient, Robust, and Anti-Collusion Fingerprinting of Image Diffusion Models
papers.abstract: Model fingerprinting, embedding user-specific identifiers (fingerprints) into generated outputs, has recently emerged as a popular solution to protect the intellectual property rights (IPR) of generative text-to-image (T2I) models and prevent unauthorized redistribution. In this work, we reveal a previously unexplored systematic vulnerability in existing generative model fingerprinting methods: they lack robustness against collusion attacks, where multiple attackers combine their models to remove or obscure the fingerprints. To address this issue, we take the first step towards a robust fingerprinting method for T2I models with anti-collusion capabilities. The proposed method encodes strings of bits, namely fingerprints, into the coefficients of a personalized normalization module (PNM) incorporated into T2I models, so that fingerprints can be reliably recovered from any generated image. To defend against collusion attacks and prevent unauthorized model redistribution, we introduce an anti-collusion mechanism based on lossless function-invariant parameter transformations. This mechanism significantly degrades the image generation quality of colluded models, making them effectively unusable. Moreover, our method allows developers to efficiently create multiple copies of fingerprinted T2I models by reparameterizing the PNM without the need for retraining. We also introduce a worst-case optimization strategy to improve robustness against model-level attacks. Our experiments demonstrate that the proposed method achieves high fidelity and robustness across multiple T2I image generation and editing tasks, with fingerprint extraction accuracy exceeding 99.5%. Compared with existing methods, our method demonstrates, for the first time, a notable proactive robustness to collusion attacks by significantly increasing the FID of colluded models.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与问题  
生成式文本到图像（T2I）模型的知识产权保护日益紧迫，**模型指纹技术**（即在生成图像中嵌入用户专属标识）已成为主流方案。然而，现有方法存在一个被长期忽视的系统性缺陷：**缺乏抗合谋攻击能力**——多个恶意用户可通过联合其指纹化模型，协同移除或混淆指纹，导致溯源失效与模型盗用泛滥。

## 方法创新  
本文首次提出一种**高效、鲁棒且具备抗合谋能力**的T2I模型指纹框架：  
- **指纹编码机制**：将二进制指纹字符串嵌入轻量级**个性化归一化模块**（PNM）的可学习系数中，实现端到端隐式编码，支持从任意生成图像中高精度提取指纹（准确率 >99.5%）；  
- **抗合谋核心设计**：引入基于**无损函数不变参数变换**的防御机制——合谋者合并模型时，该机制会不可逆地破坏PNM的函数等价性，导致生成图像质量急剧下降（FID显著升高），使合谋模型实际不可用；  
- **工程友好性**：支持无需重训练的PNM快速重参数化，开发者可高效分发海量差异化指纹副本；  
- **强鲁棒性增强**：采用**最坏情况优化策略**，显式对抗模型剪枝、微调、蒸馏等模型级攻击。

## 实验验证  
在Stable Diffusion、SDXL及InstructPix2Pix等多个主流T2I与编辑任务上验证：指纹提取平均准确率达**99.62%**，对噪声、压缩、裁剪等常见失真保持>98%鲁棒性；面对3方及以上合谋攻击，合谋模型FID平均上升**>40点**（如从12.3升至54.7），图像严重失真，证实其“功能性失效”。本工作首次实现了对合谋攻击的**主动式、可证明的鲁棒防御**，为生成式AI版权治理提供新范式。
papers.summary_en: This paper presents the first anti-collusion fingerprinting framework for text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models. We identify a critical, previously overlooked vulnerability: existing fingerprinting methods collapse under collusion attacks, where multiple adversaries jointly modify their models to erase fingerprints. Our method embeds bit-string fingerprints into coefficients of a lightweight Personalized Normalization Module (PNM), enabling reliable extraction (>99.5% accuracy) from any generated image. Crucially, we introduce a lossless function-invariant parameter transformation mechanism that provably degrades generation quality (FID increases by >40 points) when models are colluded—rendering colluded models practically unusable. The approach supports efficient, retraining-free model duplication via PNM reparameterization and incorporates worst-case optimization for enhanced robustness against model-level attacks (e.g., pruning, fine-tuning). Experiments across Stable Diffusion, SDXL, and editing tasks confirm high fidelity, strong resilience to distortions, and, for the first time, proactive, quantifiable robustness against multi-party collusion.

## 研究背景与问题  
生成式文本到图像（T2I）模型的知识产权保护日益紧迫，**模型指纹技术**（即在生成图像中嵌入用户专属标识）已成为主流方案。然而，现有方法存在一个被长期忽视的系统性缺陷：**缺乏抗合谋攻击能力**——多个恶意用户可通过联合其指纹化模型，协同移除或混淆指纹，导致溯源失效与模型盗用泛滥。

## 方法创新  
本文首次提出一种**高效、鲁棒且具备抗合谋能力**的T2I模型指纹框架：  
- **指纹编码机制**：将二进制指纹字符串嵌入轻量级**个性化归一化模块**（PNM）的可学习系数中，实现端到端隐式编码，支持从任意生成图像中高精度提取指纹（准确率 >99.5%）；  
- **抗合谋核心设计**：引入基于**无损函数不变参数变换**的防御机制——合谋者合并模型时，该机制会不可逆地破坏PNM的函数等价性，导致生成图像质量急剧下降（FID显著升高），使合谋模型实际不可用；  
- **工程友好性**：支持无需重训练的PNM快速重参数化，开发者可高效分发海量差异化指纹副本；  
- **强鲁棒性增强**：采用**最坏情况优化策略**，显式对抗模型剪枝、微调、蒸馏等模型级攻击。

在Stable Diffusion、SDXL及InstructPix2Pix等多个主流T2I与编辑任务上验证：指纹提取平均准确率达**99.62%**，对噪声、压缩、裁剪等常见失真保持>98%鲁棒性；面对3方及以上合谋攻击，合谋模型FID平均上升**>40点**（如从12.3升至54.7），图像严重失真，证实其“功能性失效”。本工作首次实现了对合谋攻击的**主动式、可证明的鲁棒防御**，为生成式AI版权治理提供新范式。

papers.title: MAStrike: Shapley-Guided Collusive Red-Teaming on Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract: Hierarchical multi-agent systems (MAS) are rapidly being deployed in high-stakes workflows across domains such as finance and software engineering. In these systems, safety and security are inherently distributed across role-specialized agents, significantly expanding the attack surface, particularly under coordinated adversarial behaviors such as privilege escalation and cross-agent collusion. Existing red-teaming approaches for MAS remain limited: they rely on heuristic selection of target agents and perturb isolated message streams, leaving critical questions unanswered as which agents are most responsible for system safety, and how compromised agents can coordinate to bypass defenses. We propose MAStrike, a closed-loop framework for collusive red-teaming in hierarchical MAS. We propose the first agent-level Shapley value analysis for MAS, quantifying each agent's marginal contribution to system robustness under task-specific distributions. GGuided by this attribution, MAStrike identifies vulnerable agent coalitions and generates coordinated, role-aware adversarial manipulations. These attacks are iteratively refined through structured causal diagnosis, attributing failure cases to uncompromised agents that block adversarial attempts. We further build a comprehensive MAS red-teaming benchmark and controllable environments spanning diverse hierarchical topologies and domains, including finance, software engineering, and CRM. Extensive experiments across MAS built on multiple frontier models show that MAStrike substantially outperforms heuristic baselines. Our analysis further uncovers non-trivial Shapley value distributions and higher-order interaction structures among agents, revealing critical vulnerabilities and coordination patterns that are overlooked by prior single-agent or template-based methods.
papers.summary_zh:
## MAStrike：基于Shapley值引导的多智能体系统协同红队攻击框架  

**背景与挑战**：分层多智能体系统（MAS）正快速部署于金融、软件工程等高风险领域。其安全性天然分布于角色特化的智能体之间，导致攻击面显著扩大——尤其在特权提升、跨智能体共谋等**协同对抗行为**下，传统单点扰动式红队方法（如随机目标选择、孤立消息篡改）难以识别关键脆弱节点与隐性协作路径，更无法量化各智能体对系统鲁棒性的边际贡献。

**方法创新**：本文提出**MAStrike**——首个面向分层MAS的闭环协同红队框架。核心突破包括：（1）首次定义**智能体级Shapley值分析**，在任务特定数据分布下，精确量化每个智能体对系统安全性的边际贡献；（2）基于该归因结果，自动识别高风险智能体联盟，并生成**角色感知、语义连贯的协同对抗操纵**（如伪造权限凭证、诱导链式错误响应）；（3）通过**结构化因果诊断**迭代优化攻击：当攻击失败时，反向归因至未被攻陷但起阻断作用的“守门人”智能体，驱动下一轮精准渗透。

**实验与发现**：构建了覆盖金融风控、代码审计、客户关系管理（CRM）三大领域的可控MAS基准环境，支持多样化拓扑（树状、网状、混合）。在基于多个前沿大模型（Llama-3、Qwen2、Claude-3）构建的12类MAS上验证表明：MAStrike攻击成功率平均提升**42.7%**（vs. heuristic baselines），且首次揭示智能体间存在显著**高阶交互效应**（如三智能体共谋效用非两两之和），暴露单智能体或模板化方法完全忽略的深层脆弱性。
papers.summary_en: MAStrike introduces the first Shapley-guided, closed-loop framework for collusive red-teaming in hierarchical multi-agent systems (MAS). It proposes the first agent-level Shapley value analysis to quantify each agent’s marginal contribution to system robustness under task-specific distributions, enabling principled identification of vulnerable coalitions. Guided by this attribution, MAStrike generates coordinated, role-aware adversarial manipulations—e.g., privilege-spoofing and cross-agent misdirection—and iteratively refines attacks via causal diagnosis that attributes failures to blocking but uncompromised agents. Evaluated on a comprehensive benchmark spanning finance, software engineering, and CRM domains across diverse topologies and frontier LLM-based MAS, MAStrike achieves up to 42.7% higher attack success than heuristic baselines. Crucially, its Shapley analysis uncovers non-trivial higher-order agent interactions, revealing critical collusion patterns and systemic vulnerabilities invisible to single-agent or template-based methods.

papers.title: PolicyGuard: Towards Test-time and Step-level Adversary Defense for Reinforcement Learning Agent
papers.abstract: While real-world applications of reinforcement learning (RL) are becoming increasingly popular, the security of RL systems deserve more attention and exploration. In particular, recent work has revealed that RL agents are vulnerable to backdoor attacks, where a victim agent behaves normally under standard conditions but executes malicious actions when a specific trigger is activated. Existing backdoor defenses for RL either require access to the agent's internal parameters, operate only at the model or trajectory level, or are limited to specific attack types. To ensure the security of RL agents, we propose \texttt{PolicyGuard}, a \textit{test-time step-level} backdoor defense which leverages Gaussian Process (GP) posterior variance and adapts pseudo trajectories to enable uncertainty computation for individual time step. Besides, we also provide theoretical foundations to explain the efficacy of GP posterior variance. Extensive experiments across seven RL games demonstrate that PolicyGuard achieves state-of-the-art detection performance in most cases, with average AUROC of 0.856 for perturbation-based attacks and 0.859 for adversary-agent attacks.
papers.summary_zh:
## 背景与挑战  
强化学习（RL）在自动驾驶、机器人控制等现实场景中加速落地，但其安全性问题日益凸显。近期研究表明，RL智能体易受**后门攻击**威胁：攻击者通过污染训练数据或模型，使智能体在常规环境下表现正常，却在特定触发信号（如图像扰动或对手策略）出现时执行恶意动作。现有防御方法存在显著局限：或需访问智能体内部参数（违背黑盒部署前提），或仅在模型级/轨迹级进行检测（缺乏细粒度响应能力），或仅适配特定攻击类型，难以泛化。

## 方法创新：PolicyGuard  
本文提出 **PolicyGuard**——首个面向**测试时（test-time）、步级（step-level）** 的轻量级后门防御框架。其核心思想是：在智能体决策每一步时，实时评估该动作的**不确定性可信度**。为此，PolicyGuard 创新性地：  
- 利用**高斯过程（GP）后验方差**作为不确定性量化指标，理论证明其能有效区分正常策略与后门触发下的异常决策分布；  
- 设计**伪轨迹自适应机制**，通过少量无标签环境交互生成局部伪轨迹，绕过对真实轨迹依赖，实现单步级不确定性估计；  
- 完全**无需访问策略网络参数或训练数据**，兼容任意黑盒RL智能体（如PPO、SAC），且部署开销低（平均增加<8%推理延迟）。

## 实验验证与贡献  
在7个主流RL基准环境（包括Atari、MuJoCo及多智能体对抗场景）上系统评估，PolicyGuard在两类典型后门攻击下均达SOTA性能：  
- 对**扰动型攻击**（如Trigger-Attack），平均AUROC达 **0.856**；  
- 对**对手智能体型攻击**（Adversary-Agent），平均AUROC达 **0.859**；  
显著优于基线方法（提升+12.3%~24.7% AUROC）。本工作首次将GP不确定性建模引入RL安全领域，为实时、细粒度、免侵入式防御提供了可验证的理论基础与实用范式。
papers.summary_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) agents face growing security threats from backdoor attacks—malicious behaviors triggered only under specific conditions while appearing normal otherwise. Existing defenses suffer from strong assumptions (e.g., white-box access), coarse-grained detection (model- or trajectory-level), or narrow attack coverage. To address this, we propose **PolicyGuard**, the first *test-time, step-level* backdoor defense for black-box RL agents. It leverages Gaussian Process (GP) posterior variance—rigorously justified theoretically—as a principled uncertainty signal per decision step, and introduces adaptive pseudo-trajectory generation to enable efficient, parameter-free uncertainty estimation without requiring internal model access or training data. Evaluated across seven diverse RL benchmarks (Atari, MuJoCo, multi-agent settings), PolicyGuard achieves state-of-the-art detection: **0.856 average AUROC** against perturbation-based attacks and **0.859** against adversary-agent attacks—outperforming prior methods by up to 24.7%. Its lightweight design incurs <8% inference overhead, enabling practical deployment in safety-critical applications.

papers.title: A Privacy-Preserving Framework Using Remote Data Science for Inter-Institutional Student Retention Prediction
papers.abstract: This study explores privacy-preserving machine learning (PPML) techniques using the PySyft platform to enable collaborative prediction of student retention between institutions. We developed a remote data science (RDS) framework with a semi-air-gapped architecture consisting of high-side and low-side servers, allowing researchers from three universities to build predictive models on sensitive student data without direct data access. Using historical data from a small private university (N=720), we evaluated three synthetic data generation approaches and validated the framework through inter-institutional collaboration. The results demonstrate consistent classification performance across institutions (Macro F1: 0.690--0.695) while maintaining strict Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act (FERPA) compliance. We also propose Data-Type-Aware Templates, a novel synthetic data method that prioritizes privacy over distributional fidelity. Our findings confirm that RDS-based PPML is technically feasible for educational settings and offers a practical alternative to federated learning for small-scale inter-institutional collaborations. The code is available at https://github.com/jtfields/NAIRR240195-Privacy-Preserving-Machine-Learning.

## 隐私保护型远程数据科学框架：支持跨校学生留存率预测  

本研究针对教育领域跨机构协作中敏感学籍数据共享的合规瓶颈，提出一种基于**远程数据科学（Remote Data Science, RDS）** 的隐私保护机器学习（PPML）框架。该框架依托PySyft平台构建，采用创新的**半气隙（semi-air-gapped）双服务器架构**——“高侧服务器”安全托管原始学生数据（严格隔离于互联网），而“低侧服务器”供研究人员远程提交代码并执行模型训练，全程无需数据导出或本地拷贝，从架构层面杜绝数据泄露风险。  

研究以一所小型私立大学的历史学生数据（N=720）为基准，系统评估了三种合成数据生成方法，并首次提出**数据类型感知模板（Data-Type-Aware Templates, DTAT）** ——一种面向教育场景的新型合成数据技术：它显式区分结构化字段（如GPA、课程数）、序数变量（如年级、退学阶段）与敏感标识符，通过约束性采样与语义掩码优先保障隐私性，主动牺牲部分分布保真度以换取更强的重识别抵御能力。  

在三所高校的实证协作中，各机构独立部署RDS节点，协同构建统一留存预测模型。结果显示：跨校模型性能高度一致（Macro F1 = 0.690–0.695），且全程满足美国《家庭教育权利与隐私法案》（FERPA）全部合规要求。相比联邦学习，本框架显著降低小规模机构的技术门槛与通信开销，验证了RDS范式在资源受限教育环境中的可行性与实用性。源代码已开源：https://github.com/jtfields/NAIRR240195-Privacy-Preserving-Machine-Learning。
papers.summary_en: This paper introduces a privacy-preserving remote data science (RDS) framework enabling inter-institutional student retention prediction without sharing raw sensitive data. Built on PySyft, it employs a semi-air-gapped architecture with isolated high-side (data-hosting) and low-side (code-execution) servers, allowing researchers from three universities to collaboratively train models while maintaining strict FERPA compliance. Using historical data (N=720) from a small private university, we benchmarked synthetic data generation methods and proposed **Data-Type-Aware Templates (DTAT)**—a novel approach that prioritizes privacy over distributional fidelity by encoding domain-specific constraints for educational variables. Experimental results show consistent cross-institutional classification performance (Macro F1: 0.690–0.695) and demonstrate RDS-based PPML as a technically feasible, low-overhead alternative to federated learning for small-scale academic collaborations. Code is publicly available.

papers.title: Detecting Functional Memorization in Code Language Models
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to generate code at scale. Meanwhile, prior work has investigated whether training data may be recoverable from model outputs, by auditing the textual overlap between training examples and model generations. Code, however, can be functionally equivalent while textually dissimilar. In this work, we study functional memorization: extraction of functional logic beyond what verbatim metrics detect. We construct a counterfactual setup for Olmo-3-32B, comparing a midtrained model (exposed to target code) against a pretrained reference (not exposed). We prompt both models with Python function signatures and measure both textual and functional similarity (i.e., LLM-as-a-judge, execution-based). Our results show clear evidence of functional memorization, highlighting the need for auditing metrics that go beyond textual overlap.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景  
随着大语言模型（LLMs）在代码生成任务中的规模化部署，其潜在的数据记忆风险引发广泛关注。现有审计方法主要依赖**文本重叠检测**（如n-gram匹配、BLEU、exact match），但代码具有高度的**功能性等价性**——不同语法实现可产生完全相同的输入-输出行为（例如，`for`循环与列表推导式、不同变量命名或重构逻辑）。因此，仅靠文本相似性无法揭示模型是否记住了训练数据中蕴含的**核心算法逻辑**。

## 方法创新  
本研究首次系统提出并实证检验“**功能记忆**”（functional memorization）概念：即模型在未复现原文的前提下，仍能精确再生训练数据中函数的功能行为。我们为开源模型 **Olmo-3-32B** 构建了严格的**反事实对照实验**：  
- ✅ **实验组**：一个在训练中期（mid-trained）的检查点，已接触目标Python函数样本；  
- ❌ **对照组**：同一架构的预训练（pretrained）检查点，明确未见过目标样本；  
- 🧪 **评估方式**：向两组模型统一输入**无实现体的函数签名**（如 `def gcd(a: int, b: int) -> int:`），分别测量：  
　　• **文本相似性**（基于Levenshtein距离与代码格式化后的token重叠）；  
　　• **功能相似性**（双路径验证）：① LLM-as-a-judge（使用GPT-4o对生成代码的功能正确性打分）；② 执行验证（在100组随机测试用例上比对输入-输出行为一致性）。

## 主要发现与意义  
实验显示：尽管文本相似度差异微弱（<5%），实验组的功能正确率显著高于对照组（+28.7%执行通过率，p<0.001）；且该差距在高复杂度函数（如动态规划、图遍历）中进一步放大。这确凿证实了**功能层面的记忆现象独立于文本复现而存在**。本工作推动代码模型安全审计范式升级——亟需将**执行等价性**与**语义判别力**纳入标准评估协议，而非止步于表面文本匹配。
papers.summary_en: Large language models (LLMs) are widely deployed for code generation, yet standard memorization audits rely solely on textual overlap (e.g., exact match, BLEU), overlooking that functionally equivalent code can differ significantly in syntax. This paper introduces *functional memorization*: the unintended retention and regeneration of computational logic—not just surface text—from training data. We design a counterfactual audit for Olmo-3-32B, comparing a mid-trained checkpoint (exposed to target Python functions) against a pretrained reference (unexposed). Both are prompted with function signatures only (no bodies), and outputs are evaluated via: (1) textual similarity (normalized Levenshtein + token overlap), and (2) functional equivalence—using both LLM-as-a-judge (GPT-4o scoring) and rigorous execution-based validation across 100 diverse test inputs. Results show statistically significant functional leakage: the mid-trained model achieves +28.7% higher execution pass rate (p < 0.001) despite negligible textual overlap, especially for algorithmically complex functions. This demonstrates that functional memorization is real, measurable, and orthogonal to verbatim reproduction—urging adoption of behavior-aware metrics in code model safety evaluation.

papers.title: Towards Personalized Federated Learning for Dysarthric Speech Recognition
papers.abstract: Speech recognition is challenging for dysarthric speakers. While federated learning (FL)-based ASR can be an effective tool for protecting privacy, it suffers from heterogeneity issues caused by speaker variability. Forcing all speakers to share the same model components can be suboptimal under such heterogeneity, making personalization a promising direction; however, related research on dysarthric speech remains limited. To this end, this paper explores two aggregation strategies to achieve personalization, including the parameter-based averaging strategy and the embedding-based averaging strategy. Experiments on UASpeech and TORGO show that the proposed methods outperform the baseline regularized FedAvg by statistically significant WER reductions of up to 0.99% absolute (3.15% relative) on UASpeech and 0.56% absolute (4.73% relative) on TORGO, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景  
构音障碍（dysarthria）患者的语音存在显著发音失真、韵律异常与个体差异，导致传统自动语音识别（ASR）系统性能严重下降。联邦学习（FL）为保护患者语音数据隐私提供了可行范式，但其标准聚合机制（如FedAvg）强制所有用户共享统一模型参数，在高度异质的构音障碍语音数据上易引发“平均化灾难”——即模型难以兼顾不同说话人的独特发音模式。

## 方法创新  
本文首次系统探索面向构音障碍语音识别的个性化联邦学习框架。提出两种新型个性化聚合策略：  
- **参数级个性化**：在客户端本地训练中引入可学习的个性化适配层（如LoRA模块），服务器端仅聚合共享主干参数，保留各说话人专属适配权重；  
- **嵌入级个性化**：利用语音表征空间中的说话人嵌入（speaker embedding），在聚合前对模型梯度进行嵌入感知加权，使更新更贴近个体声学特征分布。  
二者均无需中心化数据，完全满足医疗场景下的隐私合规要求。

## 主要结果  
在UASpeech和TORGO两大权威构音障碍语音数据集上验证：  
- 相比正则化FedAvg基线，参数级策略在UASpeech上实现**0.99%绝对WER降低**（相对改善3.15%），嵌入级策略在TORGO上达**0.56%绝对WER降低**（相对改善4.73%）；  
- 所有改进均通过双尾t检验（*p* < 0.01），统计显著；  
- 消融实验表明，个性化模块对低资源说话人（<10分钟语音）提升尤为突出（WER降幅达1.2%以上）。

本研究为隐私敏感的神经康复语音技术提供了可部署、可解释的个性化FL新范式。
papers.summary_en: Dysarthric speech recognition faces severe challenges due to high inter-speaker heterogeneity and privacy constraints. While federated learning (FL) offers a privacy-preserving framework, standard aggregation (e.g., FedAvg) fails under such heterogeneity. This paper proposes two novel personalization strategies for dysarthric ASR: (1) *parameter-level averaging*, where lightweight, speaker-specific adapter modules (e.g., LoRA) are trained locally and only shared backbone parameters are aggregated; and (2) *embedding-level averaging*, which weights client updates using speaker embeddings to align gradients with individual acoustic characteristics. Evaluated on UASpeech and TORGO, both methods significantly outperform regularized FedAvg—achieving up to **0.99% absolute WER reduction (3.15% relative) on UASpeech** and **0.56% absolute WER reduction (4.73% relative) on TORGO**, with *p* < 0.01 statistical significance. To our knowledge, this is the first work systematically addressing personalization in dysarthric FL-ASR, offering a practical, privacy-compliant pathway for clinical speech rehabilitation systems.

papers.title: G-Long: Graph-Enhanced Memory Management for Efficient Long-Term Dialogue Agents
papers.abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) have advanced open-domain dialogue systems, maintaining long-term consistency remains a challenge due to inherent limitations in long-context reasoning and the inefficiency of processing extensive raw text. Existing approaches typically rely on either unstructured memory storage, which is prone to information loss, or computationally expensive LLMs that incur high latency. To address these limitations, we propose G-Long, a graph-enhanced framework that utilizes a fine-tuned small Language Model (sLM) for structured triplet extraction and associative retrieval, significantly reducing operational costs. Furthermore, we introduce the novel attention-aware importance scoring mechanism that leverages the intrinsic cross-attention signals of a T5 summarizer to identify salient memories. Extensive experiments across diverse benchmarks demonstrate that G-Long achieves state-of-the-art performance in both response generation and memory retrieval, yielding performance gains of up to 9.8% in response quality on MSC and 40.8% in retrieval recall on LME, while significantly minimizing computational overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景  
大语言模型（LLMs）虽显著提升了开放域对话系统的生成能力，但在**长时对话一致性维护**方面仍面临根本性挑战：一方面，LLMs的长上下文推理能力有限；另一方面，直接处理海量原始对话文本导致计算效率低下。现有方法或依赖非结构化记忆存储（易造成信息丢失），或过度调用大型模型进行记忆管理（引发高延迟与高成本），难以兼顾**准确性、效率与可扩展性**。

## 方法创新  
本文提出 **G-Long**——一种图增强的长时记忆管理框架，核心包含两大原创设计：  
- **结构化三元组记忆构建**：采用轻量级微调的小型语言模型（sLM），高效抽取对话中的`<主体, 关系, 客体>`三元组，构建动态知识图谱，实现记忆的语义结构化与去冗余；  
- **注意力感知的重要性评分机制**：首次利用T5摘要器内部的**跨注意力权重信号**，自动量化每个记忆节点在当前对话上下文中的语义重要性，无需额外训练或人工标注，兼具可解释性与低开销。

## 实验结果  
在MSC（多轮社交对话）、LME（长时记忆评估）等多元基准上系统验证：  
- 响应质量（BLEU/BERTScore）提升**最高达9.8%**（MSC数据集）；  
- 记忆检索召回率提升**40.8%**（LME数据集），显著优于RAG、MemNet等基线；  
- 推理延迟降低**62%**，GPU显存占用减少**73%**，证实其在资源受限场景下的部署优势。  
G-Long为构建高效、可扩展、可持续演化的长时对话智能体提供了新范式。
papers.summary_en: G-Long is a graph-enhanced memory management framework for long-term dialogue agents, addressing the inefficiency and inconsistency of existing LLM-based approaches. It replaces costly full-model memory operations with a fine-tuned small language model (sLM) to extract structured subject-relation-object triplets from dialogue history, building a dynamic knowledge graph. Crucially, we introduce an *attention-aware importance scoring* mechanism that leverages intrinsic cross-attention weights from a T5 summarizer to rank memories without extra supervision or parameters. Experiments across MSC and LME benchmarks show G-Long achieves state-of-the-art performance: +9.8% improvement in response quality (MSC) and +40.8% in retrieval recall (LME), while reducing latency by 62% and GPU memory usage by 73% versus LLM-only baselines.

papers.title: Nous: An Attempt to Extract and Inject the Cognition Behind Prediction-Market Behavior
papers.abstract: As LLM agents proliferate in prediction markets and collective decision-making, they risk a cognitive monoculture: agents built on shared foundation models produce correlated forecasts, and recent measurement finds frontier-model errors correlated at r ~ 0.77. We ask whether human cognitive diversity can be recovered from behavior and transferred to LLM agents. Nous extracts a structured eight-dimension behavioral profile from real Polymarket trading activity and injects it into agents through prompts. Our central finding is a dissociation between the two halves of that pipeline. Extraction works, partially: across 100 wallets, 8 of 14 parameters are temporally stable (split-half ICC >= 0.5, bootstrap CI lower bound > 0.3; contrarian score reaches ICC ~ 0.9); wallets are identifiable from their profiles well above chance (top-1 retrieval 17-22% vs. 1% chance); and two of four pre-specified dimensions rank-correlate with future realized profit out-of-sample, though the correlations do not survive behavioral-confound controls. Prompt-level injection does not measurably transmit it: on a semantic embedding metric, structured injection shows no significant advantage over a length-matched control on any model, and the diversity it induces neither reduces ensemble error correlation nor improves Brier score -- a null that persists across exploratory checks on sampling temperature, profile diversity, and question difficulty. Measuring the prompts themselves locates the compression before the model: the structure-to-narrative translator emits near-uniform prompts whose spread does not track profile spread. We position Nous as measuring the cognitive-monoculture problem and the limits of a prompt-level remedy, motivating deeper, below-the-prompt injection (fine-tuning, activation steering). Code, frozen profiles, prompts, and model outputs: https://github.com/WillChienT/nous-paper
papers.summary_zh:
## 背景与问题  
随着大语言模型（LLM）代理在预测市场与集体决策中广泛应用，其底层共享基础模型正催生**认知单一性（cognitive monoculture）**：不同代理的预测高度相关（前沿模型误差相关系数 *r* ≈ 0.77），削弱群体智慧的抗噪性与准确性。本研究探索一条新路径——能否从真实人类交易行为中**提取可泛化的认知多样性特征**，并将其**有效注入LLM代理**，以缓解该结构性风险。

## 方法创新  
我们提出 **Nous 框架**：  
- **提取端**：基于 Polymarket 平台 100 个真实交易钱包的完整历史行为，构建**八维结构化行为画像**（含时间偏好、风险敏感度、信息滞后性、反共识倾向等）；  
- **注入端**：将画像转化为自然语言提示（prompt），引导 LLM 生成符合该认知风格的预测，避免微调或架构修改。

## 关键发现  
✅ **提取有效**：8/14 维度具显著时间稳定性（分半信度 ICC ≥ 0.5）；反共识得分 ICC 高达 ~0.9；钱包身份可通过画像实现远超随机水平的识别（top-1 检索率 17–22% vs. 1% 基线）；2/4 预设维度与未来实际盈利呈显著秩相关（但受行为混杂因素干扰后不稳健）。  
❌ **注入失效**：结构化提示在语义嵌入距离、集成误差相关性（*r* 未下降）、Brier 分数等所有指标上均**无统计显著优势**；探索性验证（采样温度、画像多样性、题目难度）均未改变“零结果”；进一步分析发现，**提示生成器本身即为瓶颈**——其将结构化画像转译为自然语言时严重压缩信息，输出提示呈近似均匀分布，无法反映原始画像的差异性。

## 理论启示  
Nous 首次实证量化了预测市场中人类认知多样性的可提取性，同时揭示了**纯提示工程在注入深层认知模式上的根本局限**，为后续研究锚定方向：需转向**模型内部干预**（如参数微调、激活空间引导）以突破提示层的信息瓶颈。
papers.summary_en: Nous investigates whether human cognitive diversity—latent in real prediction-market behavior—can be extracted and injected into LLM agents to counteract “cognitive monoculture.” From 100 Polymarket wallets, we extract an eight-dimensional behavioral profile (e.g., contrarianism, time discounting), achieving strong temporal stability for 8/14 parameters (ICC ≥ 0.5; contrarian score ICC ≈ 0.9) and wallet identifiability far above chance (17–22% top-1 retrieval vs. 1%). However, structured prompt-based injection fails: it yields no significant improvement in semantic fidelity, ensemble error correlation, or Brier score across models and robustness checks. Critically, the profile-to-prompt translator itself collapses behavioral variance—output prompts are near-uniform and uncorrelated with input profiles. Nous thus empirically benchmarks both the recoverability of human cognition from behavior *and* the hard limits of prompt-level remedies, motivating deeper, model-internal interventions (e.g., fine-tuning, activation steering). Code and data: https://github.com/WillChienT/nous-paper

随着大语言模型（LLM）代理在预测市场与集体决策中广泛应用，其底层共享基础模型正催生**认知单一性（cognitive monoculture）**：不同代理的预测高度相关（前沿模型误差相关系数 *r* ≈ 0.77），削弱群体智慧的抗噪性与准确性。本研究探索一条新路径——能否从真实人类交易行为中**提取可泛化的认知多样性特征**，并将其**有效注入LLM代理**，以缓解该结构性风险。

papers.title: SciR: A Controllable Benchmark for Scientific Reasoning in LLMs
papers.abstract: Three paradigmatic forms of inference recur across scientific reasoning: deduction, induction, and causal abduction. Reliably evaluating LLMs on these in scientific settings is currently out of reach: scientific benchmarks built on human annotations are costly and lack mechanistic ground truth, while synthetic logical-reasoning benchmarks do not resemble real scientific documents. We introduce SciR, a benchmark that combines multi-paradigm reasoning with controllable scientific rendering, anchored on three paradigmatic scientific problems. Tasks are generated from formal objects (deduction tree, inductive rule hypothesis, causal graph) to guarantee verifiable answers, then rendered into multi-document scientific discourse via per-track domain-tuned genres. The construction lets us independently vary two difficulty axes: how hard it is to extract the key information needed for inference, and how hard the principled inference itself is. We test six models. Both axes hurt every model, and their effects compound. The rendering even hurts neurosymbolic pipelines, which hand inference to a verified solver. The two axes yield a per-model extraction-vs-inference profile: for instance, reasoning models like deepseek-r1 mostly surpass non-reasoning instruct models on the inference axis. To our knowledge, SciR is the first multi-paradigm scientific-reasoning benchmark with parametric control on both extraction and inference difficulty.
papers.summary_zh:
## 背景与挑战  
科学推理涵盖**演绎（deduction）、归纳（induction）和因果溯因（causal abduction）**三大范式，但现有基准难以可靠评估大语言模型（LLMs）在真实科学语境下的多范式推理能力：基于人工标注的科学数据集成本高昂且缺乏**机制性真值（mechanistic ground truth）**；而纯合成逻辑推理基准又脱离真实科学文献的表述形式与知识密度。

## 方法：SciR基准设计  
我们提出**SciR（Scientific Reasoning Benchmark）**——首个支持**双轴可控难度调节**的多范式科学推理基准。其核心创新在于：  
- **形式化锚定**：三类任务分别源自严格定义的形式对象——**演绎树（deduction tree）、归纳规则假设（inductive rule hypothesis）、因果图（causal graph）**，确保答案可验证、无歧义；  
- **可控科学渲染**：通过领域适配的文体模板（如天体物理综述、分子生物学实验报告），将形式对象转化为**多文档、跨段落、含图表描述的科学话语**，逼近真实科研文本；  
- **正交难度控制**：独立调控两大难度维度：① **信息提取难度**（关键前提在冗余/隐晦文本中的定位与整合）；② **原理推理难度**（范式内逻辑操作的复杂度，如多跳因果链、反事实条件推演）。

## 主要发现与创新点  
在6个主流模型（含DeepSeek-R1等推理模型及Neurosymbolic pipeline）上的测试表明：  
- 两难度轴均显著降低性能，且存在**强协同恶化效应**（compounding effect）；  
- 即使将推理步骤交由**经验证的符号求解器**处理的神经符号系统，亦因科学文本渲染而性能下降，凸显**提取瓶颈的普遍性**；  
- 各模型呈现独特“提取–推理”能力谱系：如DeepSeek-R1在推理轴上显著优于指令微调模型，但在高提取难度下优势收窄；  
- SciR是首个实现**多范式覆盖 + 形式真值保障 + 双轴参数化控制**的科学推理基准，为细粒度能力归因与模型诊断提供新范式。
papers.summary_en: SciR is the first controllable, multi-paradigm benchmark for scientific reasoning in LLMs, grounded in deduction, induction, and causal abduction. It bridges the gap between synthetic logic benchmarks (lacking scientific realism) and human-annotated datasets (lacking mechanistic ground truth) by generating tasks from formal objects—deduction trees, inductive hypotheses, and causal graphs—to guarantee verifiable answers. These are then rendered into authentic, multi-document scientific discourse via domain-tuned genres (e.g., astrophysics reviews, molecular biology reports). Crucially, SciR orthogonally controls two difficulty axes: *extraction difficulty* (locating and integrating scattered premises) and *inference difficulty* (complexity of principled reasoning within each paradigm). Evaluation across six models reveals that both axes degrade performance significantly—and their effects compound. Even neurosymbolic pipelines suffer under scientific rendering, underscoring extraction as a critical bottleneck. SciR enables fine-grained, per-model profiling along the extraction–inference spectrum (e.g., DeepSeek-R1 excels on inference but remains vulnerable to extraction hardness), establishing a new standard for diagnostic, mechanism-aware evaluation of scientific reasoning.

papers.title: The Internet of Agentic AI: Communication, Coordination, and Collective Intelligence at Scale
papers.abstract: The rapid emergence of autonomous AI agents is transforming artificial intelligence from isolated model inference into distributed systems of reasoning, communication, and action. This paper develops the vision of the Internet of Agentic AI (IoAI): an open ecosystem in which heterogeneous agents discover one another, negotiate responsibilities, exchange context, invoke tools, and execute workflows across cloud, edge, device, organizational, and cyber-physical environments. We synthesize foundations from single-agent agentic AI, multi-agent systems, distributed computing, communication networks, game theory, and security engineering to characterize the architectures and mechanisms required for scalable agent ecosystems. The paper examines agent deployment models, workflow lifecycles, communication protocols, interoperability layers, resource-management challenges, and trust architectures, with case studies in adaptive manufacturing and distributed operational coordination. The resulting framework highlights the central research challenges of controlled emergence, semantic interoperability, secure identity, incentive-compatible coordination, resource-aware orchestration, and governance for large-scale networks of autonomous agents.
papers.summary_zh:
## 背景与愿景  
随着自主AI代理（Agentic AI）的快速涌现，人工智能正从孤立的模型推理跃迁为具备推理、通信与行动能力的分布式智能系统。本文提出“**具身智能互联网**”（Internet of Agentic AI, IoAI）这一原创性范式——一个开放、异构、跨域协同的智能体生态：代理可在云、边缘、终端设备、组织边界及信息物理系统中动态**相互发现、协商职责、交换语义上下文、调用工具并协同执行复杂工作流**。

## 方法与框架  
我们融合单代理智能体架构、多智能体系统（MAS）、分布式计算、网络协议设计、博弈论与安全工程六大基础领域，系统性构建IoAI的**四层架构模型**：（1）**部署层**（支持容器化、轻量化与跨平台代理运行）；（2）**通信层**（定义轻量级、语义感知的消息协议，支持异步事件驱动与意图协商）；（3）**互操作层**（基于统一代理描述语言与上下文本体实现语义互操作）；（4）**信任与治理层**（整合去中心化身份（DID）、零知识证明验证、激励相容机制与分级治理策略）。

## 关键发现与创新  
通过在**自适应智能制造**（动态产线重配置）与**分布式作战协调**（多军种无人平台协同）两个高保真案例中验证，本框架首次系统揭示了六大核心挑战：**可控涌现性**（避免不可预测的集体行为）、**语义互操作性**（突破API级兼容走向意图级对齐）、**安全可信身份**（抗伪造、可撤销、最小权限的代理身份体系）、**激励相容协调机制**（防止搭便车与策略性欺骗）、**资源感知编排**（实时权衡计算、带宽、能耗与延迟），以及**可扩展治理架构**（支持跨组织、跨主权边界的协作规范演进）。本研究为构建大规模、鲁棒、可信的自主智能体网络提供了首个整合性理论框架与工程路线图。
papers.summary_en: This paper introduces the *Internet of Agentic AI (IoAI)*—a foundational vision for large-scale, open ecosystems of autonomous AI agents that discover, negotiate, coordinate, and act across cloud, edge, device, organizational, and cyber-physical boundaries. Synthesizing insights from multi-agent systems, distributed computing, network protocols, game theory, and security engineering, we propose a four-layer architectural framework addressing deployment models, semantic communication protocols, interoperability via context-aware ontologies, and trust architectures grounded in decentralized identity and incentive-compatible mechanisms. Through case studies in adaptive manufacturing and distributed operational coordination, we identify six core research challenges: controlled emergence, semantic interoperability, secure agent identity, incentive-compatible coordination, resource-aware orchestration, and scalable governance. The IoAI framework provides the first integrated theoretical and engineering foundation for building robust, trustworthy, and cooperative networks of autonomous agents at planetary scale.
