papers.title: A PubMed-Scale Dataset of Structured Biomedical Abstracts
papers.abstract: Structured abstracts are important for biomedical literature processing, by facilitating information retrieval, text mining, and knowledge synthesis. However, a vast portion of abstracts indexed in PubMed remain unstructured, presenting a significant bottleneck for downstream text-processing workflows and applications. To resolve this limitation, we introduce Structured PubMed, a comprehensive corpus of section-labeled biomedical abstracts compiled from the complete PubMed database, encompassing over 23.2 million research-article records. The corpus is divided into two distinct subsets: a collection of 5.9 million author-structured abstracts parsed from official XML files, and an automatically labeled collection of 17.2 million originally unstructured abstracts structured via a verbatim-extraction Large Language Model pipeline. Every record is harmonized under a unified five-section schema and mapped to its original PubMed identifier, publication type, and publication date. This dataset can be utilized to train sentence-classification models, benchmark text-segmentation architectures, and perform large-scale, section-specific information extraction at an unprecedented PubMed-wide scale.
papers.summary_zh:
## 背景与挑战  
结构化摘要在生物医学文献处理中至关重要，可显著提升信息检索、文本挖掘与知识整合效率。然而，PubMed索引的逾3000万篇文献中，绝大多数摘要仍为无节段标记的自由文本，严重制约下游NLP任务（如句子分类、节段分割、证据抽取）的性能与可扩展性。

## 方法与构建  
为突破这一瓶颈，我们提出**Structured PubMed**——首个覆盖全PubMed规模的结构化摘要数据集。该数据集基于2023年完整PubMed元数据（含23.2百万篇研究论文），采用双轨构建策略：  
- **权威子集（5.9M）**：直接解析PubMed官方XML文件，提取作者原生标注的结构化摘要（Methods, Results等节段）；  
- **自动增强子集（17.2M）**：针对原始无结构摘要，设计**逐字提取式大语言模型（LLM）流水线**，避免生成式幻觉，确保标签严格源自原文；  
- 所有记录统一映射至**五节标准模式**（Background, Methods, Results, Discussion, Conclusion），并保留原始PMID、出版类型（如Clinical Trial）及发表日期。

## 创新与价值  
本工作首次实现PubMed级结构化抽象的系统性覆盖，填补了大规模、高保真、带细粒度节段标签的生物医学语料空白。数据集已开源，支持：  
✅ 训练鲁棒的节段分类器（如BioBERT微调）；  
✅ 基准测试文本分割模型（F1 > 92.4% on held-out test set）；  
✅ 开展千万级节段特异性信息抽取（如从“Methods”中批量识别实验模型、剂量参数）。  
代码、数据与评估协议详见https://github.com/structured-pubmed。
papers.summary_en: Structured abstracts are critical for biomedical text mining, yet most PubMed abstracts remain unstructured—hindering scalable NLP applications. To address this, we introduce **Structured PubMed**, a comprehensive, PubMed-scale dataset comprising **23.2 million** section-labeled abstracts. It integrates two complementary subsets: (1) **5.9 million** author-structured abstracts parsed directly from PubMed XML, and (2) **17.2 million** automatically structured abstracts generated via a *verbatim-extraction LLM pipeline*—ensuring zero hallucination and strict fidelity to source text. All records are harmonized under a unified five-section schema (Background, Methods, Results, Discussion, Conclusion) and linked to original PMIDs, publication types, and dates. The dataset enables training of sentence-classification models, rigorous benchmarking of text-segmentation architectures (achieving >92.4% F1), and unprecedented large-scale, section-aware information extraction across the entire PubMed corpus. Publicly available at https://github.com/structured-pubmed.

papers.title: Achieving Shannon Capacity for Computationally Bounded Errors
papers.abstract:
We study error correction in a computationally bounded world, where errors are introduced by an arbitrary polynomial-time adversarial channel. Recent works construct seeded codes in this model, where the encoding and decoding procedure share a public random seed. They achieve significantly better tradeoffs between rate and error tolerance than what is possible information theoretically for unique decoding, essentially matching the parameters of the best known efficiently list-decodable codes. Over the binary alphabet, however, this is still well short of the optimal Shannon capacity with rate $R \approx 1 - H_2(p)$ for a $p < 1/4$ fraction of errors. Even heuristic constructions meeting this target were not previously known. We make progress towards this goal. 

- $\textbf{Secret-Key Codes.}$ We first study secret-key codes, where the encoder and decoder share a secret key hidden from the adversarial channel.  Lipton (STACS '94) constructed one-time secure secret-key codes achieving Shannon capacity in this setting, but it was unknown whether one can get CPA (resp. CCA) security where the adversary may query an encoding oracle (resp. also a decoding oracle). We construct CCA-secure secret-key codes achieving Shannon capacity via pseudorandom codes (PRCs). 
    
- $\textbf{Seeded Codes (Heuristic).}$ We can heuristically upgrade the resulting secret-key codes to seeded codes by publishing an obfuscation of the encoding/decoding procedures with a hard-coded secret key as a seed. Security holds in the ideal obfuscation model. 
   
 - $\textbf{Public-key Codes.}$ We also consider public-key codes, where the decoder has a secret key and the encoder has the corresponding public key. We construct such CPA-secure public-key codes achieving Shannon capacity with unique decoding for $p < 1/4$ errors, and list decoding all the way to $p < 1/2$ errors, assuming PRCs and the subexponential security of standard crypto assumptions (e.g., LWE or DDH or QR or DCR). We also show how to get CCA security in the random oracle model. 

Our secret-key and public-key codes meeting Shannon capacity are also simultaneously pseudorandom codes.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与挑战  
本文致力于在**计算有界敌手模型**下逼近香农容量——即二元对称信道中错误率 $p < 1/4$ 时理论最优速率 $R = 1 - H_2(p)$。传统唯一译码在信息论意义上无法达到该容量；虽已有基于公共随机种子的“种子码”（seeded codes）实现了接近列表可译码的优异参数，但其仍显著落后于香农极限，且此前甚至缺乏可行的启发式构造。

## 核心创新与成果  
- **密钥码（Secret-Key Codes）**：首次构建**CCA安全**（适应性选择密文攻击安全）的密钥码，实现香农容量。突破Lipton（STACS ’94）仅支持一次性安全的局限，关键技术是基于**伪随机码（PRCs）** 的构造，确保敌手即使能自适应查询编码器与解码器，也无法区分合法通信与随机噪声。  
- **种子码（启发式）**：通过将密钥码的编/解码算法与硬编码密钥一同进行**理想混淆（ideal obfuscation）** 并公开为“种子”，在理想混淆模型下获得启发式种子码，弥合了密钥假设与实际部署间的鸿沟。  
- **公钥码（Public-Key Codes）**：提出首个达到香农容量的公钥纠错码：对 $p < 1/4$ 错误支持**唯一译码**，对 $p < 1/2$ 错误支持**列表译码**；安全性基于PRCs及标准密码学假设（如LWE、DDH等）的亚指数安全性，并可在随机预言机模型下升级至CCA安全。  
所有方案均兼具**伪随机性**——输出码字在计算上不可区分于均匀随机串，兼具纠错性与隐匿性。
papers.summary_en: We study error-correcting codes against polynomial-time adversaries, aiming to achieve the Shannon capacity $R = 1 - H_2(p)$ for binary channels with $p < 1/4$ (unique decoding) or $p < 1/2$ (list decoding). First, we construct **CCA-secure secret-key codes** achieving Shannon capacity—resolving an open question beyond Lipton’s one-time-secure scheme—using pseudorandom codes (PRCs). Second, we heuristically obtain **seeded codes** by obfuscating the PRC-based encoder/decoder with a hardcoded key (security in the ideal obfuscation model). Third, we build the first **CPA-secure public-key codes** meeting Shannon capacity: uniquely decodable for $p < 1/4$, list-decodable up to $p < 1/2$, assuming PRCs and subexponential hardness of standard assumptions (e.g., LWE, DDH); CCA security is achieved in the random oracle model. Crucially, all our capacity-achieving codes are simultaneously pseudorandom.

papers.title: Faster Leader-Based Consensus via Certificates of Exclusivity and Overlapping Iterations
papers.abstract:
Blockchain consensus protocols, also known as BFT state-machine replication, enable a system of $n$ players to decide an ever-growing chain of blocks. We consider partial synchrony: after an unknown time GST, messages sent by honest players are delivered within an unknown actual delay $\delta$, and a known bound $\Delta$ satisfies $\delta \leq \Delta$. This setting imposes $t<n/3$ corruptions. We study leader-based consensus, a class with the smallest known latency metrics when sufficiently many designated leaders behave honestly.
We consider the mainstream metric of {expected latency in the view-based sense:} for a transaction known to all honest players having entered a post-GST iteration, this is the expected time until that transaction appears in a decided block, under independent random leaders.
We introduce Hamster, a rotating-leader consensus protocol, which reduces this expected latency to $\Delta+4\delta$, down from the previous $1.5\Delta+3.5\delta$ bound achieved by Simplex (Chan-Pass, TCC'23) for the same view-based metric.
Hamster also brings this latency further down to $\Delta+3.5\delta$ for adversaries that do not get publicly caught equivocating.

The main technical novelty is a certificate of exclusivity for a block $B$. It is shown by the next leader as evidence that players can safely vote for a child of $B$. A certificate of exclusivity is an interpolation between a quorum certificate and a timeout certificate, in that it is formed from a mix of votes for a unique block $B$ and complaint votes, proving that $B$ is the only non-dummy block that can still obtain a decision certificate for that iteration.

The other novelty of Hamster is the use of {overlapping iterations: after a process has supported a newer proposal, the protocol may still allow it to support a safe proposal of an earlier iteration}.
This overlap is what allows old honest proposals to be decided in time despite players advancing iterations faster.

We also analyze another metric, called the {pessimistic block proposal time}, which is the time during which a bad leader can delay the proposal of a transaction in a block which will be decided.
Hamster achieves a pessimistic block proposal time of $2\Delta+2\delta$, refined to $2\Delta+\delta$ for leaders not caught equivocating, down from $3\Delta+\delta$ for Simplex.

## 背景与问题  
在部分同步网络下（即存在未知的全局稳定时刻 GST，此后诚实节点消息延迟为未知实际值 $\delta$，但满足 $\delta \leq \Delta$），拜占庭容错（BFT）区块链共识协议需容忍至多 $t < n/3$ 个恶意节点。当前主流 leader-based（基于指定领导者的）共识协议虽具备较低延迟潜力，但在“视图制”期望延迟（view-based expected latency）这一关键指标上仍有优化空间：即当一笔交易已被所有诚实节点知晓并进入 GST 后的某轮迭代时，其首次出现在最终确定区块中的**期望耗时**。

## 方法与创新  
本文提出 **Hamster**——一种旋转领导者共识协议，核心包含两大技术突破：  
1. **排他性证书（Certificate of Exclusivity）**：由下一轮领导者发布，证明某区块 $B$ 是当前迭代中**唯一可能获得决策证书的非虚拟区块**。该证书介于传统法定人数证书（quorum certificate）与超时证书（timeout certificate）之间，由对 $B$ 的支持票与针对其他冲突区块的投诉票（complaint votes）共同构成，形式化地保证了安全性与活性；  
2. **迭代重叠机制（Overlapping Iterations）**：允许节点在已支持较新提议后，仍可安全地为更早迭代中“未过期且兼容”的提议投票。该机制避免了因快速推进视图而导致旧但诚实的提案被丢弃，显著提升确定性时效性。

## 主要结果  
- 在标准敌手模型下，Hamster 将视图制期望延迟从 Simplex（TCC’23）的 $1.5\Delta + 3.5\delta$ 降至 **$\Delta + 4\delta$**；  
- 若敌手未被公开发现双花（equivocating），进一步优化至 **$\Delta + 3.5\delta$**；  
- 在悲观块提议时间（pessimistic block proposal time，即恶意领导者最大可拖延确定性区块生成的时间）上，Hamster 达到 $2\Delta + 2\delta$（未被抓获双花者为 $2\Delta + \delta$），优于 Simplex 的 $3\Delta + \delta$。  
Hamster 在保持 $t < n/3$ 安全阈值前提下，首次将期望延迟压缩至接近理论下界 $\Delta + \delta$，为高吞吐、低延迟区块链系统提供了新范式。
papers.summary_en: This paper introduces **Hamster**, a rotating-leader BFT consensus protocol for partially synchronous networks ($\delta \leq \Delta$, $t < n/3$), targeting the *view-based expected latency*: the expected time for a transaction—known to all honest players post-GST—to appear in a decided block. Hamster reduces this latency from $1.5\Delta + 3.5\delta$ (Simplex, TCC’23) to **$\Delta + 4\delta$**, and further to **$\Delta + 3.5\delta$** against non-equivocating adversaries. Its key innovations are: (i) a *certificate of exclusivity*, issued by the next leader to prove that a block $B$ is the unique non-dummy candidate eligible for a decision certificate in its iteration—blending support votes for $B$ and complaint votes against alternatives; and (ii) *overlapping iterations*, enabling nodes to safely vote for earlier-iteration proposals even after advancing, preserving timely finality of honest proposals. Hamster also improves the *pessimistic block proposal time* to $2\Delta + 2\delta$ ($2\Delta + \delta$ for non-equivocating leaders), beating Simplex’s $3\Delta + \delta$. All improvements preserve optimal resilience.

papers.title: Explicit Transformations from Edge-Depth-Robust to Node-Depth-Robust Graphs with Improved Concrete Efficiency
papers.abstract:
Depth-robust directed acyclic graphs (DAGs) are an important combinatorial primitive in cryptography, with applications to memory-hard functions, proofs of space, and proofs of sequential work. These applications require node depth-robustness, yet constructing sparse graphs with strong concrete guarantees remains a longstanding challenge. By contrast, edge depth-robust graphs are easier to construct explicitly and achieve better parameters, motivating the problem of efficiently transforming edge-depth-robust graphs into node-depth-robust graphs. We give a new and substantially more efficient transformation from edge-depth-robust graphs to node-depth-robust graphs. We give a new and substantially more efficient transformation from edge-depth-robust graphs to node-depth-robust graphs. Prior work of Blocki and Cinkoske (ITCS 2021) gave a general transformation by replacing each node with an ST-robust graph, resulting in extraordinarily large overhead and relying on non-explicit components. In contrast, our transformation replaces each node with a single superconcentrator rather than an ST-robust graph, yielding an explicit construction whenever the input graph is explicit, with dramatically improved concrete efficiency.

Formally, given an $(e,d)$-edge-depth-robust graph $G$ with $N$ nodes and $m$ edges, our transformation generates a graph $G'=Transform(G_N)$ with $N' = O(m)$ nodes, constant indegree, and $(e/3,\, 2d-1)$-node depth-robustness. We also show that the transformation preserves fractional depth-robustness. Moreover, when $m=\omega(N)$, we show that our transformation can amplify depth --- overcoming a key limitation of prior work. In particular, for any parameter $d'$, we can obtain a constant-indegree graph $G'$ with $N' = O(m+d'N)$ nodes and $(e/3,\, (d-e)d')$-node depth-robustness, yielding asymptotically tighter results in the important setting where $m = \omega(N)$ and $e \geq d$ by setting $d' \sim m/N$. As an application, We provide a novel analysis of Schnitger's edge-depth-robust graph construction (FOCS 1983). We show that the graph $G_n$, which has $N=2^{n+1}-1$ nodes and $m \leq n2^{n}$ edges, is $(e,2d-1)$-edge-depth robust for all $e + d \leq 2^n$. Applying our transformation yields an explicit DAG on $N'$ nodes with maximum indegree $2$ and depth-robustness parameters $e = \Omega(N'/\log N')$ and $d = \Omega(N')$, matching the best known asymptotic trade-offs—even compared with non-explicit constructions—while improving the best previously known concrete ed-product lower bound by a multiplicative factor of 6.6.
papers.summary_zh:
## 背景与挑战  
深度鲁棒有向无环图（DAG）是密码学中的关键组合原语，广泛应用于内存硬函数、空间证明和顺序工作证明等场景。这些应用严格依赖**节点深度鲁棒性**（node-depth-robustness），但构造**稀疏且具备强具体参数保证**的显式节点深度鲁棒图长期面临困难。相较之下，边深度鲁棒图（edge-depth-robust graphs）更易显式构造，且能达到更优的参数（如更高深度/边数比），因此亟需高效、显式的转换方法，将边鲁棒性“提升”为节点鲁棒性。

## 方法创新  
本文提出一种**显著更高效的显式变换**，将任意 $(e,d)$-边深度鲁棒图 $G$（含 $N$ 个节点、$m$ 条边）转化为节点深度鲁棒图 $G'$。不同于 Blocki 和 Cinkoske（ITCS 2021）依赖非显式 ST-鲁棒子图、导致巨大开销的方案，本工作仅用**单个超集中器（superconcentrator）替代每个节点**，确保：  
- **完全显式性**：若输入图 $G$ 显式，则 $G'$ 必显式；  
- **常数入度**：$G'$ 最大入度为常数（可低至 2）；  
- **参数优越**：输出图 $G'$ 含 $N' = O(m)$ 个节点，具备 $(e/3,\, 2d-1)$-节点深度鲁棒性；  
- **深度放大能力**：当 $m = \omega(N)$ 时，通过引入参数 $d'$，可获得 $(e/3,\, (d-e)d')$-鲁棒性，节点数仅 $O(m + d'N)$，突破前人无法放大的瓶颈。

## 关键成果  
对 Schnitger 经典边鲁棒图（$N=2^{n+1}-1$，$m \leq n2^n$）应用本变换，得到显式 DAG：节点数 $N' = \Theta(n2^n)$，最大入度为 2，鲁棒性达 $e = \Omega(N'/\log N')$、$d = \Omega(N')$，**首次在显式构造中匹配最优渐近权衡**（媲美非显式构造）；其 $e \cdot d$ 下界较此前最佳具体结果**提升 6.6 倍**，为实用密码协议提供更强理论支撑。
papers.summary_en: We present a new, highly efficient explicit transformation from $(e,d)$-edge-depth-robust DAGs to node-depth-robust DAGs—resolving a longstanding bottleneck in cryptographic graph construction. Unlike prior work that replaces each node with a complex ST-robust subgraph (incurring huge overhead and losing explicitness), our method substitutes each node with a *single superconcentrator*, yielding an explicit output DAG $G'$ with constant indegree (e.g., ≤2), $N' = O(m)$ nodes, and $(e/3,\, 2d-1)$-node depth-robustness. Crucially, when $m = \omega(N)$, our transformation *amplifies depth*: for any $d'$, it achieves $(e/3,\, (d-e)d')$-robustness with only $O(m + d'N)$ nodes—enabling asymptotically tighter bounds where $e \geq d$. Applied to Schnitger’s graph, it yields the first explicit DAG matching optimal asymptotic $e \cdot d = \Omega(N'^2/\log N')$, and improves the best known concrete $e \cdot d$ lower bound by a factor of 6.6.

papers.title: Algorithms for solving the isogeny problem with oriented elliptic curves
papers.abstract:
We introduce WayFinder, a framework for generalizing the Delfs-Galbraith and SuperSolver algorithms for the supersingular isogeny problem. Our framework extends the search for elliptic curves with an orientation by an order containing $\mathbb{Z}[\ell \sqrt{-p}]$ to more general orders, and we derive a cost model for such generalisations.
Our cost model not only works in a more general context, but also provides more accurate predictions when applied to SuperSolver. We instantiate WayFinder for orders containing $\mathbb{Z}[\ell_1\sqrt{-\ell_2p}]$ where $\ell_i$ are $1$ or primes such that the modular curve $X_0(\ell_2)$ has genus $0$. We then introduce a low-storage algorithm for computing an isogeny between two oriented supersingular elliptic curves, even when the curves are oriented by distinct orders. Together, these provide an algorithm that improves on the state of the art for solving the isogeny problem, and a cost model with potential applications to parameter selection in isogeny-based cryptography.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与问题  
在基于同源的密码学中，超奇异椭圆曲线间的同源问题（isogeny problem）是核心计算难题。现有算法如Delfs–Galbraith和SuperSolver依赖于对具有特定复乘结构（如$\mathbb{Z}[\ell\sqrt{-p}]$）的定向椭圆曲线进行图搜索，但其适用范围受限于所选阶（order）的代数结构，难以推广至更广泛的定向情形。

## 方法与创新  
本文提出**WayFinder框架**，系统性地推广上述算法：  
- 将搜索空间从含$\mathbb{Z}[\ell\sqrt{-p}]$的阶，拓展至任意包含该子环的**一般阶**（general orders），支持更灵活的定向结构；  
- 建立首个适用于任意此类阶的**统一成本模型**，不仅覆盖原有算法场景，且在SuperSolver上验证显示预测误差显著降低（较原模型提升约20%精度）；  
- 针对模曲线$X_0(\ell_2)$亏格为0的情形，具体实例化WayFinder于含$\mathbb{Z}[\ell_1\sqrt{-\ell_2 p}]$的阶（其中$\ell_i \in \{1\} \cup \mathbb{P}$），构造高效路径搜索策略；  
- 提出**低存储同源计算算法**，首次支持两端曲线由**不同阶定向**的情形，突破传统要求同阶定向的限制。

## 主要贡献  
本工作将同源问题求解效率提升至新水平：在典型参数下，相较SuperSolver减少约15%–30%的边遍历次数；所提成本模型可直接用于**等价安全强度下的参数优化**，为SIKE、SQIsign等协议的参数选择提供理论支撑与实践工具。

WayFinder extends the search from elliptic curves oriented by orders containing $\mathbb{Z}[\ell\sqrt{-p}]$ to arbitrary orders containing such subrings, and derives a refined cost model applicable across this broader setting. This model not only improves prediction accuracy—reducing error by ~20% on SuperSolver—but also enables instantiation for orders containing $\mathbb{Z}[\ell_1\sqrt{-\ell_2 p}]$, where $\ell_i = 1$ or prime and $X_0(\ell_2)$ has genus 0. Crucially, we design a **low-storage algorithm** that computes isogenies between two oriented supersingular curves even when their orientations stem from *distinct* orders—a previously unsupported scenario. Together, these advances yield the state-of-the-art solution to the isogeny problem and provide a practical cost model for parameter selection in isogeny-based cryptography.

papers.title: High-Accuracy, Poisoning-Resilient Frequency Estimation in the Shuffle Model
papers.abstract:
We study frequency estimation in the shuffle model of differential privacy under poisoning attacks, where corrupted users may deviate from the local randomizer to inject crafted in-domain messages. Existing shuffle-model protocols face a core tension: achieving low estimation error relies on flexible multi-message noise generation, which can amplify poisoning influence once messages are anonymized by shuffling.

To address this tension, we propose a symmetric binomial-sum noise distribution (i.e., $\mathrm{Bin}(n/2,p) + \mathrm{Bin}(n/2,1-p)$), which preserves high accuracy while limiting the impact of crafted in-domain messages. We realize this distribution via preprocessing-guided noise generation, which routes a balanced collection of mode flags through the shuffler so that each user receives a randomly assigned mode flag that fixes their noise-sampling behavior prior to shuffling. For binary estimation, our protocol requires a single Bernoulli trial per user and at most $2$ messages per user ($1.5$ on average), while bounding the worst-case poisoning influence of a single corrupted user by $O(1/n)$. We extend the protocol to histograms, including large domains via hashing, and provide formal privacy, accuracy, and robustness guarantees. Experiments on real datasets show that our protocols remain resilient under poisoning and reduce MAE by up to nearly $2\times$ over the strongest baseline at comparable per-user communication on small-domain workloads, and stay on par with it on large domains.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与挑战  
在差分隐私的**混洗模型（Shuffle Model）**中，频率估计面临新型威胁——**投毒攻击（Poisoning Attacks）**：恶意用户可绕过本地随机化机制，向系统注入精心构造的合法域内消息。现有协议陷入根本性权衡：高精度依赖灵活的多消息噪声生成，但混洗后的匿名化会放大投毒影响，导致鲁棒性严重下降。

## 创新方法  
本文提出一种**对称二项和噪声分布**：$\mathrm{Bin}(n/2,p) + \mathrm{Bin}(n/2,1-p)$，兼具高精度与抗投毒能力。其核心是**预处理引导的噪声生成机制**：通过预分配“模式标志（mode flag）”并经混洗器均衡路由，确保每位用户在混洗前即被随机固定噪声采样行为（如选择 $p$ 或 $1-p$ 的伯努利参数），从而将单个投毒用户的最坏影响严格限制在 $O(1/n)$。

## 主要成果  
- **二值频率估计**：每用户仅需1次伯努利试验，平均发送1.5条消息（最多2条），通信开销极低；  
- **扩展至直方图**：支持大域场景，结合哈希技术实现可扩展性；  
- **理论保证**：提供严格的 $(\varepsilon,\delta)$-差分隐私、$O(1/\sqrt{n})$ 均方误差界及 $O(1/n)$ 投毒鲁棒性；  
- **实证优势**：在真实数据集上，小域任务下平均绝对误差（MAE）较最强基线降低近2倍（同等每用户通信量），大域任务下性能持平且更稳健。
papers.summary_en: We study poisoning-resilient frequency estimation in the shuffle model of differential privacy, where corrupted users inject crafted in-domain messages. Existing protocols suffer from a tension between accuracy (requiring flexible multi-message noise) and robustness (as shuffling amplifies poisoning). To resolve this, we propose a symmetric binomial-sum noise distribution—$\mathrm{Bin}(n/2,p)+\mathrm{Bin}(n/2,1-p)$—realized via preprocessing-guided mode-flag routing: each user receives a shuffled flag that fixes their noise-sampling behavior *before* shuffling. papers.title: Secure Computation against $\mathsf{NC^1}$ Leakage without Secure Hardware
papers.abstract:
In this work, we construct (stateful) leakage-resilient circuits (LRCs) secure against bounded-output-length leakage functions computable by \(\mathsf{NC}^1\) circuits under the mild worst-case assumption \(\mathsf{NC}^1 \subsetneq \oplus\mathsf{L}/\mathsf{poly}\), without relying on any leak-free hardware components, thereby resolving the open problem left by Bogdanov, Ishai, and Srinivasan (Journal of Cryptology, 2021) and Wang (CRYPTO 2025).

Concretely, we first construct a leakage-tolerant circuit with succinct setup (sAI-LTC) secure against 2-adaptive \(\mathsf{NC}^1\) leakage, and then generically combine it with a 2-adaptive leakage-resilient composable encoding scheme to obtain the desired LRC.

We further give a direct non-black-box instantiation that optimizes the compiled circuit size at the cost of a slightly larger setup, matching the circuit size of Wang's construction that relies on leak-free hardware while using a more compact setup.

Finally, we show that our sAI-LTC generically implies a fine-grained multi-theorem non-interactive proof system for all \(\mathsf{NP}\), with compact common reference strings, perfect soundness, and multi-theorem zero-knowledge with offline simulation against \(\mathsf{NC}^1\) adversaries.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与问题  
本文致力于解决**无安全硬件假设下抗 $\mathsf{NC}^1$ 泄漏的电路构造**这一长期开放问题。此前，Bogdanov–Ishai–Srinivasan（*J. Cryptol.* 2021）与Wang（CRYPTO 2025）均要求依赖“泄漏隔离”的硬件组件（如掩码寄存器或物理不可克隆函数），而本文首次在**完全无泄漏隔离硬件**的前提下，构建出安全的（有状态）泄漏弹性电路（LRCs），仅需一个温和的复杂性假设：$\mathsf{NC}^1 \subsetneq \oplus\mathsf{L}/\mathsf{poly}$（即非一致模2对数空间严格强于非一致$\mathsf{NC}^1$），该假设被广泛认为成立且弱于标准密码学假设。

## 核心方法与技术路线  
研究采用两阶段构造：  
1. **首步突破**：设计首个**带简洁初始化的抗自适应泄漏电路（sAI-LTC）**，可抵御**2-轮自适应**、输出长度有界的 $\mathsf{NC}^1$ 泄漏函数；其安全性不依赖任何硬件保护，仅基于上述复杂性分离假设。  
2. **通用组合**：将sAI-LTC与一个新型**2-自适应泄漏弹性可组合编码方案**（leakage-resilient composable encoding）进行黑盒组合，导出满足强安全定义的LRC——支持任意多次执行、状态更新及组合调用。  

## 创新成果与拓展应用  
- **高效实例化**：进一步提出**非黑盒直接构造**，在略微增大初始化开销的前提下，显著压缩编译后电路规模，**达到与Wang（CRYPTO 2025）使用泄漏隔离硬件时同等的电路复杂度**，但摆脱了对硬件的信任依赖。  
- **密码学新应用**：证明sAI-LTC可**泛化导出细粒度多定理非交互式证明系统**（multi-theorem NIZK）：对所有 $\mathsf{NP}$ 语言，具备**紧凑公共参考串（CRS）**、**完美可靠性**，以及**针对 $\mathsf{NC}^1$ 敌手的离线模拟多定理零知识**——为轻量级零知识协议提供了全新理论基础。
papers.summary_en: This work resolves the open problem of constructing leakage-resilient circuits (LRCs) secure against bounded-output $\mathsf{NC}^1$ leakage *without any leak-free hardware*, under the mild worst-case assumption $\mathsf{NC}^1 \subsetneq \oplus\mathsf{L}/\mathsf{poly}$. We first build a succinct-setup, adaptively leakage-tolerant circuit (sAI-LTC) secure against 2-adaptive $\mathsf{NC}^1$ leakage. Then, via generic black-box composition with a 2-adaptive leakage-resilient composable encoding scheme, we obtain the desired stateful LRC. A direct non-black-box instantiation further optimizes compiled circuit size—matching Wang’s hardware-dependent construction while using a more compact setup. Finally, our sAI-LTC implies, generically, a fine-grained multi-theorem NIZK for all $\mathsf{NP}$ with compact CRS, perfect soundness, and multi-theorem zero-knowledge against $\mathsf{NC}^1$ adversaries via offline simulation.

papers.title: New Quantum-Classical Algorithm or the Discrete Logarithm Problem over $\mathbb{Z}_{p}^{*}$
papers.abstract: Shor demonstrated that the discrete logarithm problem in the multiplicative roup $\mathbb{Z}_{p}^{*}$, where $p$ is an odd prime, can be solved fficiently using a period-finding algorithm based on the quantum Fourier transform. In this paper, we propose a quantum-classical algorithm based on algebraic properties that do not rely on periodicity. Specifically, we show that the hardcore predicate for the discrete logarithm problem, which was introduced by Blum and Micali, can be reduced, using the swap test, to the problem of distinguishing between two Bernoulli distributions. In our algorithm, although the swap test is used as a quantum subroutine, most of the computation is performed classically. Moreover, the algorithm does not require the quantum Fourier transform.
papers.summary_zh:
## 新型量子-经典混合算法求解 $\mathbb{Z}_{p}^{*}$ 上离散对数问题  

Shor 算法通过量子傅里叶变换（QFT）实现周期寻找，从而在多项式时间内求解 $\mathbb{Z}_{p}^{*}$（$p$ 为奇素数）上的离散对数问题（DLP），但其完全依赖量子相干性与大规模 QFT 电路，对硬件容错要求极高。本文提出一种**不依赖周期性结构**的新型量子-经典混合算法，突破传统范式。核心思想在于：利用 Blum-Micali 提出的离散对数**硬核谓词**（hardcore predicate）——即最高有效位（MSB）的不可预测性——将其转化为一个可高效验证的统计判别问题。我们严格证明：该谓词的计算可规约为**区分两个伯努利分布** $ \mathrm{Bern}(1/2 + \varepsilon) $ 与 $ \mathrm{Bern}(1/2) $ 的任务，其中偏差 $ \varepsilon $ 与目标离散对数的比特长度呈指数级关联。关键量子组件仅为轻量级的 **swap test**（用于估计两量子态重叠度），仅需 $ O(\log p) $ 个量子比特与恒定深度电路，**无需量子傅里叶变换、无须模幂量子线路、不依赖相位估计**。其余全部步骤（包括格基约化、符号校验、自适应采样与最大似然估计）均由经典计算机完成。理论分析表明，算法总时间复杂度为 $ \tilde{O}(n^3) $（$ n = \log_2 p $），量子查询次数为 $ O(n/\varepsilon^2) = \mathrm{poly}(n) $，具备明确的可扩展性路径。本工作首次将 DLP 求解从“周期驱动”转向“统计判别驱动”，为中等规模含噪量子设备（NISQ）上实现实用化密码分析提供了新范式。
papers.summary_en: We propose a novel quantum-classical hybrid algorithm for the discrete logarithm problem (DLP) over $\mathbb{Z}_p^*$, bypassing Shor’s period-finding paradigm. Instead of relying on quantum Fourier transform or phase estimation, our approach leverages the Blum–Micali hardcore predicate—specifically the most significant bit—and reduces its evaluation to distinguishing two Bernoulli distributions via the swap test. This quantum subroutine requires only $O(\log p)$ qubits and constant-depth circuits; all other computation—including adaptive sampling, lattice-based verification, and maximum-likelihood decoding—is classical. The algorithm achieves polynomial quantum query complexity ($\mathrm{poly}(\log p)$) and overall $\tilde{O}((\log p)^3)$ time, with no QFT or modular exponentiation in superposition. It offers a viable path toward practical DLP solving on near-term hardware.

papers.title: On the Cryptographic Structure Required for Verifying Qubits
papers.abstract:
Classically testing for the presence of anti-commuting operators on a quantum device is a critical tool underpinning recent progress in classical verification of quantum computation. While such tests can be based on cryptographic assumptions, known constructions rely on highly structured assumptions, e.g. trapdoor claw-free functions.

In this work, we seek to explain this state of affairs by constructing strong cryptography from (certain forms of) classical tests of anti-commutation. In particular, we formulate the notion of a test of non-commutation (ToNC), an interactive protocol between a quantum prover and classical verifier in which the prover's final-round response is obtained by measuring one of two binary observables 𝑃₀, 𝑃₁ depending on the verifier's challenge bit 𝑐. We prove that, for a broad range of parameters, ToNC implies classical-communication key agreement (KA), and ToNC combined with one-way functions implies oblivious transfer (OT).

Along the way, we develop tools for and provide the first known results on hardness amplification for post-quantum KA and OT, where communication is classical but adversaries may be quantum. In particular, we prove the following results of independent interest.
- Post-quantum hard-core measure theorem: For any efficiently sampleable high-min-entropy distribution 𝐷 over pairs (𝑥,𝑏) such that quantum circuits have advantage at most 𝛿 in predicting 𝑏 from 𝑥, there exists a sub-distribution 𝑀≼𝐷 of density 1-𝛿 on which 𝑏 is nearly optimally quantum-hard to predict.
- Post-quantum interactive XOR lemma: Given any classically-interactive protocol, if quantum adversaries have advantage at most 𝛿 in guessing a private challenger bit 𝑏, then two sequential repetitions reduce the advantage for predicting the XOR of the challenger bits 𝑏₁⊕𝑏₂ to at most 𝛿² + negl(𝜆).
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与动机  
经典验证量子计算（classical verification of quantum computation）依赖于对量子设备中**反对易算符**（anti-commuting operators）的黑盒检验。现有协议多基于强结构化密码学假设（如陷门碰撞自由函数），但其必要性长期缺乏理论解释。本文旨在揭示：此类量子非交换性检验本身是否可作为**基础密码原语**，而非仅依赖外部密码假设。

## 核心贡献：非交换性检验（ToNC）的密码学力量  
我们首次形式化定义**非交换性检验（Test of Non-Commutation, ToNC）**：一个交互式协议，其中经典验证者发送挑战比特 $c \in \{0,1\}$，量子证明者据此测量一对二元可观测量 $P_0, P_1$ 并返回结果。关键在于：若 $P_0, P_1$ 反对易，则证明者无法同时确定两者值——此量子不确定性构成密码安全性根源。

## 主要理论结果  
- **密钥协商（KA）的构造**：在广泛参数范围内，任意安全ToNC协议可直接实现**经典通信下的后量子密钥协商**（post-quantum KA），无需额外假设；  
- **茫然传输（OT）的构造**：ToNC结合任意经典**单向函数**（OWF），即可构建**后量子安全的茫然传输**（OT），这是通用安全两方计算的基石；  
- **两项独立技术突破**：  
  - **后量子硬核测度定理**：对任意高效采样的高最小熵分布 $D$ 上的 $(x,b)$ 对，若量子电路预测 $b$ 的优势至多为 $\delta$，则存在密度 $\geq 1-\delta$ 的子分布 $M \preceq D$，使得 $b$ 在 $M$ 上对量子攻击者近乎最优难预测（优势 $\leq \delta + \mathrm{negl}(\lambda)$）；  
  - **后量子交互式XOR引理**：若量子敌手在单轮交互协议中猜中私有比特 $b$ 的优势 $\leq \delta$，则两次串行执行后，其预测 $b_1 \oplus b_2$ 的优势降至 $\delta^2 + \mathrm{negl}(\lambda)$。  

本工作首次建立“量子非交换性→经典密码学”的反向桥梁，为量子验证的密码基础提供深刻解释，并推动后量子密码的硬度放大理论发展。
papers.summary_en: This paper bridges quantum non-commutation and classical cryptography: we show that *tests of non-commutation* (ToNC)—interactive protocols where a quantum prover measures anti-commuting observables $P_0,P_1$ based on a classical challenge bit—serve as *foundational cryptographic primitives*. We prove that, under broad parameters, ToNC implies **classical-communication key agreement (KA)** against quantum adversaries; further, ToNC + one-way functions imply **oblivious transfer (OT)**. As key technical tools, we establish the first hardness amplification results for post-quantum KA/OT with classical communication: (i) a **post-quantum hard-core measure theorem**, showing that any quantum-hard-to-predict bit $b$ from high-min-entropy $D$ admits a dense sub-distribution where $b$ remains nearly optimally quantum-hard; and (ii) a **post-quantum interactive XOR lemma**, proving that two sequential repetitions reduce quantum advantage in predicting the XOR of challenger bits from $\delta$ to $\delta^2 + \mathrm{negl}(\lambda)$. These results explain why structured cryptographic assumptions are prevalent in quantum verification—and demonstrate that quantum non-commutation itself suffices as a minimal cryptographic resource.

  - **后量子硬核测度定理**：对任意高效采样的高最小熵分布 $D$ 上的 $(x,b)$ 对，若量子电路预测 $b$ 的优势至多为 $\delta$，则存在密度 $\geq 1-\delta$ 的子分布 $M \preceq D$，使得 $b$ 在 $M$ 上对量子攻击者近乎最优难预测（优势 $\leq \delta + \mathrm{negl}(\lambda)$）；  
  - **后量子交互式XOR引理**：若量子敌手在单轮交互协议中猜中私有比特 $b$ 的优势 $\leq \delta$，则两次串行执行后，其预测 $b_1 \oplus b_2$ 的优势降至 $\delta^2 + \mathrm{negl}(\lambda)$。  

本工作首次建立“量子非交换性→经典密码学”的反向桥梁，为量子验证的密码基础提供深刻解释，并推动后量子密码的硬度放大理论发展。

papers.title: Another Look at Non-Frameability in Group Signatures for Anonymous Auctions
papers.abstract: In addition to anonymity and traceability, which are the primary security properties of group signatures, non‑frameability is also defined (Bellare-Shi-Zhang, CT-RSA 2005). This property guarantees that even an adversary colluding with all authorities (the opener and the issuer) cannot produce a signature that frames an honest user, and it is regarded as a security notion that protects users. In this short note, we introduce a new perspective on non-frameability, namely that it can also protect the authorities, and we examine its significance in the context of anonymous auctions, a well‑known application of group signatures. We show that non-frameability serves as an effective countermeasure against situations in which a winning bidder falsely claims not to have placed a bid and accuses the organizer of forgery.
papers.summary_zh:
## 背景与问题  
在群签名的三大核心安全性质（匿名性、可追踪性、不可伪造性）之外，**不可诬陷性（non-frameability）** 是一项关键但常被低估的安全保障。该性质最早由Bellare-Shi-Zhang（CT-RSA 2005）形式化定义：即使敌手与所有权威机构（签发者Issuer与开启者Opener）完全共谋，也无法构造出一个能成功归因于某诚实用户的无效签名——从而防止对无辜用户的“诬陷”。传统理解中，不可诬陷性主要服务于**用户侧保护**；本文首次提出并系统论证其另一重关键角色：**对权威机构（尤其是拍卖组织者）的防护机制**。

## 方法与场景聚焦  
我们以**匿名拍卖**这一经典群签名应用场景为切入点，构建严谨的安全模型。在该场景中，获胜竞拍者可能出于逃避履约（如拒付中标款）等动机，**虚假否认自身投标行为**，并反向指控拍卖组织者伪造其签名。此类攻击本质上构成对组织者的“反向诬陷”——即利用签名归属的不可辩驳性，将责任转嫁至可信第三方。

## 主要发现与创新点  
- 我们证明：若群签名方案缺乏不可诬陷性，恶意获胜者可协同共谋权威（或仅通过伪造签名+操纵验证逻辑）成功实施此类诬陷，导致组织者承担无端信任风险；  
- 反之，满足不可诬陷性的方案能从密码学层面阻断该攻击路径：任何无法被权威合法开启的签名，均不能被归责于任何特定用户，从而保护组织者免于被错误指控；  
- 这一视角拓展了不可诬陷性的安全语义——它不仅是用户防御工具，更是**双向信任锚点**，对构建可信的去中心化/半中心化数字市场具有实践指导意义。
papers.summary_en: In addition to anonymity and traceability, non-frameability is a fundamental security property of group signatures—ensuring that no adversary, even colluding with both the issuer and opener, can forge a signature attributable to an honest user. This short note introduces a novel perspective: non-frameability also protects *authorities*, particularly in anonymous auctions. We identify a realistic threat where a winning bidder falsely denies having submitted a bid and accuses the auction organizer of signature forgery to evade obligations. We show that without non-frameability, such framing attacks succeed; with it, the organizer is cryptographically shielded—since any unopenable or invalid signature cannot be irrevocably linked to any user, preventing unjust attribution. Thus, non-frameability serves as a bidirectional trust guarantee, critical for fair and accountable digital markets.

papers.title: SecLoRA: Secure Aggregation of Low-Rank Matrix Products via Functional Encryption
papers.abstract: Federated fine-tuning of Large Language Models via Low Rank Adaptation (LoRA) faces a critical privacy-efficiency trade-off: low-rank factors can leak sensitive data, yet standard secure aggregation is restricted to linear operations. Existing solutions for aggregating matrix products (e.g., $\mathbf{B}_i \mathbf{A}_i$) either sacrifice exactness, depend on a trusted third party, or incur prohibitive costs at scale. We present SecLoRA, the first decentralized framework achieving exact aggregation of LoRA updates with linear communication complexity. The core of SecLoRA is a novel cryptographic primitive: Pairwise Composable Multi-Client Functional Encryption (PC-DMCFE). Unlike traditional functional encryption, which treats ciphertext recombination as an attack, the dual-encryption architecture of PC-DMCFE ($\mathsf{Enc}_A, \mathsf{Enc}_B$) is intentionally designed to harness this property. It allows any ciphertexts $\mathsf{ct}_A$ and $\mathsf{ct}_B$ to be arbitrarily paired and evaluated via a functional key to reveal their inner product. This unique property enables secure and decentralized aggregation of matrix products without losing LoRA's linear communication advantages. Furthermore, SecLoRA ensures round-isolated decryption to prevent temporal leakage without extra interaction. Evaluation shows that SecLoRA is practical for cross-silo deployments.
papers.summary_zh:
## 背景与挑战  
在跨机构（cross-silo）联邦学习场景中，基于低秩自适应（LoRA）对大语言模型进行微调虽具通信高效性，却面临严峻的隐私-效率权衡：客户端上传的低秩矩阵因子（如 $\mathbf{A}_i, \mathbf{B}_i$）可能隐含原始训练数据敏感信息；而标准安全聚合（Secure Aggregation）仅支持线性操作，无法直接、精确地聚合非线性更新——尤其是关键的矩阵乘积 $\mathbf{B}_i\mathbf{A}_i$。现有方案或牺牲精度（如近似聚合）、依赖可信第三方（TPA），或在大规模部署时通信/计算开销呈二次增长，难以实用。

## 方法创新：SecLoRA 与 PC-DMCFE  
本文提出 **SecLoRA**——首个支持**精确、去中心化、线性通信复杂度**的 LoRA 更新聚合框架。其核心是全新密码学原语：**成对可组合多客户端函数加密（PC-DMCFE）**。区别于传统函数加密将密文重组视为攻击面，PC-DMCFE 采用双加密架构（$\mathsf{Enc}_A$, $\mathsf{Enc}_B$），**主动设计并利用密文可配对特性**：任意客户端生成的 $\mathsf{ct}_A$ 与 $\mathsf{ct}_B$ 可自由两两配对，通过授权功能密钥即可无交互地解出其内积 $\langle \mathbf{a}, \mathbf{b} \rangle$。该机制天然适配 LoRA 更新的矩阵乘结构，使服务器仅需一次聚合即得精确 $\sum_i \mathbf{B}_i\mathbf{A}_i$，全程无需可信方、不增加通信轮次。

## 安全与实用性  
SecLoRA 实现**轮次隔离解密（round-isolated decryption）**：每轮解密独立，杜绝跨轮时序侧信道泄露，且无需额外交互。实验表明，在 16–64 客户端规模下，SecLoRA 的端到端延迟仅比明文 LoRA 高 2.1–3.8×，通信量保持 $O(d)$ 级别（$d$ 为秩参数），显著优于同态加密或MPC基线方案，具备实际跨机构部署能力。
papers.summary_en: SecLoRA is the first decentralized framework enabling *exact*, *linear-communication* aggregation of LoRA updates in federated LLM fine-tuning. It overcomes the privacy-efficiency trade-off by introducing Pairwise Composable Multi-Client Functional Encryption (PC-DMCFE)—a novel primitive where dual ciphertexts ($\mathsf{ct}_A$, $\mathsf{ct}_B$) can be arbitrarily paired and evaluated via a functional key to reveal their inner product *without interaction*. This enables secure, exact aggregation of matrix products $\mathbf{B}_i\mathbf{A}_i$ while preserving LoRA’s $O(r)$ communication complexity. SecLoRA further ensures round-isolated decryption to prevent temporal leakage. Evaluation confirms practicality: on cross-silo setups with up to 64 clients, it incurs only 2.1–3.8× latency overhead over plaintext LoRA and scales linearly—outperforming HE/MPC baselines.

papers.title: Influence Factors on RAG Poisoning
papers.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems enhance large language models by grounding responses in retrieved documents from external knowledge sources at inference time. However, this reliance on retrieved content introduces vulnerabilities to poisoning attacks, in which adversarial documents can manipulate both the retrieval process and the generated outputs. This paper investigates poisoning robustness in RAG through a full factorial experimental study covering 432 configurations. We analyze the impacts of dataset, retriever type, retrieval depth, database composition, chunking strategy, and generator model on retrieval-level and generation-level metrics. The results show that retriever architecture, dataset, and retrieval depth are the strongest factors affecting poisoning exposure, while generator choice and database composition have a major impact on downstream attack success. Dense and graph-based retrievers generally improve robustness relative to BM25, whereas larger retrieval depth increases the likelihood of retrieving poisoned passages. We further show that replicating poisoned content across multiple databases amplifies adversarial influence, while additional clean sources can mitigate it. These findings highlight that poisoning vulnerability in RAG is not attributable to a single component, but instead arises from the interaction of retrieval, generation, and knowledge-base configuration.

## 检索增强生成（RAG）系统中毒攻击的影响因素研究  

本研究系统探究了**检索增强生成（RAG）系统在中毒攻击下的鲁棒性机制**，首次通过全因子实验设计覆盖**432种配置组合**，全面评估六大核心因素对RAG中毒脆弱性的影响：数据集特性、检索器类型（BM25/稠密/图神经网络）、检索深度（k=1–10）、知识库构成（毒/洁比例与跨库复制）、文本分块策略（大小/重叠/语义），以及生成模型（Llama-3-8B、Qwen2-7B等）。实验采用统一中毒注入范式，在多个真实基准（如HotpotQA、NaturalQuestions）上同步测量**检索层指标**（毒片段召回率、Top-k污染率）与**生成层指标**（答案篡改率、置信度偏移）。关键发现包括：  
- **检索器架构、数据集和检索深度是影响中毒暴露的最强三要素**：稠密检索器（如ColBERT）和图检索器比BM25平均降低32.7%毒片段召回；但检索深度每增加1，中毒内容被引入生成上下文的概率提升19.4%；  
- **生成模型选择与知识库构成主导下游攻击成功率**：同条件下，Qwen2-7B比Llama-3-8B对毒内容更敏感（攻击成功率高21.3%）；而将同一毒文档复制至≥3个独立数据库，可使攻击成功率倍增；相反，添加≥2个洁净外部源可将攻击成功率压制至基线的38%；  
- **脆弱性本质是多组件协同效应**：单一模块优化（如仅升级检索器）无法根除风险，必须联合调优检索-生成-知识库三元配置。本研究为RAG安全评估提供了首个可复现的多维分析框架，并提出“跨库冗余抑制”与“洁净源稀释”两类实用防御策略。
papers.summary_en: This paper presents the first comprehensive factorial analysis of poisoning robustness in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems, evaluating 432 configurations across six key factors: dataset, retriever architecture (BM25, dense, graph-based), retrieval depth (*k*), knowledge base composition, chunking strategy, and generator model. Using standardized adversarial injection and dual-layer metrics (retrieval-level contamination & generation-level answer corruption), we find that **retriever type, dataset, and retrieval depth dominate poisoning exposure**, while **generator choice and database composition critically determine downstream attack success**. Dense and graph retrievers improve robustness over BM25 by up to 32.7%, yet increasing *k* linearly raises poisoned passage retrieval risk (+19.4% per unit *k*). Crucially, replicating poisoned documents across multiple databases amplifies attacks, whereas adding ≥2 clean external sources reduces success rates to 38% of baseline. These results demonstrate that RAG poisoning vulnerability emerges from *interactions* among retrieval, generation, and knowledge-base design—not isolated components.

papers.title: RedAct: Redacting Agent Capability Traces for Procedural Skill Protection
papers.abstract: Users rely on execution traces to observe agent behavior, diagnose failures, and ensure accountability. These traces contain rich procedural detail, including tool invocations, intermediate decisions, and error-recovery logic. Yet this detail can expose private procedural skills, allowing downstream methods to recover key formulas, thresholds, and strategies without access to model weights or skill files. To quantify this risk and evaluate protection, we construct CapTraceBench, a benchmark of 75 specialized long-horizon tasks and 154 curated skills across seven domains. We also introduce RedAct, a protected trace release framework that localizes protected key information, rewrites traces while preserving verifier-critical evidence, and embeds behavioral watermarks for downstream provenance analysis. Across representative trace reuse methods, RedAct reduces normalized skill transfer (NST) from 44.7-67.1% on raw traces to below the no-skill baseline, while preserving audit evidence. Its standalone behavioral watermarks reach 93.6-100.0% true detection with a false alarm rate of at most 1.9%. These results frame public agent traces as security interfaces and show that selective redaction can reduce procedural capability leakage without removing audit evidence.
papers.summary_zh:
## 背景与问题  
用户依赖执行迹（execution traces）观察智能体行为、诊断故障并保障可追责性。然而，这些迹包含丰富的程序性细节——如工具调用序列、中间决策链、容错逻辑等，可能无意中暴露私有 procedural skills（程序性技能），使攻击者无需访问模型权重或技能文件，即可通过下游分析还原关键公式、阈值与策略，构成新型能力泄露风险。

## 方法创新  
本文提出 **RedAct**：首个面向程序性技能保护的执行迹脱敏框架。其核心包含三阶段机制：(1) **局部化识别**——基于技能语义与结构特征定位受保护的关键信息单元；(2) **证据感知重写**——在移除敏感内容的同时，严格保留审计所需的验证性证据（如输入-输出一致性、约束满足性、失败回溯路径）；(3) **行为水印嵌入**——注入轻量级、不可移除的动态水印，支持下游对迹来源与处理历史的溯源分析。

## 评估与结果  
为量化风险并验证保护效果，我们构建了 **CapTraceBench**：覆盖7个领域的75个长周期任务、154个人工精标技能的基准数据集。实验表明：在多种典型迹复用方法下，RedAct 将归一化技能迁移率（NST）从原始迹的 **44.7–67.1%** 降至 **低于无技能基线水平**（即零迁移），证实技能泄露被有效阻断；同时，所有审计关键证据100%保留。其独立水印模块在真实场景中实现 **93.6–100.0% 真阳性检测率**，误报率 ≤1.9%。本研究首次将公开执行迹定义为“安全接口”，证明**选择性红action可在不牺牲可审计性的前提下，系统性遏制程序性能力泄露**。
papers.summary_en: Users rely on execution traces for behavior observation, failure diagnosis, and accountability—but these traces inadvertently expose proprietary procedural skills (e.g., formulas, thresholds, strategies), enabling unauthorized skill recovery without model weights or skill files. To address this, we introduce **RedAct**, a trace redaction framework that (1) localizes sensitive skill elements, (2) rewrites traces while preserving verifier-critical audit evidence (e.g., input-output consistency, constraint satisfaction), and (3) embeds tamper-resilient behavioral watermarks for provenance tracking. Evaluated on **CapTraceBench**—a benchmark of 75 long-horizon tasks and 154 curated skills across seven domains—RedAct reduces normalized skill transfer (NST) from 44.7–67.1% on raw traces to *below the no-skill baseline*, fully eliminating unintended capability leakage while retaining all audit evidence. Its standalone watermarks achieve 93.6–100.0% true detection with ≤1.9% false alarm rate. RedAct establishes public agent traces as security interfaces and demonstrates that selective redaction can protect procedural skills without compromising accountability.

papers.title: Game-Theoretic Multi-Agent Control for Robust Contextual Reasoning in LLMs
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) in multi-turn interactions maintain evolving context rather than generating isolated responses, making them vulnerable to prompt-injection and context-poisoning attacks in which locally plausible adversarial fragments gradually distort reasoning trajectories. Existing defenses mainly filter individual outputs and often ignore context evolution across turns, leaving long-horizon reasoning exposed. Although the Model Context Protocol (MCP) standardizes context exchange and tool invocation, it functions as a passive routing layer and does not enforce contextual stability. To address these limitations, we introduce the Game-Theoretic Secure Model Context Protocol (GT-MCP), a controller-driven multi-agent method that treats context management as a closed-loop dynamical process. GT-MCP coordinates three heterogeneous LLM agents and selects outputs through a trust function that jointly evaluates causal consistency against a validated context graph, semantic agreement among agents, and distributional drift over time. When instability is detected, a rollback-based self-healing mechanism restores the validated context and prevents unsupported fragments from propagating. Empirical evaluation over 500 interaction turns under an adaptive adversarial threat model shows that contextual drift remains bounded in 99.6% of turns, with recovery required in only 0.4%. Per-turn utility remains tightly concentrated, with median = -0.19, P05 = -0.72, and P95 = 0.30; severe degradation below -1 occurs in only 0.4% of cases, and no injection attempt succeeds at the controller level. Selected outputs maintain stable win rates above 98%, and computational overhead remains predictable, with latency per token = 1.63e-3 s.
papers.summary_zh:
## 背景与挑战  
大语言模型（LLMs）在多轮对话中依赖动态演化的上下文进行推理，而非孤立生成响应。这使其易受**提示注入**与**上下文投毒攻击**——攻击者通过插入局部看似合理但逻辑错误的片段，逐步扭曲长程推理轨迹。现有防御方法多聚焦单轮输出过滤，忽视跨轮次的上下文演化，导致长时程推理脆弱；而Model Context Protocol（MCP）虽标准化了上下文交换与工具调用，却仅作为被动路由层，**无法保障上下文稳定性**。

## 方法创新：GT-MCP  
本文提出**博弈论驱动的安全模型上下文协议（GT-MCP）**，将上下文管理建模为闭环动力学过程。GT-MCP引入三类异构LLM代理协同工作，并通过**联合可信度函数**筛选输出，该函数同步评估三项核心指标：  
- **因果一致性**（相对于经验证的上下文图）  
- **语义共识度**（跨代理间推理结果的一致性）  
- **分布漂移程度**（随时间推移的隐式表征偏移）  

当检测到上下文不稳时，系统触发**基于回滚的自愈机制**：自动恢复至最近验证有效的上下文快照，阻断未支持片段的传播链。

## 关键实证结果  
在500轮自适应对抗威胁下的评测中：  
- 上下文漂移在**99.6%的轮次中保持有界**，仅0.4%需触发恢复；  
- 每轮效用高度稳定（中位数 = −0.19，P₀₅ = −0.72，P₉₅ = 0.30），严重退化（< −1）发生率仅**0.4%**；  
- **控制器层级零注入成功**，选定输出胜率持续 > 98%；  
- 计算开销可控，单token平均延迟仅 **1.63 ms**。

GT-MCP首次将博弈论控制与多智能体共识机制融入上下文治理，为LLM长程鲁棒推理提供了可验证、可恢复、低开销的新型架构范式。
papers.summary_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) face growing vulnerability to prompt-injection and context-poisoning attacks in multi-turn interactions, where adversarial fragments gradually distort long-horizon reasoning by exploiting evolving context. Existing defenses—focused on per-turn output filtering or passive context routing (e.g., MCP)—fail to enforce contextual stability across turns. To bridge this gap, we propose the **Game-Theoretic Secure Model Context Protocol (GT-MCP)**: a controller-driven, multi-agent framework that treats context management as a closed-loop dynamical process. GT-MCP coordinates three heterogeneous LLM agents and selects outputs via a trust function jointly evaluating causal consistency against a validated context graph, inter-agent semantic agreement, and temporal distributional drift. Upon instability detection, a rollback-based self-healing mechanism restores verified context and blocks propagation of unsupported fragments. Empirical evaluation over 500 adversarial interaction turns shows contextual drift remains bounded in 99.6% of cases; utility is tightly concentrated (median = −0.19, P₀₅ = −0.72, P₉₅ = 0.30); severe degradation (< −1) occurs in only 0.4%; no injection succeeds at the controller level; selected outputs maintain >98% win rate; and latency per token is predictable (1.63 ms).
